verses.tafsirV2: (And He it is Who maketh night a covering for you) which covers everything, (and sleep repose) for your bodies, (and maketh day a resurrection) a pursuit for your livelihood.

verses.text: وَهُوَ ٱلَّذِيٓ أَرۡسَلَ ٱلرِّيَٰحَ بُشۡرَۢا بَيۡنَ يَدَيۡ رَحۡمَتِهِۦۚ وَأَنزَلۡنَا مِنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ مَآءٗ طَهُورٗا
verses.translation: And it is He who sends the winds as good tidings before His mercy, and We send down from the sky pure water
verses.tafsir: And He it is Who sends forth the winds al-riyāha; a variant has al-rīha ‘the wind’ dispersing before His mercy nushuran ‘dispersing’ scattered before the coming of the rain a variant reading has nushran the singular of which is nashūr similar in pattern to rasūl ‘messenger’ plural rusul; another reading has nashran as a verbal noun; and a third variant has bushran in other words the winds function as mubashshirāt ‘bearers of good tidings’ the singular of which is bashīr; and We send down from the heaven purifying water
verses.tafsirV2: (And He it is Who sendeth the winds, glad tidings heralding His mercy) rain, (and We send down purifying water from the sky) water which purifies and cannot be purified.

verses.text: لِّنُحۡـِۧيَ بِهِۦ بَلۡدَةٗ مَّيۡتٗا وَنُسۡقِيَهُۥ مِمَّا خَلَقۡنَآ أَنۡعَٰمٗا وَأَنَاسِيَّ كَثِيرٗا
verses.translation: That We may bring to life thereby a dead land and give it as drink to those We created of numerous livestock and men
verses.tafsir: with which We revive a dead land read maytan in the softened form equally valid for the masculine and the feminine but in the masculine here because of the masculine noun indicating ‘place’ implicit therein and We give it the water as drink to the many cattle camels cows and sheep and humans We have created anāsiyy is the plural of insān properly it the plural should be anāsīn but the final nūn has been replaced with a yā’ with which the other yā’ has been assimilated; or it anāsiyy is simply the plural of insiyy.
verses.tafsirV2: (That We may give life thereby to a dead land) a land that has no vegetation, (and We give many beasts and men that We have created to drink thereof.

verses.text: وَلَقَدۡ صَرَّفۡنَٰهُ بَيۡنَهُمۡ لِيَذَّكَّرُواْ فَأَبَىٰٓ أَكۡثَرُ ٱلنَّاسِ إِلَّا كُفُورٗا
verses.translation: And We have certainly distributed it among them that they might be reminded, but most of the people refuse except disbelief
verses.tafsir: And verily We have distributed it the water among them so that they may remember li-yadhdhakkarū should actually be li-yatadhakkarū but the tā’ has been assimilated with the dhāl; a variant reading has li-yadhkurū that is to say so that they may remember therewith the grace of God. But most people are only intent on ingratitude on denial of the grace saying ‘We have received this rain because of such-and-such a storm’.
verses.tafsirV2: And verily We have repeated it) the rain (among them) year after year (that they may remember) that they may take heed, (but most of mankind begrudge aught save in gratitude) they refused and stayed firm in ingratitude towards Allah and His blessings.

verses.text: وَلَوۡ شِئۡنَا لَبَعَثۡنَا فِي كُلِّ قَرۡيَةٖ نَّذِيرٗا
verses.translation: And if We had willed, We could have sent into every city a warner
verses.tafsir: And had We willed We could have sent forth in every town a warner to threaten its inhabitants with God’s chastisement; instead We have sent you to the inhabitants of all towns as a warner for your reward to be a great one.
verses.tafsirV2: (If We willed, We could raise up) We could have sent (a warner) a warning messenger (in every village) to the people of every village. Instead, We have sent you to all mankind as a Messenger so that reward and honour will be all yours.

verses.text: فَلَا تُطِعِ ٱلۡكَٰفِرِينَ وَجَٰهِدۡهُم بِهِۦ جِهَادٗا كَبِيرٗا
verses.translation: So do not obey the disbelievers, and strive against them with the Qur'an a great striving
verses.tafsir: So do not obey the disbelievers in their desires but struggle against them therewith that is through adherence to the Qur’ān with a great endeavour.
verses.tafsirV2: (So obey not the disbelievers) Abu Jahl and his host regarding hat which they ask of you, (but strive against them herewith) by means of the Qur'an (with a great endeavour) by the sword.

verses.text: ۞وَهُوَ ٱلَّذِي مَرَجَ ٱلۡبَحۡرَيۡنِ هَٰذَا عَذۡبٞ فُرَاتٞ وَهَٰذَا مِلۡحٌ أُجَاجٞ وَجَعَلَ بَيۡنَهُمَا بَرۡزَخٗا وَحِجۡرٗا مَّحۡجُورٗا
verses.translation: And it is He who has released [simultaneously] the two seas, one fresh and sweet and one salty and bitter, and He placed between them a barrier and prohibiting partition
verses.tafsir: And He it is Who merged the two seas letting them flow one adjacent to the other this one palatable sweet and the other saltish bitter; and He set between the two an isthmus so that the one does not mix with the other and a forbidding ban a shield that prevents the two from becoming mixed.
verses.tafsirV2: (And He it is Who hath given independence to the two seas (though they meet); one palatable, sweet, and the other saltish, bitter; and hath set a bar) a barrier between the sweet and the salty (and a forbidding ban between them) preventing either one from transgressing against the other, such as to make the taste of either of them change.

verses.text: وَهُوَ ٱلَّذِي خَلَقَ مِنَ ٱلۡمَآءِ بَشَرٗا فَجَعَلَهُۥ نَسَبٗا وَصِهۡرٗاۗ وَكَانَ رَبُّكَ قَدِيرٗا
verses.translation: And it is He who has created from water a human being and made him [a relative by] lineage and marriage. And ever is your Lord competent [concerning creation]
verses.tafsir: And He it is Who created man from water He created from a sperm-drop a human being and made for him ties of blood and ties of marriage whether it be a male or a female they marry for the purposes of procreation. For your Lord is ever Powerful with the power to do whatever He will.
verses.tafsirV2: (And He it is Who hath created man from water) from the water of the male and female, (and hath appointed for him kindred by blood) who are unmarriageable (and kindred by marriage) who are marriageable, whether they are relatives or not; (for thy Lord is) in relation to the lawful and the unlawful which He created (ever Powerful.

verses.text: وَيَعۡبُدُونَ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ مَا لَا يَنفَعُهُمۡ وَلَا يَضُرُّهُمۡۗ وَكَانَ ٱلۡكَافِرُ عَلَىٰ رَبِّهِۦ ظَهِيرٗا
verses.translation: But they worship rather than Allah that which does not benefit them or harm them, and the disbeliever is ever, against his Lord, an assistant [to Satan]
verses.tafsir: And they the disbelievers worship besides God that which neither benefits them when they worship it nor harms them should they refrain therefrom — and these are idols; and the disbeliever is ever a partisan against his Lord an assistant to Satan through his obedience to him.
verses.tafsirV2: Yet they) the disbelievers of Mecca (worship instead of Allah that which can neither benefit them) in this world or in the next, if they worshipped and obeyed them (nor hurt them) in this world or in the next, if they were to disobey them and abstain from their worship. (The disbeliever) Abu Jahl (was ever a partisan) rebellious (against his Lord) it is also that this means: he is always a helper, through his disbelief, to the disbelievers against his Lord.

verses.text: وَمَآ أَرۡسَلۡنَٰكَ إِلَّا مُبَشِّرٗا وَنَذِيرٗا
verses.translation: And We have not sent you, [O Muhammad], except as a bringer of good tidings and a warner
verses.tafsir: And We have not sent you except as a bearer of good tidings of Paradise and as a warner a threatener of people with the chastisement of the Fire.
verses.tafsirV2: (And We have sent thee) O Muhammad to the people of Mecca (only as a bearer of good tidings) Paradise (and a warner) from the Fire.

verses.text: قُلۡ مَآ أَسۡـَٔلُكُمۡ عَلَيۡهِ مِنۡ أَجۡرٍ إِلَّا مَن شَآءَ أَن يَتَّخِذَ إِلَىٰ رَبِّهِۦ سَبِيلٗا
verses.translation: Say, "I do not ask of you for it any payment - only that whoever wills might take to his Lord a way
verses.tafsir: Say ‘I do not ask of you in return for this that is for delivering that Message with which I have been sent any reward except that whoever wishes to follow a way to his Lord should do so’ by expending his wealth for the sake of attaining God’s pleasure exalted be He; then whoever wishes to do so I will not prevent him from doing so.
verses.tafsirV2: (Say) O Muhammad to the people of Mecca: (I ask of you no reward) no payment or provision (for this) for professing Allah's divine Oneness and for the Qur'an, (save that whoso will may choose a way unto his Lord) through faith; it is also said that this means: save for the one who desires to profess Allah's divine Oneness and by means of this profession tread a way back to his Lord whereby he will find his reward.

verses.text: وَتَوَكَّلۡ عَلَى ٱلۡحَيِّ ٱلَّذِي لَا يَمُوتُ وَسَبِّحۡ بِحَمۡدِهِۦۚ وَكَفَىٰ بِهِۦ بِذُنُوبِ عِبَادِهِۦ خَبِيرًا
verses.translation: And rely upon the Ever-Living who does not die, and exalt [Allah] with His praise. And sufficient is He to be, with the sins of His servants, Acquainted
verses.tafsir: And put your trust in the Living One Who does not die and make glorifications ensconced in His praise in other words say subhāna’Llāhi wa’l-hamdu li’Llāh ‘Glory be to God and praise be to God’. And He suffices as One Aware as Knower of the sins of His servants khabīran ‘One Aware’ is semantically connected to bi-dhunūbi ‘of the sins’.
verses.tafsirV2: (And trust thou) O Muhammad (in the Living One Who dieth not) and do not trust in those living who die such as Abu Talib or Khadijah, nor trust yet in the dead who have no movement, (and hymn His praise) and pray by His command. (He sufficeth as the Knower of His bondmen's sins) He is aware of the sins of His bondmen,

verses.text: ٱلَّذِي خَلَقَ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضَ وَمَا بَيۡنَهُمَا فِي سِتَّةِ أَيَّامٖ ثُمَّ ٱسۡتَوَىٰ عَلَى ٱلۡعَرۡشِۖ ٱلرَّحۡمَٰنُ فَسۡـَٔلۡ بِهِۦ خَبِيرٗا
verses.translation: He who created the heavens and the earth and what is between them in six days and then established Himself above the Throne - the Most Merciful, so ask about Him one well informed
verses.tafsir: He it is Who created the heavens and the earth and all that is between them in six days of the length of the days of this world since there was no sun at that point — had He willed He could have created them in an instant but His not having done so is because He will to teach His creatures to be circumspect — then presided upon the Throne al-‘arsh in the classical language is the seat on which a king sits the Compassionate One al-rahmānu substitutes for the subject of the verb istawā ‘presided’ a presiding befitting of Him; so ask O man about Him about the Compassionate One anyone who is well aware to inform you about His attributes!
verses.tafsirV2: (Who created the heavens and the earth and all that is between them) of created beings and marvels (in six Days) of the beginning of creation, the length of each day was 1,000 years of the days that you count presently; the first day was Sunday and the last day Friday, (then He mounted the Throne. The Beneficent! Ask any one informed concerning Him) ask those who possess knowledge about Allah, and they will inform you!

verses.text: وَإِذَا قِيلَ لَهُمُ ٱسۡجُدُواْۤ لِلرَّحۡمَٰنِ قَالُواْ وَمَا ٱلرَّحۡمَٰنُ أَنَسۡجُدُ لِمَا تَأۡمُرُنَا وَزَادَهُمۡ نُفُورٗا۩
verses.translation: And when it is said to them, "Prostrate to the Most Merciful," they say, "And what is the Most Merciful? Should we prostrate to that which you order us?" And it increases them in aversion
verses.tafsir: And when it is said to them to the disbelievers of Mecca ‘Prostrate yourselves before the Compassionate One’ they say ‘And what is the Compassionate One? Should we prostrate ourselves to whatever you bid us’ ta’murunā; or read ya’murunā ‘whatever he bids us’ — in both cases the one bidding is Muhammad (s) — when we do not know who He is? No! And it this that is said to them increases their aversion to faith.
verses.tafsirV2: (And when it is said unto them) to the people of Mecca: (Adore the Beneficent) submit to the Beneficent through the profession of Allah's divine Oneness! (they say: And what is the Beneficent) we do not know anyone with this name except Musaylimah the liar? (Are we to adore whatever thou (Muhammad) biddest us) a manifest lie? (And it) i.e. the mention of the Beneficent; and it is said: the mention of the Qur'an; and it is said the call of the Prophet (pbuh) (increaseth aversion in them) from faith.

verses.text: تَبَارَكَ ٱلَّذِي جَعَلَ فِي ٱلسَّمَآءِ بُرُوجٗا وَجَعَلَ فِيهَا سِرَٰجٗا وَقَمَرٗا مُّنِيرٗا
verses.translation: Blessed is He who has placed in the sky great stars and placed therein a [burning] lamp and luminous moon
verses.tafsir: God exalted be He says Blessed magnified is He Who has placed in the heaven constellations twelve of them Aries Taurus Gemini Cancer Leo Virgo al-sunbula Libra Scorpio Sagittarius Capricorn Aquarius and Pisces. They are the mansions for the seven orbiting planets Mars rules Aries and Scorpio Venus Taurus and Libra Mercury Gemini and Virgo the Moon Cancer the Sun Leo Jupiter Sagittarius and Pisces and Saturn Capricorn and Aquarius; and has also placed in it a lamp namely the sun and a shining moon a variant reading for sirājan ‘sun’ has the plural surujan which would mean ‘luminous stars’. The moon is singled out for mention because of its particular merit.
verses.tafsirV2: (Blessed be He) He is the Possessor of grace He (Who hath placed in the heaven mansions of the stars) and it is said that this means: mansions, (and hath placed therein) in the heaven (a great lamp) the sun shining during the day for the children of Adam (and a moon giving light) to the Children of Adam during the night!

verses.text: وَهُوَ ٱلَّذِي جَعَلَ ٱلَّيۡلَ وَٱلنَّهَارَ خِلۡفَةٗ لِّمَنۡ أَرَادَ أَن يَذَّكَّرَ أَوۡ أَرَادَ شُكُورٗا
verses.translation: And it is He who has made the night and the day in succession for whoever desires to remember or desires gratitude
verses.tafsir: And He it is Who made the night and day to appear in succession that is one succeeding the other for him who desires to remember read yadhdhakkara or yadhkura as before Q. 2550 — so that if he misses the opportunity to do some good during the one he can do it during the other; or desires to be thankful for the graces of his Lord to him during both of these periods.
verses.tafsirV2: (And He it is Who hath appointed night and day in succession) to each other, (for him who desireth to remember) to take admonition in their succession, (or desireth thankfulness) or desires to do righteous works, whatever he left undone at night he does it during the day, and whatever he left undone during the day he does it at night.

verses.text: وَعِبَادُ ٱلرَّحۡمَٰنِ ٱلَّذِينَ يَمۡشُونَ عَلَى ٱلۡأَرۡضِ هَوۡنٗا وَإِذَا خَاطَبَهُمُ ٱلۡجَٰهِلُونَ قَالُواْ سَلَٰمٗا
verses.translation: And the servants of the Most Merciful are those who walk upon the earth easily, and when the ignorant address them [harshly], they say [words of] peace
verses.tafsir: And the true servants of the Compassionate One ‘ibādu’l-rahmāni is the subject and what comes after it all the way up to ūlā’ika yujzawna ‘they will be rewarded’ of verse 75 below are adjectival qualifiers of this subject with the exception of the parenthetical statements are those who walk upon the earth modestly that is peacefully and humbly and who when the ignorant address them with what they are averse to say words of peace salām in other words words by which they are safe yaslamūna from committing any sin;
verses.tafsirV2: (The (faithful) slaves of the Beneficent) the elite of the Beneficent (are they who walk upon the earth modestly) with humility from the fear of Allah, (and when the foolish ones) the disbelievers and sinners (address them answer: Peace) they answer with that which is good and say only nice words;

verses.text: وَٱلَّذِينَ يَبِيتُونَ لِرَبِّهِمۡ سُجَّدٗا وَقِيَٰمٗا
verses.translation: And those who spend [part of] the night to their Lord prostrating and standing [in prayer]
verses.tafsir: and who spend the night before their Lord prostrating sujjad is the plural of sājid and standing in worship in other words they spend the night performing prayers;
verses.tafsirV2: (And who spend the night before their Lord) praying, (prostrate and standing) in the night prayer,

verses.text: وَٱلَّذِينَ يَقُولُونَ رَبَّنَا ٱصۡرِفۡ عَنَّا عَذَابَ جَهَنَّمَۖ إِنَّ عَذَابَهَا كَانَ غَرَامًا
verses.translation: And those who say, "Our Lord, avert from us the punishment of Hell. Indeed, its punishment is ever adhering
verses.tafsir: and who say ‘Our Lord avert from us from the chastisement of Hell. Truly its chastisement is abiding that is irrevocable.
verses.tafsirV2: (And who say: Our Lord!) O our Lord! (Avert from us the doom of hell; lo! the doom thereof is anguish) binding and persistent;

verses.text: إِنَّهَا سَآءَتۡ مُسۡتَقَرّٗا وَمُقَامٗا
verses.translation: Indeed, it is evil as a settlement and residence
verses.tafsir: It is truly a wretched abode and residence!’ in other words it is truly wretched as a place in which to abide and reside.
verses.tafsirV2: (Lo! it is wretched as abode and station) dwelling;

verses.text: وَٱلَّذِينَ إِذَآ أَنفَقُواْ لَمۡ يُسۡرِفُواْ وَلَمۡ يَقۡتُرُواْ وَكَانَ بَيۡنَ ذَٰلِكَ قَوَامٗا
verses.translation: And [they are] those who, when they spend, do so not excessively or sparingly but are ever, between that, [justly] moderate
verses.tafsir: And who when they expend upon their dependants are neither prodigal nor parsimonious read yaqturū or yuqtirū; but between such prodigality and parsimony lies — between the two their expenditure is in — moderation;
verses.tafsirV2: Allah then mentioned their spending, saying: (And those who, when they spend, are neither prodigal) they are not prodigal with regard to transgression (nor grudging) they do not withhold that which is right; (and there is ever a firm station) a middle ground (between the two) between prodigality and being miserly;

verses.text: وَٱلَّذِينَ لَا يَدۡعُونَ مَعَ ٱللَّهِ إِلَٰهًا ءَاخَرَ وَلَا يَقۡتُلُونَ ٱلنَّفۡسَ ٱلَّتِي حَرَّمَ ٱللَّهُ إِلَّا بِٱلۡحَقِّ وَلَا يَزۡنُونَۚ وَمَن يَفۡعَلۡ ذَٰلِكَ يَلۡقَ أَثَامٗا
verses.translation: And those who do not invoke with Allah another deity or kill the soul which Allah has forbidden [to be killed], except by right, and do not commit unlawful sexual intercourse. And whoever should do that will meet a penalty
verses.tafsir: and those who do not call on another god along with God nor slay the soul which God has forbidden that it be slain except with due cause and who do not commit fornication — for whoever does that namely whoever does one of these three things shall meet with retribution;
verses.tafsirV2: (And those who cry not unto) worship not (any other god along with Allah) among the idols, (nor take the life which Allah hath forbidden) to kill nor declare it lawful to be killed (save in (course of) justice) through stoning, retaliation or apostasy, (nor commit adultery) nor deem adultery lawful (and whoso doeth this) i.e. deem it lawful (shall pay the penalty) a valley in the Fire; and it is said: a well in the Fire;

verses.text: يُضَٰعَفۡ لَهُ ٱلۡعَذَابُ يَوۡمَ ٱلۡقِيَٰمَةِ وَيَخۡلُدۡ فِيهِۦ مُهَانًا
verses.translation: Multiplied for him is the punishment on the Day of Resurrection, and he will abide therein humiliated
verses.tafsir: doubled yudā‘af a variant reading has yuda‘‘af will be the chastisement for him on the Day of Resurrection and he will abide therein both verbs may be read in the imperfect apocopated form yudā‘af ‘it will be doubled’ and yakhlud ‘he will abide’ as substitutions or with the indicative damma inflection yudā‘afu and yakhludu to indicate the beginning of a new sentence abased muhānan is a circumstantial qualifier;
verses.tafsirV2: (The doom will be doubled for him on the Day of Resurrection, and he will abide therein) in the doom (disdained) humiliated (for ever;

verses.text: إِلَّا مَن تَابَ وَءَامَنَ وَعَمِلَ عَمَلٗا صَٰلِحٗا فَأُوْلَـٰٓئِكَ يُبَدِّلُ ٱللَّهُ سَيِّـَٔاتِهِمۡ حَسَنَٰتٖۗ وَكَانَ ٱللَّهُ غَفُورٗا رَّحِيمٗا
verses.translation: Except for those who repent, believe and do righteous work. For them Allah will replace their evil deeds with good. And ever is Allah Forgiving and Merciful
verses.tafsir: except for him who repents and believes and acts righteously from among them for such God will replace their mentioned evil deeds with good deeds in the Hereafter for God is ever Forgiving Merciful that is He is ever possessed of such attributes;
verses.tafsirV2: Save him who repenteth) from his disbelief (and believeth) in Allah (and doth righteous work) sincerely after he accepts faith; (as for such, Allah will change their evil deeds to good deeds) Allah will change them from the state of disbelief to the state of faith, from disobedience to obedience, from the worship of idols to His worship, and from evil to goodness. (Allah is ever Forgiving) He forgives whoever repents, (Merciful) He shows mercy towards whoever dies in a state of repentance.

verses.text: وَمَن تَابَ وَعَمِلَ صَٰلِحٗا فَإِنَّهُۥ يَتُوبُ إِلَى ٱللَّهِ مَتَابٗا
verses.translation: And he who repents and does righteousness does indeed turn to Allah with [accepted] repentance
verses.tafsir: and whoever repents of his sins from among other than those mentioned and acts righteously indeed turns to God with due repentance that is he returns to God a sincere return and God will requite him with good;
verses.tafsirV2: (And whosoever repenteth) from sins (and does good) sincerely between him and his Lord, (he verily repenteth towards Allah with true repentance) he will find the reward of this with his Lord.

verses.text: وَٱلَّذِينَ لَا يَشۡهَدُونَ ٱلزُّورَ وَإِذَا مَرُّواْ بِٱللَّغۡوِ مَرُّواْ كِرَامٗا
verses.translation: And [they are] those who do not testify to falsehood, and when they pass near ill speech, they pass by with dignity
verses.tafsir: and those who do not give false testimony that is testimony containing mendacity and falsehood and when they come across senseless talk in the way of vile speech and otherwise they pass by with dignity shunning such vanity;
verses.tafsirV2: (And those who will not witness vanity) those who do not attend the sessions of false testimony, (but when they pass near senseless play) the assemblies of falsehood, (pass by with dignity) they avoid them out of clemency.

verses.text: وَٱلَّذِينَ إِذَا ذُكِّرُواْ بِـَٔايَٰتِ رَبِّهِمۡ لَمۡ يَخِرُّواْ عَلَيۡهَا صُمّٗا وَعُمۡيَانٗا
verses.translation: And those who, when reminded of the verses of their Lord, do not fall upon them deaf and blind
verses.tafsir: and those who when they are reminded when they are admonished of the revelations of their Lord that is reminded of the Qur’ān do not fall on them deaf and blind but fall on them listening contemplating benefiting and obedient;
verses.tafsirV2: (And those who, when they are reminded of) admonished about (the revelations of their Lord, fall not deaf) unable to hear (and blind) unable to see while being very capable of hearing and seeing (thereat) the signs of Allah.

verses.text: وَٱلَّذِينَ يَقُولُونَ رَبَّنَا هَبۡ لَنَا مِنۡ أَزۡوَٰجِنَا وَذُرِّيَّـٰتِنَا قُرَّةَ أَعۡيُنٖ وَٱجۡعَلۡنَا لِلۡمُتَّقِينَ إِمَامًا
verses.translation: And those who say, "Our Lord, grant us from among our wives and offspring comfort to our eyes and make us an example for the righteous
verses.tafsir: and those who say ‘Our Lord! Grant us in our spouses and our offspring read plural dhurriyyātinā or singular dhurriyyatinā a joyful sight for us so that we see them obedient to You and make us paragons of virtue for the God-fearing’.
verses.tafsirV2: (And who say: Our Lord!) O our Lord! (Vouchsafe us comfort of our wives and of our offspring) make our wives and offspring righteous so that we may find comfort in them, (and make us patterns for (all) those who ward off (evil)) make us righteous so that they emulate us.

verses.text: أُوْلَـٰٓئِكَ يُجۡزَوۡنَ ٱلۡغُرۡفَةَ بِمَا صَبَرُواْ وَيُلَقَّوۡنَ فِيهَا تَحِيَّةٗ وَسَلَٰمًا
verses.translation: Those will be awarded the Chamber for what they patiently endured, and they will be received therein with greetings and [words of] peace
verses.tafsir: Those they will be rewarded with the sublime abode the highest degree in Paradise forasmuch as they were steadfast in obedience to God and they will be met read yulaqqawna or yalqawna therein in this sublime abode with a greeting and words of peace from the angels;
verses.tafsirV2: (They) those who have such traits (will be awarded the high place) the highest ranks in Paradise (forasmuch as they were steadfast) in obedience of Allah and in bearing poverty and misfortune, (and they will meet therein) in Paradise (with welcome) from Allah (and the word of peace) the angels will meet them in Paradise with greeting and peace from Allah,

verses.text: خَٰلِدِينَ فِيهَاۚ حَسُنَتۡ مُسۡتَقَرّٗا وَمُقَامٗا
verses.translation: Abiding eternally therein. Good is the settlement and residence
verses.tafsir: abiding therein. Excellent is it as an abode and station as a place of residence for them ūlā’ika ‘those they …’ and what comes after it constitute the predicate to the subject ‘ibādu’l-rahmāni ‘the servants of the Compassionate One’.
verses.tafsirV2: (Abiding there for ever) they will remain in Paradise for ever, neither to die nor leave. (Happy is it as abode) as habitation (and station!) and dwelling!

verses.text: قُلۡ مَا يَعۡبَؤُاْ بِكُمۡ رَبِّي لَوۡلَا دُعَآؤُكُمۡۖ فَقَدۡ كَذَّبۡتُمۡ فَسَوۡفَ يَكُونُ لِزَامَۢا
verses.translation: Say, "What would my Lord care for you if not for your supplication?" For you [disbelievers] have denied, so your denial is going to be adherent
verses.tafsir: Say O Muhammad (s) to the people of Mecca ‘My Lord would not be concerned with you mā is for negation were it not for your supplications to Him when you are in adversity which He then removes. But why should He be concerned with you when you have denied the Messenger and the Qur’ān and so that the chastisement will remain binding’ permanently bound to you in the Hereafter in addition to what will befall you in this world; and so on the day of Badr seventy of them were slain the response to the conditional lawlā ‘were it not for …’ is indicated the preceding words.
verses.tafsirV2: (Say) O Muhammad, to the disbelievers of Mecca: (My Lord would not concern himself with you) what would my Lord do with your bodies and forms (but for your prayer) if He commands you to profess Allah's divine Oneness. (But now ye have denied) you have disbelieved in Muhammad (pbuh) and in the Qur'an, (therefore) this is a threat to them from Allah (there will be judgement) the punishment of the Day of Badr through beating, killing and enslaving them; this is to say: you have disbelieved in your Prophet and, therefore, the chastisement must necessarily befall you'.

verses.text: طسٓمٓ
verses.translation: Ta, Seen, Meem
verses.tafsir: Tā sīn mīm God knows best what He means by these letters.
verses.tafsirV2: And from his narration on the authority of Ibn 'Abbas that he said about the interpretation of Allah's saying (Ta. Sin. Mim.): '(Ta. Sin. Mim.) He says: Ta stands for His might (tawluh) and power, Sin stands for His majesty (sana'uh), and Mim stands for His dominion (mulkuh); it is also said that (Ta. Sin. Mim.) is an oath by which Allah swore.

verses.text: تِلۡكَ ءَايَٰتُ ٱلۡكِتَٰبِ ٱلۡمُبِينِ
verses.translation: These are the verses of the clear Book
verses.tafsir: Those namely these signs are the signs of the Manifest Book the Qur’ān the genitive annexation āyātu’l-kitābi conveys the partitive meaning of min the Manifest meaning the one that manifests what is truth from what is falsehood.
verses.tafsirV2: (These are revelations of the Scripture that maketh plain) He says: I swear by this surah, the verses of the Qur'an, which make plain the lawful and the unlawful, the commands and prohibitions.

verses.text: لَعَلَّكَ بَٰخِعٞ نَّفۡسَكَ أَلَّا يَكُونُواْ مُؤۡمِنِينَ
verses.translation: Perhaps, [O Muhammad], you would kill yourself with grief that they will not be believers
verses.tafsir: Perhaps O Muhammad (s) you might kill yourself out of distress for the reason that they namely the people of Mecca will not become believers la‘alla here expresses sympathy in other words what is meant is ‘have pity on it your self by alleviating the burden of this distress’.
verses.tafsirV2: (It may be that thou tormentest thyself) it may be that you kill yourself with grief over them (because they believe not) because the Quraysh do not want to become believers. This is because he was very keen for them to become believers.

verses.text: إِن نَّشَأۡ نُنَزِّلۡ عَلَيۡهِم مِّنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ ءَايَةٗ فَظَلَّتۡ أَعۡنَٰقُهُمۡ لَهَا خَٰضِعِينَ
verses.translation: If We willed, We could send down to them from the sky a sign for which their necks would remain humbled
verses.tafsir: If We will We will send down to them a sign from the heaven before which their necks will remain fa-zallat although grammatically in the past tense is being used in the sense of the imperfect tense bowed in humility and they will believe since ‘necks’ are described as ‘bowed in humility’ a status which in fact refers to those who possess them the adjectival form khādi‘ūn ‘bowed in humility’ used therein is the one normally used for rational beings.
verses.tafsirV2: (If We will, We can send down on them from the sky a portent) a sign (so that their necks would remain bowed before it) in humiliation.

verses.text: وَمَا يَأۡتِيهِم مِّن ذِكۡرٖ مِّنَ ٱلرَّحۡمَٰنِ مُحۡدَثٍ إِلَّا كَانُواْ عَنۡهُ مُعۡرِضِينَ
verses.translation: And no revelation comes to them anew from the Most Merciful except that they turn away from it
verses.tafsir: And there would never come to them from the Compassionate One any remembrance any revelation from the Qur’ān that is new muhdathin is an explicative adjective but that they used to disregard it.
verses.tafsirV2: (Never cometh there unto them a fresh) i.e. fresh in its coming, in succession (reminder) never did Gabriel bring revelation of the Qur'an to their Prophet (from the Beneficent One, but they turn away from it) except that they disbelieved in the Qur'an.

verses.text: فَقَدۡ كَذَّبُواْ فَسَيَأۡتِيهِمۡ أَنۢبَـٰٓؤُاْ مَا كَانُواْ بِهِۦ يَسۡتَهۡزِءُونَ
verses.translation: For they have already denied, but there will come to them the news of that which they used to ridicule
verses.tafsir: Verily then they have denied it; but soon there will come to them the news the consequences of that which they used to deride.
verses.tafsirV2: (Now they have denied) Muhammad (pbuh) and the Qur'an; (but there will come unto them tidings) the news (of that whereat they used to scoff) of chastisement; it is also said that this means: there will come to them the news of their derision of Muhammad (pbuh) and of the Qur'an.

verses.text: أَوَلَمۡ يَرَوۡاْ إِلَى ٱلۡأَرۡضِ كَمۡ أَنۢبَتۡنَا فِيهَا مِن كُلِّ زَوۡجٖ كَرِيمٍ
verses.translation: Did they not look at the earth - how much We have produced therein from every noble kind
verses.tafsir: Have they not contemplated observed the earth how many We have caused to grow therein in other words We have caused to grow therein many of every splendid kind of vegetation of every fair species.
verses.tafsirV2: (Have they) the disbelievers of Mecca (not seen the earth, how much of every fruitful kind We make to grow therein?)

verses.text: إِنَّ فِي ذَٰلِكَ لَأٓيَةٗۖ وَمَا كَانَ أَكۡثَرُهُم مُّؤۡمِنِينَ
verses.translation: Indeed in that is a sign, but most of them were not to be believers
verses.tafsir: Surely in that there is a sign an indication of the perfection of His power exalted be He; but most of them in God’s knowledge are not believers kāna here according to Sībawayhi is extra.
verses.tafsirV2: (Lo! Herein) in the different kinds of fruit (is indeed a portent) a sign and an admonition; (yet most of them are not believers) they were not believers, and all of them were disbelievers, i.e. those who perished at Badr.

verses.text: وَإِنَّ رَبَّكَ لَهُوَ ٱلۡعَزِيزُ ٱلرَّحِيمُ
verses.translation: And indeed, your Lord - He is the Exalted in Might, the Merciful
verses.tafsir: And surely your Lord He is the Mighty One Who will exact vengeance from the disbelievers the Merciful Who shows mercy to believers.
verses.tafsirV2: (And lo! thy Lord! He is indeed the Mighty) in retribution against the disbelievers, (the Merciful) towards the believers.

verses.text: وَإِذۡ نَادَىٰ رَبُّكَ مُوسَىٰٓ أَنِ ٱئۡتِ ٱلۡقَوۡمَ ٱلظَّـٰلِمِينَ
verses.translation: And [mention] when your Lord called Moses, [saying], "Go to the wrongdoing people
verses.tafsir: And mention O Muhammad (s) to your people when your Lord called to Moses on the night he saw the fire and the bush saying ‘Go to the wrongdoing folk as a messenger
verses.tafsirV2: (And when thy Lord called Moses) it is also said that this means: and when your Lord commanded Moses, (saying: Go unto the wrong-doing folk) the disbelieving folk,

verses.text: قَوۡمَ فِرۡعَوۡنَۚ أَلَا يَتَّقُونَ
verses.translation: The people of Pharaoh. Will they not fear Allah
verses.tafsir: Pharaoh’s folk to them as well as him — they wronged their souls by disbelieving in God and wronged the Children of Israel by enslaving them — Will they not a-lā the hamza indicates a negation meant as a rebuke show fear?’ of God by being obedient to Him and affirm His Oneness?
verses.tafsirV2: (The folk of Pharaoh. Will they not ward off (evil)) and tell: will they not ward off the worship of other than Allah?

verses.text: قَالَ رَبِّ إِنِّيٓ أَخَافُ أَن يُكَذِّبُونِ
verses.translation: He said, "My Lord, indeed I fear that they will deny me
verses.tafsir: He Moses said ‘My Lord I fear they will deny me
verses.tafsirV2: (He said) Moses said: (My Lord! Lo! I fear that they will deny me) I fear that they will disbelieve in the message I bring to them,

verses.text: وَيَضِيقُ صَدۡرِي وَلَا يَنطَلِقُ لِسَانِي فَأَرۡسِلۡ إِلَىٰ هَٰرُونَ
verses.translation: And that my breast will tighten and my tongue will not be fluent, so send for Aaron
verses.tafsir: and that anguish will constrain my breast because of their denial of me and that my tongue will not utter clearly to deliver the Message because of the knot in it. So give the Mission to my brother Aaron alongside me.
verses.tafsirV2: (And I shall be embarrassed) because of their denial; it is also said that this means: and my heart will shrink from delivering the message, (and my tongue will not speak plainly) out of awe of him, (therefore send for Aaron (to help me)) send Aaron with me to support me; it is also said that this means: send Gabriel to Aaron so that he helps me.

verses.text: وَلَهُمۡ عَلَيَّ ذَنۢبٞ فَأَخَافُ أَن يَقۡتُلُونِ
verses.translation: And they have upon me a [claim due to] sin, so I fear that they will kill me
verses.tafsir: And I have sinned against them by my slaying of the Egyptian man and I fear they will slay me’ for this.
verses.tafsirV2: (And they have a crime against me) they may retaliate against me because I killed the Copt, (so I fear that they will kill me) because of this Copt that I killed.

verses.text: قَالَ كَلَّاۖ فَٱذۡهَبَا بِـَٔايَٰتِنَآۖ إِنَّا مَعَكُم مُّسۡتَمِعُونَ
verses.translation: [Allah] said, "No. Go both of you with Our signs; indeed, We are with you, listening
verses.tafsir: Said He exalted be He ‘Certainly not! they shall not slay you. Go both of you you and your brother — this address although in the dual form is predominantly for the person present as opposed to the absent one — with Our signs. We will indeed be with you hearing what you say and what is said to you ma‘akum the two Moses and Aaron are referred to here with the plural pronoun.
verses.tafsirV2: (He said) Allah said: (Nay, verily) I will not set them against you to kill you. (So go ye twain with Our tokens) with Our nine signs: the hand, the staff, the flood, the locusts, the lice, the frogs, blood, the lack of foodstuff and drought. (Lo! We shall be with you) We shall help you, (Hearing) what he says to you.

verses.text: فَأۡتِيَا فِرۡعَوۡنَ فَقُولَآ إِنَّا رَسُولُ رَبِّ ٱلۡعَٰلَمِينَ
verses.translation: Go to Pharaoh and say, 'We are the messengers of the Lord of the worlds
verses.tafsir: So the two of you approach Pharaoh and say “Indeed We are — indeed each of the two of us is the Messenger of the Lord of the Worlds to you
verses.tafsirV2: (And come together unto Pharaoh and say: Lo! we bear a message of the Lord of the Worlds) to you and to your people,

verses.text: أَنۡ أَرۡسِلۡ مَعَنَا بَنِيٓ إِسۡرَـٰٓءِيلَ
verses.translation: [Commanded to say], "Send with us the Children of Israel
verses.tafsir: that you should let go forth with us to Syria the Children of Israel” ’. So they approached him and said to him that which has been mentioned.
verses.tafsirV2: ((Saying): Let the Children of Israel go with Us) and do not torture them.

verses.text: قَالَ أَلَمۡ نُرَبِّكَ فِينَا وَلِيدٗا وَلَبِثۡتَ فِينَا مِنۡ عُمُرِكَ سِنِينَ
verses.translation: [Pharaoh] said, "Did we not raise you among us as a child, and you remained among us for years of your life
verses.tafsir: He Pharaoh said to Moses ‘Did we not rear you among us in our homes as a child? as an infant only recently born but weaned and did you not stay with us for years of your life? for thirty years — he would dress from Pharaoh’s clothes and ride chariots of his and was referred to as Pharaoh’s son.
verses.tafsirV2: (He said): Pharaoh looked at Moses and said: (Did we not rear thee among us as a child?) O Moses (And thou didst dwell many years of your life among us) and stayed with us for 30 years,

verses.text: وَفَعَلۡتَ فَعۡلَتَكَ ٱلَّتِي فَعَلۡتَ وَأَنتَ مِنَ ٱلۡكَٰفِرِينَ
verses.translation: And [then] you did your deed which you did, and you were of the ungrateful
verses.tafsir: And you committed that deed of yours — namely his slaying of the Egyptian — being an ingrate’ a denier of my favours to you in having reared you among us and not enslaved you.
verses.tafsirV2: (And thou didst that thy deed which thou didst) and you killed the person that you killed, (and thou wast one of the ingrates) and you are now ungrateful for my kindness,

verses.text: قَالَ فَعَلۡتُهَآ إِذٗا وَأَنَا۠ مِنَ ٱلضَّآلِّينَ
verses.translation: [Moses] said, "I did it, then, while I was of those astray
verses.tafsir: He Moses said ‘I did that then when I was astray from the knowledge and the Message which God would later give me.
verses.tafsirV2: (He said) Moses said: (I did it then, when I was of those who are astray) when I was ungrateful for your kindness.

verses.text: فَفَرَرۡتُ مِنكُمۡ لَمَّا خِفۡتُكُمۡ فَوَهَبَ لِي رَبِّي حُكۡمٗا وَجَعَلَنِي مِنَ ٱلۡمُرۡسَلِينَ
verses.translation: So I fled from you when I feared you. Then my Lord granted me wisdom and prophethood and appointed me [as one] of the messengers
verses.tafsir: So I fled from you as I was afraid of you. Then my Lord gave me judgement knowledge and made me one of the messengers.
verses.tafsirV2: (Then I fled from you when I feared you) when I feared that you would kill me, (and my Lord vouchsafed me a command) understanding, knowledge and prophethood (and appointed me (of the number) of those sent (by Him)) He made me a Messenger to you and to your people.

verses.text: وَتِلۡكَ نِعۡمَةٞ تَمُنُّهَا عَلَيَّ أَنۡ عَبَّدتَّ بَنِيٓ إِسۡرَـٰٓءِيلَ
verses.translation: And is this a favor of which you remind me - that you have enslaved the Children of Israel
verses.tafsir: That is a favour with which you now reproach me that you have enslaved the Children of Israel’ an ‘abbadta banī Isrā’īl is explicative of tilka ‘that’ in other words you have enslaved them but not me there is no favour in that for your enslavement of them is wrong some scholars have reckoned there to be an interrogative hamza of denial at the beginning of this verse a-tilka ni‘matun ‘is that a favour?’.
verses.tafsirV2: (And this is the past favour wherewith) with which (thou reproachest me) O Pharaoh, but you do not recall your aloofness towards me: (that thou hast enslaved the Children of Israel.

verses.text: قَالَ فِرۡعَوۡنُ وَمَا رَبُّ ٱلۡعَٰلَمِينَ
verses.translation: Said Pharaoh, "And what is the Lord of the worlds
verses.tafsir: Pharaoh said to Moses ‘And what is “the Lord of the Worlds” ’ the One Whose Messenger you say you indeed are? In other words what exactly is He? And since there is no way for creation to know the true nature of God but only to know Him through an articulation of His attributes Moses blessings and peace be upon him responds to him with mention of some of these attributes
verses.tafsirV2: (Pharaoh said) to Moses: (And what is the Lord of the Worlds) who is the Lord of the Worlds? Is it me you are referring to?

verses.text: قَالَ رَبُّ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِ وَمَا بَيۡنَهُمَآۖ إِن كُنتُم مُّوقِنِينَ
verses.translation: [Moses] said, "The Lord of the heavens and earth and that between them, if you should be convinced
verses.tafsir: He said ‘The Lord of the heavens and the earth and all that is between them in other words the Creator of all that — should you have conviction’ that He exalted be He is their Creator then believe in Him alone.
verses.tafsirV2: ((Moses) said: Lord of the heavens and the earth) the Lord of the Worlds is the Lord of the heavens and the earth (and all that is between them) of created beings and marvels, (if ye had but sure belief) that Allah has created them.

verses.text: قَالَ لِمَنۡ حَوۡلَهُۥٓ أَلَا تَسۡتَمِعُونَ
verses.translation: [Pharaoh] said to those around him, "Do you not hear
verses.tafsir: He Pharaoh said to those noblemen among his folk who were around him ‘Did you not hear?!’ his response how it does not correspond to the question I asked?
verses.tafsirV2: ((Pharaoh) said unto those around him) of attendants: (Hear ye not) what Moses says? There were around Pharaoh at that time 250 men wearing attires made of silk brocade plaited with gold. These men were Pharaoh's closest courtiers, and they asked Moses: who is this Lord of the heavens and the earth to whom you are calling us?

verses.text: قَالَ رَبُّكُمۡ وَرَبُّ ءَابَآئِكُمُ ٱلۡأَوَّلِينَ
verses.translation: [Moses] said, "Your Lord and the Lord of your first forefathers
verses.tafsir: He Moses said ‘Your Lord and the Lord of your forefathers’. Now even though this fact is comprised by what was said before it enrages Pharaoh and therefore
verses.tafsirV2: (He said) Moses said: (Your Lord) He is your Lord (and the Lord of your fathers.

verses.text: قَالَ إِنَّ رَسُولَكُمُ ٱلَّذِيٓ أُرۡسِلَ إِلَيۡكُمۡ لَمَجۡنُونٞ
verses.translation: [Pharaoh] said, "Indeed, your 'messenger' who has been sent to you is mad
verses.tafsir: He said ‘Verily this messenger of yours sent to you is a madman!’
verses.tafsirV2: (Pharaoh) said: Lo! your messenger who hath been sent unto you is indeed a madman!) They said: who is this that you are calling us to? And who is this Lord of ours who is also the Lord of our fathers, O Moses?

verses.text: قَالَ رَبُّ ٱلۡمَشۡرِقِ وَٱلۡمَغۡرِبِ وَمَا بَيۡنَهُمَآۖ إِن كُنتُمۡ تَعۡقِلُونَ
verses.translation: [Moses] said, "Lord of the east and the west and that between them, if you were to reason
verses.tafsir: He Moses said ‘The Lord of the east and the west and all that is between them — should you comprehend’ that He is such a Lord then believe in Him alone.
verses.tafsirV2: (He said) Moses said: (Lord of the East) He is the Lord of the East (and the West) and the Lord of the West (and all that is between them, if ye did but understand) if you did but believe.

verses.text: قَالَ لَئِنِ ٱتَّخَذۡتَ إِلَٰهًا غَيۡرِي لَأَجۡعَلَنَّكَ مِنَ ٱلۡمَسۡجُونِينَ
verses.translation: [Pharaoh] said, "If you take a god other than me, I will surely place you among those imprisoned
verses.tafsir: He Pharaoh said to Moses ‘If you choose any god other than me I will surely make you a prisoner!’. His Pharaoh’s prison was very harsh for a person would be shut up in a dungeon underground alone where he could neither see nor hear anyone else.
verses.tafsirV2: ((Pharaoh) said: If thou choosest) if you worship (a god other than me) O Moses, (I assuredly shall place thee among the prisoners) his prisons were worse than death, for he used to put people in complete isolation, unable to see or hear anyone.

verses.text: قَالَ أَوَلَوۡ جِئۡتُكَ بِشَيۡءٖ مُّبِينٖ
verses.translation: [Moses] said, "Even if I brought you proof manifest
verses.tafsir: He Moses said to him ‘What would you do this even if I bring you something manifest?’ patent proof of my Mission?
verses.tafsirV2: (He said) Moses said: (Even though I show thee) O Pharaoh (something plain) a sign that serves as proof for what I say?

verses.text: قَالَ فَأۡتِ بِهِۦٓ إِن كُنتَ مِنَ ٱلصَّـٰدِقِينَ
verses.translation: [Pharaoh] said, "Then bring it, if you should be of the truthful
verses.tafsir: He Pharaoh said to him ‘Then bring it if you are truthful’ in this.
verses.tafsirV2: ((Pharaoh) said: Produce it then) O Moses, (if thou art of the Truthful) that you are a Messenger to me and to my people!

verses.text: فَأَلۡقَىٰ عَصَاهُ فَإِذَا هِيَ ثُعۡبَانٞ مُّبِينٞ
verses.translation: So [Moses] threw his staff, and suddenly it was a serpent manifest
verses.tafsir: So he threw down his staff and lo! it was a manifest serpent a great snake.
verses.tafsirV2: (Then he) Moses (flung down his staff and it became a serpent) a yellow, male serpent (manifest) as huge as any serpent can be,

verses.text: وَنَزَعَ يَدَهُۥ فَإِذَا هِيَ بَيۡضَآءُ لِلنَّـٰظِرِينَ
verses.translation: And he drew out his hand; thereupon it was white for the observers
verses.tafsir: Then he drew out his hand he brought it out of his pocket and lo! it was white glowing before the onlookers and not its usual skin colour.
verses.tafsirV2: Pharaoh then said: “this is a manifest sign, do you have any other signs?” (And he drew forth his hand) from his armpit (and lo! it was white to the beholders) his hand had a light like the light of the sun, and whoever looked at it liked it.

verses.text: قَالَ لِلۡمَلَإِ حَوۡلَهُۥٓ إِنَّ هَٰذَا لَسَٰحِرٌ عَلِيمٞ
verses.translation: [Pharaoh] said to the eminent ones around him, "Indeed, this is a learned magician
verses.tafsir: He Pharaoh said to the council around him ‘Surely this man is a cunning sorcerer an expert in the art of magic
verses.tafsirV2: ((Pharaoh) said unto the chiefs about him: Lo, this) messenger (is verily a knowing wizard) who is very skilful in magic,

verses.text: يُرِيدُ أَن يُخۡرِجَكُم مِّنۡ أَرۡضِكُم بِسِحۡرِهِۦ فَمَاذَا تَأۡمُرُونَ
verses.translation: He wants to drive you out of your land by his magic, so what do you advise
verses.tafsir: who seeks to expel you from your land by his sorcery. So what do you advise?’
verses.tafsirV2: (Who would drive you out of your land) Egypt (by his magic. Now what counsel ye) what do you suggest that I should do?

verses.text: قَالُوٓاْ أَرۡجِهۡ وَأَخَاهُ وَٱبۡعَثۡ فِي ٱلۡمَدَآئِنِ حَٰشِرِينَ
verses.translation: They said, "Postpone [the matter of] him and his brother and send among the cities gatherers
verses.tafsir: They said ‘Put him and his brother off for a while postpone judgement of their affair and send musterers into the cities
verses.tafsirV2: (They said: Put him off) retain him, ((him) and his brother) and do not kill them, (and send them) i.e. the police (into the cities) the cities where the wizards are found (summoners) to summon these wizards,

verses.text: يَأۡتُوكَ بِكُلِّ سَحَّارٍ عَلِيمٖ
verses.translation: Who will bring you every learned, skilled magician
verses.tafsir: to bring you every cunning sorcerer’ to surpass Moses in the art of magic.
verses.tafsirV2: (Who shall bring unto thee every knowing wizard) who is skilful in magic so that they can do what Moses did.

verses.text: فَجُمِعَ ٱلسَّحَرَةُ لِمِيقَٰتِ يَوۡمٖ مَّعۡلُومٖ
verses.translation: So the magicians were assembled for the appointment of a well-known day
verses.tafsir: So the sorcerers were assembled at a fixed time of a known day which was the morning of the Festival Day.
verses.tafsirV2: (So the wizards were gathered together) there were 72 of them (at a set time on a day appointed) which was the day of the market, and it also said that it was the day of their festival, and it is also said that it was the day of their new year.

verses.text: وَقِيلَ لِلنَّاسِ هَلۡ أَنتُم مُّجۡتَمِعُونَ
verses.translation: And it was said to the people, "Will you congregate
verses.tafsir: And it was said to the people ‘Will you assemble!’
verses.tafsirV2: (And it was said unto the people: Are ye (also) gathering?

verses.text: لَعَلَّنَا نَتَّبِعُ ٱلسَّحَرَةَ إِن كَانُواْ هُمُ ٱلۡغَٰلِبِينَ
verses.translation: That we might follow the magicians if they are the predominant
verses.tafsir: Maybe we will follow the sorcerers should they be the victors’ the interrogative of the previous verse is an incitement to assemble and the optative sense implicit in la‘alla is due to their anticipation of victory and hence their continued adherence to their religion and rejection of Moses.
verses.tafsirV2: (They said): Aye, so that we may follow the wizards) that we may follow the religion of the wizards (if they are the winners) against Moses.

verses.text: فَلَمَّا جَآءَ ٱلسَّحَرَةُ قَالُواْ لِفِرۡعَوۡنَ أَئِنَّ لَنَا لَأَجۡرًا إِن كُنَّا نَحۡنُ ٱلۡغَٰلِبِينَ
verses.translation: And when the magicians arrived, they said to Pharaoh, "Is there indeed for us a reward if we are the predominant
verses.tafsir: So when the sorcerers came they said to Pharaoh ‘Shall we indeed read a-inna either by pronouncing both hamzas or by not pronouncing the second but in both cases inserting an alif have a reward if we were to be the victors?’
verses.tafsirV2: (And when the wizards came they said unto Pharaoh: Will there surely be a reward for us if we are the winners) against Moses?

verses.text: قَالَ نَعَمۡ وَإِنَّكُمۡ إِذٗا لَّمِنَ ٱلۡمُقَرَّبِينَ
verses.translation: He said, "Yes, and indeed, you will then be of those near [to me]
verses.tafsir: He said ‘Yes of course! And you shall then be among those closest to me’.
verses.tafsirV2: (He said) Pharaoh said: (Aye) you will have that, (and ye will then surely be of those brought near) in terms of status, position and attending my assembly.

verses.text: قَالَ لَهُم مُّوسَىٰٓ أَلۡقُواْ مَآ أَنتُم مُّلۡقُونَ
verses.translation: Moses said to them, "Throw whatever you will throw
verses.tafsir: Moses said to them after they had said to him Either you cast or we shall be the casters Q. 7115 ‘Cast what you have to cast’ — the command to do this signifies an authorisation for them to cast and a means whereby the truth will be made to prevail.
verses.tafsirV2: (Moses said unto them) he said to the wizards: (Throw what ye are going to throw!

verses.text: فَأَلۡقَوۡاْ حِبَالَهُمۡ وَعِصِيَّهُمۡ وَقَالُواْ بِعِزَّةِ فِرۡعَوۡنَ إِنَّا لَنَحۡنُ ٱلۡغَٰلِبُونَ
verses.translation: So they threw their ropes and their staffs and said, "By the might of Pharaoh, indeed it is we who are predominant
verses.tafsir: So they cast their ropes and their staffs and said ‘By the power of Pharaoh we shall surely be the victors!’
verses.tafsirV2: Then they threw down their cords and their staves) 72 ropes and 72 staffs (and said) i.e. the wizards said: (By Pharaoh's might, lo! we verily are the winners) against Moses.

verses.text: فَأَلۡقَىٰ مُوسَىٰ عَصَاهُ فَإِذَا هِيَ تَلۡقَفُ مَا يَأۡفِكُونَ
verses.translation: Then Moses threw his staff, and at once it devoured what they falsified
verses.tafsir: Thereat Moses cast his staff and lo! it was swallowing talqafu one of the original two tā’ letters of taltaqifu has been assimilated what they had faked what they had transformed through illusion making their ropes and staffs appear to be moving serpents.
verses.tafsirV2: (Then Moses threw his staff and lo! it swallowed that which they did falsely show) of wizardry.

verses.text: فَأُلۡقِيَ ٱلسَّحَرَةُ سَٰجِدِينَ
verses.translation: So the magicians fell down in prostration [to Allah]
verses.tafsir: So the sorcerers fell down prostrating.
verses.tafsirV2: (And the wizards were flung prostrate) they fell prostrate so fast that it looked that they were thrown to the floor, because when they saw their ropes and staffs disappear, they knew that what Moses brought was from Allah,

verses.text: قَالُوٓاْ ءَامَنَّا بِرَبِّ ٱلۡعَٰلَمِينَ
verses.translation: They said, "We have believed in the Lord of the worlds
verses.tafsir: They said ‘We believe in the Lord of the Worlds
verses.tafsirV2: (Crying: We believe in the Lord of the Worlds) upon which Pharaoh said: are you referring to me?

verses.text: رَبِّ مُوسَىٰ وَهَٰرُونَ
verses.translation: The Lord of Moses and Aaron
verses.tafsir: the Lord of Moses and Aaron’ for they realised that what they had witnessed in the case of the staff could not have been the result of mere sorcery.
verses.tafsirV2: They said: (The Lord of Moses and Aaron.

verses.text: قَالَ ءَامَنتُمۡ لَهُۥ قَبۡلَ أَنۡ ءَاذَنَ لَكُمۡۖ إِنَّهُۥ لَكَبِيرُكُمُ ٱلَّذِي عَلَّمَكُمُ ٱلسِّحۡرَ فَلَسَوۡفَ تَعۡلَمُونَۚ لَأُقَطِّعَنَّ أَيۡدِيَكُمۡ وَأَرۡجُلَكُم مِّنۡ خِلَٰفٖ وَلَأُصَلِّبَنَّكُمۡ أَجۡمَعِينَ
verses.translation: [Pharaoh] said, "You believed Moses before I gave you permission. Indeed, he is your leader who has taught you magic, but you are going to know. I will surely cut off your hands and your feet on opposite sides, and I will surely crucify you all
verses.tafsir: Pharaoh said ‘Do you believe a-āmantum read pronouncing both hamzas or replacing the second one with an alif him Moses though I have not given you leave? He is indeed your chief the one who has taught you sorcery — so that he only taught you some tricks and then surpassed you with others. Soon you will know what I will do with you! I will assuredly cut off your hands and legs on opposite sides — in other words the right hand of each one together with his left leg — then I shall surely crucify you all.’
verses.tafsirV2: (Pharaoh) said, You put your faith in him) you believed in him (before I give you leave) I commanded you to do so. (Lo! He) i.e. Moses (doubtless is your chief) your master wizard (who taught you magic! But verily ye shall come to know) what I will do to you. (Verily I will cut off your hands and your feet alternately) the right hand with the left leg, (and verily I will crucify you everyone) on the bank of the river of Egypt.

verses.text: قَالُواْ لَا ضَيۡرَۖ إِنَّآ إِلَىٰ رَبِّنَا مُنقَلِبُونَ
verses.translation: They said, "No harm. Indeed, to our Lord we will return
verses.tafsir: They said ‘There is no harm in that no damage will be done to us thereby. Surely to our Lord after we die whichever way that may be we shall return in the Hereafter.
verses.tafsirV2: (They said: It is no hurt) what you do with us in this worldly life will not harm us in the Hereafter, (for lo! unto our Lord we shall return) we shall return to Allah and His reward.

verses.text: إِنَّا نَطۡمَعُ أَن يَغۡفِرَ لَنَا رَبُّنَا خَطَٰيَٰنَآ أَن كُنَّآ أَوَّلَ ٱلۡمُؤۡمِنِينَ
verses.translation: Indeed, we aspire that our Lord will forgive us our sins because we were the first of the believers
verses.tafsir: Indeed We hope our Lord will forgive us our iniquities for being the first to believe’ in our time.
verses.tafsirV2: (Lo! we ardently hope that our Lord will forgive us our sins) our idolatry (because we are the first of the believers) in Moses.

verses.text: ۞وَأَوۡحَيۡنَآ إِلَىٰ مُوسَىٰٓ أَنۡ أَسۡرِ بِعِبَادِيٓ إِنَّكُم مُّتَّبَعُونَ
verses.translation: And We inspired to Moses, "Travel by night with My servants; indeed, you will be pursued
verses.tafsir: And We revealed to Moses after many years which he spent among them calling them to the truth with God’s signs but all of which only increased them in insolence saying ‘Journey with My servants the Children of Israel by night a variant reading for an asri is an isr from the verb sarā one form of asrā go with them by night in the direction of the sea for indeed you will be pursued’. Pharaoh and his armies will pursue you but when they enter the sea in pursuit of you I will deliver you and drown them.
verses.tafsirV2: (And We inspired Moses, saying: Take away My slaves by night) take by night whoever believes in you from among the Children of Israel, (for ye will be pursued) Pharaoh and his people will catch up with you.

verses.text: فَأَرۡسَلَ فِرۡعَوۡنُ فِي ٱلۡمَدَآئِنِ حَٰشِرِينَ
verses.translation: Then Pharaoh sent among the cities gatherers
verses.tafsir: Then Pharaoh having been informed of their night departure sent to the cities — it is said that he ruled a thousand cities and twelve thousand villages — musterers to assemble the army saying
verses.tafsirV2: (Then Pharaoh sent into the cities summoners) he summoned his police force,

verses.text: إِنَّ هَـٰٓؤُلَآءِ لَشِرۡذِمَةٞ قَلِيلُونَ
verses.translation: [And said], "Indeed, those are but a small band
verses.tafsir: ‘Lo! these are but a small gang. It is said that they the Children of Israel numbered 670000 while his Pharaoh’s vanguard alone numbered 700000 and so he deemed their number insignificant in comparison to his huge army.
verses.tafsirV2: ((Who said): Lo! These) the followers of Moses (indeed are but a little troop) a small group,

verses.text: وَإِنَّهُمۡ لَنَا لَغَآئِظُونَ
verses.translation: And indeed, they are enraging us
verses.tafsir: And indeed they have enraged us their actions infuriate us
verses.tafsirV2: (And lo! they are offenders against us) they have caused our fury and anger.

verses.text: وَإِنَّا لَجَمِيعٌ حَٰذِرُونَ
verses.translation: And indeed, we are a cautious society
verses.tafsir: and indeed we are all on our guard’ ready a variant reading for hadhirūna has hādhirūn meaning ‘alert’.
verses.tafsirV2: (And lo! we are a ready host) we are in doubt, and we will supply weapons.

verses.text: فَأَخۡرَجۡنَٰهُم مِّن جَنَّـٰتٖ وَعُيُونٖ
verses.translation: So We removed them from gardens and springs
verses.tafsir: God exalted be He says So We made them Pharaoh and his folk go forth out of Egypt in order to pursue Moses and his people from gardens orchards on either side of the Nile and springs streams running from the Nile through their dwellings
verses.tafsirV2: (Thus did We take them away from gardens and water springs) pure water,

verses.text: وَكُنُوزٖ وَمَقَامٖ كَرِيمٖ
verses.translation: And treasures and honorable station
verses.tafsir: and treasures visible riches of gold and silver — these riches are called kunūz as opposed to amwāl ‘riches’ because that portion which is always due to God exalted be He from them had not been paid — and splendid places exquisite residences for princes and ministers surrounded by their retinues.
verses.tafsirV2: (And treasures) wealth (and a fair estate) beautiful houses.

verses.text: كَذَٰلِكَۖ وَأَوۡرَثۡنَٰهَا بَنِيٓ إِسۡرَـٰٓءِيلَ
verses.translation: Thus. And We caused to inherit it the Children of Israel
verses.tafsir: So it was that is Our expulsion of them was as We have described and We made the Children of Israel to inherit these after drowning Pharaoh and his folk.
verses.tafsirV2: (Thus) I do with the ones who disobey Me, (and We caused the Children of Israel to inherit them) to inherit Egypt after their destruction.

verses.text: فَأَتۡبَعُوهُم مُّشۡرِقِينَ
verses.translation: So they pursued them at sunrise
verses.tafsir: Then they pursued them they caught them up at sunrise.
verses.tafsirV2: (And they overtook them at sunrise.

verses.text: فَلَمَّا تَرَـٰٓءَا ٱلۡجَمۡعَانِ قَالَ أَصۡحَٰبُ مُوسَىٰٓ إِنَّا لَمُدۡرَكُونَ
verses.translation: And when the two companies saw one another, the companions of Moses said, "Indeed, we are to be overtaken
verses.tafsir: And when the two hosts sighted each other the companions of Moses said ‘We have been caught!’ Pharaoh’s hosts have caught us up and we have no power against them.
verses.tafsirV2: (And when the two hosts) the group of Moses and that of Pharaoh (saw each other, those with Moses said: Lo! we are indeed caught) O Moses, they have caught up with us.

verses.text: قَالَ كَلَّآۖ إِنَّ مَعِيَ رَبِّي سَيَهۡدِينِ
verses.translation: [Moses] said, "No! Indeed, with me is my Lord; He will guide me
verses.tafsir: He Moses said ‘Certainly not! they shall not catch us up; indeed I have my Lord with me to provide assistance. He will guide me’ to the route of deliverance.
verses.tafsirV2: (He said) Moses said: (Nay) they have not, (verily! for lo! my Lord is with me. He will guide me) He will save me from them and guide me to the right way.

verses.text: فَأَوۡحَيۡنَآ إِلَىٰ مُوسَىٰٓ أَنِ ٱضۡرِب بِّعَصَاكَ ٱلۡبَحۡرَۖ فَٱنفَلَقَ فَكَانَ كُلُّ فِرۡقٖ كَٱلطَّوۡدِ ٱلۡعَظِيمِ
verses.translation: Then We inspired to Moses, "Strike with your staff the sea," and it parted, and each portion was like a great towering mountain
verses.tafsir: God exalted be He says Thereupon We revealed to Moses ‘Strike the sea with your staff’ and he struck it whereupon it parted it split into twelve parts and each part was as a mighty mountain between each of these parts were paths which they followed such that not even the saddles or the felts of the riders were touched by water.
verses.tafsirV2: (Then We inspired Moses, saying: Smite the sea with thy staff. And) when he hit it (it parted) into 12 roads, (and each part) and each road (was as a mountain vast) like a huge mountain.

verses.text: وَأَزۡلَفۡنَا ثَمَّ ٱلۡأٓخَرِينَ
verses.translation: And We advanced thereto the pursuers
verses.tafsir: And there We brought near the others Pharaoh and his folk until they followed them across the same paths.
verses.tafsirV2: (Then brought We near the others to that place) then We kept Pharaoh and his people in the cloud, and it is said in the sea, and all of them were disbelievers.

verses.text: وَأَنجَيۡنَا مُوسَىٰ وَمَن مَّعَهُۥٓ أَجۡمَعِينَ
verses.translation: And We saved Moses and those with him, all together
verses.tafsir: And We delivered Moses and all those who were with him by bringing them out of the sea while it was in the state mentioned above.
verses.tafsirV2: (And We saved Moses and those with him, every one) from drowning;

verses.text: ثُمَّ أَغۡرَقۡنَا ٱلۡأٓخَرِينَ
verses.translation: Then We drowned the others
verses.tafsir: Then We drowned the others Pharaoh and his folk by closing the sea on them after they had entered the sea and the Children of Israel had exited therefrom.
verses.tafsirV2: (We drowned the others) Pharaoh and his host in the sea.

verses.text: إِنَّ فِي ذَٰلِكَ لَأٓيَةٗۖ وَمَا كَانَ أَكۡثَرُهُم مُّؤۡمِنِينَ
verses.translation: Indeed in that is a sign, but most of them were not to be believers
verses.tafsir: Surely in that drowning of Pharaoh and his folk there is a sign a lesson for those generations who would come after them; but most of them are not believers in God. The only ones to believe were Āsiya — Pharaoh’s wife — Hizqīl the believing man of Pharaoh’s family and Maryam daughter of Nāmūsī she who pointed out the bone remains of the prophet Joseph peace be upon him.
verses.tafsirV2: (Lo! Herein) in that which We did to them (is indeed a portent) a sign and an admonition, (yet most of them are not believers) most of them were not believers.

verses.text: وَإِنَّ رَبَّكَ لَهُوَ ٱلۡعَزِيزُ ٱلرَّحِيمُ
verses.translation: And indeed, your Lord - He is the Exalted in Might, the Merciful
verses.tafsir: And surely your Lord He is the Mighty for He wrought vengeance upon the disbelievers by drowning them the Merciful to believers delivering them from drowning.
verses.tafsirV2: (And lo, thy Lord! He is indeed the Mighty) in retribution against the disbelievers, (the Merciful) towards the believers, since He saved them from drowning.

verses.text: وَٱتۡلُ عَلَيۡهِمۡ نَبَأَ إِبۡرَٰهِيمَ
verses.translation: And recite to them the news of Abraham
verses.tafsir: And recite to them the disbelievers of Mecca the tiding the tale of Abraham Ibrāhīma is substituted by the following idh qāla ‘when he said’
verses.tafsirV2: (Recite unto them) unto Quraysh, your people (the story of Abraham) the event of Abraham in the Qur'an:

verses.text: إِذۡ قَالَ لِأَبِيهِ وَقَوۡمِهِۦ مَا تَعۡبُدُونَ
verses.translation: When he said to his father and his people, "What do you worship
verses.tafsir: when he said to his father and his people ‘What do you worship?’
verses.tafsirV2: (When he said unto his father) Azar (and his folk) the idol worshippers: (What worship ye) Abraham said to them: what do you worship?

verses.text: قَالُواْ نَعۡبُدُ أَصۡنَامٗا فَنَظَلُّ لَهَا عَٰكِفِينَ
verses.translation: They said, "We worship idols and remain to them devoted
verses.tafsir: They said ‘We worship idols — they reiterate the verb in the response in order to supplement it with the following remark — and remain cleaving to them’ we remain worshipping them all day; they give a longer response to indicate their misplaced pride in such an act.
verses.tafsirV2: (They said: We worship idols) deities, (and are ever devoted unto them) we worship them and remain devoted to their worship.

verses.text: قَالَ هَلۡ يَسۡمَعُونَكُمۡ إِذۡ تَدۡعُونَ
verses.translation: He said, "Do they hear you when you supplicate
verses.tafsir: He said ‘Do they hear you when you supplicate?
verses.tafsirV2: (He said) Abraham said to them: (Do they hear you when ye cry) do these deities answer you when you call upon them?

verses.text: أَوۡ يَنفَعُونَكُمۡ أَوۡ يَضُرُّونَ
verses.translation: Or do they benefit you, or do they harm
verses.tafsir: Or do they bring you benefit when you worship them or harm? to you if you do not?
verses.tafsirV2: (Or do they benefit) you in your livelihood when you obey them (or harm you) in your livelihood when you disobey them?

verses.text: قَالُواْ بَلۡ وَجَدۡنَآ ءَابَآءَنَا كَذَٰلِكَ يَفۡعَلُونَ
verses.translation: They said, "But we found our fathers doing thus
verses.tafsir: They said ‘Rather we found our fathers so doing’ that is doing the same as we do.
verses.tafsirV2: (They said: Nay, but we found our fathers acting on this use) we found our fathers worshipping these deities, and we have emulated them.

verses.text: قَالَ أَفَرَءَيۡتُم مَّا كُنتُمۡ تَعۡبُدُونَ
verses.translation: He said, "Then do you see what you have been worshipping
verses.tafsir: He said ‘Have you considered what you have been worshipping
verses.tafsirV2: (He said) Abraham said: (See now that which ye worship,

verses.text: أَنتُمۡ وَءَابَآؤُكُمُ ٱلۡأَقۡدَمُونَ
verses.translation: You and your ancient forefathers
verses.tafsir: you and your ancestors?
verses.tafsirV2: Ye and your forefathers!) before you,

verses.text: فَإِنَّهُمۡ عَدُوّٞ لِّيٓ إِلَّا رَبَّ ٱلۡعَٰلَمِينَ
verses.translation: Indeed, they are enemies to me, except the Lord of the worlds
verses.tafsir: They are indeed hateful to me I do not worship them; but the Lord of the Worlds I do worship Him
verses.tafsirV2: Lo! they are (all) an enemy unto me) and I disassociate myself from them, (save the Lord of the Worlds) except the worship of the Lord of the Worlds.

verses.text: ٱلَّذِي خَلَقَنِي فَهُوَ يَهۡدِينِ
verses.translation: Who created me, and He [it is who] guides me
verses.tafsir: He Who created me it is He Who guides me to the proper religion
verses.tafsirV2: (Who created me) from a sperm drop, (and He doth guide me) He preserves me on the right religion and guides me to the Truth and guidance,

verses.text: وَٱلَّذِي هُوَ يُطۡعِمُنِي وَيَسۡقِينِ
verses.translation: And it is He who feeds me and gives me drink
verses.tafsir: and provides me with food and drink
verses.tafsirV2: (And Who feedeth me) He provides for me and gives me my full when I am hungry (and watereth me) and gives me to drink when I am thirsty.

verses.text: وَإِذَا مَرِضۡتُ فَهُوَ يَشۡفِينِ
verses.translation: And when I am ill, it is He who cures me
verses.tafsir: and when I am sick it is He Who cures me;
verses.tafsirV2: (And when I sicken, then He healeth me) He cures me from sickness when I am sick,

verses.text: وَٱلَّذِي يُمِيتُنِي ثُمَّ يُحۡيِينِ
verses.translation: And who will cause me to die and then bring me to life
verses.tafsir: and Who will make me die then give me life
verses.tafsirV2: (And Who causeth me to die) in this worldly life, (then giveth me life (again)) on the Day of Judgement,

verses.text: وَٱلَّذِيٓ أَطۡمَعُ أَن يَغۡفِرَ لِي خَطِيٓـَٔتِي يَوۡمَ ٱلدِّينِ
verses.translation: And who I aspire that He will forgive me my sin on the Day of Recompense
verses.tafsir: and Who I hope will forgive me my iniquity on the Day of Judgement the Day of Requital.
verses.tafsirV2: (And Who, I ardently hope, will forgive me my sin on the Day of Judgement) on the Day of Reckoning. His sins being his pretending that he was sick, and claiming that it was the biggest idol that smashed the smaller ones and also that his wife was his sister.

verses.text: رَبِّ هَبۡ لِي حُكۡمٗا وَأَلۡحِقۡنِي بِٱلصَّـٰلِحِينَ
verses.translation: [And he said], "My Lord, grant me authority and join me with the righteous
verses.tafsir: My Lord! Grant me unerring judgement knowledge and unite me with the righteous the prophets.
verses.tafsirV2: (My Lord! Vouchsafe me wisdom) understanding and knowledge (and unite me to the righteous) to my forefathers, the messengers, in Paradise.

verses.text: وَٱجۡعَل لِّي لِسَانَ صِدۡقٖ فِي ٱلۡأٓخِرِينَ
verses.translation: And grant me a reputation of honor among later generations
verses.tafsir: And confer on me a worthy repute excellent praise among posterity those who will come after me up to the Day of Resurrection.
verses.tafsirV2: (And give unto me a good report) a good mention (in later generations) those who come after me.

verses.text: وَٱجۡعَلۡنِي مِن وَرَثَةِ جَنَّةِ ٱلنَّعِيمِ
verses.translation: And place me among the inheritors of the Garden of Pleasure
verses.tafsir: And make me among the inheritors of the Garden of Bliss among those who will be given it.
verses.tafsirV2: (And place me among the inheritors of the Garden of Delight) and make me among the dwellers of the Garden of Bliss,

verses.text: وَٱغۡفِرۡ لِأَبِيٓ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ مِنَ ٱلضَّآلِّينَ
verses.translation: And forgive my father. Indeed, he has been of those astray
verses.tafsir: And forgive my father for indeed he is one of those who are astray by Your relenting to him and forgiving him this was before it became clear to him Abraham that he his father was an enemy of God as mentioned in sūrat Barā’a Q. 9114.
verses.tafsirV2: (And forgive my father) and guide my father through me. (Lo! he is of those who err) he is in error, a disbeliever.

verses.text: وَلَا تُخۡزِنِي يَوۡمَ يُبۡعَثُونَ
verses.translation: And do not disgrace me on the Day they are [all] resurrected
verses.tafsir: And do not disgrace me do not expose me on the day when they mankind are resurrected;
verses.tafsirV2: (And abase me not) and do not chastise me (on the day when they are raised) from the graves,

verses.text: يَوۡمَ لَا يَنفَعُ مَالٞ وَلَا بَنُونَ
verses.translation: The Day when there will not benefit [anyone] wealth or children
verses.tafsir: of which day God exalted be He says the following the day when neither wealth nor children will avail anyone
verses.tafsirV2: (The day when wealth) the abundance of wealth (and sons) and abundance of sons (avail not (any man),

verses.text: إِلَّا مَنۡ أَتَى ٱللَّهَ بِقَلۡبٖ سَلِيمٖ
verses.translation: But only one who comes to Allah with a sound heart
verses.tafsir: except him who comes to God with a heart that is sound free from idolatry and hypocrisy — and this is the heart of the believer whom such things will avail.
verses.tafsirV2: Save him who bringeth unto Allah a whole heart) a heart free of sins and love for this worldly life; it is also said that this means: a heart free of hatred for the Companions of the Prophet (pbuh).

verses.text: وَأُزۡلِفَتِ ٱلۡجَنَّةُ لِلۡمُتَّقِينَ
verses.translation: And Paradise will be brought near [that Day] to the righteous
verses.tafsir: And Paradise will be brought near for the God-fearing and they will be able to see it
verses.tafsirV2: (And the Garden will be brought nigh for those who ward off (evil)) disbelief, idolatry, and indecencies, becoming thus their abode.

verses.text: وَبُرِّزَتِ ٱلۡجَحِيمُ لِلۡغَاوِينَ
verses.translation: And Hellfire will be brought forth for the deviators
verses.tafsir: and Hell will be revealed plainly for the perverse the disbelievers.
verses.tafsirV2: (And hell will appear plainly to the erring) to the disbelievers, becoming thus their abode.

verses.text: وَقِيلَ لَهُمۡ أَيۡنَ مَا كُنتُمۡ تَعۡبُدُونَ
verses.translation: And it will be said to them, "Where are those you used to worship
verses.tafsir: And it will be said to them ‘Where is that which you used to worship
verses.tafsirV2: (And it will be said unto them) it will be said to the idol worshippers: (Where is (all) that ye used to worship) of idols in the life of the world,

verses.text: مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ هَلۡ يَنصُرُونَكُمۡ أَوۡ يَنتَصِرُونَ
verses.translation: Other than Allah? Can they help you or help themselves
verses.tafsir: besides God? that is other than Him in the way of idols. Do they help you by averting from you the chastisement or do they help one another?’ by averting it from themselves? No neither!
verses.tafsirV2: (Instead of Allah? Can they help you) can they help you to avoid Allah's chastisement (or help themselves) or help themselves to avoid Allah's chastisement?

verses.text: فَكُبۡكِبُواْ فِيهَا هُمۡ وَٱلۡغَاوُۥنَ
verses.translation: So they will be overturned into Hellfire, they and the deviators
verses.tafsir: Then they will be hurled cast into it they and the perverse
verses.tafsirV2: (Then they will be hurled therein) they will be cast all together in hell, (they) the disbelievers of Mecca and all the disbelievers among human beings (and the seducers) the disbelievers of the jinn and their deities,

verses.text: وَجُنُودُ إِبۡلِيسَ أَجۡمَعُونَ
verses.translation: And the soldiers of Iblees, all together
verses.tafsir: and the hosts of Iblīs his followers and those jinn and humans who were obedient to him all together.
verses.tafsirV2: (And the hosts of Iblis) the offspring of Iblis, (together) who are the satans.

verses.text: قَالُواْ وَهُمۡ فِيهَا يَخۡتَصِمُونَ
verses.translation: They will say while they dispute therein
verses.tafsir: They the perverse shall say as they wrangle therein with those whom they used to worship
verses.tafsirV2: (And they) i.e. the disbelievers (will say, when they are quarrelling) with their deities, leaders and the offspring of Iblis (therein) in hell:

verses.text: تَٱللَّهِ إِن كُنَّا لَفِي ضَلَٰلٖ مُّبِينٍ
verses.translation: By Allah, we were indeed in manifest error
verses.tafsir: ‘By God we had indeed in softened in place of the hardened form with its subject omitted in other words it would usually be innahu been in manifest error
verses.tafsirV2: (By Allah, of a truth we were in error manifest) in the life of the world,

verses.text: إِذۡ نُسَوِّيكُم بِرَبِّ ٱلۡعَٰلَمِينَ
verses.translation: When we equated you with the Lord of the worlds
verses.tafsir: when we equated you in worship with the Lord of the Worlds.
verses.tafsirV2: (When we made you equal with the Lord of the Worlds) in relation to worship.

verses.text: وَمَآ أَضَلَّنَآ إِلَّا ٱلۡمُجۡرِمُونَ
verses.translation: And no one misguided us except the criminals
verses.tafsir: And it was none other than the sinners the devils or our predecessors whose example we were following that led us astray from guidance.
verses.tafsirV2: (It was but the guilty) the idolaters who came before us and whom we emulated (who misled us) who turned us away from faith and obedience.

verses.text: فَمَا لَنَا مِن شَٰفِعِينَ
verses.translation: So now we have no intercessors
verses.tafsir: So now we have no intercessors as the believers have in the way of angels prophets and other believers
verses.tafsirV2: (Now we have no intercessors) from amongst the angels, prophets or righteous people who may intercede for us,

verses.text: وَلَا صَدِيقٍ حَمِيمٖ
verses.translation: And not a devoted friend
verses.tafsir: nor any sympathetic friend who might be concerned for us.
verses.tafsirV2: (Nor any loving friend) nor anyone close who might be interested in our plight.

verses.text: فَلَوۡ أَنَّ لَنَا كَرَّةٗ فَنَكُونَ مِنَ ٱلۡمُؤۡمِنِينَ
verses.translation: Then if we only had a return [to the world] and could be of the believers
verses.tafsir: If only we had another turn another return to this world we would have been among those who believe!’ law ‘if only’ here is for the conditional optative to which nakūna ‘we would have been’ constitutes the response.
verses.tafsirV2: (Oh, that we had another turn) in the life of the world, (that we might be of the believers!

verses.text: إِنَّ فِي ذَٰلِكَ لَأٓيَةٗۖ وَمَا كَانَ أَكۡثَرُهُم مُّؤۡمِنِينَ
verses.translation: Indeed in that is a sign, but most of them were not to be believers
verses.tafsir: Surely in that which is mentioned of the tale of Abraham and his people there is a sign; but most of them are not believers.
verses.tafsirV2: Lo! Herein) in that which I have mentioned of their states (is indeed a portent) a sign and an admonition, (yet most of them are not believers!) that is, if they were to have another turn in the life of the world; it is also said that this means: they were not believers and most of them were disbelievers.

verses.text: وَإِنَّ رَبَّكَ لَهُوَ ٱلۡعَزِيزُ ٱلرَّحِيمُ
verses.translation: And indeed, your Lord - He is the Exalted in Might, the Merciful
verses.tafsir: And truly your Lord He is the Mighty the Merciful.
verses.tafsirV2: (And lo, thy Lord! He is Indeed the Mighty) in retribution against them, (the Merciful) towards the believers.

verses.text: كَذَّبَتۡ قَوۡمُ نُوحٍ ٱلۡمُرۡسَلِينَ
verses.translation: The people of Noah denied the messengers
verses.tafsir: The people of Noah denied the messengers by denying him for they all brought the same message affirming God’s Oneness; or it is because he stayed among them for so long that it was as though he was many messengers the feminine person of the verb kadhdhabat ‘denied’ governed by qawm ‘the people’ is on account of the import but it is masculine on account of its morphological form;
verses.tafsirV2: (Noah's folk denied the messengers (of Allah)) i.e. they denied Noah and all the other messengers who were mentioned by Noah,

verses.text: إِذۡ قَالَ لَهُمۡ أَخُوهُمۡ نُوحٌ أَلَا تَتَّقُونَ
verses.translation: When their brother Noah said to them, "Will you not fear Allah
verses.tafsir: when Noah their brother — their brother only in terms of lineage — said to them ‘Will you not fear? God?
verses.tafsirV2: (When their brother) their Prophet; he was not their brother in religion but only in kinship (Noah said unto them: Will ye not ward off (evil)) the worship of other than Allah?

verses.text: إِنِّي لَكُمۡ رَسُولٌ أَمِينٞ
verses.translation: Indeed, I am to you a trustworthy messenger
verses.tafsir: Truly I am a trusted messenger sent to you to deliver the Message with which I have been sent.
verses.tafsirV2: (Lo! I am a faithful messenger) faithful in conveying the message; it is also said that this means: I was deemed very trustworthy in your eyes before this, so how could you doubt me today, (unto you) from Allah,

verses.text: فَٱتَّقُواْ ٱللَّهَ وَأَطِيعُونِ
verses.translation: So fear Allah and obey me
verses.tafsir: So fear God and obey me in what I enjoin you to of God’s Oneness and obedience to Him.
verses.tafsirV2: (So keep your duty to Allah) so fear Allah regarding that which He has commanded you of repentance and faith, (and obey me) and follow my way and religion.

verses.text: وَمَآ أَسۡـَٔلُكُمۡ عَلَيۡهِ مِنۡ أَجۡرٍۖ إِنۡ أَجۡرِيَ إِلَّا عَلَىٰ رَبِّ ٱلۡعَٰلَمِينَ
