verses.translation: And I do not ask you for it any payment. My payment is only from the Lord of the worlds
verses.tafsir: I do not ask of you any reward for it for delivering it; for my reward lies only with the Lord of the Worlds.
verses.tafsirV2: (And I ask of you no wage) no provision (therefore) in exchange for the profession of Allah's divine Oneness; (my wage) my provision (is the concern only of the Lord of the Worlds.

verses.text: فَٱتَّقُواْ ٱللَّهَ وَأَطِيعُونِ
verses.translation: So fear Allah and obey me
verses.tafsir: So fear God and obey me’ — he repeats this statement for emphasis.
verses.tafsirV2: So keep your duty to Allah) so fear Allah regarding that which He has commanded you of repentance and faith, (and obey me) and follow my advice.

verses.text: ۞قَالُوٓاْ أَنُؤۡمِنُ لَكَ وَٱتَّبَعَكَ ٱلۡأَرۡذَلُونَ
verses.translation: They said, "Should we believe you while you are followed by the lowest [class of people]
verses.tafsir: They said ‘Shall we believe in you in your words when it is the lowliest people who follow you?’ wa’ttaba‘aka a variant reading has wa-atbā‘uka ‘when your followers’ plural of tābi‘ ‘follower’ as a subject the riffraff such as the weavers and the shoemakers.
verses.tafsirV2: (They said: Shall we put faith in thee) shall we believe in you, O Noah, (when the lowest (of the people) follow thee) when our most lowly and weak have followed you? We will not believe in you until you repulse them.

verses.text: قَالَ وَمَا عِلۡمِي بِمَا كَانُواْ يَعۡمَلُونَ
verses.translation: He said, "And what is my knowledge of what they used to do
verses.tafsir: He said ‘And what do I know of what they may have been doing?
verses.tafsirV2: (He said) Noah said: (And what knowledge have I of what they may have been doing (in the past)) I do not know whether it is you or them who will agree with me?

verses.text: إِنۡ حِسَابُهُمۡ إِلَّا عَلَىٰ رَبِّيۖ لَوۡ تَشۡعُرُونَ
verses.translation: Their account is only upon my Lord, if you [could] perceive
verses.tafsir: Their reckoning is only my Lord’s concern and He will requite them if only you were aware — had you known this you would not have reviled them.
verses.tafsirV2: (Lo! their reckoning) their reward and sustenance (is my Lord's concern, if ye but knew) this;

verses.text: وَمَآ أَنَا۠ بِطَارِدِ ٱلۡمُؤۡمِنِينَ
verses.translation: And I am not one to drive away the believers
verses.tafsir: And I am not about to drive away the believers.
verses.tafsirV2: (And I am not (here) to repulse believers) from the worship of Allah.

verses.text: إِنۡ أَنَا۠ إِلَّا نَذِيرٞ مُّبِينٞ
verses.translation: I am only a clear warner
verses.tafsir: I am just a plain warner’.
verses.tafsirV2: (I am only a plain warner) I am only a Messenger warning you of a curse that you know well.

verses.text: قَالُواْ لَئِن لَّمۡ تَنتَهِ يَٰنُوحُ لَتَكُونَنَّ مِنَ ٱلۡمَرۡجُومِينَ
verses.translation: They said, "If you do not desist, O Noah, you will surely be of those who are stoned
verses.tafsir: They said ‘Lo! if you do not desist O Noah from what you say to us you will assuredly be among those assailed’ with stones or curses.
verses.tafsirV2: (They said: If thou cease not) from what you are saying, (O Noah, thou wilt surely be among those stoned (to death)) we will kill you just as we killed the strangers who believed in you.

verses.text: قَالَ رَبِّ إِنَّ قَوۡمِي كَذَّبُونِ
verses.translation: He said, "My Lord, indeed my people have denied me
verses.tafsir: He Noah said ‘My Lord my people have denied me
verses.tafsirV2: (He said) Noah said: (My Lord! Lo! my own folk deny me) regarding the message, and have killed those strangers who believed in me.

verses.text: فَٱفۡتَحۡ بَيۡنِي وَبَيۡنَهُمۡ فَتۡحٗا وَنَجِّنِي وَمَن مَّعِيَ مِنَ ٱلۡمُؤۡمِنِينَ
verses.translation: Then judge between me and them with decisive judgement and save me and those with me of the believers
verses.tafsir: so judge conclusively between me and them and deliver me and the believers who are with me’.
verses.tafsirV2: (Therefore judge Thou between us, a (conclusive) judgement) a fair judgement, (and save me and those believers who are with me) from their torment.

verses.text: فَأَنجَيۡنَٰهُ وَمَن مَّعَهُۥ فِي ٱلۡفُلۡكِ ٱلۡمَشۡحُونِ
verses.translation: So We saved him and those with him in the laden ship
verses.tafsir: He exalted be He says So We delivered him and those who were with him in the laden ark the ship filled with humans animals and birds.
verses.tafsirV2: (And We saved him and those with him) among the believers (in the laden ship) and it was only waiting to sail away.

verses.text: ثُمَّ أَغۡرَقۡنَا بَعۡدُ ٱلۡبَاقِينَ
verses.translation: Then We drowned thereafter the remaining ones
verses.tafsir: Then afterwards after We delivered them We drowned the rest of his people.
verses.tafsirV2: (Then afterward We drowned the others) i.e. the rest of his people, after Noah boarded the ship.

verses.text: إِنَّ فِي ذَٰلِكَ لَأٓيَةٗۖ وَمَا كَانَ أَكۡثَرُهُم مُّؤۡمِنِينَ
verses.translation: Indeed in that is a sign, but most of them were not to be believers
verses.tafsir: Surely in that there is a sign; but most of them are not believers.
verses.tafsirV2: (Lo! Herein) in that which We did with them (is indeed a portent) a sign and an admonition to those who came after them, (yet most of them are not believers) they were not believers and most of them were disbelievers.

verses.text: وَإِنَّ رَبَّكَ لَهُوَ ٱلۡعَزِيزُ ٱلرَّحِيمُ
verses.translation: And indeed, your Lord - He is the Exalted in Might, the Merciful
verses.tafsir: Truly your Lord He is the Mighty the Merciful.
verses.tafsirV2: (And lo, thy Lord, He is indeed the Mighty) in retribution against them when He drowned them, (the Merciful) towards the believers when He saved them from drowning.

verses.text: كَذَّبَتۡ عَادٌ ٱلۡمُرۡسَلِينَ
verses.translation: Aad denied the messengers
verses.tafsir: ‘Ād denied the messengers
verses.tafsirV2: ((The tribe of) 'Aad denied the messengers (of Allah)) the people of Hud denied Hud as well as all the messenger whom Hud had mentioned to them,

verses.text: إِذۡ قَالَ لَهُمۡ أَخُوهُمۡ هُودٌ أَلَا تَتَّقُونَ
verses.translation: When their brother Hud said to them, "Will you not fear Allah
verses.tafsir: when Hūd their brother said to them ‘Will you not fear God?
verses.tafsirV2: (When their brother) their Prophet (Hud said unto them: Will ye not ward off (evil)) the worship of other than Allah?

verses.text: إِنِّي لَكُمۡ رَسُولٌ أَمِينٞ
verses.translation: Indeed, I am to you a trustworthy messenger
verses.tafsir: Truly I am a trusted messenger sent to you.
verses.tafsirV2: (Lo! I am a faithful messenger) I am faithful regarding the message (unto you) from Allah,

verses.text: فَٱتَّقُواْ ٱللَّهَ وَأَطِيعُونِ
verses.translation: So fear Allah and obey me
verses.tafsir: So fear God and obey me.
verses.tafsirV2: (So keep your duty to Allah) so obey Allah regarding that which He has commanded you of repentance and faith (and obey me) in that which I command you.

verses.text: وَمَآ أَسۡـَٔلُكُمۡ عَلَيۡهِ مِنۡ أَجۡرٍۖ إِنۡ أَجۡرِيَ إِلَّا عَلَىٰ رَبِّ ٱلۡعَٰلَمِينَ
verses.translation: And I do not ask you for it any payment. My payment is only from the Lord of the worlds
verses.tafsir: I do not ask of you any reward for this; for my reward lies only with the Lord of the Worlds.
verses.tafsirV2: (And I ask of you no wage) no payment (therefore) for professing Allah's divine Oneness; (my wage) my reward (is the concern only of the Lord of the Worlds.

verses.text: أَتَبۡنُونَ بِكُلِّ رِيعٍ ءَايَةٗ تَعۡبَثُونَ
verses.translation: Do you construct on every elevation a sign, amusing yourselves
verses.tafsir: Do you build on every prominence every high place a monument an edifice as a signpost for passers-by so that you may hurl abuse? at those who pass by you and deride them ta‘bathūna is a circumstantial qualifier referring to the subject of the verb tabnūna ‘you build’.
verses.tafsirV2: Build ye on every high place a monument for vain delight?) you beat up any stranger who passes by you and steal his clothes; this can also be understood in this manner: do you build in every marketplace a sign by means of which you scoff at whoever passes by you?

verses.text: وَتَتَّخِذُونَ مَصَانِعَ لَعَلَّكُمۡ تَخۡلُدُونَ
verses.translation: And take for yourselves palaces and fortresses that you might abide eternally
verses.tafsir: And you set up structures for extracting water underground that perhaps you might as though you will last forever therein and not die.
verses.tafsirV2: (And seek ye out strongholds) houses, palaces and pools, (that haply ye may last for ever) in this worldly life? Nay, you will not last for ever!

verses.text: وَإِذَا بَطَشۡتُم بَطَشۡتُمۡ جَبَّارِينَ
verses.translation: And when you strike, you strike as tyrants
verses.tafsir: And when you assault to smite or slay you assault like tyrants mercilessly!
verses.tafsirV2: (And if ye seize by force, seize ye as tyrants?) And when you punish, you do so in the manner of the tyrants: you beat up and kill in a state of anger.

verses.text: فَٱتَّقُواْ ٱللَّهَ وَأَطِيعُونِ
verses.translation: So fear Allah and obey me
verses.tafsir: So fear God in this and obey me in what I have commanded you.
verses.tafsirV2: (Rather keep your duty to Allah) rather, fear Allah regarding that which He has commanded you of repentance and faith, (and obey me) and follow my way.

verses.text: وَٱتَّقُواْ ٱلَّذِيٓ أَمَدَّكُم بِمَا تَعۡلَمُونَ
verses.translation: And fear He who provided you with that which you know
verses.tafsir: And fear Him Who has provided you Who has been gracious to you in a way that you know
verses.tafsirV2: (Keep your duty towards Him) fear Him (who hath aided) provided (you with (the good things) that ye know),

verses.text: أَمَدَّكُم بِأَنۡعَٰمٖ وَبَنِينَ
verses.translation: Provided you with grazing livestock and children
verses.tafsir: provided you with cattle and sons
verses.tafsirV2: Then He explained what He provided them with, saying: (Hath aided ye with cattle and sons) He gave you cattle and sons.

verses.text: وَجَنَّـٰتٖ وَعُيُونٍ
verses.translation: And gardens and springs
verses.tafsir: and gardens orchards and springs rivers.
verses.tafsirV2: (And gardens and water springs) and pure water.

verses.text: إِنِّيٓ أَخَافُ عَلَيۡكُمۡ عَذَابَ يَوۡمٍ عَظِيمٖ
verses.translation: Indeed, I fear for you the punishment of a terrible day
verses.tafsir: Indeed I fear for you the chastisement of a tremendous day’ in this world and in the Hereafter should you disobey me.
verses.tafsirV2: (Lo! I fear for you) I know you will be visited by (the retribution of an awful day) in the Fire, if you do not repent of disbelief, idolatry and idol worship.

verses.text: قَالُواْ سَوَآءٌ عَلَيۡنَآ أَوَعَظۡتَ أَمۡ لَمۡ تَكُن مِّنَ ٱلۡوَٰعِظِينَ
verses.translation: They said, "It is all the same to us whether you advise or are not of the advisors
verses.tafsir: They said ‘It is the same to us whether you admonish us or are not one of those who admonish anyway. In other words we will not heed your admonition.
verses.tafsirV2: (They said: It is all one to us whether thou preachest) you warn us (or art not of those who preach) or you are a warner to us;

verses.text: إِنۡ هَٰذَآ إِلَّا خُلُقُ ٱلۡأَوَّلِينَ
verses.translation: This is not but the custom of the former peoples
verses.tafsir: This that you threaten us with is merely the fabrication of the ancients that is their inventions and lies a variant reading for khalq ‘fabrication’ is khuluq ‘ethos’ in other words this denial of resurrection to which we adhere is merely ‘the ethos of the ancients’ in other words their nature and wont;
verses.tafsirV2: (This) that in which we are now (is but a fable of the men of old) the religion of the people of old; the religion of our forefathers; it is also said that this means: what you say is nothing but the invention of the people of old,

verses.text: وَمَا نَحۡنُ بِمُعَذَّبِينَ
verses.translation: And we are not to be punished
verses.tafsir: and we will not be chastised’.
verses.tafsirV2: (And we shall not be doomed) for adhering to this religion, as you claim.

verses.text: فَكَذَّبُوهُ فَأَهۡلَكۡنَٰهُمۡۚ إِنَّ فِي ذَٰلِكَ لَأٓيَةٗۖ وَمَا كَانَ أَكۡثَرُهُم مُّؤۡمِنِينَ
verses.translation: And they denied him, so We destroyed them. Indeed in that is a sign, but most of them were not to be believers
verses.tafsir: So they denied him concerning the chastisement whereupon We destroyed them in this world with the barren wind cf. Q. 5141. Surely in that there is a sign; but most of them are not believers.
verses.tafsirV2: (And they denied him) they disbelieved in his message and in what he said to them; (therefore We destroyed them) by the wind. (Lo! Herein) in that which We did to them (is indeed a portent) a sign and an admonition to those who came after them, (yet most of them are not believers) they were not believers and most of them were disbelievers.

verses.text: وَإِنَّ رَبَّكَ لَهُوَ ٱلۡعَزِيزُ ٱلرَّحِيمُ
verses.translation: And indeed, your Lord - He is the Exalted in Might, the Merciful
verses.tafsir: Truly your Lord He is the Mighty the Merciful.
verses.tafsirV2: (And lo! thy Lord, He is indeed the Mighty) in retribution against the disbelievers, (the Merciful) towards the believers, for He saved them from the wind.

verses.text: كَذَّبَتۡ ثَمُودُ ٱلۡمُرۡسَلِينَ
verses.translation: Thamud denied the messengers
verses.tafsir: Thamūd denied the messengers
verses.tafsirV2: ((The tribe of) Thamud denied the messengers (of Allah)) the people of Salih denied Salih just as they denied all the messengers that Salih mentioned to them.

verses.text: إِذۡ قَالَ لَهُمۡ أَخُوهُمۡ صَٰلِحٌ أَلَا تَتَّقُونَ
verses.translation: When their brother Salih said to them, "Will you not fear Allah
verses.tafsir: when Sālih their brother said to them ‘Will you fear God?
verses.tafsirV2: (When their brother) their Prophet (Salih said unto them: Will ye not ward off (evil)) the worship of other than Allah?

verses.text: إِنِّي لَكُمۡ رَسُولٌ أَمِينٞ
verses.translation: Indeed, I am to you a trustworthy messenger
verses.tafsir: Truly I am a trusted messenger sent to you.
verses.tafsirV2: (Lo! I am a faithful messenger unto you) I am a Messenger from Allah to you, and I am faithful as regards the message I bring,

verses.text: فَٱتَّقُواْ ٱللَّهَ وَأَطِيعُونِ
verses.translation: So fear Allah and obey me
verses.tafsir: So fear God and obey me.
verses.tafsirV2: (So keep your duty to Allah) so fear Allah regarding that which He commanded you of repentance and faith (and obey me) and follow my way and religion.

verses.text: وَمَآ أَسۡـَٔلُكُمۡ عَلَيۡهِ مِنۡ أَجۡرٍۖ إِنۡ أَجۡرِيَ إِلَّا عَلَىٰ رَبِّ ٱلۡعَٰلَمِينَ
verses.translation: And I do not ask you for it any payment. My payment is only from the Lord of the worlds
verses.tafsir: I do not ask of you any reward for this; for my reward lies only with the Lord of the Worlds.
verses.tafsirV2: (And I ask of you no wage) no payment or provision (therefore) in exchange for the profession of Allah's divine Oneness; (my wage) my reward (is the concern only of the Lord of the Worlds.

verses.text: أَتُتۡرَكُونَ فِي مَا هَٰهُنَآ ءَامِنِينَ
verses.translation: Will you be left in what is here, secure [from death]
verses.tafsir: Will you be left secure in that which is here of good things —
verses.tafsirV2: Will ye be left secure) from death, cessation or punishment (in that which is here before us) of bounties,

verses.text: فِي جَنَّـٰتٖ وَعُيُونٖ
verses.translation: Within gardens and springs
verses.tafsir: amid gardens and springs
verses.tafsirV2: (In gardens and water springs) pure water

verses.text: وَزُرُوعٖ وَنَخۡلٖ طَلۡعُهَا هَضِيمٞ
verses.translation: And fields of crops and palm trees with softened fruit
verses.tafsir: and farms and date palms with slender delicate and tender spathes?
verses.tafsirV2: (And tilled fields and heavy sheathed palm-trees) bearing ripe and seemly fruits,

verses.text: وَتَنۡحِتُونَ مِنَ ٱلۡجِبَالِ بُيُوتٗا فَٰرِهِينَ
verses.translation: And you carve out of the mountains, homes, with skill
verses.tafsir: And you hew dwellings out of the mountains arrogantly a variant reading of farihīna ‘arrogant’ has fārihīn ‘skilfully’.
verses.tafsirV2: (Though ye hew out dwellings in the mountain, being skilful?) it is also said that this means: feeling proud of, and haughty about, your farms.

verses.text: فَٱتَّقُواْ ٱللَّهَ وَأَطِيعُونِ
verses.translation: So fear Allah and obey me
verses.tafsir: So fear God and obey me in what I have commanded you
verses.tafsirV2: (Therefore keep your duty to Allah) fear Allah regarding that which He commanded you (and obey me) and follow my way and advice,

verses.text: وَلَا تُطِيعُوٓاْ أَمۡرَ ٱلۡمُسۡرِفِينَ
verses.translation: And do not obey the order of the transgressors
verses.tafsir: and do not obey the command of the prodigal
verses.tafsirV2: (And obey not the command of the prodigal) and obey not the words of the idolaters,

verses.text: ٱلَّذِينَ يُفۡسِدُونَ فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ وَلَا يُصۡلِحُونَ
verses.translation: Who cause corruption in the land and do not amend
verses.tafsir: who cause corruption in the earth through acts of disobedience and act righteously’ by being obedient to God.
verses.tafsirV2: (Who spread corruption in the earth) through disbelief, idolatry and calling to the worship of other than Allah, (and reform not) they do not command righteousness.

verses.text: قَالُوٓاْ إِنَّمَآ أَنتَ مِنَ ٱلۡمُسَحَّرِينَ
verses.translation: They said, "You are only of those affected by magic
verses.tafsir: They said ‘You are indeed one of the bewitched those who have succumbed so many times to sorcery that their minds have been overcome.
verses.tafsirV2: (They said: thou art but one of the bewitched) you are neither an angel nor a prophet;

verses.text: مَآ أَنتَ إِلَّا بَشَرٞ مِّثۡلُنَا فَأۡتِ بِـَٔايَةٍ إِن كُنتَ مِنَ ٱلصَّـٰدِقِينَ
verses.translation: You are but a man like ourselves, so bring a sign, if you should be of the truthful
verses.tafsir: And moreover you are just a human being like us. So bring us a sign if you are sincere’ in your Mission.
verses.tafsirV2: (Thou art but a mortal) a human being (like us) you eat and drink just like we do. (So bring some token) a sign to prove what you claim (if thou art of the truthful) that the punishment is coming and that you are a Messenger to us.

verses.text: قَالَ هَٰذِهِۦ نَاقَةٞ لَّهَا شِرۡبٞ وَلَكُمۡ شِرۡبُ يَوۡمٖ مَّعۡلُومٖ
verses.translation: He said, "This is a she-camel. For her is a [time of] drink, and for you is a [time of] drink, [each] on a known day
verses.tafsir: He said ‘This is a she-camel; she shall drink a share of the water and you shall drink each on a known day.
verses.tafsirV2: (He said) Salih said to them: ((Behold) this she-camel) she is a sign that I am sent as a prophet to you. (She hath the right to drink (at the well)) one day, (and ye have the right to drink) another day, ((each) on an appointed day) i.e. in alternate days: one day for you and one day for her.

verses.text: وَلَا تَمَسُّوهَا بِسُوٓءٖ فَيَأۡخُذَكُمۡ عَذَابُ يَوۡمٍ عَظِيمٖ
verses.translation: And do not touch her with harm, lest you be seized by the punishment of a terrible day
verses.tafsir: And do not cause her any harm for then you shall be seized by the chastisement of an awful day’ awful because of the awfulness of the chastisement.
verses.tafsirV2: (And touch her not with ill) do not hamstrung her (lest there come on you the retribution of an awful day.

verses.text: فَعَقَرُوهَا فَأَصۡبَحُواْ نَٰدِمِينَ
verses.translation: But they hamstrung her and so became regretful
verses.tafsir: But they hamstrung her — a group of them hamstrung her with the approval of others; and then became remorseful for having hamstrung it.
verses.tafsirV2: But they hamstrung her) they killed her, (and then were penitent) and they regretted killing her.

verses.text: فَأَخَذَهُمُ ٱلۡعَذَابُۚ إِنَّ فِي ذَٰلِكَ لَأٓيَةٗۖ وَمَا كَانَ أَكۡثَرُهُم مُّؤۡمِنِينَ
verses.translation: And the punishment seized them. Indeed in that is a sign, but most of them were not to be believers
verses.tafsir: So they were seized by the chastisement which had been promised and were destroyed. Surely in that there is a sign; but most of them are not believers.
verses.tafsirV2: (So the retribution came on them) after three days. (Lo! Herein) in that which We did to them (is indeed a portent) a sign and an admonition for those who came after them, (yet most of them are not believers) they were not believers and were all disbelievers.

verses.text: وَإِنَّ رَبَّكَ لَهُوَ ٱلۡعَزِيزُ ٱلرَّحِيمُ
verses.translation: And indeed, your Lord - He is the Exalted in Might, the Merciful
verses.tafsir: Truly your Lord He is the Mighty the Merciful.
verses.tafsirV2: (And lo! thy Lord) O Muhammad! (He is indeed the Mighty) in retribution against the disbelievers, (the Merciful) towards the believers.

verses.text: كَذَّبَتۡ قَوۡمُ لُوطٍ ٱلۡمُرۡسَلِينَ
verses.translation: The people of Lot denied the messengers
verses.tafsir: The people of Lot denied the messengers
verses.tafsirV2: (The folk of Lot denied the messengers (of Allah)) the people of Lot denied Lot and they also denied all the messengers mentioned to them by Lot,

verses.text: إِذۡ قَالَ لَهُمۡ أَخُوهُمۡ لُوطٌ أَلَا تَتَّقُونَ
verses.translation: When their brother Lot said to them, "Will you not fear Allah
verses.tafsir: when Lot their brother said to them ‘Will you not fear God?
verses.tafsirV2: (When their brother) their Prophet (Lot said unto them: Will ye not ward off (evil)) will you not ward off the worship of other than Allah?

verses.text: إِنِّي لَكُمۡ رَسُولٌ أَمِينٞ
verses.translation: Indeed, I am to you a trustworthy messenger
verses.tafsir: Truly I am a trusted messenger sent to you.
verses.tafsirV2: (Lo! I am a faithful messenger unto you) from Allah and I am faithful regarding the message I have brought to you,

verses.text: فَٱتَّقُواْ ٱللَّهَ وَأَطِيعُونِ
verses.translation: So fear Allah and obey me
verses.tafsir: So fear God and obey me.
verses.tafsirV2: (So keep your duty to Allah) so fear Allah in that which He commanded you regarding repentance and faith (and obey me) follow my way and religion.

verses.text: وَمَآ أَسۡـَٔلُكُمۡ عَلَيۡهِ مِنۡ أَجۡرٍۖ إِنۡ أَجۡرِيَ إِلَّا عَلَىٰ رَبِّ ٱلۡعَٰلَمِينَ
verses.translation: And I do not ask you for it any payment. My payment is only from the Lord of the worlds
verses.tafsir: I do not ask of you any reward for this; my reward lies only with the Lord of the Worlds.
verses.tafsirV2: (And I ask of you no wage) no payment (therefore) for professing Allah's divine Oneness; (my wage) my reward (is the concern only of the Lord of the Worlds.

verses.text: أَتَأۡتُونَ ٱلذُّكۡرَانَ مِنَ ٱلۡعَٰلَمِينَ
verses.translation: Do you approach males among the worlds
verses.tafsir: What! Of all people you come unto males to fornicate
verses.tafsirV2: What! Of all creatures do ye come unto the males) for sexual intercourse,

verses.text: وَتَذَرُونَ مَا خَلَقَ لَكُمۡ رَبُّكُم مِّنۡ أَزۡوَٰجِكُمۚ بَلۡ أَنتُمۡ قَوۡمٌ عَادُونَ
verses.translation: And leave what your Lord has created for you as mates? But you are a people transgressing
verses.tafsir: and forsake the wives your Lord has created for you? in other words you forsake intimacy with their front parts? Nay but you are a transgressing folk’ overstepping the bounds of what is lawful into what is unlawful.
verses.tafsirV2: (And leave the wives) and avoid having sex with your wives (your Lord created for you) that your Lord made lawful for you? (Nay, but ye are froward folk) who transgress from the lawful to the unlawful.

verses.text: قَالُواْ لَئِن لَّمۡ تَنتَهِ يَٰلُوطُ لَتَكُونَنَّ مِنَ ٱلۡمُخۡرَجِينَ
verses.translation: They said, "If you do not desist, O Lot, you will surely be of those evicted
verses.tafsir: They said ‘If you do not desist O Lot from reproaching us you will assuredly be of those expelled’ from our land.
verses.tafsirV2: (They said: If thou cease not, O Lot) from what you say, (thou wilt soon be of the outcast) you will be expelled from our land, Sodom.

verses.text: قَالَ إِنِّي لِعَمَلِكُم مِّنَ ٱلۡقَالِينَ
verses.translation: He said, "Indeed, I am, toward your deed, of those who detest [it]
verses.tafsir: He Lot said ‘Truly I abhor I detest what you do.
verses.tafsirV2: (He said) Lot said: (I am in truth of those who hate your conduct) your evil conduct.

verses.text: رَبِّ نَجِّنِي وَأَهۡلِي مِمَّا يَعۡمَلُونَ
verses.translation: My Lord, save me and my family from [the consequence of] what they do
verses.tafsir: My Lord deliver me and my family from what they do’ that is from the punishment for it.
verses.tafsirV2: (My Lord! Save me and my household from what they do.

verses.text: فَنَجَّيۡنَٰهُ وَأَهۡلَهُۥٓ أَجۡمَعِينَ
verses.translation: So We saved him and his family, all
verses.tafsir: So We delivered him and all his family
verses.tafsirV2: So We saved him and his household, every one,

verses.text: إِلَّا عَجُوزٗا فِي ٱلۡغَٰبِرِينَ
verses.translation: Except an old woman among those who remained behind
verses.tafsir: except an old woman — his wife — among those who stayed behind whom We destroyed.
verses.tafsirV2: Save an old woman) his hypocrite wife (among those who stayed behind) to be destroyed.

verses.text: ثُمَّ دَمَّرۡنَا ٱلۡأٓخَرِينَ
verses.translation: Then We destroyed the others
verses.tafsir: Then We destroyed all the others
verses.tafsirV2: (Then afterward We destroyed the others) We destroyed the remainder of his people.

verses.text: وَأَمۡطَرۡنَا عَلَيۡهِم مَّطَرٗاۖ فَسَآءَ مَطَرُ ٱلۡمُنذَرِينَ
verses.translation: And We rained upon them a rain [of stones], and evil was the rain of those who were warned
verses.tafsir: and We rained on them a rain We rained on them stones — this detail pertains to the previous statement concerning their destruction — and evil was their rain the rain of those who were warned!
verses.tafsirV2: (And We rained on them) on their sodomites and travellers (a rain) of stones. (And dreadful is the rain of those who have been warned) evil is the rain of stones for those who were warned by Lot but did not believe.

verses.text: إِنَّ فِي ذَٰلِكَ لَأٓيَةٗۖ وَمَا كَانَ أَكۡثَرُهُم مُّؤۡمِنِينَ
verses.translation: Indeed in that is a sign, but most of them were not to be believers
verses.tafsir: Surely in that there is a sign; but most of them are not believers.
verses.tafsirV2: (Lo! Herein) in that which We did to them (is indeed a portent) a sign and an admonition for those who came after them, (yet most of them are not believers) they were not believers and most of them were disbelievers.

verses.text: وَإِنَّ رَبَّكَ لَهُوَ ٱلۡعَزِيزُ ٱلرَّحِيمُ
verses.translation: And indeed, your Lord - He is the Exalted in Might, the Merciful
verses.tafsir: Surely your Lord He is the Mighty the Merciful.
verses.tafsirV2: (And lo! thy Lord, He is indeed the Mighty) in retribution against the disbelievers, (the Merciful) towards the believers.

verses.text: كَذَّبَ أَصۡحَٰبُ لۡـَٔيۡكَةِ ٱلۡمُرۡسَلِينَ
verses.translation: The companions of the thicket denied the messengers
verses.tafsir: The dwellers in the wood a variant reading for ashābu’l-aykati has ashābu laykata a thicket of trees near Midian denied the messengers
verses.tafsirV2: (The dwellers in the wood (of Midian) denied the messengers (of Allah)) the people of Shu'ayb denied Shu'ayb just as they denied all the messengers mentioned to them by Shu'ayb,

verses.text: إِذۡ قَالَ لَهُمۡ شُعَيۡبٌ أَلَا تَتَّقُونَ
verses.translation: When Shu'ayb said to them, "Will you not fear Allah
verses.tafsir: when Shu‘ayb — He God does not say ‘their brother’ in this instance because he Shu‘ayb was not in terms of lineage one of them — said to them ‘Will you not fear God?
verses.tafsirV2: (When Shu'ayb said unto them: Will ye not ward off (evil)) will you not ward off the worship of other than Allah?

verses.text: إِنِّي لَكُمۡ رَسُولٌ أَمِينٞ
verses.translation: Indeed, I am to you a trustworthy messenger
verses.tafsir: Truly I am a trusted messenger sent to you.
verses.tafsirV2: (Lo! I am a faithful messenger unto you) from Allah and I am faithful regarding the message I convey to you,

verses.text: فَٱتَّقُواْ ٱللَّهَ وَأَطِيعُونِ
verses.translation: So fear Allah and obey me
verses.tafsir: So fear God and obey me.
verses.tafsirV2: (So keep your duty to Allah) so fear Allah in that which He commanded you regarding repentance and faith (and obey me) and follow my way and religion.

verses.text: وَمَآ أَسۡـَٔلُكُمۡ عَلَيۡهِ مِنۡ أَجۡرٍۖ إِنۡ أَجۡرِيَ إِلَّا عَلَىٰ رَبِّ ٱلۡعَٰلَمِينَ
verses.translation: And I do not ask you for it any payment. My payment is only from the Lord of the worlds
verses.tafsir: I do not ask of you any reward for this; indeed my reward lies only with the Lord of the Worlds.
verses.tafsirV2: (And I ask of you no wage) no payment (for it) for the profession of Allah's divine Oneness; (my wage) my reward (is the concern only of the Lord of the Worlds.

verses.text: ۞أَوۡفُواْ ٱلۡكَيۡلَ وَلَا تَكُونُواْ مِنَ ٱلۡمُخۡسِرِينَ
verses.translation: Give full measure and do not be of those who cause loss
verses.tafsir: Give full measure and do not be of those who give short measure
verses.tafsirV2: Give full measure) when you measure or weigh, (and be not of those who give less (than the due)) in measurement and weighing; this is because they were well known for giving less than what is due in measurement.

verses.text: وَزِنُواْ بِٱلۡقِسۡطَاسِ ٱلۡمُسۡتَقِيمِ
verses.translation: And weigh with an even balance
verses.tafsir: and weigh with an even balance
verses.tafsirV2: (And weigh with the true balance) and weigh with the balance of justice.

verses.text: وَلَا تَبۡخَسُواْ ٱلنَّاسَ أَشۡيَآءَهُمۡ وَلَا تَعۡثَوۡاْ فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ مُفۡسِدِينَ
verses.translation: And do not deprive people of their due and do not commit abuse on earth, spreading corruption
verses.tafsir: and do not defraud people in their goods do not diminish anything of what is due to them and do not be degenerate in the earth seeking corruption by killing or otherwise ta‘thaw ‘degenerate’ derives from ‘athiya meaning afsada ‘to corrupt’; mufsidīna ‘seeking corruption’ is a circumstantial qualifier emphasising the import of its operator ta‘thaw.
verses.tafsirV2: (Wrong not mankind in their goods) do not diminish people's due in measurement and weight, (and do not evil, making mischief, in the earth) do not commit transgressions and corruption in the land by giving less in measurement and weight and calling to the worship of other than Allah.

verses.text: وَٱتَّقُواْ ٱلَّذِي خَلَقَكُمۡ وَٱلۡجِبِلَّةَ ٱلۡأَوَّلِينَ
verses.translation: And fear He who created you and the former creation
verses.tafsir: And fear Him Who created you and the former generations’ all creation before you.
verses.tafsirV2: (And keep your duty unto) and fear (Him Who created you and the generations of the men of old) He created the people of old before you.

verses.text: قَالُوٓاْ إِنَّمَآ أَنتَ مِنَ ٱلۡمُسَحَّرِينَ
verses.translation: They said, "You are only of those affected by magic
verses.tafsir: They said ‘You are indeed one of the bewitched.
verses.tafsirV2: (They said: thou art but one of the bewitched) you are neither an angel nor a Prophet;

verses.text: وَمَآ أَنتَ إِلَّا بَشَرٞ مِّثۡلُنَا وَإِن نَّظُنُّكَ لَمِنَ ٱلۡكَٰذِبِينَ
verses.translation: You are but a man like ourselves, and indeed, we think you are among the liars
verses.tafsir: You are just a human being like us. And we indeed in softened in place of the hardened form its subject omitted in other words it would be innahu think that you are one of the liars.
verses.tafsirV2: (Thou art but a mortal) a human being (like us) you eat and drink just as we do, (and lo! we deem thee of the liars) in what you claim.

verses.text: فَأَسۡقِطۡ عَلَيۡنَا كِسَفٗا مِّنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ إِن كُنتَ مِنَ ٱلصَّـٰدِقِينَ
verses.translation: So cause to fall upon us fragments of the sky, if you should be of the truthful
verses.tafsir: Then make fragments read kisfan or kisafan of the heaven fall upon us if you are of the truthful’ in your Mission.
verses.tafsirV2: (Then make fragments of the heaven fall upon us) as punishment, (if thou art of the Truthful) that the punishment is coming.

verses.text: قَالَ رَبِّيٓ أَعۡلَمُ بِمَا تَعۡمَلُونَ
verses.translation: He said, "My Lord is most knowing of what you do
verses.tafsir: He said ‘My Lord knows best what you are doing’ and will requite you for it.
verses.tafsirV2: (He said) Shu'ayb said: (My Lord is best aware of what ye do) in your state of disbelief, and He is more aware of you and your punishment.

verses.text: فَكَذَّبُوهُ فَأَخَذَهُمۡ عَذَابُ يَوۡمِ ٱلظُّلَّةِۚ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ عَذَابَ يَوۡمٍ عَظِيمٍ
verses.translation: And they denied him, so the punishment of the day of the black cloud seized them. Indeed, it was the punishment of a terrible day
verses.tafsir: But they denied him so they were seized by the chastisement of the day of the shade al-zulla — a cloud which gave them shade when they suffered a bout of extreme heat but which then rained down fire on them and they were incinerated. Assuredly it was the chastisement of a tremendous day.
verses.tafsirV2: (But they denied him) they denied his message, (so there came on them the retribution of the day of gloom) the punishment came in the form of a cloud that stopped above them and burned them with its heat. (Lo! it was the retribution of an awful day) it was a severe day of chastisement for them.

verses.text: إِنَّ فِي ذَٰلِكَ لَأٓيَةٗۖ وَمَا كَانَ أَكۡثَرُهُم مُّؤۡمِنِينَ
verses.translation: Indeed in that is a sign, but most of them were not to be believers
verses.tafsir: Surely in that there is a sign; but most of them are not believers.
verses.tafsirV2: (Lo! Herein) in that which We did to them (is indeed a portent) a sign and an admonition for those who came after them; (yet most of them are not believers) they were not believers and most of them were disbelievers.

verses.text: وَإِنَّ رَبَّكَ لَهُوَ ٱلۡعَزِيزُ ٱلرَّحِيمُ
verses.translation: And indeed, your Lord - He is the Exalted in Might, the Merciful
verses.tafsir: Surely your Lord He is the Mighty the Merciful.
verses.tafsirV2: (And lo! thy Lord! He is indeed the Mighty) in retribution against the disbelievers, (the Merciful) towards the believers.

verses.text: وَإِنَّهُۥ لَتَنزِيلُ رَبِّ ٱلۡعَٰلَمِينَ
verses.translation: And indeed, the Qur'an is the revelation of the Lord of the worlds
verses.tafsir: Truly it the Qur’ān is the revelation of the Lord of the Worlds
verses.tafsirV2: (And lo! it is) i.e. the Qur'an (a revelation) an address (of the Lord of the Worlds),

verses.text: نَزَلَ بِهِ ٱلرُّوحُ ٱلۡأَمِينُ
verses.translation: The Trustworthy Spirit has brought it down
verses.tafsir: brought down by the Trustworthy Spirit Gabriel
verses.tafsirV2: (Which the True Spirit hath brought down) Allah sent down Gabriel, the trustworthy Gabriel, to convey the message to His prophets,

verses.text: عَلَىٰ قَلۡبِكَ لِتَكُونَ مِنَ ٱلۡمُنذِرِينَ
verses.translation: Upon your heart, [O Muhammad] - that you may be of the warners
verses.tafsir: upon your heart that you may be one of the warners
verses.tafsirV2: (Upon your heart) according to your memorisation; it is also said that this means: when it was recited to you, (that thou mayst be (one) of the warners) by means of the Qur'an,

verses.text: بِلِسَانٍ عَرَبِيّٖ مُّبِينٖ
verses.translation: In a clear Arabic language
verses.tafsir: in a clear Arabic tongue a variant reading for nazala ‘he brought down’ verse 193 has nuzzila ‘was sent down’ and al-rūha ‘the Spirit’ in the accusative the subject of the verb being God.
verses.tafsirV2: (In plain Arabic speech) He says: the Qur'an is in the Arabic usage; it is also said that this means: inform them, O Muhammad, using their own language.

verses.text: وَإِنَّهُۥ لَفِي زُبُرِ ٱلۡأَوَّلِينَ
verses.translation: And indeed, it is [mentioned] in the scriptures of former peoples
verses.tafsir: And truly it the allusion to the Qur’ān that would be revealed to Muhammad (s) is in the Scriptures the Books of the ancients such as the Torah and the Gospel.
verses.tafsirV2: (And lo, it is) i.e. the description of the Qur'an and Muhammad (pbuh) (in the Scriptures of the men of old) is written in the Scriptures of the prophets who came before you.

verses.text: أَوَلَمۡ يَكُن لَّهُمۡ ءَايَةً أَن يَعۡلَمَهُۥ عُلَمَـٰٓؤُاْ بَنِيٓ إِسۡرَـٰٓءِيلَ
verses.translation: And has it not been a sign to them that it is recognized by the scholars of the Children of Israel
verses.tafsir: Is it not a sign of this fact for them for the disbelievers of Mecca that the learned of the Children of Israel recognise it? those such as ‘Abd Allāh b. Salām and his companions from among those who became Muslim believers they are able inform you of this read yakun with āyatan in the accusative or takun with āyatun in the nominative.
verses.tafsirV2: (Is it not a token) a sign for the prophethood of Muhammad, Allah bless him and give peace, (for them) for the people of Mecca (that the doctors of the Children of Israel know it?) That is, when they asked them about Muhammad (pbuh) and the Qur'an and they informed them about both.

verses.text: وَلَوۡ نَزَّلۡنَٰهُ عَلَىٰ بَعۡضِ ٱلۡأَعۡجَمِينَ
verses.translation: And even if We had revealed it to one among the foreigners
verses.tafsir: For had We revealed it to some non-Arabs a‘jamūn is the plural of a‘jam
verses.tafsirV2: (And if We had revealed it) and if We sent Gabriel with the Qur'an (unto one of any other nation than the Arabs) to a person who spoke no Arabic,

verses.text: فَقَرَأَهُۥ عَلَيۡهِم مَّا كَانُواْ بِهِۦ مُؤۡمِنِينَ
verses.translation: And he had recited it to them [perfectly], they would [still] not have been believers in it
verses.tafsir: and had he recited it to them that is to the disbelievers of Mecca they would not have believed in it disdaining to follow it.
verses.tafsirV2: (And he had read it unto them) unto Quraysh, (they would not have believed in it) i.e. in the Qur'an, because they did not believe in what was in their own language, so how were they to believe in something which is in a different language?

verses.text: كَذَٰلِكَ سَلَكۡنَٰهُ فِي قُلُوبِ ٱلۡمُجۡرِمِينَ
verses.translation: Thus have We inserted disbelief into the hearts of the criminals
verses.tafsir: So in the same way in which We would have caused denial of it to penetrate the hearts of disbelievers had it been recited by a non-Arab We have caused denial of it to penetrate the hearts of the criminals the Meccan disbelievers when Muhammad (s) recites it.
verses.tafsirV2: (Thus do We make it) the denial (traverse the hearts of the guilty) the idolaters: Abu Jahl and his host.

verses.text: لَا يُؤۡمِنُونَ بِهِۦ حَتَّىٰ يَرَوُاْ ٱلۡعَذَابَ ٱلۡأَلِيمَ
verses.translation: They will not believe in it until they see the painful punishment
verses.tafsir: They will not believe in it until they behold the painful chastisement
verses.tafsirV2: (They will not believe in it) so that they do not believe in Muhammad (pbuh) or in the Qur'an (till they behold the painful doom,

verses.text: فَيَأۡتِيَهُم بَغۡتَةٗ وَهُمۡ لَا يَشۡعُرُونَ
verses.translation: And it will come to them suddenly while they perceive [it] not
verses.tafsir: so that it will come upon them suddenly while they are not aware.
verses.tafsirV2: So that it) the torment (will come upon them suddenly, when they perceive not) the coming of the punishment upon them.

verses.text: فَيَقُولُواْ هَلۡ نَحۡنُ مُنظَرُونَ
verses.translation: And they will say, "May we be reprieved
verses.tafsir: Thereupon they will say ‘Shall we be granted any respite?’ that we might become believers?; and it shall be said to them ‘No!’ and they will say ‘When will this chastisement be?’ God exalted be He says
verses.tafsirV2: (Then they will say) when the punishment comes upon them: (Are we to be reprieved) from the punishment?

verses.text: أَفَبِعَذَابِنَا يَسۡتَعۡجِلُونَ
verses.translation: So for Our punishment are they impatient
verses.tafsir: So do they seek to hasten Our chastisement?
verses.tafsirV2: (Would they (now) hasten on Our doom) the coming of Our punishment?

verses.text: أَفَرَءَيۡتَ إِن مَّتَّعۡنَٰهُمۡ سِنِينَ
verses.translation: Then have you considered if We gave them enjoyment for years
verses.tafsir: Consider this then — inform Me If We were to let them enjoy life for many years
verses.tafsirV2: (Hast thou then seen) O Muhammad, (We content them for (long) years) in their state of disbelief,

verses.text: ثُمَّ جَآءَهُم مَّا كَانُواْ يُوعَدُونَ
verses.translation: And then there came to them that which they were promised
verses.tafsir: then there were to come on them that which they have been promised of chastisement
verses.tafsirV2: (And then cometh that which they were promised) of punishment,

verses.text: مَآ أَغۡنَىٰ عَنۡهُم مَّا كَانُواْ يُمَتَّعُونَ
verses.translation: They would not be availed by the enjoyment with which they were provided
verses.tafsir: in what way mā here is interrogative would that enjoyment which they were given avail them? in averting the chastisement or mitigating it? It would be of no avail!
verses.tafsirV2: ((How) that wherewith) Allah's punishment (they were contented) because of the reprieve (naught availeth them) from Allah's punishment?

verses.text: وَمَآ أَهۡلَكۡنَا مِن قَرۡيَةٍ إِلَّا لَهَا مُنذِرُونَ
verses.translation: And We did not destroy any city except that it had warners
verses.tafsir: And We have not destroyed any town but it had warners messengers to warn its inhabitants;
verses.tafsirV2: (And We destroyed no township) no inhabitants of any township (but it had its warners) warning messengers,

verses.text: ذِكۡرَىٰ وَمَا كُنَّا ظَٰلِمِينَ
verses.translation: As a reminder; and never have We been unjust
verses.tafsir: as a reminder an admonition for them; for We were never unjust for We destroy them only after they have been warned. The following was revealed to refute what the idolaters were saying
verses.tafsirV2: (For reminder) they remind them of Allah's punishment, (for We never were oppressors) by destroying them.

verses.text: وَمَا تَنَزَّلَتۡ بِهِ ٱلشَّيَٰطِينُ
verses.translation: And the devils have not brought the revelation down
verses.tafsir: It the Qur’ān has not been brought down by the devils.
verses.tafsirV2: (The devils) at the time of the Prophet (pbuh) (did not bring it down) did not bring the Qur'an down.

verses.text: وَمَا يَنۢبَغِي لَهُمۡ وَمَا يَسۡتَطِيعُونَ
verses.translation: It is not allowable for them, nor would they be able
verses.tafsir: Neither would it behove befit them to bring it down nor are they capable of doing that.
verses.tafsirV2: (It is not meet for them) the devils are not fit to do so, (nor is it in their power) nor could they do this,

verses.text: إِنَّهُمۡ عَنِ ٱلسَّمۡعِ لَمَعۡزُولُونَ
verses.translation: Indeed they, from [its] hearing, are removed
verses.tafsir: Truly they are barred restrained with blazing stars from the hearing of the sayings of the angels.
verses.tafsirV2: (Lo! verily they) i.e. the devils (are banished from the hearing) they are prevented from hearing the revelation.

verses.text: فَلَا تَدۡعُ مَعَ ٱللَّهِ إِلَٰهًا ءَاخَرَ فَتَكُونَ مِنَ ٱلۡمُعَذَّبِينَ
verses.translation: So do not invoke with Allah another deity and [thus] be among the punished
verses.tafsir: So do not invoke any other god with God lest you be among the chastised — if you were to do what they call you to.
verses.tafsirV2: (Therefore invoke not) worship not (with Allah another god) among the idols, (lest thou be one of the doomed) in the Fire.

verses.text: وَأَنذِرۡ عَشِيرَتَكَ ٱلۡأَقۡرَبِينَ
verses.translation: And warn, [O Muhammad], your closest kindred
verses.tafsir: And warn the nearest of your kinsfolk namely the Banū Hāshim and the Banū al-Muttalib ‘He the Prophet warned them publicly …’ as reported by al-Bukhārī and Muslim.
verses.tafsirV2: (And warn thy tribe of near kindred) your blood relations,

verses.text: وَٱخۡفِضۡ جَنَاحَكَ لِمَنِ ٱتَّبَعَكَ مِنَ ٱلۡمُؤۡمِنِينَ
verses.translation: And lower your wing to those who follow you of the believers
verses.tafsir: And lower your wing show your gentle side to the believers the affirmers of God’s Oneness who follow you.
verses.tafsirV2: (And lower thy wing (in kindness) unto those believers who follow thee) be kind to the believers.

verses.text: فَإِنۡ عَصَوۡكَ فَقُلۡ إِنِّي بَرِيٓءٞ مِّمَّا تَعۡمَلُونَ
verses.translation: And if they disobey you, then say, "Indeed, I am disassociated from what you are doing
verses.tafsir: But if they your kinsfolk disobey you say to them ‘I am absolved of what you do’ in worshipping gods other than God.
verses.tafsirV2: (And if they) the Quraysh (disobey thee, say: Lo! I am innocent of what they do) and say.

verses.text: وَتَوَكَّلۡ عَلَى ٱلۡعَزِيزِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ
verses.translation: And rely upon the Exalted in Might, the Merciful
verses.tafsir: And put your trust wa-tawakkal or read fa-tawakkal ‘then put your trust’ in the Mighty the Merciful God in other words entrust Him with all your affairs
verses.tafsirV2: (And put thy trust in the Mighty) in His retribution against His enemies, (the Merciful) towards you and all believers.

verses.text: ٱلَّذِي يَرَىٰكَ حِينَ تَقُومُ
verses.translation: Who sees you when you arise
verses.tafsir: Who sees you when you stand for prayer
verses.tafsirV2: (Who seeth thee when thou standest up) in prayer,

verses.text: وَتَقَلُّبَكَ فِي ٱلسَّـٰجِدِينَ
verses.translation: And your movement among those who prostrate
verses.tafsir: and your movements — in performing the various parts of prayer standing sitting bowing and prostrating — among those who prostrate those who perform the prayers.
verses.tafsirV2: (And (seeth) thine abasement among those who fall prostrate (in worship)) among those who pray in their bowing, prostration and standing up; it is also said that this means: in the loins of your forefathers.

verses.text: إِنَّهُۥ هُوَ ٱلسَّمِيعُ ٱلۡعَلِيمُ
verses.translation: Indeed, He is the Hearing, the Knowing
verses.tafsir: Truly He is the Hearing the Knowing.
verses.tafsirV2: (Lo! He, only He, is the Hearer) of what they say, (the Knower) of them and of their works.

verses.text: هَلۡ أُنَبِّئُكُمۡ عَلَىٰ مَن تَنَزَّلُ ٱلشَّيَٰطِينُ
verses.translation: Shall I inform you upon whom the devils descend
verses.tafsir: Shall I inform you O disbelievers of Mecca upon whom the devils descend? tanazzalu one of the tā’ letters in the original tatanazzalu has been omitted.
verses.tafsirV2: (Shall I inform you upon whom the devils descend) with fortune telling?

verses.text: تَنَزَّلُ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ أَفَّاكٍ أَثِيمٖ
verses.translation: They descend upon every sinful liar
verses.tafsir: They descend upon every sinful profligate liar such as Musaylama and other soothsayers.
verses.tafsirV2: (They descend on every sinful, false one) they descend on every sinful fortune teller: Musaylimah the liar and Talhah.

verses.text: يُلۡقُونَ ٱلسَّمۡعَ وَأَكۡثَرُهُمۡ كَٰذِبُونَ
verses.translation: They pass on what is heard, and most of them are liars
verses.tafsir: They the devils report the heard sayings what they hear from the angels they report to the soothsayers but most of them are liars adding much that is false to what they hear — this was revealed before the devils were barred from the heaven.
verses.tafsirV2: (They listen eagerly) the devils listen eagerly to the speech of the angels, (but most of them are liars) the devils are liars because they hear one thing and convey instead 100 things to fortune tellers.

verses.text: وَٱلشُّعَرَآءُ يَتَّبِعُهُمُ ٱلۡغَاوُۥنَ
verses.translation: And the poets - [only] the deviators follow them
verses.tafsir: As for the poets only the perverse follow them in their poetry propounding it and reciting it on their behalf to others; they are thus reprehensible.
verses.tafsirV2: (As for poets) 'Abdullah Ibn al-Zib'ari and his host who composed poetry, (the erring follow them) those who transmit poetry relate it from them.

verses.text: أَلَمۡ تَرَ أَنَّهُمۡ فِي كُلِّ وَادٖ يَهِيمُونَ
verses.translation: Do you not see that in every valley they roam
verses.tafsir: Have you not noticed that — are you not aware that — in every valley of the valleys of rhetoric and the art thereof they rove overstepping the bounds of decency in their eulogies and diatribes
verses.tafsirV2: (Hast thou not seen how they) the poets (stray) they come and go, sometimes eulogizing and sometimes satirizing (in every valley) in every genre and theme,

verses.text: وَأَنَّهُمۡ يَقُولُونَ مَا لَا يَفۡعَلُونَ
verses.translation: And that they say what they do not do
verses.tafsir: and that they say we do what they do not do? in other words that they lie.
verses.tafsirV2: (And how they say) in their poetry (that which they do not?) they keep mentioning “I” and “I” when things are not as they say; it is also said that this means: they say things which they cannot do; and hence both poet and narrator are in error.

verses.text: إِلَّا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ وَعَمِلُواْ ٱلصَّـٰلِحَٰتِ وَذَكَرُواْ ٱللَّهَ كَثِيرٗا وَٱنتَصَرُواْ مِنۢ بَعۡدِ مَا ظُلِمُواْۗ وَسَيَعۡلَمُ ٱلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوٓاْ أَيَّ مُنقَلَبٖ يَنقَلِبُونَ
verses.translation: Except those [poets] who believe and do righteous deeds and remember Allah often and defend [the Muslims] after they were wronged. And those who have wronged are going to know to what [kind of] return they will be returned
verses.tafsir: Save those poets who believe and perform righteous deeds and remember God frequently in other words those whom poetry does not distract from the remembrance of God and vindicate themselves by lampooning the disbelievers after they have been wronged by the disbelievers’ reviling of them as belonging together with all believers — such individuals are not reprehensible. God exalted be He says God does not like the utterance of evil words out loud unless a person has been wronged Q. 4148; He exalted be He also says so whoever commits aggression against you commit aggression against him in the manner that he committed against you Q. 2194; and those poets and others who are wrongdoers will soon know the reversal the return with which they will meet by which they will return after death.
verses.tafsirV2: (Save those who believe) in Muhammad (pbuh) and in the Qur'an, like Hassan Ibn Thabit and his fellow believing poets (and do good works) between them and their Lord, (and remember Allah much) in their poetry, (and vindicate themselves) through Muhammad (pbuh) and his Companions by answering back the disbelievers (after they have been wronged) after being satirized by the disbelievers. (Those who do wrong) those who satirized the Prophet (pbuh) and his Companions (will come to know by what a (great) reverse they will be overturned!) what kind of destination they will return to in the Hereafter, i.e. the Fire, if they do not believe. And Allah knows best the secrets of His Book'.

verses.text: طسٓۚ تِلۡكَ ءَايَٰتُ ٱلۡقُرۡءَانِ وَكِتَابٖ مُّبِينٍ
verses.translation: Ta, Seen. These are the verses of the Qur'an and a clear Book
verses.tafsir: Tā sīn God knows best what He means by these letters. Those namely these signs are the signs of the Qur’ān signs from it and a Manifest Book manifesting what is truth from what is falsehood wa-kitābin ‘Book’ is a supplement to al-qur’ān with the addition of an adjective mubīn ‘manifest’.
verses.tafsirV2: And from his narration on the authority of Ibn 'Abbas that he said regarding the interpretation of Allah's saying (Ta. Sin.): '(Ta. Sin.) He says: the (Ta) stands for His might (tawluh) and the (Sin) stands for His majesty (sana'uh); it is also said that it is an oath by which Allah swore. (These are revelations of the Qur'an and a Scripture that maketh plain) this surah consists of verses of the Qur'an and it is a Book that makes plain the lawful and the unlawful;

verses.text: هُدٗى وَبُشۡرَىٰ لِلۡمُؤۡمِنِينَ
verses.translation: As guidance and good tidings for the believers
verses.tafsir: It is a guidance guiding from error and good tidings for the believers who believe in it of Paradise;
verses.tafsirV2: (A guidance) from error (and good tidings) that they will gain Paradise (for believers) who are true in their faith.

verses.text: ٱلَّذِينَ يُقِيمُونَ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ وَيُؤۡتُونَ ٱلزَّكَوٰةَ وَهُم بِٱلۡأٓخِرَةِ هُمۡ يُوقِنُونَ
verses.translation: Who establish prayer and give zakah, and of the Hereafter they are certain [in faith]
verses.tafsir: those who observe prayer performing it in the way that it should be performed and give alms and who are certain of the Hereafter knowing it to be true through the many proofs thereof hum ‘they’ is repeated because a separation has taken place between it the first hum and the predicate yūqinūna.
verses.tafsirV2: Allah then showed the attributes of these true believers, saying: (Who establish worship) those who complete the five daily prayers along with their necessary ritual ablution, bowing, prostrating and all that which is obligated in their due times (and pay the poor-due) from their wealth (and are sure of) they believe in (the Hereafter) resurrection after death, Paradise and hell.

verses.text: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ لَا يُؤۡمِنُونَ بِٱلۡأٓخِرَةِ زَيَّنَّا لَهُمۡ أَعۡمَٰلَهُمۡ فَهُمۡ يَعۡمَهُونَ
verses.translation: Indeed, for those who do not believe in the Hereafter, We have made pleasing to them their deeds, so they wander blindly
verses.tafsir: Truly those who do not believe in the Hereafter We have adorned their vile deeds for them by making such deeds seem sensuous so that they then deem them wholesome and so they are bewildered confused about why We deem these deeds to be vile.
verses.tafsirV2: (Lo! as for those who believe not in the Hereafter) those who do not believe in resurrection after death: Abu Jahl and his host, (We have made their works fair-seeming unto them) in their state of disbelief (so that they are all astray) so they proceed blindly, unable to see.

verses.text: أُوْلَـٰٓئِكَ ٱلَّذِينَ لَهُمۡ سُوٓءُ ٱلۡعَذَابِ وَهُمۡ فِي ٱلۡأٓخِرَةِ هُمُ ٱلۡأَخۡسَرُونَ
verses.translation: Those are the ones for whom there will be the worst of punishment, and in the Hereafter they are the greatest losers
verses.tafsir: Those are they for whom there is an awful chastisement the worst chastisement in this world being killed or being taken captive; and in the Hereafter they will be the greatest losers because they will end up in the Fire which has been made everlasting for them.
verses.tafsirV2: (Those) who have this attribute (are they for whom is the worst of punishment) a severe chastisement in the Fire, (and in the Hereafter) on the Day of Judgement (they will be the greatest losers) they will loose Paradise and enter the Fire.

verses.text: وَإِنَّكَ لَتُلَقَّى ٱلۡقُرۡءَانَ مِن لَّدُنۡ حَكِيمٍ عَلِيمٍ
verses.translation: And indeed, [O Muhammad], you receive the Qur'an from one Wise and Knowing
verses.tafsir: And truly you — this is an address to the Prophet s — are receiving the Qur’ān it is being transmitted to you intensely from One Wise Knowing in such transmission.
verses.tafsirV2: (Lo! as for thee) O Muhammad, (thou verily receivest the Qur'an) He says: Gabriel comes down to you with the Qur'an (from the presence of One Wise) in His command and judgement, (Aware) of His created beings.

verses.text: إِذۡ قَالَ مُوسَىٰ لِأَهۡلِهِۦٓ إِنِّيٓ ءَانَسۡتُ نَارٗا سَـَٔاتِيكُم مِّنۡهَا بِخَبَرٍ أَوۡ ءَاتِيكُم بِشِهَابٖ قَبَسٖ لَّعَلَّكُمۡ تَصۡطَلُونَ
verses.translation: [Mention] when Moses said to his family, "Indeed, I have perceived a fire. I will bring you from there information or will bring you a burning torch that you may warm yourselves
verses.tafsir: Mention when Moses said to his family to his wife during his journey from Midian back to Egypt ‘Assuredly I notice I see in the distance a fire. I will bring you news from there about the journey’s route — for he had lost his way — or bring you a firebrand read as a genitive annexation bi-shihābi qabasin as an explication of shihāb ‘flame’; or read without annexation bi-shihābin qabasin meaning a flame of fire at the end of a wick or a wooden stick that perhaps you might warm yourselves’ tastalūn the tā’ replaces the tā’ of the 8th verbal form ifta‘ala sc. istalā; it derives from salaya or saliya ‘to be exposed to the blaze of fire’ that perhaps you might warm yourselves from the cold.
verses.tafsirV2: ((Remember) when Moses said unto his household) when he became unsure about the way: (Lo! I spy afar off a fire) on the left side of the road; stay here (I will bring you tidings thence) news about the right way to take, (or bring to you a borrowed flame that ye may warm yourselves) because this happened in a cold winter.

verses.text: فَلَمَّا جَآءَهَا نُودِيَ أَنۢ بُورِكَ مَن فِي ٱلنَّارِ وَمَنۡ حَوۡلَهَا وَسُبۡحَٰنَ ٱللَّهِ رَبِّ ٱلۡعَٰلَمِينَ
verses.translation: But when he came to it, he was called, "Blessed is whoever is at the fire and whoever is around it. And exalted is Allah, Lord of the worlds
verses.tafsir: But when he reached it he was called with the following words ‘Blessed is he that is to say God bless him who is in the fire namely Moses and who is around it namely the angels — or vice-versa the verb bāraka may be followed immediately by the direct object or by a preposition and then the direct object; a noun such as makān ‘location’ is implied after fī ‘in’ sc. man fī makāni’l-nār ‘who is in the area of the fire’; and Glory be to God the Lord of the Worlds — this is included in the call and is meant to declare that God is above all evil associations.
verses.tafsirV2: (But when he reached it, he was called, saying: Blessed is whosoever is in the Fire) blessed is the Fire (and whosoever is round about it) of angels! This is the reading of Ubayy and 'Abdullah Ibn Mas'ud; it is also said that this means: blessed is He Who lightened this light; and it also said that this means: blessed is he who is seeking, i.e. Moses and whoever is around him of angels, (And glorified be Allah) He exonerated Himself, (the Lord of the Worlds!) the Master of the jinn and human beings.

verses.text: يَٰمُوسَىٰٓ إِنَّهُۥٓ أَنَا ٱللَّهُ ٱلۡعَزِيزُ ٱلۡحَكِيمُ
verses.translation: O Moses, indeed it is I - Allah, the Exalted in Might, the Wise
verses.tafsir: O Moses lo! in other words the fact is that it is I God the Mighty the Wise.
verses.tafsirV2: (O Moses! Lo! it is I) Who is calling you, (Allah, the Mighty) in retribution against those who do not believe in Me, (the Wise) in My command and judgement, I command that none should be worshipped besides Me.

verses.text: وَأَلۡقِ عَصَاكَۚ فَلَمَّا رَءَاهَا تَهۡتَزُّ كَأَنَّهَا جَآنّٞ وَلَّىٰ مُدۡبِرٗا وَلَمۡ يُعَقِّبۡۚ يَٰمُوسَىٰ لَا تَخَفۡ إِنِّي لَا يَخَافُ لَدَيَّ ٱلۡمُرۡسَلُونَ
verses.translation: And [he was told], "Throw down your staff." But when he saw it writhing as if it were a snake, he turned in flight and did not return. [Allah said], "O Moses, fear not. Indeed, in My presence the messengers do not fear
verses.tafsir: Throw down your staff’ and he threw it down. And when he saw it wriggling moving like a serpent a slender snake he turned his back in flight and did not come back. God exalted be He says ‘O Moses do not fear it. Surely in My presence before Me the messengers do not fear any snake or otherwise
verses.tafsirV2: (And throw down thy staff) from your hand! And he threw it, (But when he saw it writhing) moving (as it were a demon) like a serpent which is neither big nor small, (he turned to flee headlong) from it and did not look back out of fear; but Allah said to him: (O Moses! Fear not! Lo! the emissaries fear not in My presence,

verses.text: إِلَّا مَن ظَلَمَ ثُمَّ بَدَّلَ حُسۡنَۢا بَعۡدَ سُوٓءٖ فَإِنِّي غَفُورٞ رَّحِيمٞ
verses.translation: Otherwise, he who wrongs, then substitutes good after evil - indeed, I am Forgiving and Merciful
verses.tafsir: except him who has wronged his soul but then changed his wrong for good — he then performs good deeds — after having done evil in other words he has repented then truly I am Forgiving Merciful I will accept his repentance and forgive him.
verses.tafsirV2: Save him who hath done wrong and afterward hath changed evil for good. And lo! I am Forgiving) I forgive the one who repents, (Merciful) I show mercy towards he who dies in a state of repentance.

verses.text: وَأَدۡخِلۡ يَدَكَ فِي جَيۡبِكَ تَخۡرُجۡ بَيۡضَآءَ مِنۡ غَيۡرِ سُوٓءٖۖ فِي تِسۡعِ ءَايَٰتٍ إِلَىٰ فِرۡعَوۡنَ وَقَوۡمِهِۦٓۚ إِنَّهُمۡ كَانُواْ قَوۡمٗا فَٰسِقِينَ
verses.translation: And put your hand into the opening of your garment [at the breast]; it will come out white without disease. [These are] among the nine signs [you will take] to Pharaoh and his people. Indeed, they have been a people defiantly disobedient
verses.tafsir: And insert your hand into your bosom into the collar of your shirt and it will emerge not in its usual skin colour but white without any blemish any vestige of leprosy with a glare that dazzles the eyes as one sign among nine signs with which you shall be sent as God’s messenger to Pharaoh and his folk; indeed they are an immoral lot’.
verses.tafsirV2: (And put thy hand into the bosom of thy robe) in your armpit, (it will come forth white but unhurt) without having contracted leprosy. Go! ((This will be one) among nine tokens) go with nine signs (unto Pharaoh and his people) the Copts. (Lo! they were ever evil-living folk) they were disbelievers.

verses.text: فَلَمَّا جَآءَتۡهُمۡ ءَايَٰتُنَا مُبۡصِرَةٗ قَالُواْ هَٰذَا سِحۡرٞ مُّبِينٞ
verses.translation: But when there came to them Our visible signs, they said, "This is obvious magic
verses.tafsir: But when Our signs came to them plain to see illuminating and clear they said ‘This is manifest sorcery’ clear and evident sorcery.
verses.tafsirV2: (But when Our tokens came unto them) when Moses went with our tokens to them, (plain to see) demonstrating, one after the other, (they said: This is mere magic) what you have brought us, O Moses, is a manifest lie,

verses.text: وَجَحَدُواْ بِهَا وَٱسۡتَيۡقَنَتۡهَآ أَنفُسُهُمۡ ظُلۡمٗا وَعُلُوّٗاۚ فَٱنظُرۡ كَيۡفَ كَانَ عَٰقِبَةُ ٱلۡمُفۡسِدِينَ
verses.translation: And they rejected them, while their [inner] selves were convinced thereof, out of injustice and haughtiness. So see how was the end of the corrupters
verses.tafsir: And they denied them they did not affirm them though in reality their souls had been convinced in other words though they were certain that these signs were from God wrongfully and arrogantly in defiance of believing in what Moses had brought these two adverbs refer back to the cause of their denial. So behold O Muhammad (s) how was the sequel for the agents of corruption a sequel which you know they were destroyed.
verses.tafsirV2: (And they denied them) they denied the tokens, (though their souls acknowledged them) after being accepted by their souls that they were from Allah, (for spite) out of opposition and enmity (and arrogance) and haughtiness and pride. (Then see) O Muhammad (the nature of the consequence for the wrong-doers) how was the end result of the idolaters, Pharaoh and his people, how We destroyed them in the sea!

verses.text: وَلَقَدۡ ءَاتَيۡنَا دَاوُۥدَ وَسُلَيۡمَٰنَ عِلۡمٗاۖ وَقَالَا ٱلۡحَمۡدُ لِلَّهِ ٱلَّذِي فَضَّلَنَا عَلَىٰ كَثِيرٖ مِّنۡ عِبَادِهِ ٱلۡمُؤۡمِنِينَ
verses.translation: And We had certainly given to David and Solomon knowledge, and they said, "Praise [is due] to Allah, who has favored us over many of His believing servants
verses.tafsir: And verily We gave David and Solomon his son knowledge of rendering decisive judgement between people and knowledge of the speech of birds and of other things and they said giving thanks to God ‘Praise be to God Who has favoured us with prophethood and the disposal of jinn humans and devils to our service over many of His believing servants’.
verses.tafsirV2: (And We verily gave knowledge) and understanding through prophethood and judgeship (unto David) the son of Jesse (and Solomon) the son of David, (and they said) both of them: (Praise be to Allah) thanks and gratitude to Allah, (Who hath preferred us) through knowledge and prophethood (above many of His believing slaves!

verses.text: وَوَرِثَ سُلَيۡمَٰنُ دَاوُۥدَۖ وَقَالَ يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلنَّاسُ عُلِّمۡنَا مَنطِقَ ٱلطَّيۡرِ وَأُوتِينَا مِن كُلِّ شَيۡءٍۖ إِنَّ هَٰذَا لَهُوَ ٱلۡفَضۡلُ ٱلۡمُبِينُ
verses.translation: And Solomon inherited David. He said, "O people, we have been taught the language of birds, and we have been given from all things. Indeed, this is evident bounty
verses.tafsir: And Solomon inherited from David prophethood and knowledge exclusively from among all his other children; and he said ‘O people we have been taught the speech of the birds that is the ability to understand their sounds and we have been given of all things given to prophets and kings. Indeed this gift is the manifest the evident favour’.
verses.tafsirV2: And Solomon was David's heir) as king instead of all the other sons of David who were 19 in number. (And he said) Solomon said: (O mankind! Lo! we have been taught) we were given the understanding of (the language of birds, and have been given (abundance) of all things) and we were given the knowledge of everything in my kingdom. (This surely is evident favour) this is surely a great blessing from Allah.

verses.text: وَحُشِرَ لِسُلَيۡمَٰنَ جُنُودُهُۥ مِنَ ٱلۡجِنِّ وَٱلۡإِنسِ وَٱلطَّيۡرِ فَهُمۡ يُوزَعُونَ
verses.translation: And gathered for Solomon were his soldiers of the jinn and men and birds, and they were [marching] in rows
verses.tafsir: And on one journey Solomon’s hosts of jinn and humans and birds stood assembled for him as they were being arrayed brought together in groups and marshalled.
verses.tafsirV2: (And there were gathered together) and made subservient (unto Solomon his armies of the jinn and humankind, and of the birds, and they were set in battle order) they were all retained from the first to the last until they were gathered together;

verses.text: حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَآ أَتَوۡاْ عَلَىٰ وَادِ ٱلنَّمۡلِ قَالَتۡ نَمۡلَةٞ يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلنَّمۡلُ ٱدۡخُلُواْ مَسَٰكِنَكُمۡ لَا يَحۡطِمَنَّكُمۡ سُلَيۡمَٰنُ وَجُنُودُهُۥ وَهُمۡ لَا يَشۡعُرُونَ
verses.translation: Until, when they came upon the valley of the ants, an ant said, "O ants, enter your dwellings that you not be crushed by Solomon and his soldiers while they perceive not
verses.tafsir: When they came to the Valley of the Ants — which is located either in Tā’if or in Syria and whose ants are either small or large — an ant the queen ant who had seen Solomon’s hosts said ‘O ants enter your dwellings lest Solomon and his hosts crush you while they are unaware!’ — the ants are likened to rational beings in their use of the latter’s speech.
verses.tafsirV2: (Till, when they reached the Valley of the Ants) in Historic Syria, (an ant exclaimed: O ants! Enter your dwellings lest Solomon and his armies crush you) step on you, (unperceiving) unaware of you.

verses.text: فَتَبَسَّمَ ضَاحِكٗا مِّن قَوۡلِهَا وَقَالَ رَبِّ أَوۡزِعۡنِيٓ أَنۡ أَشۡكُرَ نِعۡمَتَكَ ٱلَّتِيٓ أَنۡعَمۡتَ عَلَيَّ وَعَلَىٰ وَٰلِدَيَّ وَأَنۡ أَعۡمَلَ صَٰلِحٗا تَرۡضَىٰهُ وَأَدۡخِلۡنِي بِرَحۡمَتِكَ فِي عِبَادِكَ ٱلصَّـٰلِحِينَ
verses.translation: So [Solomon] smiled, amused at her speech, and said, "My Lord, enable me to be grateful for Your favor which You have bestowed upon me and upon my parents and to do righteousness of which You approve. And admit me by Your mercy into [the ranks of] Your righteous servants
verses.tafsir: Whereat he Solomon smiled fa-tabassama the beginning of the sentence amused dāhikan the end of the sentence at its words which he had heard from three miles away and which was carried to him by the winds. When he was on the verge of entering their valley he Solomon made his hosts halt until they the ants had entered their dwellings — on this journey his hosts consisted of cavalry and infantry. And he said ‘My Lord inspire me to be thankful for Your grace with which You have favoured me and my parents and to do good that will please You and include me by Your mercy among Your righteous servants’ the prophets and saints.
verses.tafsirV2: (And (Solomon) smiled, laughing) in amazement (at her speech) because he heard her speech while his army did not, (and said: My Lord, arouse me) inspire in me (to be thankful for Thy favour wherewith Thou hast favoured me) you have blessed me with the profession of Allah's divine Oneness (and my parents) whom you also blessed with the profession of Allah's divine Oneness, (and to do good) in all sincerity (that shall be pleasing unto Thee) that you would accept (and include me in (the number of) Thy righteous slaves) and include me with Your righteous slaves in Paradise.

verses.text: وَتَفَقَّدَ ٱلطَّيۡرَ فَقَالَ مَالِيَ لَآ أَرَى ٱلۡهُدۡهُدَ أَمۡ كَانَ مِنَ ٱلۡغَآئِبِينَ
verses.translation: And he took attendance of the birds and said, "Why do I not see the hoopoe - or is he among the absent
verses.tafsir: And he reviewed the birds to see the hoopoe — which would locate water beneath the ground and indicate its location by pecking at it whereupon the devils would extract it for Solomon required it for when he prayed; but he could not see him — then he said ‘Why is it that I do not see the hoopoe? in other words is there something preventing me from seeing him? Or is he among the absent? and so I cannot see him because he is absent?’ And when he became certain of the hoopoe’s absence
verses.tafsirV2: (And he sought among the birds) he inspected the birds (and said) when he could not see the hoopoe among them: (How is it that I see not the hoopoe) in his place, (or is he among the absent?)

verses.text: لَأُعَذِّبَنَّهُۥ عَذَابٗا شَدِيدًا أَوۡ لَأَاْذۡبَحَنَّهُۥٓ أَوۡ لَيَأۡتِيَنِّي بِسُلۡطَٰنٖ مُّبِينٖ
verses.translation: I will surely punish him with a severe punishment or slaughter him unless he brings me clear authorization
verses.tafsir: He said ‘Assuredly I will chastise him with a severe chastisement by having all his feathers as well as his tail plucked and leaving him out in the sun where he would not be able to escape from reptiles or I will slaughter him by slitting his throat unless he brings me read la-ya’tiyannī or la-ya’tinannī a clear warrant’ plain manifest proof for his having a valid excuse.
verses.tafsirV2: He said: if he is among the absent, then (I verily will punish him with hard punishment) I will pluck out his feathers; such was the punishment of the birds, (or I verily will slay him, or he verily shall bring me a plain excuse) an acceptable excuse.

verses.text: فَمَكَثَ غَيۡرَ بَعِيدٖ فَقَالَ أَحَطتُ بِمَا لَمۡ تُحِطۡ بِهِۦ وَجِئۡتُكَ مِن سَبَإِۭ بِنَبَإٖ يَقِينٍ
verses.translation: But the hoopoe stayed not long and said, "I have encompassed [in knowledge] that which you have not encompassed, and I have come to you from Sheba with certain news
verses.tafsir: But he did not remain read fa-makutha or fa-makatha long in absence in other words he was away only for a short while and came to Solomon humbly with his head up and his wings and tail lowered. Solomon pardoned him and asked him about what he had encountered during his absence and he said ‘I have discovered something of which you have no knowledge and I have brought you from Sheba this may be read in declined form min Saba’in or left as indeclinable min Saba’a — a tribe in Yemen whose name is taken from the name of one of their ancestors which is also the reason why it may be declined — a verified report.
verses.tafsirV2: (But he was not long in coming, and he said: I have found out (a thing) that thou apprehendest not) O king! I reached a place that you have not reached and have come to know that which you do not, (and I come unto thee from Sheba) the city of Sheba (with sure tidings) with an amazing, true information.

verses.text: إِنِّي وَجَدتُّ ٱمۡرَأَةٗ تَمۡلِكُهُمۡ وَأُوتِيَتۡ مِن كُلِّ شَيۡءٖ وَلَهَا عَرۡشٌ عَظِيمٞ
verses.translation: Indeed, I found [there] a woman ruling them, and she has been given of all things, and she has a great throne
verses.tafsir: I found a woman ruling over them in other words she was their queen her name Bilqīs; and she has been given an abundance of all things that kings might require in the way of machines and instruments and she possesses a great throne — its length was 80 cubits its width 40 cubits its height 30 cubits and was made of gold and silver encrusted with pearls rubies chrysolite and emeralds with its legs made of rubies chrysolite and emeralds containing seven inner doors the door of each chamber shut.
verses.tafsirV2: (Lo! I found a woman ruling over them) whose name is Balqis, (and she hath been given (abundance) of all things) she has been given the knowledge of all things in her country, (and hers is a mighty throne) adorned with gems, pearls, gold and silver.

verses.text: وَجَدتُّهَا وَقَوۡمَهَا يَسۡجُدُونَ لِلشَّمۡسِ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ وَزَيَّنَ لَهُمُ ٱلشَّيۡطَٰنُ أَعۡمَٰلَهُمۡ فَصَدَّهُمۡ عَنِ ٱلسَّبِيلِ فَهُمۡ لَا يَهۡتَدُونَ
verses.translation: I found her and her people prostrating to the sun instead of Allah, and Satan has made their deeds pleasing to them and averted them from [His] way, so they are not guided
verses.tafsir: I found her and her people prostrating to the sun instead of God and Satan has adorned for them their deeds and he has barred them from the Way from the path of truth so that they are not guided
verses.tafsirV2: (I found her and her people worshipping the sun instead of Allah; and Satan maketh their works) their worship of the sun (fair-seeming unto them, and debarreth them from the way (of Truth)) the devil has barred them from the way of Truth and guidance, (so that they go not aright) to the way of truth and guidance:

verses.text: أَلَّاۤ يَسۡجُدُواْۤ لِلَّهِ ٱلَّذِي يُخۡرِجُ ٱلۡخَبۡءَ فِي ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِ وَيَعۡلَمُ مَا تُخۡفُونَ وَمَا تُعۡلِنُونَ
verses.translation: [And] so they do not prostrate to Allah, who brings forth what is hidden within the heavens and the earth and knows what you conceal and what you declare
verses.tafsir: to prostrate themselves to God allā yasjudū should be read as an yasjudū the lā is extra and with it has been assimilated the nūn of an similar to the construction where God says li-allā ya‘lama ahlu’l-kitābi so that the People of the Scripture may know Q. 5729; the sentence functions as the direct object of yahtadūna ‘guided’ whose ilā ‘to’ has been omitted; He Who brings forth the hidden al-khab’ is a verbal noun with the same meaning as al-makhbū’ ‘that which is hidden’ of rain and plants in the heavens and the earth and He knows what they conceal within their hearts and what they proclaim with their tongues.
verses.tafsirV2: (So that they worship not Allah) and I said to them: “O you, prostrate to Allah” it is also said that it is Solomon who said: “why do they not prostrate to Allah?” (Who bringeth forth the hidden in the heavens) the rain (and the earth) vegetation, (and knoweth what ye hide) of good and evil (and what ye proclaim) of good and evil,

verses.text: ٱللَّهُ لَآ إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ رَبُّ ٱلۡعَرۡشِ ٱلۡعَظِيمِ۩
verses.translation: Allah - there is no deity except Him, Lord of the Great Throne
verses.tafsir: God — there is no god except Him the Lord of the Mighty Throne’ this clause constitutes an independent new sentence which is a eulogy comprising praise of the Throne of the Compassionate One to counter the description of the throne of Bilqīs between the two however is an unfathomable difference.
verses.tafsirV2: (Allah; there is no God save Him, the Lord of the tremendous Throne.

verses.text: ۞قَالَ سَنَنظُرُ أَصَدَقۡتَ أَمۡ كُنتَ مِنَ ٱلۡكَٰذِبِينَ
verses.translation: [Solomon] said, "We will see whether you were truthful or were of the liars
verses.tafsir: He Solomon said to the hoopoe ‘We shall see whether you have spoken the truth in what you have informed us or whether you are of the liars that is of their ilk — for to say that is rhetorically more powerful than simply saying ‘or whether you have lied’. He the hoopoe indicated to them the place of the water and it was extracted. They thus drank performed their ablutions and prayed. Solomon then composed a letter in the following form ‘From the servant of God Solomon son of David to Bilqīs Queen of Sheba. In the Name of God the Compassionate the Merciful Peace be upon those who follow Guidance. To wit do not rise up against me in defiance but come to me in submission’. He then stamped it with musk and sealed it with his ring and said to the hoopoe
verses.tafsirV2: (Solomon) said) to the hoopoe: (We shall see whether thou speakest truth or whether thou art of the liars.

verses.text: ٱذۡهَب بِّكِتَٰبِي هَٰذَا فَأَلۡقِهۡ إِلَيۡهِمۡ ثُمَّ تَوَلَّ عَنۡهُمۡ فَٱنظُرۡ مَاذَا يَرۡجِعُونَ
verses.translation: Take this letter of mine and deliver it to them. Then leave them and see what [answer] they will return
verses.tafsir: Take this letter of mine and deliver it to them that is to Bilqīs and her people then turn away withdraw from them but remain close by them and see what response they shall return’ and see what kind of response they shall give. Thus he took it and approached her Bilqīs. But as her soldiers were all around her he cast it into her private chamber. When she saw it she shuddered and was consumed by fear. She read what it said.
verses.tafsirV2: Go with this my letter and throw it down unto them; then turn away) then move away such that they do not see you (and see what (answer) they return) when they read my letter,

verses.text: قَالَتۡ يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلۡمَلَؤُاْ إِنِّيٓ أُلۡقِيَ إِلَيَّ كِتَٰبٞ كَرِيمٌ
verses.translation: She said, "O eminent ones, indeed, to me has been delivered a noble letter
verses.tafsir: Then she said to the noblemen of her people ‘O members of the council lo! read yā ayyuhā’l-mala’u innī pronouncing in the last two words both hamzas; or by not pronouncing the second one and changing it into a wāw with kasra vowelling a noble a sealed letter has been delivered to me.
verses.tafsirV2: He did as Solomon commanded, and Balqis took the letter and went to meet her entourage. ((The Queen of Sheba) said: O chieftains! Lo! there hath been thrown unto me a noble letter) a sealed letter.

verses.text: إِنَّهُۥ مِن سُلَيۡمَٰنَ وَإِنَّهُۥ بِسۡمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحۡمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ
verses.translation: Indeed, it is from Solomon, and indeed, it reads: 'In the name of Allah, the Entirely Merciful, the Especially Merciful
verses.tafsir: It is from Solomon and lo! it is in other words its text says “In the Name of God the Compassionate the Merciful.
verses.tafsirV2: (Lo! it is from Solomon, and lo! it is) the first line of it is: (In the name of Allah the Beneficent, the Merciful;

verses.text: أَلَّا تَعۡلُواْ عَلَيَّ وَأۡتُونِي مُسۡلِمِينَ
verses.translation: Be not haughty with me but come to me in submission [as Muslims]
verses.tafsir: Do not rise up against me in defiance but come to me in submission”’.
verses.tafsirV2: Exalt not yourselves against me) feel not too haughty towards me, (but come unto me as those who surrender) and seek peace; as well as demanding other things which were mentioned in the letter.

verses.text: قَالَتۡ يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلۡمَلَؤُاْ أَفۡتُونِي فِيٓ أَمۡرِي مَا كُنتُ قَاطِعَةً أَمۡرًا حَتَّىٰ تَشۡهَدُونِ
verses.translation: She said, "O eminent ones, advise me in my affair. I would not decide a matter until you witness [for] me
verses.tafsir: She said ‘O members of the council give me an opinion read yā ayyuhā’l-mala’u aftūnī pronouncing both hamzas or by not pronouncing the second and changing it into a wāw in other words guide me in this matter of mine. I never decide on a matter I never conclude it until you are present’.
