verses.translation: And if We willed, We could have deformed them, [paralyzing them] in their places so they would not be able to proceed, nor could they return
verses.tafsir: And had We willed We would have transformed them into apes or swine or stones in their place makānatihim variant reading has makānātihim the plural of makāna meaning makān in other words ‘in their dwellings’; then they would have neither been able to go ahead nor to return in other words they would not then be able to come and go.
verses.tafsirV2: (And had We willed, We verily could have fixed them in their place) We could have turned them into apes and swine in their own homes, (making them powerless to go forward) making them unable to come and go (or turn back) to their initial state.

verses.text: وَمَن نُّعَمِّرۡهُ نُنَكِّسۡهُ فِي ٱلۡخَلۡقِۚ أَفَلَا يَعۡقِلُونَ
verses.translation: And he to whom We grant long life We reverse in creation; so will they not understand
verses.tafsir: And whomever We give long life by prolonging his term of life We cause him to regress nankushu; a variant reading has 2nd verbal form nunakkishu derived from al-tankīs in creation that is in terms of his physical form so that after having enjoyed strength and youth he becomes feeble and decrepit. Will they then not understand? that One Who is able to effect such a state — with which they are familiar — is also able to resurrect that they might then become believers? a variant reading for ya‘qilūna ‘they understand’ has the second person plural ta‘qilūna ‘you understand’.
verses.tafsirV2: (He whom We bring unto old age, We reverse him in creation (making him go back to weakness after strength)) until he becomes like a little child, possessing no teeth or power, he urinates and defecates on himself like a young child. (Have ye then no sense) do you then not believe in this?

verses.text: وَمَا عَلَّمۡنَٰهُ ٱلشِّعۡرَ وَمَا يَنۢبَغِي لَهُۥٓۚ إِنۡ هُوَ إِلَّا ذِكۡرٞ وَقُرۡءَانٞ مُّبِينٞ
verses.translation: And We did not give Prophet Muhammad, knowledge of poetry, nor is it befitting for him. It is not but a message and a clear Qur'an
verses.tafsir: And We did not teach him that is the Prophet poetry — this was revealed to refute their saying ‘This Qur’ān that he has brought is but poetry!’ — nor is it poetry seemly nor is it facilitated for him. It — that which he has brought — is just Remembrance an admonition and a Qur’ān that clarifies that manifests God’s rulings and other matters;
verses.tafsirV2: (And we have not taught him) i.e. Muhammad (pbuh) (poetry, nor is it meet for him) poetry is not appropriate for him. (This is) i.e. the Qur'an (naught else than a Reminder) an admonition (and a Lecture making plain) the lawful and unlawful, the commands and prohibitions,

verses.text: لِّيُنذِرَ مَن كَانَ حَيّٗا وَيَحِقَّ ٱلۡقَوۡلُ عَلَى ٱلۡكَٰفِرِينَ
verses.translation: To warn whoever is alive and justify the word against the disbelievers
verses.tafsir: that he may warn li-yundhira; or read li-tundhira ‘that you may warn’ therewith whoever is alive able to comprehend what is being said to him — and such are the believers — and that the Word of chastisement from God may be fulfilled against the disbelievers who are like the dead unable to comprehend what is said to them.
verses.tafsirV2: (To warn) so that Muhammad (pbuh) warns by means of the Qur'an (whosoever liveth) whoever has an intellect, (and that the word) enjoining wrath and punishment (may be fulfilled against the disbelievers) of Mecca such that they do not believe in Muhammad (pbuh) or in the Qur'an.

verses.text: أَوَلَمۡ يَرَوۡاْ أَنَّا خَلَقۡنَا لَهُم مِّمَّا عَمِلَتۡ أَيۡدِينَآ أَنۡعَٰمٗا فَهُمۡ لَهَا مَٰلِكُونَ
verses.translation: Do they not see that We have created for them from what Our hands have made, grazing livestock, and [then] they are their owners
verses.tafsir: Or have they not seen have they not realised the interrogative is meant as an affirmative and the wāw inserted therein in a-wa-lam is for supplementation that We have created for them and for all human beings of what Our hands worked of what We have made without any partner or helper cattle namely camels cows and sheep so that they are their owners? masters controlling them.
verses.tafsirV2: (Have they not seen) have they not been informed (how We have created for them) for the people of Mecca (of Our handiwork) by means of Our power (the cattle, so that they are their owners) and controllers,

verses.text: وَذَلَّلۡنَٰهَا لَهُمۡ فَمِنۡهَا رَكُوبُهُمۡ وَمِنۡهَا يَأۡكُلُونَ
verses.translation: And We have tamed them for them, so some of them they ride, and some of them they eat
verses.tafsir: And We have subdued We have disposed these cattle for them so that some of them provide rides for them and some of them they eat.
verses.tafsirV2: (And have subdued them unto them) and made the cattle subservient to them, (so that some of them they have for riding, some for food) their meat is food for them?

verses.text: وَلَهُمۡ فِيهَا مَنَٰفِعُ وَمَشَارِبُۚ أَفَلَا يَشۡكُرُونَ
verses.translation: And for them therein are [other] benefits and drinks, so will they not be grateful
verses.tafsir: And there are other benefits for them therein such as their wool fur and hairs and drinks made from their milk mashārib is the plural of mashrab meaning shurb ‘a drink’; or what is meant is the place from which the drink issues. Will they not then give thanks? to the One Who has bestowed these graces upon them and so become believers? In other words they do not do any of this.
verses.tafsirV2: (Benefits) carrying their loads and trading through them (and (divers) drinks) from their milk (have they) i.e. the people of Mecca (from them) from the cattle. (Will they not then give thanks) to He Who did this for them and, thus, believe in Him?

verses.text: وَٱتَّخَذُواْ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ ءَالِهَةٗ لَّعَلَّهُمۡ يُنصَرُونَ
verses.translation: But they have taken besides Allah [false] deities that perhaps they would be helped
verses.tafsir: And they have taken besides God in other words other than Him other gods idols which they worship that perhaps they might be helped protected against God’s chastisement by their gods’ interceding for them as they are wont to claim.
verses.tafsirV2: (And they have) and the disbelievers of Mecca worshipped ((other) gods) idols (beside Allah, in order that they may be helped) so that they may save them from Allah's punishment.

verses.text: لَا يَسۡتَطِيعُونَ نَصۡرَهُمۡ وَهُمۡ لَهُمۡ جُندٞ مُّحۡضَرُونَ
verses.translation: They are not able to help them, and they [themselves] are for them soldiers in attendance
verses.tafsir: They their gods cannot help them — they are being treated as though they were rational beings — and they their idol gods are their host as they claim their supporters ever-present but in the Fire together with them.
verses.tafsirV2: (It is not in their power to help them) the idols are unable to save them from Allah's chastisement; (but they) i.e. the disbelievers of Mecca (are unto them) in falsehood (a host in arms) like slaves standing before the idols.

verses.text: فَلَا يَحۡزُنكَ قَوۡلُهُمۡۘ إِنَّا نَعۡلَمُ مَا يُسِرُّونَ وَمَا يُعۡلِنُونَ
verses.translation: So let not their speech grieve you. Indeed, We know what they conceal and what they declare
verses.tafsir: So do not be grieved by their remarks to you that you have not been sent by God and otherwise. Assuredly We know what they conceal and what they proclaim in this respect and otherwise and We will requite them accordingly.
verses.tafsirV2: (So let not their speech) their denial (grieve thee) O Muhammad. (Lo! We know what they conceal) of plotting and treachery (and proclaim) of enmity.

verses.text: أَوَلَمۡ يَرَ ٱلۡإِنسَٰنُ أَنَّا خَلَقۡنَٰهُ مِن نُّطۡفَةٖ فَإِذَا هُوَ خَصِيمٞ مُّبِينٞ
verses.translation: Does man not consider that We created him from a [mere] sperm-drop - then at once he is a clear adversary
verses.tafsir: Or has man — namely the like of al-‘Āsī b. Wā’il — not seen has he not realised that We created him from a drop of sperm and so on in stages until We made him powerful and strong. Then lo! he is an open adversary severely antagonistic towards Us openly making this manifest by his denial of resurrection.
verses.tafsirV2: (Hath not man seen) does not Ubayy Ibn Khalaf know (that We have created him from a drop of seed) of a weak and stinking sperm drop? (Yet lo! he is an open opponent) he openly argues in falsehood.

verses.text: وَضَرَبَ لَنَا مَثَلٗا وَنَسِيَ خَلۡقَهُۥۖ قَالَ مَن يُحۡيِ ٱلۡعِظَٰمَ وَهِيَ رَمِيمٞ
verses.translation: And he presents for Us an example and forgets his [own] creation. He says, "Who will give life to bones while they are disintegrated
verses.tafsir: And he strikes for Us a similitude in this respect and forgets the manner of his creation from a sperm-drop a thing more curious than his similitude; he says ‘Who will revive the bones when they are rot?’ in other words when they have become withered He does not say ramīmatun ‘decayed’ because it ramīmun ‘rot’ is a noun and not an adjective. It is reported that he al-‘Āsī took some withered bones and crushed them into pieces and said to the Prophet s ‘Do you think that God can revive these bones after they have decayed and become rot?’ And so the Prophet s said ‘Yes indeed! And He will also throw you into the Fire’.
verses.tafsirV2: (And he hath coined for Us a similitude) he gave Us a similitude regarding bones, (and hath forgotten the fact of his creation) he left out the mention of his initial creation, (saying: Who will revive these bones when they have rotted away) who will revive these bones when they become dust?

verses.text: قُلۡ يُحۡيِيهَا ٱلَّذِيٓ أَنشَأَهَآ أَوَّلَ مَرَّةٖۖ وَهُوَ بِكُلِّ خَلۡقٍ عَلِيمٌ
verses.translation: Say, "He will give them life who produced them the first time; and He is, of all creation, Knowing
verses.tafsir: Say ‘He will revive them Who originated them the first time and He is Knower of all creation of every single creature generally and in detail before and after it has been created —
verses.tafsirV2: (Say) to him, O Muhammad: (He will revive them Who produced them) Who created them (at the first) from a sperm drop, (for He is Knower of every creation) He is Knower of the creation of everything,

verses.text: ٱلَّذِي جَعَلَ لَكُم مِّنَ ٱلشَّجَرِ ٱلۡأَخۡضَرِ نَارٗا فَإِذَآ أَنتُم مِّنۡهُ تُوقِدُونَ
verses.translation: [It is] He who made for you from the green tree, fire, and then from it you ignite
verses.tafsir: He Who has made for you and for all human beings fire from the green tree namely from the markh and ‘afār variety or from all trees except for the jujube ‘unnāb and behold from it you kindle’ from it you strike fire this is proof of the power of God to resurrect for in this example of the green tree He has combined the elements of water fire and wood; but neither the water extinguishes the fire nor does the fire ignite the wood.
verses.tafsirV2: (Who hath appointed for you fire) other than the Fire of punishment (from the green tree, and behold! Ye) O people of Mecca (kindle from it) you derive from the green tree fire.

verses.text: أَوَلَيۡسَ ٱلَّذِي خَلَقَ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضَ بِقَٰدِرٍ عَلَىٰٓ أَن يَخۡلُقَ مِثۡلَهُمۚ بَلَىٰ وَهُوَ ٱلۡخَلَّـٰقُ ٱلۡعَلِيمُ
verses.translation: Is not He who created the heavens and the earth Able to create the likes of them? Yes, [it is so]; and He is the Knowing Creator
verses.tafsir: Is not He Who created the heavens and the earth in all their immensity able to create the like of them? namely human beings in all their minuteness? Yes indeed He is able to do this — God Himself replies here. And He is the Creator khallāq means Creator of many things the Knower of all things.
verses.tafsirV2: (Is not He Who created the heavens and the earth Able to create) to revive (the like of them? Aye that He is!) He is Able to do so, (for He is the All-Wise Creator) Who will resurrect the dead,

verses.text: إِنَّمَآ أَمۡرُهُۥٓ إِذَآ أَرَادَ شَيۡـًٔا أَن يَقُولَ لَهُۥ كُن فَيَكُونُ
verses.translation: His command is only when He intends a thing that He says to it, "Be," and it is
verses.tafsir: His command His affair when He wills a thing that is when He will to create something is just to say to it ‘Be’ and it is a variant reading for fa-yakūnu has fa-yakūna as a supplement to yaqūla ‘to say’.
verses.tafsirV2: (But His command) regarding the resurrection, (when He intends a thing) when He wishes the resurrection to take place, (is only that he says unto it: Be! and it is) and the coming of the Hour happens.

verses.text: فَسُبۡحَٰنَ ٱلَّذِي بِيَدِهِۦ مَلَكُوتُ كُلِّ شَيۡءٖ وَإِلَيۡهِ تُرۡجَعُونَ
verses.translation: So exalted is He in whose hand is the realm of all things, and to Him you will be returned
verses.tafsir: So glory be to Him in Whose hand is the dominion of all things malakūt means mulk the wāw and tā’ have been added for hyperbole and to Whom you will be returned restored in the Hereafter.
verses.tafsirV2: (Therefore glory be to Him) Allah glorified Himself (in Whose hand is the dominion over all things) the stores of all things and the creating of all things! (Unto Him you will be brought back) after death and He will requite you each according to his works'.

verses.text: وَٱلصَّـٰٓفَّـٰتِ صَفّٗا
verses.translation: By those [angels] lined up in rows
verses.tafsir: By those who are ranged in ranks — by the angels who range their souls in worship or their wings in the air awaiting their orders;
verses.tafsirV2: And from his narration on the authority of Ibn 'Abbas that he said regarding the interpretation of Allah's saying (By those who set the ranks in battle order): '(By those who set the ranks in battle order) Allah swore by the angels who are, in heaven, aligned in rows like the rows of the believers in prayer.

verses.text: فَٱلزَّـٰجِرَٰتِ زَجۡرٗا
verses.translation: And those who drive [the clouds]
verses.tafsir: and the drivers who drive away the angels who drive the clouds;
verses.tafsirV2: (And those who drive away with reproof) He also swore by the angels who drive away the clouds and bring them together.

verses.text: فَٱلتَّـٰلِيَٰتِ ذِكۡرًا
verses.translation: And those who recite the message
verses.tafsir: and those who recite that is to say the readers of the Qur’ān they recite it by way remembrance dhikran is a verbal noun referring to the action of al-tāliyāt ‘those who recite’.
verses.tafsirV2: (And those who read (the Word) for a reminder) He swore by the angels who recite the Qur'an; it is also said that He swore by the reciters of the Qur'an,

verses.text: إِنَّ إِلَٰهَكُمۡ لَوَٰحِدٞ
verses.translation: Indeed, your God is One
verses.tafsir: Indeed your God O people of Mecca is certainly One
verses.tafsirV2: (Lo! thy Lord is surely One) without a son or partner; this oath says: O people of Mecca, your Lord is One, He has no son or partner.

verses.text: رَّبُّ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِ وَمَا بَيۡنَهُمَا وَرَبُّ ٱلۡمَشَٰرِقِ
verses.translation: Lord of the heavens and the earth and that between them and Lord of the sunrises
verses.tafsir: Lord of the heavens and the earth and all that is between them and Lord of the sun’s risings that is as well as the sun’s settings — each day it the sun has a rising and a setting.
verses.tafsirV2: (Lord of the heavens and of the earth) the Creator of the heavens and of the earth (and all that is between them) of created beings and marvels, (and Lord of the sun's risings) the risings of winter and summer.

verses.text: إِنَّا زَيَّنَّا ٱلسَّمَآءَ ٱلدُّنۡيَا بِزِينَةٍ ٱلۡكَوَاكِبِ
verses.translation: Indeed, We have adorned the nearest heaven with an adornment of stars
verses.tafsir: We have indeed adorned the lowest heaven with an adornment the stars that is to say adorned with their light or with them the stars the genitive annexation bi-zīnati’l-kawākib is for explication; similarly explicative is the reading of bi-zīnatin ‘with an adornment’ with nunation the adornment explained as being ‘the stars’;
verses.tafsirV2: (Lo! We have adorned the lowest heaven) the first heaven (with an ornament, the planets) He says: the first heaven is adorned with planets:

verses.text: وَحِفۡظٗا مِّن كُلِّ شَيۡطَٰنٖ مَّارِدٖ
verses.translation: And as protection against every rebellious devil
verses.tafsir: and to guard wa-hifzan is in the accusative because of an implied verb that is to say ‘We have guarded it with meteors’ from every min kulli is semantically connected to the implied verb any rebellious devil who is a transgressor in rebellion against obedience.
verses.tafsirV2: (With security) He says: they are made safe (from every froward devil) from every tough, rebellious devil.

verses.text: لَّا يَسَّمَّعُونَ إِلَى ٱلۡمَلَإِ ٱلۡأَعۡلَىٰ وَيُقۡذَفُونَ مِن كُلِّ جَانِبٖ
verses.translation: [So] they may not listen to the exalted assembly [of angels] and are pelted from every side
verses.tafsir: They namely the devils lā yasma‘ūna this is the beginning of a new sentence cannot listen in — this ‘listening’ of theirs represents that faculty with which they memorise what they hear — on the High Council the angels in the heavens the normally transitive verb al-samā‘ is complemented with the preposition ilā ‘to’ here ‘in on’ because it includes the additional sense of ‘paying attention’ while listening; a variant reading has yassamma‘una which is actually yatasamma‘ūna the tā’ have been assimilated with the sīn for they the devils are pelted with flames from every side from the remotest regions of the heavens
verses.tafsirV2: (They cannot listen) so that they do not listen (to the Highest Chiefs) to the speech of the angels, i.e. the guardian angels, regarding that which is communicated amongst them (for they are pelted from every side) they rise up to,

verses.text: دُحُورٗاۖ وَلَهُمۡ عَذَابٞ وَاصِبٌ
verses.translation: Repelled; and for them is a constant punishment
verses.tafsir: to repel them duhūran is a verbal noun from daharahu meaning ‘he repelled him driving him away’; it is an object denoting reason and theirs in the Hereafter is an everlasting chastisement;
verses.tafsirV2: (Outcast) they are driven away from heaven and from listening to the angels, (and theirs is a perpetual torment) by means of the stars; and it is also said that this means: in the Fire;

verses.text: إِلَّا مَنۡ خَطِفَ ٱلۡخَطۡفَةَ فَأَتۡبَعَهُۥ شِهَابٞ ثَاقِبٞ
verses.translation: Except one who snatches [some words] by theft, but they are pursued by a burning flame, piercing [in brightness]
verses.tafsir: except him who snatches a fragment al-khatfa is the verbal noun that is to say ‘that one time’; the exceptive clause refers to the subject of the verb yasma‘ūna in other words ‘the only devil that is able to listen is the one that hears a word from the angels and snatches it away quickly’ and who is then pursued by a piercing flame shihāb is a meteor that pierces him or burns him or robs him of his senses.
verses.tafsirV2: (Save him who snatcheth a fragment) save him who snatches a little of the words of the angels, (and there pursueth him a piercing flame) and is chased by a bright star which burns him.

verses.text: فَٱسۡتَفۡتِهِمۡ أَهُمۡ أَشَدُّ خَلۡقًا أَم مَّنۡ خَلَقۡنَآۚ إِنَّا خَلَقۡنَٰهُم مِّن طِينٖ لَّازِبِۭ
verses.translation: Then inquire of them, [O Muhammad], "Are they a stronger [or more difficult] creation or those [others] We have created?" Indeed, We created men from sticky clay
verses.tafsir: So ask them in other words inquire of the people of Mecca for affirmation or by way of rebuke Are they stronger as a creation or those others whom We created? of angels heavens the two earths and all that is in them the use of man ‘those whom’ in man khalaqnā indicates that the reference is predominantly to other rational creatures. Indeed We created them that is their origin Adam from a viscous clay that sticks to the hand. The intended meaning is that their physical make-up is fragile so let them not behave arrogantly by rejecting the Prophet and the Qur’ān a fact which will result in their — easily accomplished — destruction.
verses.tafsirV2: (Then ask them (O Muhammad)) ask the people of Mecca: (Are they stronger as a creation) as a resurrected people, (or those (others) whom We have created) of angels and all other people? (Lo! We created them of plastic) sticking (clay) We created them from Adam and Adam is from clay.

verses.text: بَلۡ عَجِبۡتَ وَيَسۡخَرُونَ
verses.translation: But you wonder, while they mock
verses.tafsir: Nay but bal is for effecting a transition from one object to another which in this case is to inform of his state and theirs you marvel ‘ajibta addressing the Prophet s that is you marvel that they deny you while they engage in ridicule at your marvelling
verses.tafsirV2: (Nay, but thou dost) O Muhammad (marvel) their denial of you (when they mock) you and your Scripture.

verses.text: وَإِذَا ذُكِّرُواْ لَا يَذۡكُرُونَ
verses.translation: And when they are reminded, they remember not
verses.tafsir: and even when they are reminded when they are admonished with the Qur’ān they are not mindful they do not heed the admonition
verses.tafsirV2: (And heed not) and take no admonition (when they are reminded) by the Qur'an,

verses.text: وَإِذَا رَأَوۡاْ ءَايَةٗ يَسۡتَسۡخِرُونَ
verses.translation: And when they see a sign, they ridicule
verses.tafsir: and when they see a sign such as the splitting of the moon cf. Q. 541 they make it an object of ridicule they deride it.
verses.tafsirV2: (And seek to scoff when they) the people of Mecca (behold a portent) a sign such as the splitting of the moon and the eclipse of the sun.

verses.text: وَقَالُوٓاْ إِنۡ هَٰذَآ إِلَّا سِحۡرٞ مُّبِينٌ
verses.translation: And say, "This is not but obvious magic
verses.tafsir: And they say regarding it ‘This is nothing but manifest sorcery — and they say in denial of the Resurrection —
verses.tafsirV2: (And they say: lo! This) which Muhammad (pbuh) brought us (is mere magic) a manifest lie;

verses.text: أَءِذَا مِتۡنَا وَكُنَّا تُرَابٗا وَعِظَٰمًا أَءِنَّا لَمَبۡعُوثُونَ
verses.translation: When we have died and become dust and bones, are we indeed to be resurrected
verses.tafsir: When we are dead and have become dust and bones shall we indeed be resurrected? In both places sc. a-idhā and a-innā either pronounce both hamzas or read without pronouncing the second one and inserting an alif between them in both cases.
verses.tafsirV2: (When we are dead and have become dust and) withered (bones, shall we then, forsooth, be raised (again)) shall we then be brought back to life after we die? Say to them, O Muhammad: indeed you shall.

verses.text: أَوَءَابَآؤُنَا ٱلۡأَوَّلُونَ
verses.translation: And our forefathers [as well]
verses.tafsir: And our forefathers too?’ read aw ābā’unā indicating a supplement; or read a-wa-ābā’unā as an interrogative effecting the supplement with the wāw; so that what is being supplemented is either the inna together with its subject sc. a-inna la-mab‘ūthūna or the subject of the verb la-mab‘ūthūna in which case the interrogative hamza is a separator.
verses.tafsirV2: They asked: (And our forefathers) shall they be raised again?

verses.text: قُلۡ نَعَمۡ وَأَنتُمۡ دَٰخِرُونَ
verses.translation: Say, "Yes, and you will be [rendered] contemptible
verses.tafsir: Say ‘Yes you will be resurrected and you will be utterly humiliated!’
verses.tafsirV2: (Say (O Muhammad): Yea, in truth; and ye) and them (will be brought low) abased and humiliated.

verses.text: فَإِنَّمَا هِيَ زَجۡرَةٞ وَٰحِدَةٞ فَإِذَا هُمۡ يَنظُرُونَ
verses.translation: It will be only one shout, and at once they will be observing
verses.tafsir: For it will be only innamā hiya this hiya is a demonstrative pronoun explained by the following zajratun a single cry and lo! they all creatures will be alive watching to see what will be done with them.
verses.tafsirV2: (There is but one Shout) it is but one single blow, which is the blowing of the Resurrection, (and lo!) they emerge from the graves and (they behold) what they will be commanded to do.

verses.text: وَقَالُواْ يَٰوَيۡلَنَا هَٰذَا يَوۡمُ ٱلدِّينِ
verses.translation: They will say, "O woe to us! This is the Day of Recompense
verses.tafsir: And they the disbelievers will say ‘O yā is for calling attention woe to us!’ O our destruction is here waylanā is a verbal noun without any regular verbal conjugation. And the angels will say to them ‘This is the Day of Retribution’ the Day of Reckoning and Requital.
verses.tafsirV2: (And say) when they come forth from their graves: (Ah, woe for us! This is the Day of Judgement) this is the Day of Reckoning.

verses.text: هَٰذَا يَوۡمُ ٱلۡفَصۡلِ ٱلَّذِي كُنتُم بِهِۦ تُكَذِّبُونَ
verses.translation: [They will be told], "This is the Day of Judgement which you used to deny
verses.tafsir: ‘This is the Day of Judgement between all creatures that you used to deny!’
verses.tafsirV2: And the angels will say to them: (This is the Day of Separation) the Day of Judgement between you and the believers, (which ye used to deny) in the life of this world.

verses.text: ۞ٱحۡشُرُواْ ٱلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُواْ وَأَزۡوَٰجَهُمۡ وَمَا كَانُواْ يَعۡبُدُونَ
verses.translation: [The angels will be ordered], "Gather those who committed wrong, their kinds, and what they used to worship
verses.tafsir: It is then said to the angels ‘Gather those who did wrong to their own souls through idolatry together with their mates their associates from among the devils and what they used to worship
verses.tafsirV2: Allah would then say to the angels: (Assemble those who did wrong) assemble those who associated partners with Allah, (together with their wives) with their friends and those who are of their calibre from among the jinn, humans and satans (and what they used to worship) of idols

verses.text: مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ فَٱهۡدُوهُمۡ إِلَىٰ صِرَٰطِ ٱلۡجَحِيمِ
verses.translation: Other than Allah, and guide them to the path of Hellfire
verses.tafsir: besides God in other words other than Him in the way of graven images and lead them direct them and drive them to the path of Hell the way to the Fire.
verses.tafsirV2: (Instead of Allah, and lead them to the path to hell) to the middle of hell;

verses.text: وَقِفُوهُمۡۖ إِنَّهُم مَّسۡـُٔولُونَ
verses.translation: And stop them; indeed, they are to be questioned
verses.tafsir: But first stop them detain them on the path for they must be questioned about all their sayings and deeds and it will be said to them in rebuke
verses.tafsirV2: Allah would also say to the angels: (And stop them) detain them in hell, (for they must be questioned) about this claim; it is also said that this means: they will be questioned about their rejection of “there is no deity except Allah”.

verses.text: مَا لَكُمۡ لَا تَنَاصَرُونَ
verses.translation: [They will be asked], "What is [wrong] with you? Why do you not help each other
verses.tafsir: “What is wrong with you that you do not help one another?” as was the case with you in this world. And it will be said to them
verses.tafsirV2: (What aileth you that ye help not one another?) how is it that you do not save yourselves from Allah's chastisement, or help one another to avoid Allah's chastisement?

verses.text: بَلۡ هُمُ ٱلۡيَوۡمَ مُسۡتَسۡلِمُونَ
verses.translation: But they, that Day, are in surrender
verses.tafsir: Nay but today they offer complete submission they are compliant abased.
verses.tafsirV2: (Nay, but this day) which is the Day of Judgement (they make full submission) the worshipper and the worshipped submitted to Allah and knew that the Truth is with Allah.

verses.text: وَأَقۡبَلَ بَعۡضُهُمۡ عَلَىٰ بَعۡضٖ يَتَسَآءَلُونَ
verses.translation: And they will approach one another blaming each other
verses.tafsir: And some of them will turn to others questioning each other blaming one another and disputing.
verses.tafsirV2: (And some of them draw near unto others) the humans go to the satans and the lowly among people go to the leaders, (mutually questioning) reproaching one another and arguing.

verses.text: قَالُوٓاْ إِنَّكُمۡ كُنتُمۡ تَأۡتُونَنَا عَنِ ٱلۡيَمِينِ
verses.translation: They will say, "Indeed, you used to come at us from the right
verses.tafsir: They that is the followers among them will say to those whom they followed ‘Indeed you used to approach us from the right’ in other words from that aspect in which we used to trust you for you used to swear that you followed the truth and so we believed you and we followed you — in other words ‘Indeed you have led us astray!’
verses.tafsirV2: (They say) i.e. the humans say to the satans: (Lo! ye used to come unto us, imposing, (swearing that ye spoke the Truth)) and enticing us to reject Religion.

verses.text: قَالُواْ بَل لَّمۡ تَكُونُواْ مُؤۡمِنِينَ
verses.translation: The oppressors will say, "Rather, you [yourselves] were not believers
verses.tafsir: They the ones who were followed say to them the followers ‘On the contrary! You were simply not believers for it would only be true that we led you astray if you had actually been believers in the first place and then rejected faith and followed us.
verses.tafsirV2: (They answer) the satans would answer the humans: (Nay, but ye (yourselves) were not believers) in Allah.

verses.text: وَمَا كَانَ لَنَا عَلَيۡكُم مِّن سُلۡطَٰنِۭۖ بَلۡ كُنتُمۡ قَوۡمٗا طَٰغِينَ
verses.translation: And we had over you no authority, but you were a transgressing people
verses.tafsir: And we did not have any warrant any sway or power over you to compel you to follow us. Nay but you yourselves were a rebellious folk astray like us.
verses.tafsirV2: (We had no power over you) we had no reason or proof to win you over, (but ye were wayward folk) but you were disbelievers in Allah.

verses.text: فَحَقَّ عَلَيۡنَا قَوۡلُ رَبِّنَآۖ إِنَّا لَذَآئِقُونَ
verses.translation: So the word of our Lord has come into effect upon us; indeed, we will taste [punishment]
verses.tafsir: So our Lord’s Words of chastisement — namely His Words ‘Verily I shall fill Hell with jinn and mankind together’ Q. 11119 — have become due against us both. Indeed we shall both taste the chastisement with these Words — which prompts them to say
verses.tafsirV2: (Now the Word of our Lord) that His chastisement and wrath will be enjoined upon us (hath been fulfilled concerning us. Lo! we are about to taste (the doom)) of the Fire.

verses.text: فَأَغۡوَيۡنَٰكُمۡ إِنَّا كُنَّا غَٰوِينَ
verses.translation: And we led you to deviation; indeed, we were deviators
verses.tafsir: So we led you astray — the reason for which is given by their saying — indeed we ourselves were astray’.
verses.tafsirV2: (Thus we misled you) from Religion. (Lo! we were (ourselves) astray) from Religion.

verses.text: فَإِنَّهُمۡ يَوۡمَئِذٖ فِي ٱلۡعَذَابِ مُشۡتَرِكُونَ
verses.translation: So indeed they, that Day, will be sharing in the punishment
verses.tafsir: God exalted be He says So they on that day the Day of Resurrection will share in the chastisement for they shared in the error.
verses.tafsirV2: (Then lo! this day) which is the Day of Judgement (they (both) are sharers in the doom) the worshipper and those worshipped.

verses.text: إِنَّا كَذَٰلِكَ نَفۡعَلُ بِٱلۡمُجۡرِمِينَ
verses.translation: Indeed, that is how We deal with the criminals
verses.tafsir: Indeed so in the same way that We deal with these We deal with sinners other than these in other words We chastise both of them the followers and those who were followed.
verses.tafsirV2: (Lo! thus deal We with the guilty) thus We deal with the idolaters.

verses.text: إِنَّهُمۡ كَانُوٓاْ إِذَا قِيلَ لَهُمۡ لَآ إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا ٱللَّهُ يَسۡتَكۡبِرُونَ
verses.translation: Indeed they, when it was said to them, "There is no deity but Allah," were arrogant
verses.tafsir: For truly it was they who in other words it was these sinners who — given the context that follows — when it was said to them ‘There is no god except God’ used to be scornful
verses.tafsirV2: (For when it was said unto them) in the life of the world, say: (There is no god save Allah, they were scornful) they were too proud to say it

verses.text: وَيَقُولُونَ أَئِنَّا لَتَارِكُوٓاْ ءَالِهَتِنَا لِشَاعِرٖ مَّجۡنُونِۭ
verses.translation: And were saying, "Are we to leave our gods for a mad poet
verses.tafsir: and would say ‘Are we to abandon our gods for a mad poet?’ that is for the sake of what Muhammad (s) says? as regards the hamzas in a-innā ‘are we’ the same applies as mentioned above.
verses.tafsirV2: (And said: Shall we forsake our gods) shall we leave the worship of our gods (for a mad poet) who invents lies? Meaning the Prophet Muhammad (pbuh).

verses.text: بَلۡ جَآءَ بِٱلۡحَقِّ وَصَدَّقَ ٱلۡمُرۡسَلِينَ
verses.translation: Rather, the Prophet has come with the truth and confirmed the [previous] messengers
verses.tafsir: God exalted be He says Nay but he has brought them the truth and confirmed the earlier messengers namely those who had also brought this truth which is that there is no god except God.
verses.tafsirV2: (Nay, but he) Muhammad (pbuh) (brought the Truth) he brought the Qur'an and the profession of Allah's divine Oneness, (and he confirmed those sent (before him)) and he brought a confirmation of the messengers who were sent before him.

verses.text: إِنَّكُمۡ لَذَآئِقُواْ ٱلۡعَذَابِ ٱلۡأَلِيمِ
verses.translation: Indeed, you [disbelievers] will be tasters of the painful punishment
verses.tafsir: ‘You shall certainly there is a shift from the third person address to the second here taste the painful chastisement
verses.tafsirV2: (Lo! (now) verily ye) O people of Mecca (taste the painful doom) in the Fire.

verses.text: وَمَا تُجۡزَوۡنَ إِلَّا مَا كُنتُمۡ تَعۡمَلُونَ
verses.translation: And you will not be recompensed except for what you used to do
verses.tafsir: and you will only be requited the requital for what you used to do’.
verses.tafsirV2: (Ye are requited) in the Hereafter (naught save what ye did) in the life of the world in your state of idolatry and disbelief.

verses.text: إِلَّا عِبَادَ ٱللَّهِ ٱلۡمُخۡلَصِينَ
verses.translation: But not the chosen servants of Allah
verses.tafsir: Except for God’s sincere servants namely the believers the exception clause here is a discontinuous one
verses.tafsirV2: (Save single minded slaves of Allah) who are protected from disbelief and idolatry; it is also said that its meaning is: save those who are chosen for worship and for the profession of Allah's divine Oneness;

verses.text: أُوْلَـٰٓئِكَ لَهُمۡ رِزۡقٞ مَّعۡلُومٞ
verses.translation: Those will have a provision determined
verses.tafsir: whose requital is mentioned in His saying For them there will be in Paradise a distinct provision morning and evening —
verses.tafsirV2: (For them there is a known provision) in measure for the morning and evening of the life of this world, except that over there there is no morning or evening.

verses.text: فَوَٰكِهُ وَهُم مُّكۡرَمُونَ
verses.translation: Fruits; and they will be honored
verses.tafsir: fruits fawākihu either substitutes for rizqun or is an explication thereof here these fruits represent what is eaten for delight and not for the sake of preserving one’s health as in this world for the inhabitants of Paradise are in no need of preserving it given that their bodies will be created to be everlasting — and they will be honoured with God’s reward glory be to Him exalted be He
verses.tafsirV2: (Fruits) they have different kinds of fruit. (And they will be honoured) with gifts

verses.text: فِي جَنَّـٰتِ ٱلنَّعِيمِ
verses.translation: In gardens of pleasure
verses.tafsir: in the Gardens of Bliss
verses.tafsirV2: (In the Gardens of Delight) whose delight is endless,

verses.text: عَلَىٰ سُرُرٖ مُّتَقَٰبِلِينَ
verses.translation: On thrones facing one another
verses.tafsir: reclining upon couches facing one another so that they do not see the back of one another;
verses.tafsirV2: (On couches facing one another) upon visitation

verses.text: يُطَافُ عَلَيۡهِم بِكَأۡسٖ مِّن مَّعِينِۭ
verses.translation: There will be circulated among them a cup [of wine] from a flowing spring
verses.tafsir: they are served from all round each one of them is so served with a cup ka’san this denotes the vessel with the drink in it from a spring of wine that flows along the ground like streams of water
verses.tafsirV2: (A cup) of wine (from a gushing spring) of pure wine (is brought round for them) as service,

verses.text: بَيۡضَآءَ لَذَّةٖ لِّلشَّـٰرِبِينَ
verses.translation: White and delicious to the drinkers
verses.tafsir: white whiter than milk delicious to the drinkers in contrast to the wine of this world which is distasteful to drink
verses.tafsirV2: (White, delicious to the drinkers,

verses.text: لَا فِيهَا غَوۡلٞ وَلَا هُمۡ عَنۡهَا يُنزَفُونَ
verses.translation: No bad effect is there in it, nor from it will they be intoxicated
verses.tafsir: wherein there is neither madness nothing to snatch away their minds nor will they be spent by it read yunzafūna or yunzifūna from 1st form nazafa or 4th form anzafa said of one drinking in other words they are not inebriated by it in contrast to the wine of this world
verses.tafsirV2: Wherein) in drinking this wine (there is no headache) stomach-ache, drunkenness, harm or sinning (nor are they made mad thereby) because of intoxication; it is also said that this means: they never run out of it.

verses.text: وَعِندَهُمۡ قَٰصِرَٰتُ ٱلطَّرۡفِ عِينٞ
verses.translation: And with them will be women limiting [their] glances, with large, [beautiful] eyes
verses.tafsir: and with them will be maidens of restrained glances who reserved their glances exclusively for their spouses and do not look upon any other — because of the beauty they the maidens see in them — with beautiful eyes ‘īn means with large and beautiful eyes
verses.tafsirV2: (And with them) in Paradise (are those of modest gaze) wives who lower their gaze, content with their husbands and wish no man instead of their husband, (with lovely eyes) and beautiful faces,

verses.text: كَأَنَّهُنَّ بَيۡضٞ مَّكۡنُونٞ
verses.translation: As if they were [delicate] eggs, well-protected
verses.tafsir: as if they were in terms of the starkness of their white colour hidden eggs of ostriches sheltered by their feathers from dust the colour being that whiteness with a hint of pallor which is the most beautiful of female complexions.
verses.tafsirV2: (As they were hidden eggs) in their purity, in both heat and cold.

verses.text: فَأَقۡبَلَ بَعۡضُهُمۡ عَلَىٰ بَعۡضٖ يَتَسَآءَلُونَ
verses.translation: And they will approach one another, inquiring of each other
verses.tafsir: Some of them some of the inhabitants of Paradise will turn to others questioning each other regarding what they experienced in the life of the world.
verses.tafsirV2: (And some of them draw near unto others, mutually questioning) conversing with one another.

verses.text: قَالَ قَآئِلٞ مِّنۡهُمۡ إِنِّي كَانَ لِي قَرِينٞ
verses.translation: A speaker among them will say, "Indeed, I had a companion [on earth]
verses.tafsir: One of them will say ‘Indeed I had a comrade a companion who used to reject the idea of resurrection
verses.tafsirV2: (A speaker of them saith) one of the inhabitants of Paradise, Yehuda the believer, says: (Lo! I had a comrade) whose name was Abu Qutrus, who was actually his brother.

verses.text: يَقُولُ أَءِنَّكَ لَمِنَ ٱلۡمُصَدِّقِينَ
verses.translation: Who would say, 'Are you indeed of those who believe
verses.tafsir: who used to say to me in reproach “Are you really among those who affirm as truth the Resurrection and
verses.tafsirV2: (Who used to say: Art thou in truth of those who put faith (in his words)) do you really believe those messengers?

verses.text: أَءِذَا مِتۡنَا وَكُنَّا تُرَابٗا وَعِظَٰمًا أَءِنَّا لَمَدِينُونَ
verses.translation: That when we have died and become dust and bones, we will indeed be recompensed
verses.tafsir: that when we are dead and have become dust and bones we shall actually be called to account?” ’ that we shall be requited and reckoned with — he rejects the truth of this as well as regards all three instances of the hamzas sc. a-innaka a-idhā and a-innā what has been mentioned above applies.
verses.tafsirV2: (Can we, when we are dead and have become mere dust and) rotten (bones, can we (then) verily be brought to book) because he denied resurrection after death?

verses.text: قَالَ هَلۡ أَنتُم مُّطَّلِعُونَ
verses.translation: He will say, "Would you [care to] look
verses.tafsir: He the one speaking says to his brethren in Paradise ‘Will you have a look?’ together with me into the Fire to see his condition — but they will say ‘No’.
verses.tafsirV2: (He saith) to his brothers in Paradise: (Will ye look) in the Fire that haply you may find out about his state?

verses.text: فَٱطَّلَعَ فَرَءَاهُ فِي سَوَآءِ ٱلۡجَحِيمِ
verses.translation: And he will look and see him in the midst of the Hellfire
verses.tafsir: Then he that speaker will take a look through one of the apertures in Paradise and he will catch sight of him that is he will see his comrade in the centre of Hell in the middle of the Fire.
verses.tafsirV2: (Then looketh he and seeth him) and sees his disbelieving brother (in the depth of hell) in the middle of hell.

verses.text: قَالَ تَٱللَّهِ إِن كِدتَّ لَتُرۡدِينِ
verses.translation: He will say, "By Allah, you almost ruined me
verses.tafsir: He will say to him acknowledging that he the latter deserves his fate ‘By God! You very nearly destroyed me you almost ruined me through your misguidance in this has been softened from the hardened form inna.
verses.tafsirV2: (He saith: By Allah, thou verily didst all but cause my ruin) you almost led me away from Religion and you would have certainly destroyed me if I obeyed you,

verses.text: وَلَوۡلَا نِعۡمَةُ رَبِّي لَكُنتُ مِنَ ٱلۡمُحۡضَرِينَ
verses.translation: If not for the favor of my Lord, I would have been of those brought in [to Hell]
verses.tafsir: And had it not been for the favour of my Lord His grace to me in giving me faith I too would have been of those arraigned’ with you in the Fire. The inhabitants of Paradise will say
verses.tafsirV2: (And had it not been for the favour of my Lord) Who bestowed faith upon me and protected me from disbelief, (I too had been of those haled forth (to doom)) I too would be tormented with you in the Fire.

verses.text: أَفَمَا نَحۡنُ بِمَيِّتِينَ
verses.translation: Then, are we not to die
verses.tafsir: Do we then not die anymore
verses.tafsirV2: Then he heard a crier saying: " O people of Paradise death is slain and from now on there is no death ". Upon which he will say to his brothers: (Are we then not to die) after the slaying of death

verses.text: إِلَّا مَوۡتَتَنَا ٱلۡأُولَىٰ وَمَا نَحۡنُ بِمُعَذَّبِينَ
verses.translation: Except for our first death, and we will not be punished
verses.tafsir: aside from our first death that is the one which we suffered in this world and are we not to be chastised?’ — this interrogative statement is one made out of sheer delight and in order to speak at length of the graces of God exalted be He in His granting of everlasting life and refraining from inflicting any punishment.
verses.tafsirV2: (Saving our former death) after our death in the life of the world. They would say to him: “Yes, indeed!” Thereupon he will hear a crier crying: “O people of hell! The fire is now closed; none will enter it or leave it”, and he will say to his brothers: (and are we not to be punished) after the Fire is closed? And their answer will be in the affirmative.

verses.text: إِنَّ هَٰذَا لَهُوَ ٱلۡفَوۡزُ ٱلۡعَظِيمُ
verses.translation: Indeed, this is the great attainment
verses.tafsir: Truly this that has mentioned as being the reward for the inhabitants of Paradise is indeed the mighty success.
verses.tafsirV2: (Lo! this is the Supreme Triumph) this is the ultimate safety; we gained Paradise and all that which is in it and were saved from hell and all that which is in it. The story of these two brothers is the same story of the two brothers mentioned in surah al-Kahf, one of whom was a believer, this is Yehuda, and the other an unbeliever, Abu Qutrus.

verses.text: لِمِثۡلِ هَٰذَا فَلۡيَعۡمَلِ ٱلۡعَٰمِلُونَ
verses.translation: For the like of this let the workers [on earth] work
verses.tafsir: For the like of this let all the workers work — it is said that this is said to them or it is what they say themselves.
verses.tafsirV2: Then Allah will say to him: (For the like of this, then) eternity in Paradise and its bliss, (let the workers work) let those who hasten to do righteous works hasten to do them; it is also said that this means: for the like of this let those who compete to spend in the way of Allah spend their wealth; and it is also said that this means: for the like of this let those who strive in seeking knowledge and worship strive.

verses.text: أَذَٰلِكَ خَيۡرٞ نُّزُلًا أَمۡ شَجَرَةُ ٱلزَّقُّومِ
verses.translation: Is Paradise a better accommodation or the tree of zaqqum
verses.tafsir: Is that which is mentioned to them a better hospitality nuzul denotes what is prepared for one who is being received as a guest and so forth or the Zaqqūm tree that is prepared for the inhabitants of the Fire — it is the vilest and most bitter tree of the Tihāma region which God causes to grow in the Fire as will be stated shortly.
verses.tafsirV2: (Is this) which I have mentioned for the inhabitants of Paradise of food and drink (better as a welcome) better as food, drink and reward for the believers, (or the tree of Zaqqum) for Abu Jahl and his host?

verses.text: إِنَّا جَعَلۡنَٰهَا فِتۡنَةٗ لِّلظَّـٰلِمِينَ
verses.translation: Indeed, We have made it a torment for the wrongdoers
verses.tafsir: We have indeed made it for that reason sc. its being a tree in the Fire a trial for the wrongdoers? namely for the disbelievers of Mecca for they said ‘Fire consumes trees so how can it make them grow forth?’
verses.tafsirV2: (Lo! We have appointed it) We mentioned it as (a torment) a trial (for wrong-doers) Abu Jahl and his host, for they said: the Zaqqum is nothing but dates and butter.

verses.text: إِنَّهَا شَجَرَةٞ تَخۡرُجُ فِيٓ أَصۡلِ ٱلۡجَحِيمِ
verses.translation: Indeed, it is a tree issuing from the bottom of the Hellfire
verses.tafsir: Indeed it is a tree that comes forth from the very source of Hell in other words from the depths of Hell with its branches extending up through all its different levels.
verses.tafsirV2: (Lo! it is a tree that springeth) grows (in the heart of hell) in the middle of hell.

verses.text: طَلۡعُهَا كَأَنَّهُۥ رُءُوسُ ٱلشَّيَٰطِينِ
verses.translation: Its emerging fruit as if it was heads of the devils
verses.tafsir: Its spathes likened to the spathes of a date-palm are like the heads of devils as vile-looking snakes.
verses.tafsirV2: (Its crop) its fruit (is as it were the heads of devils) the heads of snakes which resemble devils. This kind of snakes is found near Yemen.

verses.text: فَإِنَّهُمۡ لَأٓكِلُونَ مِنۡهَا فَمَالِـُٔونَ مِنۡهَا ٱلۡبُطُونَ
verses.translation: And indeed, they will eat from it and fill with it their bellies
verses.tafsir: And indeed they the disbelievers will eat of it despite its vileness because of the severity of their hunger and will fill their bellies from it.
verses.tafsirV2: (And lo! They) i.e. the people of Mecca as well as all the disbelievers (verily must eat thereof) of the tree of Zaqqum, (and fill (their) bellies therewith) and fill their bellies of it.

verses.text: ثُمَّ إِنَّ لَهُمۡ عَلَيۡهَا لَشَوۡبٗا مِّنۡ حَمِيمٖ
verses.translation: Then indeed, they will have after it a mixture of scalding water
verses.tafsir: Then lo! on top of it they will have a brew of boiling water which they drink and which mixes with what they have eaten and becomes a brew thereof.
verses.tafsirV2: (And afterward, lo! thereupon they have a drink of boiling water) to go with the Zaqqum.

verses.text: ثُمَّ إِنَّ مَرۡجِعَهُمۡ لَإِلَى ٱلۡجَحِيمِ
verses.translation: Then indeed, their return will be to the Hellfire
verses.tafsir: Then indeed their return shall be to Hell-fire — this suggests that they exit from it only to drink the boiling water which is located outside it.
verses.tafsirV2: (And afterward, lo! their return) their destination (is surely unto hell) the middle of hell.

verses.text: إِنَّهُمۡ أَلۡفَوۡاْ ءَابَآءَهُمۡ ضَآلِّينَ
verses.translation: Indeed they found their fathers astray
verses.tafsir: Lo! they found their fathers to be astray
verses.tafsirV2: (They indeed found their fathers) in the life of this world (astray) from the Truth and guidance,

verses.text: فَهُمۡ عَلَىٰٓ ءَاثَٰرِهِمۡ يُهۡرَعُونَ
verses.translation: So they hastened [to follow] in their footsteps
verses.tafsir: and so they are also now hurrying in their footsteps they shall be prodded to follow them and they end up hurrying towards it Hell-fire.
verses.tafsirV2: (But they make haste (to follow) in their footsteps) they hasten to follow their religion, and do as they did.

verses.text: وَلَقَدۡ ضَلَّ قَبۡلَهُمۡ أَكۡثَرُ ٱلۡأَوَّلِينَ
verses.translation: And there had already strayed before them most of the former peoples
verses.tafsir: And verily most of the ancients of past communities went astray before them
verses.tafsirV2: (And verily most of the men of old) of past generations, (went astray before them) before your folk, O Muhammad.

verses.text: وَلَقَدۡ أَرۡسَلۡنَا فِيهِم مُّنذِرِينَ
verses.translation: And We had already sent among them warners
verses.tafsir: and We certainly had sent among them warners in the way of messengers to threaten them.
verses.tafsirV2: (And verily We sent among them warners) but they disbelieved in them and, as a result, We destroyed them.

verses.text: فَٱنظُرۡ كَيۡفَ كَانَ عَٰقِبَةُ ٱلۡمُنذَرِينَ
verses.translation: Then look how was the end of those who were warned
verses.tafsir: So behold how was the consequence for them who were warned namely the disbelievers in other words the sequel for them was that they ended up in the chastisement;
verses.tafsirV2: (Then see) O Muhammad (the nature of the consequence for) the requital of (those warned) of those who were warned by the messenger, but chose to disbelieve, how we destroyed them,

verses.text: إِلَّا عِبَادَ ٱللَّهِ ٱلۡمُخۡلَصِينَ
verses.translation: But not the chosen servants of Allah
verses.tafsir: all except God’s sincere servants namely the believers who are saved from chastisement because they were sincere in their worship mukhlisīna; or if one reads mukhlasīna because God has made them sincerely devoted to such worship.
verses.tafsirV2: Allah then made an exception, saying: (Save singled minded slaves of Allah) who are protected from disbelief and idolatry; and it is said that this means according to a variant reading: except those chosen for worship and the profession of Allah's divine Oneness. The latter did not disbelieve and therefore We did not destroy them.

verses.text: وَلَقَدۡ نَادَىٰنَا نُوحٞ فَلَنِعۡمَ ٱلۡمُجِيبُونَ
verses.translation: And Noah had certainly called Us, and [We are] the best of responders
verses.tafsir: And verily Noah called to Us when he said ‘My Lord I have been overcome so help me Q. 5410 and how excellent were the Hearers of the prayer for him were We in other words he invoked Us against his people so We destroyed them by drowning them.
verses.tafsirV2: (And Noah verily prayed unto Us) Noah prayed against his folk, saying: (My Lord! Leave not one of the disbelievers in the land…) [Noah, 71: 26-27], (and gracious was the Hearer of his prayer) by destroying his folk.

verses.text: وَنَجَّيۡنَٰهُ وَأَهۡلَهُۥ مِنَ ٱلۡكَرۡبِ ٱلۡعَظِيمِ
verses.translation: And We saved him and his family from the great affliction
verses.tafsir: And We delivered him and his family from the great distress which was the drowning
verses.tafsirV2: (And We saved him and his household) and all those who believed in him (from the great distress) i.e. drowning,

verses.text: وَجَعَلۡنَا ذُرِّيَّتَهُۥ هُمُ ٱلۡبَاقِينَ
verses.translation: And We made his descendants those remaining [on the earth]
verses.tafsir: and made his descendants the survivors thus all human beings are descended from him peace be upon him. He had three sons Shem Sām the ancestor of the Arabs the Persians and the Byzantines; Ham Hām the ancestor of the Negroes; and Japheth Yāfith the ancestor of the Turks the Khazar and the peoples of Gog and Magog and the inhabitants of such regions.
verses.tafsirV2: (And made his seed the survivors) until the Day of Judgement. Noah had three sons: Shem, Ham and Yapheth. Shem is the father of the Arabs and those people surrounding them; Ham is the father the Abyssinians, Berbers and inhabitants of Sind; and Yapheth is the father of the rest of people,

verses.text: وَتَرَكۡنَا عَلَيۡهِ فِي ٱلۡأٓخِرِينَ
verses.translation: And left for him [favorable mention] among later generations
verses.tafsir: And We left We preserved for him fair praise among posterity among the prophets and communities after him until the Day of Resurrection which is
verses.tafsirV2: (And left for him) for Noah good praise (among the later folk) who remained after him:

verses.text: سَلَٰمٌ عَلَىٰ نُوحٖ فِي ٱلۡعَٰلَمِينَ
verses.translation: Peace upon Noah among the worlds
verses.tafsir: ‘Peace from Us be to Noah among the worlds!’
verses.tafsirV2: (Peace be unto Noah) safety and happiness from Us unto Noah (among the peoples) of his time!

verses.text: إِنَّا كَذَٰلِكَ نَجۡزِي ٱلۡمُحۡسِنِينَ
verses.translation: Indeed, We thus reward the doers of good
verses.tafsir: Thus indeed in the way that We requited them We requite the virtuous.
verses.tafsirV2: (Lo! thus do We reward the good) in words and works by bestowing upon them good praise and safety.

verses.text: إِنَّهُۥ مِنۡ عِبَادِنَا ٱلۡمُؤۡمِنِينَ
verses.translation: Indeed, he was of Our believing servants
verses.tafsir: He was indeed one of Our faithful servants.
verses.tafsirV2: (Lo! he is one of Our believing slaves.

verses.text: ثُمَّ أَغۡرَقۡنَا ٱلۡأٓخَرِينَ
verses.translation: Then We drowned the disbelievers
verses.tafsir: Then We did drown the others the disbelievers from among his folk.
verses.tafsirV2: Then We did drown the others) those who remained after him.

verses.text: ۞وَإِنَّ مِن شِيعَتِهِۦ لَإِبۡرَٰهِيمَ
verses.translation: And indeed, among his kind was Abraham
verses.tafsir: And truly of his adherents that is of those who agreed with him on the fundaments of religion was Abraham despite the fact that there was a long interval between them 2640 years and between them came the prophets Hūd and Sālih.
verses.tafsirV2: (And lo! of his persuasion) of Noah's persuasion; and it is also said this means: of Muhammad's persuasion (verily was Abraham) He says: Abraham followed the religion and way of Noah and Muhammad (pbuh) followed Abraham's religion and way.

verses.text: إِذۡ جَآءَ رَبَّهُۥ بِقَلۡبٖ سَلِيمٍ
verses.translation: When he came to his Lord with a sound heart
verses.tafsir: When he came to his Lord in other words he continued to follow Him upon coming to Him with a heart that was pure of any doubt or the like
verses.tafsirV2: (When he came unto his Lord) He says: when Abraham betook himself to worshipping his Lord (with a whole heart) with a heart free from any blemish;

verses.text: إِذۡ قَالَ لِأَبِيهِ وَقَوۡمِهِۦ مَاذَا تَعۡبُدُونَ
verses.translation: [And] when he said to his father and his people, "What do you worship
verses.tafsir: when he said while still in this continuous state of his to his father and his folk in reproach ‘What do — what is it that — you worship?
verses.tafsirV2: (When he said unto his father) Azar (and his folk) the idol worshippers: (What is it that you worship) beside Allah?

verses.text: أَئِفۡكًا ءَالِهَةٗ دُونَ ٱللَّهِ تُرِيدُونَ
verses.translation: Is it falsehood [as] gods other than Allah you desire
verses.tafsir: Is it a calumny a-ifkan as regards the two hamzas the same applies as mentioned before — gods other than God — that you desire? ifkan is an object denoting reason; ālihatan is the direct object of turīdūna ‘you desire’; ifk denotes the worst kind of lie. In other words do you worship any other than God?
verses.tafsirV2: They replied: " we worship idols " , to which Abraham said: (Is it a falsehood gods beside Allah that ye desire) do you then worship false deities?

verses.text: فَمَا ظَنُّكُم بِرَبِّ ٱلۡعَٰلَمِينَ
verses.translation: Then what is your thought about the Lord of the worlds
verses.tafsir: What then is your supposition regarding the Lord of the Worlds?’ having worshipped other than Him do you think that He will leave you without punishment? No! They were a people of astrologers. On one occasion they went out to celebrate a festival of theirs and left their food behind with their idols claiming that they were securing thereby blessings for it and that they would eat it upon their return. They had said to the lord Abraham ‘Come out with us’.
verses.tafsirV2: (What then is your opinion of the Lord of the Worlds) what do you think He will do to you if you worship other than Him?

verses.text: فَنَظَرَ نَظۡرَةٗ فِي ٱلنُّجُومِ
verses.translation: And he cast a look at the stars
verses.tafsir: And he cast a glance at the stars — to delude them into thinking that he relies on them so that they would then trust him —
verses.tafsirV2: (And he glanced a glance at the stars) it is also said that this means: he reflected for a while,

verses.text: فَقَالَ إِنِّي سَقِيمٞ
verses.translation: And said, "Indeed, I am [about to be] ill
verses.tafsir: and said ‘Indeed I feel I will be sick’ that is I will fall ill.
verses.tafsirV2: (Then said: Lo! I feel sick!) so that they leave him alone.

verses.text: فَتَوَلَّوۡاْ عَنۡهُ مُدۡبِرِينَ
verses.translation: So they turned away from him, departing
verses.tafsir: So they went away to their festival leaving him behind.
verses.tafsirV2: (And they turned their backs and went away from him) they went to their festival and left him alone.

verses.text: فَرَاغَ إِلَىٰٓ ءَالِهَتِهِمۡ فَقَالَ أَلَا تَأۡكُلُونَ
verses.translation: Then he turned to their gods and said, "Do you not eat
verses.tafsir: Then he turned he stole away to their gods the idols in front of which the food had been placed and said mockingly ‘Will you not eat? — but they failed to utter a word.
verses.tafsirV2: (Then turned he) i.e. Abraham (to their gods and said) to them: (Will ye not eat) the honey you have on you?

verses.text: مَا لَكُمۡ لَا تَنطِقُونَ
verses.translation: What is [wrong] with you that you do not speak
verses.tafsir: He then said What is wrong with you that you do not speak?’ — but still he received no response.
verses.tafsirV2: When they did not answer him, he said: (What aileth you that ye speak not) why do you not answer me?

verses.text: فَرَاغَ عَلَيۡهِمۡ ضَرۡبَۢا بِٱلۡيَمِينِ
verses.translation: And he turned upon them a blow with [his] right hand
verses.tafsir: He then turned on them striking them with his right hand with might smashing them. Those who saw him reported this to the rest of his people.
verses.tafsirV2: (Then he attacked them striking with his right hand) with an axe; it is also said that he fulfilled his oath.

verses.text: فَأَقۡبَلُوٓاْ إِلَيۡهِ يَزِفُّونَ
verses.translation: Then the people came toward him, hastening
verses.tafsir: So they came running towards him walking hurriedly and they said to him ‘We worship them while you smash them?!’
verses.tafsirV2: (And (his people) came towards him, hastening) from their festival.

verses.text: قَالَ أَتَعۡبُدُونَ مَا تَنۡحِتُونَ
verses.translation: He said, "Do you worship that which you [yourselves] carve
verses.tafsir: He said to them in reproach ‘Do you worship what you yourselves have carved out of stone and other materials idols
verses.tafsirV2: (He said) Abraham said to them: (Worship ye that which ye yourselves do carve) with your own hands from stones and wood,

verses.text: وَٱللَّهُ خَلَقَكُمۡ وَمَا تَعۡمَلُونَ
verses.translation: While Allah created you and that which you do
verses.tafsir: when God created you and whatever you make?’ whether it be your act of carving and that which you have carved? So worship Him alone! the mā in wa-mā ta‘malūna ‘and whatever you make’ is that of the verbal noun; but it is also said to introduce a relative clause or it is adjectivally qualified.
verses.tafsirV2: (When Allah hath created you) and leave the worship of Allah Who created you (and what ye make) and He also created your act of carving as well as that which you carve?

verses.text: قَالُواْ ٱبۡنُواْ لَهُۥ بُنۡيَٰنٗا فَأَلۡقُوهُ فِي ٱلۡجَحِيمِ
verses.translation: They said, "Construct for him a furnace and throw him into the burning fire
verses.tafsir: They said amongst themselves ‘Build for him a structure then fill it with firewood and set it on fire and when it is ablaze then cast him into the fierce fire’.
verses.tafsirV2: (They said: Build for him a building) a furnace (and fling him in the red hot fire.

verses.text: فَأَرَادُواْ بِهِۦ كَيۡدٗا فَجَعَلۡنَٰهُمُ ٱلۡأَسۡفَلِينَ
verses.translation: And they intended for him a plan, but We made them the most debased
verses.tafsir: So they sought to outwit him by flinging him into the fire so that it may destroy him but We made them the lowermost the vanquished as he came out of the fire unharmed.
verses.tafsirV2: And they designed a snare for him) to burn him in the Fire, (but We made them the undermost) of those who dwell in the bottom of the Fire; it is also said that this means: We made them of the losers by subjecting them to chastisement.

verses.text: وَقَالَ إِنِّي ذَاهِبٌ إِلَىٰ رَبِّي سَيَهۡدِينِ
verses.translation: And [then] he said, "Indeed, I will go to [where I am ordered by] my Lord; He will guide me
verses.tafsir: And he said ‘I shall indeed depart to my Lord I shall emigrating to Him from the abode of disbelief — He will guide me to the place to which My Lord has commanded that I end up in and this was Syria. When he reached the Holy Land he said
verses.tafsirV2: (And he said) Abraham said to Lot: (Lo! I am going unto my Lord) I am going to worship my Lord (Who will guide me) who will save me from them.

verses.text: رَبِّ هَبۡ لِي مِنَ ٱلصَّـٰلِحِينَ
verses.translation: My Lord, grant me [a child] from among the righteous
verses.tafsir: My Lord! Grant me a child of the righteous’.
verses.tafsirV2: Then he said: (My Lord! Vouchsafe me of the righteous) a son who is among the messengers.

verses.text: فَبَشَّرۡنَٰهُ بِغُلَٰمٍ حَلِيمٖ
verses.translation: So We gave him good tidings of a forbearing boy
verses.tafsir: So We gave him the good tidings of a forbearing son.
verses.tafsirV2: (So We gave him tidings of a gentle son) a son who is knowledgeable in his youth, gentle in his old age.

verses.text: فَلَمَّا بَلَغَ مَعَهُ ٱلسَّعۡيَ قَالَ يَٰبُنَيَّ إِنِّيٓ أَرَىٰ فِي ٱلۡمَنَامِ أَنِّيٓ أَذۡبَحُكَ فَٱنظُرۡ مَاذَا تَرَىٰۚ قَالَ يَـٰٓأَبَتِ ٱفۡعَلۡ مَا تُؤۡمَرُۖ سَتَجِدُنِيٓ إِن شَآءَ ٱللَّهُ مِنَ ٱلصَّـٰبِرِينَ
verses.translation: And when he reached with him [the age of] exertion, he said, "O my son, indeed I have seen in a dream that I [must] sacrifice you, so see what you think." He said, "O my father, do as you are commanded. You will find me, if Allah wills, of the steadfast
verses.tafsir: And when he was old enough to walk with him that is to go about with him and help him out — this is said to have been either at the age of seven or at the age of thirteen — he said ‘O my dear son I see that is I have seen in a dream that I shall sacrifice you — and the visions of prophets are always true and their actions are inspired by the command of God exalted be He. So see what you think’ of this dream. He consulted him so that he his son might accept the idea of being sacrificed and comply with the command for it. He said ‘O my father the final tā’ in abati replaces the yā’ of the genitive possessive annexation yā abī do whatever you have been commanded to do. You shall find me God willing of the steadfast’ in this affair.
verses.tafsirV2: (And when (his son) was old enough to walk with him) when his son was old enough to strive for Allah and obey Him; it is also said that this means: when his son was old enough to walk with him in the mountains, ((Abraham) said) to his son Ishmael; and it is also said: to his son Isaac: (O my dear son, I have seen in a dream that I must sacrifice thee) I am commanded in a dream vision to sacrifice you. (So look, what thinkest thou) what do you say? (He said: O my father! Do that which thou art commanded) of sacrificing me. (Allah willing, thou shalt find me of the steadfast) in the face of this sacrifice.

verses.text: فَلَمَّآ أَسۡلَمَا وَتَلَّهُۥ لِلۡجَبِينِ
verses.translation: And when they had both submitted and he put him down upon his forehead
verses.tafsir: And when they had both submitted when they had submitted to and were prepared to comply with God’s command exalted be He and he had laid him down on his forehead when he had pushed him down to the ground thereon — every human being has two brows jabīn between which is the forehead jabha; this was at Minā. Abraham passed the knife across his son’s throat but it did not do anything by some impediment of the Divine Power
verses.tafsirV2: (Then, when they had both surrendered (to Allah)) when they both agreed and consigned the matter to Allah, (and he had flung him down upon his face) and it is said: on his side,

verses.text: وَنَٰدَيۡنَٰهُ أَن يَـٰٓإِبۡرَٰهِيمُ
verses.translation: We called to him, "O Abraham
verses.tafsir: We called to him ‘O Abraham!
verses.tafsirV2: (We called unto him: O Abraham:

verses.text: قَدۡ صَدَّقۡتَ ٱلرُّءۡيَآۚ إِنَّا كَذَٰلِكَ نَجۡزِي ٱلۡمُحۡسِنِينَ
verses.translation: You have fulfilled the vision." Indeed, We thus reward the doers of good
verses.tafsir: Verily you have fulfilled the vision’ by what you have done in that you were able to go through with the act of sacrifice. In other words that which you have done suffices for you as redemption the statement nādaynāhu ‘We called to him’ is the response to the lammā ‘when’ so that the wāw in wa-nādaynāhu ‘We called to him’ is extra. So in the same way that We have rewarded you do We reward those who are virtuous to their own souls in obeying the Command of God by removing from them their distress.
verses.tafsirV2: Thou hast already fulfilled the vision) you have fulfilled what you were commanded in the dream vision. (Lo! thus do We reward the good) in their words and works.

verses.text: إِنَّ هَٰذَا لَهُوَ ٱلۡبَلَـٰٓؤُاْ ٱلۡمُبِينُ
verses.translation: Indeed, this was the clear trial
verses.tafsir: Truly this sacrifice to which he was commanded was indeed a clear test’ that is to say the ultimate test of faith.
verses.tafsirV2: (Lo! that verily was a clear test) that was a manifest trial.

verses.text: وَفَدَيۡنَٰهُ بِذِبۡحٍ عَظِيمٖ
verses.translation: And We ransomed him with a great sacrifice
verses.tafsir: Then We ransomed him the one whom he had been commanded to sacrifice namely Ishmael or Isaac — two different opinions — with a mighty sacrifice a mighty ram from Paradise the same one that Abel had offered as as sacrifice Gabriel peace be upon him brought it and the lord Abraham sacrificed it as he cried Allāhu akbar ‘God is Great’.
verses.tafsirV2: (Then We ransomed him with a tremendous victim) We ransomed him with a fat ram.

verses.text: وَتَرَكۡنَا عَلَيۡهِ فِي ٱلۡأٓخِرِينَ
verses.translation: And We left for him [favorable mention] among later generations
verses.tafsir: And We left We preserved for him among posterity fair praise namely
verses.tafsirV2: (And We left for him among the later folk (the salutation)) We left Abraham with good praise among the people who came after him:

verses.text: سَلَٰمٌ عَلَىٰٓ إِبۡرَٰهِيمَ
verses.translation: Peace upon Abraham
verses.tafsir: ‘Peace from Us be to Abraham!’
verses.tafsirV2: (Peace be unto Abraham) bliss and safety from Us unto Abraham!

verses.text: كَذَٰلِكَ نَجۡزِي ٱلۡمُحۡسِنِينَ
verses.translation: Indeed, We thus reward the doers of good
verses.tafsir: So in way that We rewarded him do We reward those who are virtuous to their own souls.
verses.tafsirV2: (Thus do We reward the good) with good praise and safety.

verses.text: إِنَّهُۥ مِنۡ عِبَادِنَا ٱلۡمُؤۡمِنِينَ
verses.translation: Indeed, he was of Our believing servants
verses.tafsir: Indeed he is one of Our faithful servants.
verses.tafsirV2: (Lo! He) i.e. Abraham (is one of Our believing slaves) who are true in their faith.

verses.text: وَبَشَّرۡنَٰهُ بِإِسۡحَٰقَ نَبِيّٗا مِّنَ ٱلصَّـٰلِحِينَ
verses.translation: And We gave him good tidings of Isaac, a prophet from among the righteous
verses.tafsir: And We gave him the good tidings of the birth of Isaac — some have argued that this proves that the one who was sacrificed was not him Isaac — a prophet nabiyyan is a future circumstantial qualifier that is to say ‘he will come to be with his prophethood decreed one of the righteous.
verses.tafsirV2: (And We gave him tidings of the birth of Isaac, a Prophet of the righteous) of the messengers.

verses.text: وَبَٰرَكۡنَا عَلَيۡهِ وَعَلَىٰٓ إِسۡحَٰقَۚ وَمِن ذُرِّيَّتِهِمَا مُحۡسِنٞ وَظَالِمٞ لِّنَفۡسِهِۦ مُبِينٞ
verses.translation: And We blessed him and Isaac. But among their descendants is the doer of good and the clearly unjust to himself
verses.tafsir: And We blessed him by multiplying his descendants and Isaac his son We also blessed by appointing the majority of prophets from among his progeny. And among their descendants is he who is virtuous he who is a believer and he who plainly wrongs his soul he who is a disbeliever whose disbelief is manifest.
verses.tafsirV2: (And We blessed him) with good praise and righteous offspring (and Isaac. And of their seed) and of the offspring of Abraham and Isaac (are some who do good) who believe in Allah's divine Oneness, (and some who plainly wrong themselves) through disbelief.

verses.text: وَلَقَدۡ مَنَنَّا عَلَىٰ مُوسَىٰ وَهَٰرُونَ
verses.translation: And We did certainly confer favor upon Moses and Aaron
verses.tafsir: And verily We favoured Moses and Aaron with prophethood
verses.tafsirV2: (And We verily gave grace unto Moses and Aaron) by bestowing upon them prophethood and complete surrender unto Him,

verses.text: وَنَجَّيۡنَٰهُمَا وَقَوۡمَهُمَا مِنَ ٱلۡكَرۡبِ ٱلۡعَظِيمِ
verses.translation: And We saved them and their people from the great affliction
verses.tafsir: and We delivered them and their people the Children of Israel from the great distress namely Pharaoh’s enslavement of them.
verses.tafsirV2: (And saved them and their people) who believed in them (from the great distress) from drowning,

verses.text: وَنَصَرۡنَٰهُمۡ فَكَانُواْ هُمُ ٱلۡغَٰلِبِينَ
verses.translation: And We supported them so it was they who overcame
verses.tafsir: And We helped them against the Egyptians so that they became the victors.
verses.tafsirV2: (And helped them) against Pharaoh and his host (so that they became the victors) by means of proof.

verses.text: وَءَاتَيۡنَٰهُمَا ٱلۡكِتَٰبَ ٱلۡمُسۡتَبِينَ
verses.translation: And We gave them the explicit Scripture
verses.tafsir: And We gave them the enlightening scripture the one whose statements concerning prescribed punishments and rulings and otherwise are excellently expressed — this is the Torah.
verses.tafsirV2: (And We gave them the clear Scripture) We gave them the Torah which made clear the lawful and the unlawful,

verses.text: وَهَدَيۡنَٰهُمَا ٱلصِّرَٰطَ ٱلۡمُسۡتَقِيمَ
verses.translation: And We guided them on the straight path
verses.tafsir: And We guided them to the straight path the straight way
verses.tafsirV2: (And showed them the right path) We confirmed them on the true, straight religion.

verses.text: وَتَرَكۡنَا عَلَيۡهِمَا فِي ٱلۡأٓخِرِينَ
verses.translation: And We left for them [favorable mention] among later generations
verses.tafsir: and We left We preserved for them among posterity fair praise namely
verses.tafsirV2: (And We left for them) for Moses and Aaron, (among the later folk (the salutation)) good praise among the people who came after them:

verses.text: سَلَٰمٌ عَلَىٰ مُوسَىٰ وَهَٰرُونَ
verses.translation: Peace upon Moses and Aaron
verses.tafsir: ‘Peace from Us be to Moses and Aaron!’
verses.tafsirV2: (Peace be unto Moses and Aaron) bliss and safety from Us unto Moses and Aaron!

verses.text: إِنَّا كَذَٰلِكَ نَجۡزِي ٱلۡمُحۡسِنِينَ
verses.translation: Indeed, We thus reward the doers of good
verses.tafsir: So just as We rewarded them both do We reward the virtuous.
verses.tafsirV2: (Lo! thus do We reward the good) with words, deeds and good praise.

verses.text: إِنَّهُمَا مِنۡ عِبَادِنَا ٱلۡمُؤۡمِنِينَ
verses.translation: Indeed, they were of Our believing servants
verses.tafsir: Indeed both were among Our faithful servants.
verses.tafsirV2: (Lo! they are two of our believing slaves) who are true in their faith.

verses.text: وَإِنَّ إِلۡيَاسَ لَمِنَ ٱلۡمُرۡسَلِينَ
verses.translation: And indeed, Elias was from among the messengers
verses.tafsir: And truly Elias read wa-inna Ilyās with the initial hamza or without wa-inna’l-yāsa was also one of the messengers. Some think that this Elias was the son of Aaron’s brother — Aaron the brother of Moses; but some say that this Elias was some other person who was sent to the people living in and around Baalbak.
verses.tafsirV2: (And lo! Elias was of those sent (to warn)) his folk.

verses.text: إِذۡ قَالَ لِقَوۡمِهِۦٓ أَلَا تَتَّقُونَ
verses.translation: When he said to his people, "Will you not fear Allah
verses.tafsir: When idh is dependent because of an implicit verb udhkur ‘mention’ he said to his people ‘Will you not fear God?
verses.tafsirV2: (When he said unto his folk: Will ye not ward off (evil)) the worship of other than Allah?

verses.text: أَتَدۡعُونَ بَعۡلٗا وَتَذَرُونَ أَحۡسَنَ ٱلۡخَٰلِقِينَ
verses.translation: Do you call upon Ba'l and leave the best of creators
verses.tafsir: Do you call on Baal — this was the name of an idol of theirs which was made of gold from which the name of their city derives with the addition of the suffix bak — that is to say do you worship him and abandon the Best of Creators and not worship Him
verses.tafsirV2: (Will ye cry unto Baal) will you worship other deities beside Allah; it is also said that this means: will you worship a bull instead of worshipping Allah; it is also said that his people had an idol called Baal which was 30 cubits tall and had four faces (and forsake the best of Creators) and forsake the worship of the greatest of Creators, such that you do not worship him at all,

verses.text: ٱللَّهَ رَبَّكُمۡ وَرَبَّ ءَابَآئِكُمُ ٱلۡأَوَّلِينَ
verses.translation: Allah, your Lord and the Lord of your first forefathers
verses.tafsir: God your Lord and the Lord of your forefathers?’ read as predicates allāhu rabbukum and rabbu in the nominative because of the implicit omitted huwa being the subject; or read allāha rabbakum and rabba in the accusative as supplements to ahsana ‘the best of’.
verses.tafsirV2: (Allah, your Lord) your Creator (and Lord of your forefathers) and the Creator of your forefathers before you?

verses.text: فَكَذَّبُوهُ فَإِنَّهُمۡ لَمُحۡضَرُونَ
verses.translation: And they denied him, so indeed, they will be brought [for punishment]
verses.tafsir: But they denied him. So they will indeed be arraigned in the Fire
verses.tafsirV2: (But they denied him) they denied his message, (so they surely will be haled forth (to the doom)) they will be brought in order to be tormented in the Fire,

verses.text: إِلَّا عِبَادَ ٱللَّهِ ٱلۡمُخۡلَصِينَ
verses.translation: Except the chosen servants of Allah
verses.tafsir: — all except God’s delivered servants namely the believers who will be saved from it
verses.tafsirV2: (Save single minded slaves of Allah) save the salves of Allah who are sincere in their worship and have faith in Allah's divine Oneness; these will not be tormented.

verses.text: وَتَرَكۡنَا عَلَيۡهِ فِي ٱلۡأٓخِرِينَ
verses.translation: And We left for him [favorable mention] among later generations
verses.tafsir: and We left for him among posterity fair praise namely
verses.tafsirV2: (And we left for him among the later folk (the salutation)) We left for Elias good praise among the people who came after him:

verses.text: سَلَٰمٌ عَلَىٰٓ إِلۡ يَاسِينَ
verses.translation: Peace upon Elias
verses.tafsir: ‘Peace from Us be to Elias!’. It is said that this ilyāsīn is the same Elias mentioned above; but it is also said that this denotes him together with all those who were believers with him and so they have been coupled under the same term with him being the predominant as when one might say al-Muhallabūn ‘the Muhallabids’ to mean al-Muhallab and his folk; a variant reading has āl yāsīn by which is meant his family as well as Elias himself.
verses.tafsirV2: (Peace be) bliss and safety from Us (unto Elias!) who is none other than Idris the Prophet!

verses.text: إِنَّا كَذَٰلِكَ نَجۡزِي ٱلۡمُحۡسِنِينَ
verses.translation: Indeed, We thus reward the doers of good
verses.tafsir: Indeed so — just as We rewarded him — do We reward the virtuous.
verses.tafsirV2: (Lo! thus do We reward the good) with words, deeds and good praise.

verses.text: إِنَّهُۥ مِنۡ عِبَادِنَا ٱلۡمُؤۡمِنِينَ
verses.translation: Indeed, he was of Our believing servants
verses.tafsir: Truly he is one of Our faithful servants.
verses.tafsirV2: (Lo! he is one of Our believing slaves) who are true in their faith.

verses.text: وَإِنَّ لُوطٗا لَّمِنَ ٱلۡمُرۡسَلِينَ
verses.translation: And indeed, Lot was among the messengers
verses.tafsir: And indeed Lot was one of the messengers;
verses.tafsirV2: (And lo! Lot verily was of those sent (to warn)) his folk,

verses.text: إِذۡ نَجَّيۡنَٰهُ وَأَهۡلَهُۥٓ أَجۡمَعِينَ
verses.translation: [So mention] when We saved him and his family, all
verses.tafsir: mention when We delivered him together with all his family
verses.tafsirV2: (When We saved him and his household) his two daughters: Za'ura and Raytha, (every one,

verses.text: إِلَّا عَجُوزٗا فِي ٱلۡغَٰبِرِينَ
verses.translation: Except his wife among those who remained [with the evildoers]
verses.tafsir: except an old woman who was among those who stayed behind in other words those who stayed behind in the chastisement.
verses.tafsirV2: Save an old woman among those who stayed behind) except his hypocrite wife who stayed behind with those who were destroyed;

verses.text: ثُمَّ دَمَّرۡنَا ٱلۡأٓخَرِينَ
verses.translation: Then We destroyed the others
verses.tafsir: Then We destroyed all the others the disbelievers from among his people.
verses.tafsirV2: (Then We destroyed the others) We destroyed those who remained behind after the departure of Lot and his daughters.

verses.text: وَإِنَّكُمۡ لَتَمُرُّونَ عَلَيۡهِم مُّصۡبِحِينَ
verses.translation: And indeed, you pass by them in the morning
verses.tafsir: And indeed you pass by them by their remains and the remains of their dwellings during your travels both in the morning that is during the daytime
verses.tafsirV2: (And lo! Ye) O people of Mecca (verily pass by (the ruin of) them) by the towns of Lot: Sodom, 'Amura, Sabura and Daduma (in the morning

verses.text: وَبِٱلَّيۡلِۚ أَفَلَا تَعۡقِلُونَ
verses.translation: And at night. Then will you not use reason
verses.tafsir: and at night will you O people of Mecca not then understand? what befell them and so take heed therefrom?
verses.tafsirV2: And at night time; have ye then no sense) do you not believe in what was done to them, such that you do not follow their example?

verses.text: وَإِنَّ يُونُسَ لَمِنَ ٱلۡمُرۡسَلِينَ
verses.translation: And indeed, Jonah was among the messengers
verses.tafsir: And indeed Jonah was one of the messengers;
verses.tafsirV2: (And lo! Jonah verily was of those sent (to warn)) his folk,

verses.text: إِذۡ أَبَقَ إِلَى ٱلۡفُلۡكِ ٱلۡمَشۡحُونِ
verses.translation: [Mention] when he ran away to the laden ship
