verses.tafsirV2: (And warnings came in truth unto the house of Pharaoh) Moses and Aaron went to Pharaoh and his folk

verses.text: كَذَّبُواْ بِـَٔايَٰتِنَا كُلِّهَا فَأَخَذۡنَٰهُمۡ أَخۡذَ عَزِيزٖ مُّقۡتَدِرٍ
verses.translation: They denied Our signs, all of them, so We seized them with a seizure of one Exalted in Might and Perfect in Ability
verses.tafsir: Rather They denied Our signs all nine of them which were given to Moses. So We seized them by way of chastisement with the seizing of One Who is Mighty Strong Omnipotent Powerful Whom nothing can thwart.
verses.tafsirV2: (Who denied Our revelations, every one) of the nine signs. (Therefore We grasped them with the grasp of the Mighty) by means of punishment, (the Powerful) to inflict punishment.

verses.text: أَكُفَّارُكُمۡ خَيۡرٞ مِّنۡ أُوْلَـٰٓئِكُمۡ أَمۡ لَكُم بَرَآءَةٞ فِي ٱلزُّبُرِ
verses.translation: Are your disbelievers better than those [former ones], or have you immunity in the scripture
verses.tafsir: Are your disbelievers O Quraysh better than those? mentioned beginning from the people of Noah to those of Pharaoh which is why they have not been chastised? Or have you O disbelievers of Quraysh been granted some immunity from chastisement in the Scriptures? the Books? the interrogative in both instances is meant as a denial in other words it is not so.
verses.tafsirV2: (Are your disbelievers) O Muhammad; and it is said: O people of Mecca (better than those) We related to you, (or have ye some immunity in the Scriptures) from punishment?

verses.text: أَمۡ يَقُولُونَ نَحۡنُ جَمِيعٞ مُّنتَصِرٞ
verses.translation: Or do they say, "We are an assembly supporting [each other]
verses.tafsir: Or do they the disbelievers of Quraysh say ‘We are a host that will be helped to victory’? against Muhammad (s)? When Abū Jahl on the day of Badr said ‘We are a host that will be helped to victory’ the following was revealed
verses.tafsirV2: (Or say they) i.e. the disbelievers of Mecca: (We are a host victorious) and immune from punishment?

verses.text: سَيُهۡزَمُ ٱلۡجَمۡعُ وَيُوَلُّونَ ٱلدُّبُرَ
verses.translation: [Their] assembly will be defeated, and they will turn their backs [in retreat]
verses.tafsir: The host will truly be routed and turn its back to flee and so they were defeated at Badr and God’s Messenger s was granted victory over them.
verses.tafsirV2: (The hosts) the hosts of the disbelieving (will all be routed) on the Day of Badr (and will turn and flee) defeated; this refers to Abu Jahl and his host, some of whom were killed on the Day of Badr and others defeated.

verses.text: بَلِ ٱلسَّاعَةُ مَوۡعِدُهُمۡ وَٱلسَّاعَةُ أَدۡهَىٰ وَأَمَرُّ
verses.translation: But the Hour is their appointment [for due punishment], and the Hour is more disastrous and more bitter
verses.tafsir: Nay but the Hour is their tryst for chastisement and the Hour that is the chastisement thereat will be more calamitous greater in affliction and more bitter than the chastisement of this world.
verses.tafsirV2: (Nay, but the Hour (of doom)) the advent of the Hour (is their appointed tryst) of punishment, (and the Hour) of punishment (will be more wretched) more tremendous (and more bitter) than the punishment they suffered on the Day of Badr.

verses.text: إِنَّ ٱلۡمُجۡرِمِينَ فِي ضَلَٰلٖ وَسُعُرٖ
verses.translation: Indeed, the criminals are in error and madness
verses.tafsir: Indeed the guilty are in error in the destruction of being killed in this world and in a blazing fire a fire that has been set ablaze musa‘‘ara that is fiercely ignited in the Hereafter.
verses.tafsirV2: (Lo! the guilty) the idolaters: Abu Jahl and his host (are in error) in manifest error in the life of the world (and madness) toil and tiredness in hell.

verses.text: يَوۡمَ يُسۡحَبُونَ فِي ٱلنَّارِ عَلَىٰ وُجُوهِهِمۡ ذُوقُواْ مَسَّ سَقَرَ
verses.translation: The Day they are dragged into the Fire on their faces [it will be said], "Taste the touch of Saqar
verses.tafsir: The day when they are dragged into the Fire on their faces in the Hereafter and it is said to them ‘Taste now the touch of Saqar’ Hell’s affliction of you.
verses.tafsirV2: (On the day) which is the Day of Judgement (when they are dragged into the Fire) the angels of the Fire will drag them (upon their faces) and these angels will say to them: (Feel the touch of hell) taste the punishment of the Fire.

verses.text: إِنَّا كُلَّ شَيۡءٍ خَلَقۡنَٰهُ بِقَدَرٖ
verses.translation: Indeed, all things We created with predestination
verses.tafsir: Truly everything read inna kulla shay’in is in the accusative as a dependent clause because of a verb governing it have We created in a measure by ordainment bi-qadarin ‘in a measure’ is a circumstantial qualifier referring to kulla ‘every’ in other words ‘already predetermined’; a variant reading for kulla has nominative kullu as the subject the predicate of which is khalaqnāhu ‘We have created’.
verses.tafsirV2: (Lo! We have created every thing) of your works (by measure) by you rejected this. This verse was revealed about those who argued about destiny.

verses.text: وَمَآ أَمۡرُنَآ إِلَّا وَٰحِدَةٞ كَلَمۡحِۭ بِٱلۡبَصَرِ
verses.translation: And Our command is but one, like a glance of the eye
verses.tafsir: And Our command for a thing which We want to bring into existence is but a single word like the twinkling of an eye in terms of speed and this is the saying of kun ‘Be’ whereat it comes into existence. His command when He wills a thing is just to say to it ‘Be’ and it is Q. 3682.
verses.tafsirV2: (And Our commandment) concerning the coming of the Hour (is but one (commandment)) is but one word, (as the twinkling of an eye) in its swiftness. It is also said that (We have created every thing) means: We have created for everything something similar to it and also that which agrees with it of clothes and things.

verses.text: وَلَقَدۡ أَهۡلَكۡنَآ أَشۡيَاعَكُمۡ فَهَلۡ مِن مُّدَّكِرٖ
verses.translation: And We have already destroyed your kinds, so is there any who will remember
verses.tafsir: And verily We have destroyed the likes of you the likes of you in terms of disbelief from among past communities. So is there anyone who will remember? this is an interrogative meant as an imperative that is to say ‘Remember and be admonished!’.
verses.tafsirV2: (And verily We have destroyed your fellows) We have destroyed the like of you and those who followed your religion, O people of Mecca; (but is there any that remembereth) is there any that takes admonition from what was done with them and, thus, desist from transgression?

verses.text: وَكُلُّ شَيۡءٖ فَعَلُوهُ فِي ٱلزُّبُرِ
verses.translation: And everything they did is in written records
verses.tafsir: And everything they that is servants have done is recorded in the scrolls the books of the Guardian Angels al-hafaza
verses.tafsirV2: (And every thing they did) of transgression in their state of idolatry and opposition of the prophets (is in the Scriptures) written down; and it is said this means: it is written in the Guarded Tablet. This also was revealed about those who disputed about fate.

verses.text: وَكُلُّ صَغِيرٖ وَكَبِيرٖ مُّسۡتَطَرٌ
verses.translation: And every small and great [thing] is inscribed
verses.tafsir: and every small and great sin or deed is inscribed is recorded in the Preserved Tablet al-lawh al-mahfūz.
verses.tafsirV2: (And every small and great thing) of good or evil (is recorded) in the Guarded Tablet; this was revealed about the people who disputed about fate and who denied that everything is recorded in the Guarded Tablet.

verses.text: إِنَّ ٱلۡمُتَّقِينَ فِي جَنَّـٰتٖ وَنَهَرٖ
verses.translation: Indeed, the righteous will be among gardens and rivers
verses.tafsir: Assuredly the God-fearing will be amid gardens orchards and rivers the collective noun is meant here; a variant reading for nahar has the plural nuhur similar in form to asad ‘lion’ plural usud the meaning being that they will drink from its rivers water milk honey and wine;
verses.tafsirV2: (Lo! the righteous) those who ward off disbelief, idolatry and indecencies (will dwell among Gardens and rivers) many rivers; and it is said: in vast meadows,

verses.text: فِي مَقۡعَدِ صِدۡقٍ عِندَ مَلِيكٖ مُّقۡتَدِرِۭ
verses.translation: In a seat of honor near a Sovereign, Perfect in Ability
verses.tafsir: in an abode of truth a place of truth wherein there is no idle talk or cause for sin — the collective noun maq‘ad is meant here; a variant reading has maqā‘id ‘abodes’ in other words they are in congregations in Paradise that are free from idle talk and cause for sin in contrast to the congregations of this world which are rarely free from such things syntactically this statement is considered a second predicate and also a substitution; it the ‘abode’ may be understood as being ‘one of truth’ regardless of whether one reads the substitution as being of the part for the whole or otherwise; before a King malīk this form is hyperbolic that is to say One of a mighty and vast kingdom Who is Omnipotent Powerful Whom nothing can thwart namely God exalted be He ‘inda indicates glorious rank and closeness to His bounty exalted be He.
verses.tafsirV2: (Firmly established) they are in an honoured place in Paradise (in the favour of a Mighty King) Who is able to dispense both reward and punishment to His slaves'.

verses.text: ٱلرَّحۡمَٰنُ
verses.translation: The Most Merciful
verses.tafsir: The Compassionate One God exalted be He
verses.tafsirV2: And from his narration on the authority of Ibn 'Abbas that he said: “When the verse (Say (unto mankind): Cry unto Allah, or cry unto the Beneficent) [17:111] was revealed, the disbelievers of Mecca-Abu Jahl, al-Walid, 'Utbah and Shaybah and their hosts-said: we know no one called the Beneficent except Musaylimah the liar who lives in Yamamah. So he is this Beneficent one, O Muhammad?” And so Allah revealed this: (The Beneficent

verses.text: عَلَّمَ ٱلۡقُرۡءَانَ
verses.translation: Taught the Qur'an
verses.tafsir: has taught whomever He will the Qur’ān.
verses.tafsirV2: Hath made known the Qur'an) to Gabriel and the latter to Muhammad, and Muhammad to his nation. Allah sent Gabriel with the Qur'an to Muhammad (pbuh) and the Prophet taught it to his nation.

verses.text: خَلَقَ ٱلۡإِنسَٰنَ
verses.translation: Created man
verses.tafsir: He created man the species mankind
verses.tafsirV2: (He hath created man) i.e. Adam from the surface of the earth.

verses.text: عَلَّمَهُ ٱلۡبَيَانَ
verses.translation: [And] taught him eloquence
verses.tafsir: teaching him the coherent speech utterance.
verses.tafsirV2: (He hath taught him utterance) Allah inspired him with the exposition of everything as well as with the names of every beast on the surface of the earth.

verses.text: ٱلشَّمۡسُ وَٱلۡقَمَرُ بِحُسۡبَانٖ
verses.translation: The sun and the moon [move] by precise calculation
verses.tafsir: The sun and the moon follow a reckoning they move according to a strict calculation
verses.tafsirV2: (The sun and the moon are made punctual) their orbits are measured; and it is also said that this means: they are suspended half way between heaven and earth; and it is also said that this means: they both will be taken to task and have a lifespan like the lifespan of human beings.

verses.text: وَٱلنَّجۡمُ وَٱلشَّجَرُ يَسۡجُدَانِ
verses.translation: And the stars and trees prostrate
verses.tafsir: and the grass all stalkless vegetation and the trees that vegetation which possesses stalk prostrate comply with what is required of them.
verses.tafsirV2: (The najm and the trees adore) the stars and the trees prostrate to the Beneficent; and it is also said that najm refers to vegetation that has no stalks.

verses.text: وَٱلسَّمَآءَ رَفَعَهَا وَوَضَعَ ٱلۡمِيزَانَ
verses.translation: And the heaven He raised and imposed the balance
verses.tafsir: And He has raised the heaven and set up the balance He has established justice
verses.tafsirV2: (And the sky He hath uplifted) above everything; such that nothing touches it; (and He hath set the measure) on the earth; He explained fair measure through the scale,

verses.text: أَلَّا تَطۡغَوۡاْ فِي ٱلۡمِيزَانِ
verses.translation: That you not transgress within the balance
verses.tafsir: declaring that you should not contravene that is to say so that you may not do wrong with regard to the balance that instrument with which one weighs.
verses.tafsirV2: (That ye exceed not the measure) that you do not transgress or be unjust in measure,

verses.text: وَأَقِيمُواْ ٱلۡوَزۡنَ بِٱلۡقِسۡطِ وَلَا تُخۡسِرُواْ ٱلۡمِيزَانَ
verses.translation: And establish weight in justice and do not make deficient the balance
verses.tafsir: And observe the weights with justice fairly and do not skimp the balance do not decrease the value of what is being weighed.
verses.tafsirV2: (But observe the measure strictly) keep the balance of the scale justly; and it is also said that this means: observe your tongues by saying only the Truth, (nor fall short thereof) do not weigh less for the people such that you take away their rights.

verses.text: وَٱلۡأَرۡضَ وَضَعَهَا لِلۡأَنَامِ
verses.translation: And the earth He laid [out] for the creatures
verses.tafsir: And the earth He placed it He fixed it in place for all creatures man jinn and others.
verses.tafsirV2: (And the earth hath He appointed) He spread it on the water (for (His) creatures) for all created beings whether dead or alive,

verses.text: فِيهَا فَٰكِهَةٞ وَٱلنَّخۡلُ ذَاتُ ٱلۡأَكۡمَامِ
verses.translation: Therein is fruit and palm trees having sheaths [of dates]
verses.tafsir: In it are fruits and the familiar date-palms with sheaths the spathes containing its flowers
verses.tafsirV2: (Wherein) in the earth (are fruit) different kind of fruits (and sheathed palm-trees) which has foreskin or shells, or anything that has not sprouted up.

verses.text: وَٱلۡحَبُّ ذُو ٱلۡعَصۡفِ وَٱلرَّيۡحَانُ
verses.translation: And grain having husks and scented plants
verses.tafsir: and grain such as wheat and barley with husk and fragrant herb.
verses.tafsirV2: (Husked grain) all kind of grain (and scented herb) spikes of grain and fruits.

verses.text: فَبِأَيِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ
verses.translation: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny
verses.tafsir: So which of your Lord’s favours graces will you deny? tukadhdhibān is mentioned thirty one times; the interrogative is meant to be understood as an affirmative judging by what al-Hākim al-Naysābūrī reported by way of an isnād from Jābir b. ‘Abd Allāh al-Ansārī who said ‘The Messenger of God s was reciting surāt al-Rahmān to us and when he completed it he said “What is wrong with you that you have been silent throughout? Verily the jinn are more responsive than you. Not once did I recite this verse to them — So which of your Lord’s favours will you deny? — but that they said ‘Not one of your graces our Lord do we deny for all praise belongs to You’ ”.
verses.tafsirV2: (Which is it, of the favours of your Lord, that ye deny) and claim that they are not from Allah, O jinn and humans? This is addressed to all human beings except Muhammad (pbuh).

verses.text: خَلَقَ ٱلۡإِنسَٰنَ مِن صَلۡصَٰلٖ كَٱلۡفَخَّارِ
verses.translation: He created man from clay like [that of] pottery
verses.tafsir: He created man Adam of dry clay salsāl a dry hollow mud producing an echo if tapped resembling the potter’s fakhkhār clay that has been baked
verses.tafsirV2: (He created man) i.e. Adam (of clay like the potter's) out of which pottery is made,

verses.text: وَخَلَقَ ٱلۡجَآنَّ مِن مَّارِجٖ مِّن نَّارٖ
verses.translation: And He created the jinn from a smokeless flame of fire
verses.tafsir: and He created the Jann the father of the jinn namely Iblīs of a smokeless flame of fire.
verses.tafsirV2: (And the jinn) the father of the jinn and satans (did He create of smokeless fire.

verses.text: فَبِأَيِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ
verses.translation: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny
verses.tafsir: So which of your Lord’s favours will you deny?
verses.tafsirV2: Which is it, of the favours of your Lord, that ye deny) which of the blessings of your Lord do you deny?

verses.text: رَبُّ ٱلۡمَشۡرِقَيۡنِ وَرَبُّ ٱلۡمَغۡرِبَيۡنِ
verses.translation: [He is] Lord of the two sunrises and Lord of the two sunsets
verses.tafsir: Lord of the two Easts the points of the winter sunrise and the summer sunrise and Lord of the two Wests likewise the two points of sunset.
verses.tafsirV2: (Lord of the two Easts) the East of winter and the East of summer, (and Lord of the two Wests) the West of winter and the West of summer! There are two Easts and two Wests. The East of winter and the East of summer have 180 phases just as the two Wests and the moon have 180 phases. It is also said that the Easts of summer and winter have 177 phases and the Wests of summer and winter as well as the moon have 177 phases. The sun rises throughout the year two days in the same phase and it also sets two days in the same phase.

verses.text: فَبِأَيِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ
verses.translation: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny
verses.tafsir: So which of your Lord’s favours will you deny?
verses.tafsirV2: (Which is it, of the favours of your Lord, that ye deny?

verses.text: مَرَجَ ٱلۡبَحۡرَيۡنِ يَلۡتَقِيَانِ
verses.translation: He released the two seas, meeting [side by side]
verses.tafsir: He has loosed the two waters the sweet and the salty; and so they meet in the perception of the eye.
verses.tafsirV2: He hath loosed the two seas) the sweet and the salty. (They meet) without mixing.

verses.text: بَيۡنَهُمَا بَرۡزَخٞ لَّا يَبۡغِيَانِ
verses.translation: Between them is a barrier [so] neither of them transgresses
verses.tafsir: Between them there is a barrier by His power exalted be He. They do not overstep neither of the two encroaches upon the other to become mixed with it.
verses.tafsirV2: (There is a barrier) from Allah (between them) between the sweet and salty seas. (They encroach not (one upon the other)) nor does any one of them change the taste of the other.

verses.text: فَبِأَيِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ
verses.translation: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny
verses.tafsir: So which of your Lord’s favours will you deny?
verses.tafsirV2: (Which is it, of the favours of your Lord: that you deny?

verses.text: يَخۡرُجُ مِنۡهُمَا ٱللُّؤۡلُؤُ وَٱلۡمَرۡجَانُ
verses.translation: From both of them emerge pearl and coral
verses.tafsir: From both of them from the point at which they seem to meet — but which is actually from only one of the two and that is the salt water — is brought forth yukhraju passive may also be read as active yakhruju ‘emerge’ the pearl and the coral marjān these are red pieces of shell or small pearls.
verses.tafsirV2: There cometh forth from both of them) but especially from the salty one (the pearl) big in size (and coral stone) small in size.

verses.text: فَبِأَيِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ
verses.translation: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny
verses.tafsir: So which of your Lord’s favours will you deny?
verses.tafsirV2: (Which is it, of the favours of your Lord, that ye deny?

verses.text: وَلَهُ ٱلۡجَوَارِ ٱلۡمُنشَـَٔاتُ فِي ٱلۡبَحۡرِ كَٱلۡأَعۡلَٰمِ
verses.translation: And to Him belong the ships [with sails] elevated in the sea like mountains
verses.tafsir: His are the crafted ships that sail in the sea appearing like landmarks like mountains in their tremendous size and height.
verses.tafsirV2: His are the ships displayed) floating (upon the sea, like banners) like mountains, that is when the ships raise their sails.

verses.text: فَبِأَيِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ
verses.translation: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny
verses.tafsir: So which of your Lord’s favours will you deny?
verses.tafsirV2: Which is it, of the favours of your Lord, that ye deny?

verses.text: كُلُّ مَنۡ عَلَيۡهَا فَانٖ
verses.translation: Everyone upon the earth will perish
verses.tafsir: Everyone who is on it that is on the earth of animal beings will perish man ‘who’ is used to indicate predominance of rational beings;
verses.tafsirV2: Everyone that is thereon) on the face of the earth (will pass away) will die; it is also said that this means: everyone upon it will vanish; and it is also said that this means: every act that is done for other than Allah will perish;

verses.text: وَيَبۡقَىٰ وَجۡهُ رَبِّكَ ذُو ٱلۡجَلَٰلِ وَٱلۡإِكۡرَامِ
verses.translation: And there will remain the Face of your Lord, Owner of Majesty and Honor
verses.tafsir: yet there will remain the countenance of your Lord His Essence the countenance of majesty magnificence and munificence towards believers through His graces to them.
verses.tafsirV2: (There remaineth but the Countenance of thy Lord) dies not; and it is also said that this means: the righteous works which are performed for the sake of Allah's Countenance will not perish (of Might) Who possesses might and sovereignty (and Glory) and who also possesses forgiveness and beneficence.

verses.text: فَبِأَيِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ
verses.translation: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny
verses.tafsir: So which of your Lord’s favours will you deny?
verses.tafsirV2: Which is it, of the favours of your Lord, that ye deny?

verses.text: يَسۡـَٔلُهُۥ مَن فِي ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِۚ كُلَّ يَوۡمٍ هُوَ فِي شَأۡنٖ
verses.translation: Whoever is within the heavens and earth asks Him; every day He is bringing about a matter
verses.tafsir: All that is in the heavens and the earth implore Him either by way of speech or by their very state of dependence on Him for the strength which they require for worship for provision forgiveness and other things. Every day all the time He is upon some matter something that He manifests in accordance with what He has decreed since pre-eternity such as the giving of life the bringing of death exalting and abasing individuals giving abundantly and withholding responding to a supplicating person and giving the one requesting something and so on and so forth.
verses.tafsirV2: All that are in the heavens) among the angels (and the earth) among the believers. The inhabitants of the earth ask Him forgiveness, success, preservation from sin, bestowal of honour and provision (entreat Him. Every day He exerciseth (universal) power) He gives life, He takes life, He raises, He abases, He brings into the world a new born baby, He releases a prisoner; and the things He exercises are beyond count.

verses.text: فَبِأَيِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ
verses.translation: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny
verses.tafsir: So which of your Lord’s favours will you deny?
verses.tafsirV2: Which is it, of the favours of your Lord, that ye deny?

verses.text: سَنَفۡرُغُ لَكُمۡ أَيُّهَ ٱلثَّقَلَانِ
verses.translation: We will attend to you, O prominent beings
verses.tafsir: We will attend to you We shall turn to reckon with you O you two heavy ones! mankind and jinn.
verses.tafsirV2: We shall dispose of you) We shall record the works that you do in the life of the world and take you to task for them on the Day of Judgement, (O ye two dependents) human beings and the jinn.

verses.text: فَبِأَيِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ
verses.translation: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny
verses.tafsir: So which of your Lord’s favours will you deny?
verses.tafsirV2: Which is it, of the favours of your Lord, that ye deny?

verses.text: يَٰمَعۡشَرَ ٱلۡجِنِّ وَٱلۡإِنسِ إِنِ ٱسۡتَطَعۡتُمۡ أَن تَنفُذُواْ مِنۡ أَقۡطَارِ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِ فَٱنفُذُواْۚ لَا تَنفُذُونَ إِلَّا بِسُلۡطَٰنٖ
verses.translation: O company of jinn and mankind, if you are able to pass beyond the regions of the heavens and the earth, then pass. You will not pass except by authority [from Allah]
verses.tafsir: O company of jinn and humans if you are able to pass through to exit from the confines the regions of the heavens and the earth then pass through! — a command meant to challenge them to what they are incapable of doing. You will not pass through except with a sanction except with some power and you have no power for such a thing.
verses.tafsirV2: O company of jinn and men, if ye have power) if you are able (to penetrate (all)) to break free from (regions) the extremities (of the heavens and the earth) and from the rows of angels; (then penetrate (them)) then break free and flee! (You will never penetrate them) you will not be able to break free (save with (Our) sanction) save with a reason and proof.

verses.text: فَبِأَيِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ
verses.translation: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny
verses.tafsir: So which of your Lord’s favours will you deny?
verses.tafsirV2: Which is it, of the favours of your Lord, that ye deny?

verses.text: يُرۡسَلُ عَلَيۡكُمَا شُوَاظٞ مِّن نَّارٖ وَنُحَاسٞ فَلَا تَنتَصِرَانِ
verses.translation: There will be sent upon you a flame of fire and smoke, and you will not defend yourselves
verses.tafsir: Against you will be unleashed a heat of fire shuwāz can either mean that the flame thereof has no smoke or that it does have it with it and a flash of brass without any flame and you will not be able to seek help you will not be able to defend yourselves against this nay it will drive you to the site of the Gathering.
verses.tafsirV2: There will be sent, against you both) when you emerge from the graves, O humans and jinn, (heat of fire) of smokeless fire (and flash of brass) and smoke which will lead you to the place of assembly, (and ye will not escape) you will not refuse to be led.

verses.text: فَبِأَيِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ
verses.translation: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny
verses.tafsir: So which of your Lord’s favours will you deny?
verses.tafsirV2: Which is it, of the favours of your Lord, that ye deny?

verses.text: فَإِذَا ٱنشَقَّتِ ٱلسَّمَآءُ فَكَانَتۡ وَرۡدَةٗ كَٱلدِّهَانِ
verses.translation: And when the heaven is split open and becomes rose-colored like oil
verses.tafsir: And when the heaven is split open when it becomes open with many gates in preparation for the descent of the angels and it turns crimson wardatan literally ‘a rose’ in other words red like this rose like tanned leather red skins in contrast to its the heaven’s usual appearance the response to idhā ‘when’ is along the lines of fa-mā a‘zama’l-hawli ‘How great will be the terror then!’.
verses.tafsirV2: And when the heaven splitteth asunder) because of the descent of the angels and awe towards the Lord (and becometh rosy) and become coloured (like red hide) like different kinds of paint; and it is said: like the different colours of roses; and it is also said: red in black

verses.text: فَبِأَيِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ
verses.translation: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny
verses.tafsir: So which of your Lord’s favours will you deny?
verses.tafsirV2: Which is it, of the favours of your Lord, that ye deny?

verses.text: فَيَوۡمَئِذٖ لَّا يُسۡـَٔلُ عَن ذَنۢبِهِۦٓ إِنسٞ وَلَا جَآنّٞ
verses.translation: Then on that Day none will be asked about his sin among men or jinn
verses.tafsir: Thus on that day no man will be questioned about his sin nor any jinn about his sin; but they are questioned on some other occasion By your Lord We shall question them all Q.1592 al-jānn in this instance and in what will follow denotes the jinn and also in both cases al-ins denotes human beings.
verses.tafsirV2: On that day) which is the Day of Judgement; after the end of reckoning (neither man nor jinn will be questioned of his sin) his works; the believer will be known with his blooming, white face; it is also said that this means: the sins of human beings and the jinn will not be asked about.

verses.text: فَبِأَيِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ
verses.translation: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny
verses.tafsir: So which of your Lord’s favours will you deny?
verses.tafsirV2: Which is it, of the favours of your Lord, that ye deny?

verses.text: يُعۡرَفُ ٱلۡمُجۡرِمُونَ بِسِيمَٰهُمۡ فَيُؤۡخَذُ بِٱلنَّوَٰصِي وَٱلۡأَقۡدَامِ
verses.translation: The criminals will be known by their marks, and they will be seized by the forelocks and the feet
verses.tafsir: The guilty will be recognised by their mark blackened faces and bruised eyes; so they will be seized by the forelocks and the feet.
verses.tafsirV2: The guilty will be known by their marks) the idolaters will be known by their dark faces and bluish eyes, (and will be taken by the forelocks and the feet) and cast in the Fire.

verses.text: فَبِأَيِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ
verses.translation: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny
verses.tafsir: So which of your Lord’s favours will you deny?
verses.tafsirV2: Which is it, of the favours of your Lord, that ye deny?)

verses.text: هَٰذِهِۦ جَهَنَّمُ ٱلَّتِي يُكَذِّبُ بِهَا ٱلۡمُجۡرِمُونَ
verses.translation: This is Hell, which the criminals deny
verses.tafsir: ‘This is Hell which the guilty were wont to deny!’
verses.tafsirV2: The angels in-charge of the Fire will say to them: (This is hell which the guilty deny) the idolaters, that is during the life of the world and claimed that it does not exist.

verses.text: يَطُوفُونَ بَيۡنَهَا وَبَيۡنَ حَمِيمٍ ءَانٖ
verses.translation: They will go around between it and scalding water, heated [to the utmost degree]
verses.tafsir: They shall pass round they shall pace between it and boiling hot water water of extreme temperature which they are given to drink every time they call to be rescued from the heat of the Fire ānin is defective like qādin.
verses.tafsirV2: (They go circling round between it) i.e. the Fire (and fierce, boiling water) water as hot as can be.

verses.text: فَبِأَيِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ
verses.translation: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny
verses.tafsir: So which of your Lord’s favours will you deny?
verses.tafsirV2: Which is it, of the favours of your Lord, that ye deny?

verses.text: وَلِمَنۡ خَافَ مَقَامَ رَبِّهِۦ جَنَّتَانِ
verses.translation: But for he who has feared the position of his Lord are two gardens
verses.tafsir: But for those who feared that is for every one of them or for all of them together the station of their Lord the standing before Him for the Reckoning and therefore refrained from being disobedient to Him there will be two gardens.
verses.tafsirV2: (But for him who feareth the standing before his Lord) but he who fears standing before his Lord upon being on the verge of committing a transgression and thus desists from it (there are two Gardens) the Garden of Eden and the Firdaws.

verses.text: فَبِأَيِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ
verses.translation: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny
verses.tafsir: So which of your Lord’s favours will you deny?
verses.tafsirV2: (Which is it, of the favours of your Lord, that ye deny?

verses.text: ذَوَاتَآ أَفۡنَانٖ
verses.translation: Having [spreading] branches
verses.tafsir: Both with dhawātā the dual form of the regular form dhawāt with its lām its third consonant is changed into a yā’ abundant branches afnān is the plural of fanan similar in pattern to talal atlāl.
verses.tafsirV2: Of spreading branches) and different kinds.

verses.text: فَبِأَيِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ
verses.translation: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny
verses.tafsir: So which of your Lord’s favours will you deny?
verses.tafsirV2: Which is it, of the favours of your Lord, that ye deny) regarding the Gardens?

verses.text: فِيهِمَا عَيۡنَانِ تَجۡرِيَانِ
verses.translation: In both of them are two springs, flowing
verses.tafsir: In both of them there are two flowing springs.
verses.tafsirV2: (Wherein are two fountains flowing) for the dwellers of Paradise containing goodness, mercy, bestowal of honour, grace and more from Allah.

verses.text: فَبِأَيِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ
verses.translation: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny
verses.tafsir: So which of your Lord’s favours will you deny?
verses.tafsirV2: (Which is it, of the favours of your Lord, that ye deny) regarding the Gardens?

verses.text: فِيهِمَا مِن كُلِّ فَٰكِهَةٖ زَوۡجَانِ
verses.translation: In both of them are of every fruit, two kinds
verses.tafsir: In both of them of every fruit fākiha of the fruits of this world — or it fākiha means all those things in which one delights yutafakkahu bihi — there are two kinds two varieties one juicy one dried and those which in this world are bitter like colocynth will be sweet therein.
verses.tafsirV2: (Wherein is every kind of fruit in pairs) both with regard to shape and taste.

verses.text: فَبِأَيِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ
verses.translation: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny
verses.tafsir: So which of your Lord’s favours will you deny?
verses.tafsirV2: Which is it, of the favours of your Lord, that ye deny?

verses.text: مُتَّكِـِٔينَ عَلَىٰ فُرُشِۭ بَطَآئِنُهَا مِنۡ إِسۡتَبۡرَقٖۚ وَجَنَى ٱلۡجَنَّتَيۡنِ دَانٖ
verses.translation: [They are] reclining on beds whose linings are of silk brocade, and the fruit of the two gardens is hanging low
verses.tafsir: They will be reclining muttaki’īna is a circumstantial qualifier operated by an omitted verb that is to say yatana‘‘amūna they will enjoy bliss while reclining’ upon couches lined with heavy silk brocade istabraq thick or coarse silk the outer lining being of fine silk sundus. And the fruits of both gardens will be near so that it may be reached by the one standing up the one sitting down or the one lying down.
verses.tafsirV2: Reclining upon couches) sitting in comfort upon couches (lined with silk brocade) their outside is made of thick silk brocade while their inside is of soft silk brocade, (the fruit of both Gardens near to hand.

verses.text: فَبِأَيِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ
verses.translation: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny
verses.tafsir: So which of your Lord’s favours will you deny?
verses.tafsirV2: Which is it, of the favours of your Lord, that ye deny) regarding all the Gardens?

verses.text: فِيهِنَّ قَٰصِرَٰتُ ٱلطَّرۡفِ لَمۡ يَطۡمِثۡهُنَّ إِنسٞ قَبۡلَهُمۡ وَلَا جَآنّٞ
verses.translation: In them are women limiting [their] glances, untouched before them by man or jinni
verses.tafsir: In them in the two gardens and what they comprise of upper chambers and palaces are maidens of restrained glances restricting their eyes to those spouses of theirs from among either the men or the jinn who are reclining maidens who have not been touched who have not been deflowered — and these maidens are either houris or women of this world who will have been created anew by any man or jinn before them.
verses.tafsirV2: (Therein are those of modest gaze) modest maiden who are content with their husbands and who do not look at other than their own husbands, (whom neither man nor jinn will have touched before them) before their husbands,

verses.text: فَبِأَيِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ
verses.translation: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny
verses.tafsir: So which of your Lord’s favours will you deny?
verses.tafsirV2: (Which is it, of the favours of your Lord, that ye deny?

verses.text: كَأَنَّهُنَّ ٱلۡيَاقُوتُ وَٱلۡمَرۡجَانُ
verses.translation: As if they were rubies and coral
verses.tafsir: It is as though they are rubies in their purity and pearls in their fairness.
verses.tafsirV2: (In beauty) like the jacynth and the coral stone.

verses.text: فَبِأَيِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ
verses.translation: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny
verses.tafsir: So which of your Lord’s favours will you deny?
verses.tafsirV2: Which is it, of the favours of your Lord, that ye deny?

verses.text: هَلۡ جَزَآءُ ٱلۡإِحۡسَٰنِ إِلَّا ٱلۡإِحۡسَٰنُ
verses.translation: Is the reward for good [anything] but good
verses.tafsir: Is the reward of goodness manifested through obedience anything but goodness? granted through bliss?
verses.tafsirV2: Is the reward of goodness aught save goodness?) He says: is the reward of he whom We have blessed with the profession of Allah's divine Oneness anything but the Garden?

verses.text: فَبِأَيِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ
verses.translation: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny
verses.tafsir: So which of your Lord’s favours will you deny?
verses.tafsirV2: (Which is it, of the favours of your Lord, that ye deny?

verses.text: وَمِن دُونِهِمَا جَنَّتَانِ
verses.translation: And below them both [in excellence] are two [other] gardens
verses.tafsir: And beside these two mentioned gardens there will be two other gardens in addition for those who feared the standing before their Lord.
verses.tafsirV2: And beside them) besides the gardens mentioned earlier (are two other Gardens) which are less than the first two and which are: the Garden of Comfort (jannat al-na'im) and the Garden of Refuge (jannat al-ma'wa),

verses.text: فَبِأَيِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ
verses.translation: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny
verses.tafsir: So which of your Lord’s favours will you deny?
verses.tafsirV2: (Which is it, of the favours of your Lord, that ye deny) regarding the two Gardens?

verses.text: مُدۡهَآمَّتَانِ
verses.translation: Dark green [in color]
verses.tafsir: Deep green mudhāmmatān this means that they are almost black on account of the intensity of their greenness.
verses.tafsirV2: (Dark green with foliage) because of their abundant watering.

verses.text: فَبِأَيِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ
verses.translation: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny
verses.tafsir: So which of your Lord’s favours will you deny?
verses.tafsirV2: (Which is it, of the favours of your Lord, that ye deny) regarding these two Gardens?

verses.text: فِيهِمَا عَيۡنَانِ نَضَّاخَتَانِ
verses.translation: In both of them are two springs, spouting
verses.tafsir: In both of them will be two gushing fountains rushing with water unceasing.
verses.tafsirV2: (Wherein) in the Gardens (are two abundant springs) and it is said: springs full of goodness, grace, mercy and bestowal of honour and much more from Allah.

verses.text: فَبِأَيِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ
verses.translation: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny
verses.tafsir: So which of your Lord’s favours will you deny?
verses.tafsirV2: (Which is it, of the favours of your Lord, that ye deny) regarding he two Gardens?

verses.text: فِيهِمَا فَٰكِهَةٞ وَنَخۡلٞ وَرُمَّانٞ
verses.translation: In both of them are fruit and palm trees and pomegranates
verses.tafsir: In both of them will be fruits and date-palms and pomegranates the latter two fruits being from among these fruits of the two gardens; but it is also said that they belong to the fruits of some other garden.
verses.tafsirV2: (Wherein) in the two Gardens (is fruit) different kinds of fruit, (the date-palm) different kinds of palm- trees (and pomegranate) different kinds of pomegranate in both taste and shape.

verses.text: فَبِأَيِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ
verses.translation: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny
verses.tafsir: So which of your Lord’s favours will you deny?
verses.tafsirV2: (Which is it, of the favours of your Lord, that ye deny) regarding the four Gardens; and it is said: regarding all the Gardens?

verses.text: فِيهِنَّ خَيۡرَٰتٌ حِسَانٞ
verses.translation: In them are good and beautiful women
verses.tafsir: In them that is in the two gardens and their palaces and what they comprise are maidens who are good in nature and with beautiful faces.
verses.tafsirV2: (Wherein (are found) the good and beautiful) wives, i.e. good for their husbands.

verses.text: فَبِأَيِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ
verses.translation: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny
verses.tafsir: So which of your Lord’s favours will you deny?
verses.tafsirV2: (Which is it, of the favours of your Lord, that ye deny?

verses.text: حُورٞ مَّقۡصُورَٰتٞ فِي ٱلۡخِيَامِ
verses.translation: Fair ones reserved in pavilions
verses.tafsir: Houris hur this means maidens with intense black eyes set against the intense whiteness of the iris secluded concealed in pavilions made of studded gems annexed to the palaces like boudoirs.
verses.tafsirV2: Fair ones, close-guarded) for their husbands (in pavilions) of hollowed pearls.

verses.text: فَبِأَيِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ
verses.translation: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny
verses.tafsir: So which of your Lord’s favours will you deny?
verses.tafsirV2: Which is it, of the favours of your Lord, that ye deny?

verses.text: لَمۡ يَطۡمِثۡهُنَّ إِنسٞ قَبۡلَهُمۡ وَلَا جَآنّٞ
verses.translation: Untouched before them by man or jinni
verses.tafsir: Untouched by any man before them before these soon-to-be spouses of theirs or jinn.
verses.tafsirV2: Whom neither man nor jinn will have touched before them) before their husbands

verses.text: فَبِأَيِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ
verses.translation: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny
verses.tafsir: So which of your Lord’s favours will you deny?
verses.tafsirV2: (Which is it, of the favours of your Lord, that ye deny?

verses.text: مُتَّكِـِٔينَ عَلَىٰ رَفۡرَفٍ خُضۡرٖ وَعَبۡقَرِيٍّ حِسَانٖ
verses.translation: Reclining on green cushions and beautiful fine carpets
verses.tafsir: Reclining namely their spouses muttaki’īna syntactically it is as described above upon green cushions rafraf is the plural of rafrafa which can mean either ‘carpets’ or ‘cushions’ and lovely druggets ‘abqariyyin the plural of ‘abqariyya which are velvet carpets.
verses.tafsirV2: Reclining on green cushions) and it is also said: in meadows (and fair carpets) beautifully coloured carpets.

verses.text: فَبِأَيِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ
verses.translation: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny
verses.tafsir: So which of your Lord’s favours will you deny?
verses.tafsirV2: (Which is it, of the favours of your Lord, that ye deny) which of the blessings of your Lord, O men and jinn-here to the exception of Muhammad (pbuh)-do you reject and claim that it is not from Allah?

verses.text: تَبَٰرَكَ ٱسۡمُ رَبِّكَ ذِي ٱلۡجَلَٰلِ وَٱلۡإِكۡرَامِ
verses.translation: Blessed is the name of your Lord, Owner of Majesty and Honor
verses.tafsir: Blessed be the Name of your Lord He of Majesty and Munificence as explained above; the word ism is extra.
verses.tafsirV2: (Blessed be the Name of thy Lord) your Lord is the Possessor of grace and Mercy; and it is said: Allah exonerates Himself from having a son or partner, (Mighty) the Possessor of might and sovereignty (and Glorious) and the Possessor of forgiveness and beneficence upon the advent of the Day of Judgement!'

verses.text: إِذَا وَقَعَتِ ٱلۡوَاقِعَةُ
verses.translation: When the Occurrence occurs
verses.tafsir: When the imminent Event comes to pass when the Resurrection takes place
verses.tafsirV2: And from his narration on the authority of Ibn 'Abbas that he said regarding the interpretation of Allah's saying (When the event befalleth): '(When the event befalleth) He says: when the Day of Judgement comes.

verses.text: لَيۡسَ لِوَقۡعَتِهَا كَاذِبَةٌ
verses.translation: There is, at its occurrence, no denial
verses.tafsir: there will be no denying its coming to pass there is no soul to deny it by repudiating it as it did in this world
verses.tafsirV2: (There is no denying that it will befall) its coming cannot be repulsed, delayed or contain any ambiguity.

verses.text: خَافِضَةٞ رَّافِعَةٌ
verses.translation: It will bring down [some] and raise up [others]
verses.tafsir: it will be abasing some exalting others that is it will manifest the abasing of some people by virtue of their admission into the Fire and manifest the exalting of others by their admission into Paradise.
verses.tafsirV2: (Abasing (some)) due to their own works and, thus, sends them to the Fire, (exalting (others)) due to their own works and, thus, sends to the Garden. It is also said it is called the Event because of its sound which will be heard by the near and the far;

verses.text: إِذَا رُجَّتِ ٱلۡأَرۡضُ رَجّٗا
verses.translation: When the earth is shaken with convulsion
verses.tafsir: When the earth is shaken with a violent shock
verses.tafsirV2: (When the earth is shaken with a shock) when the earth is shaken with such an earthquake that every mountain and building in it will be obliterated and turn into rubble.

verses.text: وَبُسَّتِ ٱلۡجِبَالُ بَسّٗا
verses.translation: And the mountains are broken down, crumbling
verses.tafsir: and the mountains are pulverised to tiny pieces
verses.tafsirV2: (And the hills are ground to powder) and it is also said: and the hills are made to move like the passing of the clouds; and it is also said that this means: when the hills are uprooted from their spots.

verses.text: فَكَانَتۡ هَبَآءٗ مُّنۢبَثّٗا
verses.translation: And become dust dispersing
verses.tafsir: so that they become a scattered dust the second idh ‘when’ is a substitution for the first idh
verses.tafsirV2: (So that they become a scattered dust) like the dust which sticks to the hooves of beasts or the atoms of dust which can be seen when the rays of the sun emerge from a hole in a house or a crack in a door,

verses.text: وَكُنتُمۡ أَزۡوَٰجٗا ثَلَٰثَةٗ
verses.translation: And you become [of] three kinds
verses.tafsir: and you will be at the Resurrection three kinds categories
verses.tafsirV2: (And ye will be) on the Day of Judgement (three kinds:

verses.text: فَأَصۡحَٰبُ ٱلۡمَيۡمَنَةِ مَآ أَصۡحَٰبُ ٱلۡمَيۡمَنَةِ
verses.translation: Then the companions of the right - what are the companions of the right
verses.tafsir: Those of the right hand those who are given their record of deeds in their right hand fa-ashābu’l-maymanati is the subject the predicate of which is the following mā ashābu’l-maymanati — what of those of the right hand? — a glorification of their status on account of their admittance into Paradise.
verses.tafsirV2: (First) those on the right hand) these are the inhabitants of the Garden who will be given their scrolls in their right hands; they are the ones about whom Allah said: " These are destined for Paradise, and I care not " ; (what of those on the right hand) arousing by this expression the wonder of His Prophet: and what do you know, O Muhammad, about the bliss, happiness and honour of the people of the Garden?

verses.text: وَأَصۡحَٰبُ ٱلۡمَشۡـَٔمَةِ مَآ أَصۡحَٰبُ ٱلۡمَشۡـَٔمَةِ
verses.translation: And the companions of the left - what are the companions of the left
verses.tafsir: And those of the left hand al-mash’ama means al-shimāl ‘left’ each of whom is given his record of deeds in their left hands — what of those of the left hand? — an expression of contempt for their status on account of their admittance into the Fire.
verses.tafsirV2: (And (then) those on the left hand) these are the dwellers of the Fire who will be given their scrolls in their left hands; they are the ones about whom Allah said: “These are destined for hell, and I care not”; (what of those on the left hand) again arousing the wonder of His Prophet: and what do you know, O Muhammad, about the humiliation, punishment and chastisement suffered by the dwellers of hell?

verses.text: وَٱلسَّـٰبِقُونَ ٱلسَّـٰبِقُونَ
verses.translation: And the forerunners, the forerunners
verses.tafsir: And the foremost in the race to do good namely the prophets al-sābiqūna is a subject the foremost this repetition is to emphasise their exalted status; the predicate is the following ūlā’ika’l-muqarrabūna
verses.tafsirV2: (And the foremost in the race) and the forerunners in the life of the world towards faith, migration, jihad, the utterance of the first “Allahu akbar” [Allah is the greatest] as well as towards all good things, these are (the foremost in the race) the forerunners in the Hereafter towards the Garden:

verses.text: أُوْلَـٰٓئِكَ ٱلۡمُقَرَّبُونَ
verses.translation: Those are the ones brought near [to Allah]
verses.tafsir: they are the ones brought near to God
verses.tafsirV2: (Those are they who will be brought nigh) to Allah

verses.text: فِي جَنَّـٰتِ ٱلنَّعِيمِ
verses.translation: In the Gardens of Pleasure
verses.tafsir: in the Gardens of Bliss
verses.tafsirV2: (In Gardens of Delight) whose delight is eternal;

verses.text: ثُلَّةٞ مِّنَ ٱلۡأَوَّلِينَ
verses.translation: A [large] company of the former peoples
verses.tafsir: a multitude from the former generations thullatun mina’l-awwalīna the subject that is to say a group of individuals from communities of old
verses.tafsirV2: (A multitude of those of old) a group of people from the earlier nations before the community of Muhammad (pbuh)

verses.text: وَقَلِيلٞ مِّنَ ٱلۡأٓخِرِينَ
verses.translation: And a few of the later peoples
verses.tafsir: and a few from the later ones from among the community of Muhammad (s) being the foremost from among the communities of old and this community the predicate is the following ‘alā sururin mawdūnatin
verses.tafsirV2: (And a few of those of later time) and a group from the later nations, which is the community of Muhammad (pbuh). It is also said that both groups are from the community of Muhammad (pbuh). When Allah's saying (A multitude of those of old), the Prophet (pbuh) and his Companions were aggrieved because of it, until Allah revealed (And a few of those of later time).

verses.text: عَلَىٰ سُرُرٖ مَّوۡضُونَةٖ
verses.translation: On thrones woven [with ornament]
verses.tafsir: will be upon encrusted couches their linings woven onto rods of gold and jewels
verses.tafsirV2: (On lined couches) sitting on couches linked to each other by branches of gold and silver, weaved with pearls and sapphires,

verses.text: مُّتَّكِـِٔينَ عَلَيۡهَا مُتَقَٰبِلِينَ
verses.translation: Reclining on them, facing each other
verses.tafsir: reclining on them face to face muttaki’īna ‘alayhā mutaqābilīna constitute two circumstantial qualifiers referring to the subject person of the predicate ‘they’.
verses.tafsirV2: (Reclining) in comfort (therein) on couches (face to face) upon visitation.

verses.text: يَطُوفُ عَلَيۡهِمۡ وِلۡدَٰنٞ مُّخَلَّدُونَ
verses.translation: There will circulate among them young boys made eternal
verses.tafsir: They will be waited on by immortal youths resembling young boys never ageing;
verses.tafsirV2: (There wait on them) for service (immortal youths) servants; it is also said that these are the children of the disbelievers who are made servants for the people of Paradise. Another way of reading this verse is (There wait on them youths, and they are immortal): i.e. they will never die nor leave the Garden.

verses.text: بِأَكۡوَابٖ وَأَبَارِيقَ وَكَأۡسٖ مِّن مَّعِينٖ
verses.translation: With vessels, pitchers and a cup [of wine] from a flowing spring
verses.tafsir: with goblets akwāb are drinking-vessels without handles and ewers abārīq are vessels that have handles and spouts and a cup ka’s is the vessel for drinking wine from a flowing spring in other words wine flowing from a spring that never runs out
verses.tafsirV2: The youth will go round (With bowls and ewers and a cup from a pure spring) of pure running wine

verses.text: لَّا يُصَدَّعُونَ عَنۡهَا وَلَا يُنزِفُونَ
verses.translation: No headache will they have therefrom, nor will they be intoxicated
verses.tafsir: wherefrom they suffer no headache nor any stupefaction read yanzafūna or yanzifūna respectively derived from nazafa or anzafa al-shāribu ‘the drinker became inebriated’ in other words they do not get a headache from it nor do they lose their senses in contrast to the case with the wine of this world;
verses.tafsirV2: (Wherefrom they get no aching of the head) from drinking (nor any madness) nor get intoxicated; it is also said that this means, according to another reading: their drinking is continuous,

verses.text: وَفَٰكِهَةٖ مِّمَّا يَتَخَيَّرُونَ
verses.translation: And fruit of what they select
verses.tafsir: and such fruits as they prefer
verses.tafsirV2: (And fruit) different kinds of fruit (that they prefer) that they desire.

verses.text: وَلَحۡمِ طَيۡرٖ مِّمَّا يَشۡتَهُونَ
verses.translation: And the meat of fowl, from whatever they desire
verses.tafsir: and such flesh of fowls as they desire for themselves to enjoy
verses.tafsirV2: (And flesh of fowls that they desire) and different types of birds' meat that they desire.

verses.text: وَحُورٌ عِينٞ
verses.translation: And [for them are] fair women with large, [beautiful] eyes
verses.tafsir: and houris maidens with intensely black eyes set against the whiteness of their irises with wide eyes ‘īn the ‘ayn here is inflected with a kasra instead of a damma because it the kasra better harmonises with the yā’; the singular is ‘aynā’ similar in pattern to hamrā’; a variant reading for wa-hūrun ‘īn has the genitive case wa-hūrin ‘īn
verses.tafsirV2: (And (there are) fair ones with wide, lovely eyes,

verses.text: كَأَمۡثَٰلِ ٱللُّؤۡلُوِٕ ٱلۡمَكۡنُونِ
verses.translation: The likenesses of pearls well-protected
verses.tafsir: resembling hidden guarded pearls
verses.tafsirV2: Like unto hidden pearls) hidden from heat and cold,

verses.text: جَزَآءَۢ بِمَا كَانُواْ يَعۡمَلُونَ
verses.translation: As reward for what they used to do
verses.tafsir: a reward jazā’an is an object denoting reason or a verbal noun with the operator being an implicit verb in other words ‘We have appointed for them the mentioned as a reward’ or ‘We have rewarded them this’ for what they used to do.
verses.tafsirV2: (Reward) this is a reward for the inhabitants of the Garden (for what they used do) and say of good things in the life of the world.

verses.text: لَا يَسۡمَعُونَ فِيهَا لَغۡوٗا وَلَا تَأۡثِيمًا
verses.translation: They will not hear therein ill speech or commission of sin
verses.tafsir: They will not hear therein in Paradise any vain talk any lewd words or any sinful words
verses.tafsirV2: (There) in the Garden (hear they no vain speaking) no falsehood or lying oaths (nor recrimination) nor abuse; it is also said: there is no sin on them for it.

verses.text: إِلَّا قِيلٗا سَلَٰمٗا سَلَٰمٗا
verses.translation: Only a saying: "Peace, peace
verses.tafsir: but only the saying ‘Peace!’ ‘Peace!’ salāman salāman substitutes for qīlan ‘the saying’ which they will hear.
verses.tafsirV2: ((Naught) but the saying: Peace, (and again) Peace) they greet each other with the greeting peace and the angels also greet them with salutations and greeting of peace from their Lord.

verses.text: وَأَصۡحَٰبُ ٱلۡيَمِينِ مَآ أَصۡحَٰبُ ٱلۡيَمِينِ
verses.translation: The companions of the right - what are the companions of the right
verses.tafsir: And those of the right hand — what of those of the right hand?
verses.tafsirV2: (And those on the right hand) the inhabitants of Paradise; (what of those on the right hand) and what do you know, O Muhammad, about the bliss and happiness of the people of Paradise?

verses.text: فِي سِدۡرٖ مَّخۡضُودٖ
verses.translation: [They will be] among lote trees with thorns removed
verses.tafsir: Amid thornless lote-trees nabk trees
verses.tafsirV2: (Among thornless lote tree) under the shade of thornless lote trees.

verses.text: وَطَلۡحٖ مَّنضُودٖ
verses.translation: And [banana] trees layered [with fruit]
verses.tafsir: and clustered plantains banana trees weighed down with its load of fruit from top to bottom
verses.tafsirV2: (And clustered plantains) and clustered banana trees; and it is also said that this means: continuous and uninterrupted,

verses.text: وَظِلّٖ مَّمۡدُودٖ
verses.translation: And shade extended
verses.tafsir: and extended shade one that is permanent
verses.tafsirV2: (And spreading shade) continuously over them, such that there is no sun,

verses.text: وَمَآءٖ مَّسۡكُوبٖ
verses.translation: And water poured out
verses.tafsir: and cascading water running continuously
verses.tafsirV2: (And water gushing) from the leg of the Throne,

verses.text: وَفَٰكِهَةٖ كَثِيرَةٖ
verses.translation: And fruit, abundant [and varied]
verses.tafsir: and abundant fruit
verses.tafsirV2: (And fruit in plenary) plenty of different kinds of fruit.

verses.text: لَّا مَقۡطُوعَةٖ وَلَا مَمۡنُوعَةٖ
verses.translation: Neither limited [to season] nor forbidden
verses.tafsir: neither unavailable during certain times nor forbidden because of its cost
verses.tafsirV2: (Neither out of reach) such that they are available sometimes and unavailable at other times (nor yet forbidden) from when they look at it,

verses.text: وَفُرُشٖ مَّرۡفُوعَةٍ
verses.translation: And [upon] beds raised high
verses.tafsir: and mattresses that are raised on top of couches.
verses.tafsirV2: (And raised couches) in the air, for its folks,

verses.text: إِنَّآ أَنشَأۡنَٰهُنَّ إِنشَآءٗ
verses.translation: Indeed, We have produced the women of Paradise in a [new] creation
verses.tafsir: Verily We have created them with an unmediated creation namely the wide-eyed houris We created them without the process of birth
verses.tafsirV2: (Lo! We have created them a (new) creation) We created the females of the life of the world; We created them again after they went through impotence, lack of vision, sickness and death.

verses.text: فَجَعَلۡنَٰهُنَّ أَبۡكَارًا
verses.translation: And made them virgins
verses.tafsir: and made them virgins immaculate — every time their spouses enter them they find them virgins nor is there any pain of defloration —
verses.tafsirV2: (And made them virgins

verses.text: عُرُبًا أَتۡرَابٗا
verses.translation: Devoted [to their husbands] and of equal age
verses.tafsir: amorous read ‘uruban or ‘urban plural of ‘arūb meaning ‘a woman passionately enamoured of her spouse’ of equal age atrāb is the plural of tirb
verses.tafsirV2: Lovers) to their husbands and flirtatious with them, (friends) all with the same age, i.e. 33 years of age,

verses.text: لِّأَصۡحَٰبِ ٱلۡيَمِينِ
verses.translation: For the companions of the right [who are]
verses.tafsir: for those of the right hand li-ashābi’l-yamīni is the relative clause of either ansha’nāhunna ‘We have created them’ or ja‘alnāhunna ‘We made them’ who are
verses.tafsirV2: (For those on the right hand) for the inhabitants of Paradise and all of them are the inhabitants of Paradise;

verses.text: ثُلَّةٞ مِّنَ ٱلۡأَوَّلِينَ
verses.translation: A company of the former peoples
verses.tafsir: A multitude from the former generations
verses.tafsirV2: (A multitude of those of old) a group of people from among the nations which came before Muhammad (pbuh)

verses.text: وَثُلَّةٞ مِّنَ ٱلۡأٓخِرِينَ
verses.translation: And a company of the later peoples
verses.tafsir: and a multitude of the later ones.
verses.tafsirV2: (And a multitude of those of later time) a group of people from the later nations, which is the community of Muhammad (pbuh); and it is also said that both groups of people belong to the community of Muhammad (pbuh).

verses.text: وَأَصۡحَٰبُ ٱلشِّمَالِ مَآ أَصۡحَٰبُ ٱلشِّمَالِ
verses.translation: And the companions of the left - what are the companions of the left
verses.tafsir: And those of the left hand — what of those of the left hand?
verses.tafsirV2: (And those on the left hand) the inhabitants of the Fire: (What of those on the left hand) what do you know, O Muhammad, about the degradation and punishment of the people of the Fire?

verses.text: فِي سَمُومٖ وَحَمِيمٖ
verses.translation: [They will be] in scorching fire and scalding water
verses.tafsir: Amid a scorching wind an infernal wind permeating the pores of skins and scalding water water of extreme temperatures
verses.tafsirV2: (In scorching wind) in the flames of the Fire; it is also said: in the scorching wind of the Fire; and it is also said that this means: in the ice-biting wind of the Fire (and scalding water) and boiling water.

verses.text: وَظِلّٖ مِّن يَحۡمُومٖ
verses.translation: And a shade of black smoke
verses.tafsir: and the shade of pitch-black smoke
verses.tafsirV2: (And shadow of black smoke) over them in Gehenna,

verses.text: لَّا بَارِدٖ وَلَا كَرِيمٍ
verses.translation: Neither cool nor beneficial
verses.tafsir: neither cool like all other shade nor pleasant nor agreeable in its appearance.
verses.tafsirV2: (Neither cool) to reinvigorate them (nor refreshing) nor any good for them; it is also said that this means: their drink is not refreshing nor is their punishment good.

verses.text: إِنَّهُمۡ كَانُواْ قَبۡلَ ذَٰلِكَ مُتۡرَفِينَ
verses.translation: Indeed they were, before that, indulging in affluence
verses.tafsir: Indeed before that in the world they used to live at ease enjoying life’s comforts never wearying themselves with an act of obedience
verses.tafsirV2: (Lo! Heretofore) in the life of the world (they were effete with luxury) they were prodigal; it is also said that this means: they were immersed in comfort; and it is also said that this means: they were bewildered.

verses.text: وَكَانُواْ يُصِرُّونَ عَلَى ٱلۡحِنثِ ٱلۡعَظِيمِ
verses.translation: And they used to persist in the great violation
verses.tafsir: and they used to persist in the great sin namely idolatry.
verses.tafsirV2: (And used to persist) in the life of the world (in the awful sin) i.e. associating partners with Allah; and it is also said that this refers to the lying oath.

verses.text: وَكَانُواْ يَقُولُونَ أَئِذَا مِتۡنَا وَكُنَّا تُرَابٗا وَعِظَٰمًا أَءِنَّا لَمَبۡعُوثُونَ
verses.translation: And they used to say, "When we die and become dust and bones, are we indeed to be resurrected
verses.tafsir: And they used to say ‘What! When we are dead and have become dust and bones shall we indeed be resurrected? in both instances a-idhā and a-innā the two hamzas may be read either by pronouncing them fully or by not pronouncing the second and in either case inserting an intervening alif.
verses.tafsirV2: (And they used to say) in the life of the world: (When we are dead and have come) scattered (dust and) rotten (bones, shall we then, forsooth, be raised again) shall we then be given life again,

verses.text: أَوَءَابَآؤُنَا ٱلۡأَوَّلُونَ
verses.translation: And our forefathers [as well]
verses.tafsir: What! And our forefathers too?’ read a-wa-ābā’unā with the wa- being for supplement the hamza a- for the interrogative; here and in the previous instance it is used to express ‘remoteness of probability’; a variant reading has aw-ābā’unā as a supplement with aw and that to which this is supplemented is the syntactical locus of inna and its subject.
verses.tafsirV2: When the prophets answered in the affirmative, they asked the prophets: (And also our forefathers) who died before us?

verses.text: قُلۡ إِنَّ ٱلۡأَوَّلِينَ وَٱلۡأٓخِرِينَ
verses.translation: Say, [O Muhammad], "Indeed, the former and the later peoples
verses.tafsir: Say ‘Truly the former and the later generations
verses.tafsirV2: (Say) O Muhammad, to the people of Mecca: (Lo! those of old and those of later time

verses.text: لَمَجۡمُوعُونَ إِلَىٰ مِيقَٰتِ يَوۡمٖ مَّعۡلُومٖ
verses.translation: Are to be gathered together for the appointment of a known Day
verses.tafsir: will be gathered for the tryst the time of a known day that is the Day of Resurrection.
verses.tafsirV2: Will all be brought together to the tryst of an appointed day) a well-known day, which is the Day of Judgement, whereby the people of old and the people of later times will be brought all together.

verses.text: ثُمَّ إِنَّكُمۡ أَيُّهَا ٱلضَّآلُّونَ ٱلۡمُكَذِّبُونَ
verses.translation: Then indeed you, O those astray [who are] deniers
verses.tafsir: Then indeed you the erring the deniers
verses.tafsirV2: (Then lo! ye, the erring) from faith and guidance, (the deniers) of Allah, His Messenger and Scripture. This refers to Abu Jahl and his host,

verses.text: لَأٓكِلُونَ مِن شَجَرٖ مِّن زَقُّومٖ
verses.translation: Will be eating from trees of zaqqum
verses.tafsir: will assuredly eat from a Zaqqūm tree min zaqqūm the explication of shajar ‘tree’
verses.tafsirV2: (Ye verily will eat of a tree called Zaqqum

verses.text: فَمَالِـُٔونَ مِنۡهَا ٱلۡبُطُونَ
verses.translation: And filling with it your bellies
verses.tafsir: and fill therewith with the tree your bellies
verses.tafsirV2: And will fill your bellies therewith) from the trees of Zaqqum which grow inside the Fire;

verses.text: فَشَٰرِبُونَ عَلَيۡهِ مِنَ ٱلۡحَمِيمِ
verses.translation: And drinking on top of it from scalding water
verses.tafsir: and drink on top of that the consumed Zaqqūm boiling water
verses.tafsirV2: (And thereon) and upon eating from the Zaqqum (ye will drink of boiling water,

verses.text: فَشَٰرِبُونَ شُرۡبَ ٱلۡهِيمِ
verses.translation: And will drink as the drinking of thirsty camels
verses.tafsir: drinking like the drinking read sharba or shurba verbal noun of thirsty camels’ hīm is the plural of masculine haymān and feminine haymā similar in pattern to ‘atshān ‘atshā ‘thirsty’.
verses.tafsirV2: Drinking even as the camel drinketh) drinking even as a thirsty and sick camel do: it hardly gets filled; it is also said that this means: even as a thirsty camel drinks upon eating sour food.

verses.text: هَٰذَا نُزُلُهُمۡ يَوۡمَ ٱلدِّينِ
verses.translation: That is their accommodation on the Day of Recompense
verses.tafsir: This will be the hospitality for them what has been prepared for them on the Day of Judgement the Day of Resurrection.
verses.tafsirV2: (This will be their welcome) this will be their food and drink (on the Day of Judgement) on the Day of Reckoning.

verses.text: نَحۡنُ خَلَقۡنَٰكُمۡ فَلَوۡلَا تُصَدِّقُونَ
verses.translation: We have created you, so why do you not believe
verses.tafsir: We created you We brought you into existence from nothing. Will you not then affirm this truth? in resurrection? For the One able to create from nothing is also able to repeat this creation.
verses.tafsirV2: (We created you) O people of Mecca. (Will ye then admit the Truth) will you then believe in the Messenger?

verses.text: أَفَرَءَيۡتُم مَّا تُمۡنُونَ
verses.translation: Have you seen that which you emit
verses.tafsir: Have you considered the sperm that you emit? the sperm you spill in the wombs of women?
verses.tafsirV2: (Have ye seen that which ye emit) in the wombs of women?

verses.text: ءَأَنتُمۡ تَخۡلُقُونَهُۥٓ أَمۡ نَحۡنُ ٱلۡخَٰلِقُونَ
verses.translation: Is it you who creates it, or are We the Creator
verses.tafsir: Is it you a-antum read by pronouncing both hamzas fully or by replacing the second one with an alif or not pronouncing it but inserting an alif between the one not pronounced and the other one or without this insertion in the four instances here and below who create it that is the sperm making it into a human being or are We the Creators?
verses.tafsirV2: (Do ye) O people of Mecca (create it) as a human life, male or female, felicitous or damned (or are We the Creator)? No indeed, you are not the Creator, We are.

verses.text: نَحۡنُ قَدَّرۡنَا بَيۡنَكُمُ ٱلۡمَوۡتَ وَمَا نَحۡنُ بِمَسۡبُوقِينَ
verses.translation: We have decreed death among you, and We are not to be outdone
verses.tafsir: We have ordained read qaddarnā or qadarnā death among you and We are not to be outmanoeuvred from We are not incapable of
verses.tafsirV2: (We mete out death among you) We made you equal as far as death is concerned, such that all of you will die; it is also said that this means: We apportioned between you your lifespan until you die. Some of you will live to 100 years, others to 80, some to 50, some to more and others to less, (and We are not to be outrun) and We are capable of doing so,

verses.text: عَلَىٰٓ أَن نُّبَدِّلَ أَمۡثَٰلَكُمۡ وَنُنشِئَكُمۡ فِي مَا لَا تَعۡلَمُونَ
verses.translation: In that We will change your likenesses and produce you in that [form] which you do not know
verses.tafsir: replacing you with We are not incapable of appointing your likes in your place and making you creating you in what you do not know in the way of forms such as apes or swine.
verses.tafsirV2: (That We may transfigure you) that We may destroy you and bring instead other people who are better and more obedient than you (and make you) and create you on the Day of Judgement in (what ye know not) in a form that you know not: with dark faces and bluish eyes; it is also said that this means: in the form of apes and swine; and it is also said that this means: We shall place your spirits in the Fire which you do not believe in.

verses.text: وَلَقَدۡ عَلِمۡتُمُ ٱلنَّشۡأَةَ ٱلۡأُولَىٰ فَلَوۡلَا تَذَكَّرُونَ
verses.translation: And you have already known the first creation, so will you not remember
verses.tafsir: For verily you have known the first creation al-nashā’ata a variant reading has al-nash’ata why then will you not remember? tadhakkarūna the original second tā’ of tatadhakkarūna has been assimilated with the dhāl.
verses.tafsirV2: (And verily ye know) O people of Mecca (the first creation) in the wombs of mothers; and it is also said: the creation of Adam. (Why, then, do ye not reflect) upon the first creation and thus believe in the second creation?

verses.text: أَفَرَءَيۡتُم مَّا تَحۡرُثُونَ
verses.translation: And have you seen that [seed] which you sow
verses.tafsir: Have you considered what you sow? what you stir of the earth to place seeds therein?
verses.tafsirV2: (Have ye seen that which ye cultivate) of grains?

verses.text: ءَأَنتُمۡ تَزۡرَعُونَهُۥٓ أَمۡ نَحۡنُ ٱلزَّـٰرِعُونَ
verses.translation: Is it you who makes it grow, or are We the grower
verses.tafsir: Is it you who make it grow or are We the Grower?
verses.tafsirV2: (Is it ye) O people of Mecca (who foster it) who makes it grow, (or are We the Fosterer) or are We the One to make it grow?

verses.text: لَوۡ نَشَآءُ لَجَعَلۡنَٰهُ حُطَٰمٗا فَظَلۡتُمۡ تَفَكَّهُونَ
verses.translation: If We willed, We could make it [dry] debris, and you would remain in wonder
verses.tafsir: If We will We could surely turn it into chaff dried vegetation producing no seed and you would remain zaltum is actually zaliltum the lām having a kasra inflection; but it has been omitted to soften it that is to say you spend all day bemused tafakkahūna one of the original tā’ tatafakkahūna letters has been omitted surprised by this and you would say
verses.tafsirV2: (If We willed, We verily could make it) the cultivation (chaff) and dry after being green, (then would ye cease not to exclaim) then you would wonder at its dryness and destruction, and exclaim:

verses.text: إِنَّا لَمُغۡرَمُونَ
verses.translation: [Saying], "Indeed, we are [now] in debt
verses.tafsir: ‘We have indeed suffered loss! losing what we expended on the cultivation.
verses.tafsirV2: (Lo! we are laden with debt) we are being punished by the destruction of our cultivations!

verses.text: بَلۡ نَحۡنُ مَحۡرُومُونَ
verses.translation: Rather, we have been deprived
verses.tafsir: Nay but we are deprived!’ prevented from reaping our provision.
verses.tafsirV2: (Nay, but we are deprived) we are deprived of our cultivations! It is also said that this means: we are being fought against!

verses.text: أَفَرَءَيۡتُمُ ٱلۡمَآءَ ٱلَّذِي تَشۡرَبُونَ
verses.translation: And have you seen the water that you drink
verses.tafsir: Have you considered the water you drink?
verses.tafsirV2: (Have ye) O people of Mecca (observed the) pure (water which ye drink) irrigate your fields with and give to your cattle to drink?

verses.text: ءَأَنتُمۡ أَنزَلۡتُمُوهُ مِنَ ٱلۡمُزۡنِ أَمۡ نَحۡنُ ٱلۡمُنزِلُونَ
verses.translation: Is it you who brought it down from the clouds, or is it We who bring it down
verses.tafsir: Is it you who cause it to come down from the rain clouds muzn is the plural of muzna or are We the Causer of its coming down?
verses.tafsirV2: (Is it ye) O people of Mecca (who shed it from the rain cloud, or are We the Shedder?) Indeed, it is We Who send it down to you.

verses.text: لَوۡ نَشَآءُ جَعَلۡنَٰهُ أُجَاجٗا فَلَوۡلَا تَشۡكُرُونَ
verses.translation: If We willed, We could make it bitter, so why are you not grateful
verses.tafsir: If We willed We could make it bitter salty undrinkable — why then will you not give thanks?
verses.tafsirV2: (If We willed We verily could make it) i.e. pure water (bitter. Why, then, give ye not thanks) for its purity and therefore believe?

verses.text: أَفَرَءَيۡتُمُ ٱلنَّارَ ٱلَّتِي تُورُونَ
verses.translation: And have you seen the fire that you ignite
verses.tafsir: Have you considered the fire that you kindle? the fire which you produce out of the oil of green trees?
verses.tafsirV2: (Have ye observed the Fire which ye strike out) from every dry twig except for the twigs of the Jujube tree;

verses.text: ءَأَنتُمۡ أَنشَأۡتُمۡ شَجَرَتَهَآ أَمۡ نَحۡنُ ٱلۡمُنشِـُٔونَ
verses.translation: Is it you who produced its tree, or are We the producer
verses.tafsir: Was it you who created the tree thereof trees such as the markh the ‘afār or the kalkh ‘fennel’ or were We the Creator?
verses.tafsirV2: (Was it ye) O people of Mecca (who made the tree thereof to grow) is it you who created the trees from which fire can be struck out, (or were We the Grower) or are We the Creator?

verses.text: نَحۡنُ جَعَلۡنَٰهَا تَذۡكِرَةٗ وَمَتَٰعٗا لِّلۡمُقۡوِينَ
verses.translation: We have made it a reminder and provision for the travelers
verses.tafsir: We made it a reminder of the fire of Hell and a boon a provision for the desert-travellers al-muqwīn derives from the expression aqwā al-qawmu ‘they have reached al-qawā or al-qawā’ that is al-qafr ‘desolate land’ which is a wilderness mafāza that has neither vegetation nor water.
verses.tafsirV2: (We, even We, appointed it) i.e. the Fire (a memorial) a reminder of the Fire of the Hereafter (and a comfort) a benefit (for the dwellers in the wilderness) for the travellers in the wilderness.

verses.text: فَسَبِّحۡ بِٱسۡمِ رَبِّكَ ٱلۡعَظِيمِ
verses.translation: So exalt the name of your Lord, the Most Great
verses.tafsir: So glorify exalt the transcendence of the Name ism is extra of your Lord the Tremendous God.
verses.tafsirV2: (Therefore (O Muhammad), praise the name of thy Lord, the Tremendous) therefore pray in the name of your Lord, the Mighty; it is also said that this means: remember the divine Oneness of your Lord, the Mighty.

verses.text: ۞فَلَآ أُقۡسِمُ بِمَوَٰقِعِ ٱلنُّجُومِ
verses.translation: Then I swear by the setting of the stars
verses.tafsir: Nay I swear fa-lā uqsimu lā is extra by the setting-places of the stars!
verses.tafsirV2: (Nay, I swear by the places of the stars) I swear by the revelation of the Qur'an in instalments (nujuman) unto Muhammad (pbuh).

verses.text: وَإِنَّهُۥ لَقَسَمٞ لَّوۡ تَعۡلَمُونَ عَظِيمٌ
verses.translation: And indeed, it is an oath - if you could know - [most] great
verses.tafsir: And indeed it the swearing by these setting-places of stars is a tremendous oath if you only knew — if you were people of deep knowledge you would realise the magnitude of this oath.
verses.tafsirV2: (And lo! That) i.e. the Qur'an (verily is a tremendous oath, if ye but knew) if you but believe.

verses.text: إِنَّهُۥ لَقُرۡءَانٞ كَرِيمٞ
verses.translation: Indeed, it is a noble Qur'an
verses.tafsir: This namely what is being recited to you is indeed a noble Qur’ān
verses.tafsirV2: (That (this) is indeed a noble Qur'an) a noble and bounteous Qur'an

verses.text: فِي كِتَٰبٖ مَّكۡنُونٖ
verses.translation: In a Register well-protected
verses.tafsir: in a Book inscribed guarded preserved and this is the Mushaf;
verses.tafsirV2: (In a Book kept hidden) it is written down in the Guarded Tablet; and this is why the oath was made

verses.text: لَّا يَمَسُّهُۥٓ إِلَّا ٱلۡمُطَهَّرُونَ
verses.translation: None touch it except the purified
verses.tafsir: which none touch lā yamassuhu is a predicate functioning as a prohibitive command except the purified those who have purified themselves of ritual impurities 5680 a revelation revealed by the Lord of the Worlds.
verses.tafsirV2: (Which none toucheth) i.e. the Guarded Tablet (save the purified) from ritual impurities and sins, i.e. the angels; it is also said that this means: none acts upon the Qur'an except those who are given success,

verses.text: تَنزِيلٞ مِّن رَّبِّ ٱلۡعَٰلَمِينَ
verses.translation: [It is] a revelation from the Lord of the worlds
verses.tafsir: Do you then belittle do you take lightly and deny this discourse? the Qur’ān.
verses.tafsirV2: (A revelation) a speech (from the Lord of the Worlds) unto Muhammad (pbuh).

verses.text: أَفَبِهَٰذَا ٱلۡحَدِيثِ أَنتُم مُّدۡهِنُونَ
verses.translation: Then is it to this statement that you are indifferent
verses.tafsir: And for your livelihood in the way of rain that is to say the thanks for it you offer your denial? of God’s granting it to you by saying ‘We have rain because of this or that storm’?
verses.tafsirV2: (Is it this Statement) is it this Qur'an which Muhammad (pbuh) recites to you, O people of Mecca, (that ye scorn) that you deny, and claim that there is no Paradise or hell, resurrection or reckoning, as the Prophet says,

verses.text: وَتَجۡعَلُونَ رِزۡقَكُمۡ أَنَّكُمۡ تُكَذِّبُونَ
verses.translation: And make [the thanks for] your provision that you deny [the Provider]
verses.tafsir: And for your livelihood in the way of rain that is to say the thanks for it you offer your denial? of God’s granting it to you by saying ‘We have rain because of this or that storm’?
verses.tafsirV2: (And make denial thereof your livelihood) and say about the rain that you are given: we were given rain because of such-and-such a storm?

verses.text: فَلَوۡلَآ إِذَا بَلَغَتِ ٱلۡحُلۡقُومَ
verses.translation: Then why, when the soul at death reaches the throat
verses.tafsir: Why then when it the spirit during the throes of death reaches the dying person’s throat hulqūm is the passage for food
verses.tafsirV2: (Why, then, when (the soul) cometh up to the throat (of the dying)

verses.text: وَأَنتُمۡ حِينَئِذٖ تَنظُرُونَ
verses.translation: And you are at that time looking on
verses.tafsir: and you are O you attending the dying person at that moment looking at him —
verses.tafsirV2: And ye) O people of Mecca (are at that moment looking) when his soul will come out

verses.text: وَنَحۡنُ أَقۡرَبُ إِلَيۡهِ مِنكُمۡ وَلَٰكِن لَّا تُبۡصِرُونَ
verses.translation: And Our angels are nearer to him than you, but you do not see
verses.tafsir: and We are nearer to him than you are to know of his state but you do not perceive tubsirūna derives from al-basīra ‘perception’ that is to say you do not realise this —
verses.tafsirV2: (And We are nearer unto him) the angel of death and his aids are closer to the dying person (than ye are) than his own family, (but ye see not) the angel of death and his aids.

verses.text: فَلَوۡلَآ إِن كُنتُمۡ غَيۡرَ مَدِينِينَ
verses.translation: Then why do you not, if you are not to be recompensed
verses.tafsir: why then if you are not going to face a reckoning if you are not going to be requited by your being resurrected in other words why then if you are not going to be resurrected as you claim
verses.tafsirV2: (Why then, if ye are not in bondage (unto Us)) if you are not legally bound, rewarded or taken to task,

verses.text: تَرۡجِعُونَهَآ إِن كُنتُمۡ صَٰدِقِينَ
verses.translation: Bring it back, if you should be truthful
verses.tafsir: do you not bring it back why do you not restore the spirit to the body after it has reached the throat if you are truthful? in what you claim the second law-lā ‘why … if’ is repeated to emphasise the first one; idhā ‘when’ is an adverbial particle qualifying tarji‘ūna ‘bring it back’ to which both conditions are semantically connected. The meaning is ‘Why do you not bring it back when in repudiating resurrection you are being truthful in this repudiation?’ That is to say ‘Let death also be repudiated as impossible in its case just as you claim that resurrection is impossible’.
