verses.text: إِنَّا خَلَقۡنَا ٱلۡإِنسَٰنَ مِن نُّطۡفَةٍ أَمۡشَاجٖ نَّبۡتَلِيهِ فَجَعَلۡنَٰهُ سَمِيعَۢا بَصِيرًا
verses.translation: Indeed, We created man from a sperm-drop mixture that We may try him; and We made him hearing and seeing
verses.tafsir: Verily We created man the species from a drop of mixed fluid from a mixture that is from the seminal fluid of the man and the ovarian fluid of the woman that have mixed and blended so that We may test him trying him with the moral obligations of religion nabtalīhi is either a new sentence ‘We will test him’ or an implied circumstantial qualifier meaning ‘intending to test him when he is ready’. So We made him for that very reason hearing seeing.
verses.tafsirV2: (Lo! We create man) i.e. the progeny of Adam (from a drop of thickened fluid) from Adam and Eve's drops of two different kinds of fluid: that of man being white and thick and that of the woman being yellow and thin; thus progeny comes from both of them (to test him) with hardship and comfort; it is also said this means: to test him with good and evil; (so We make him hearing, knowing) We gave him the faculty of hearing so that he could hear the Truth and guidance and the faculty of sight so that he could see the Truth and guidance. It is also said that We make him hearing, knowing in order to test him with good and evil, faith and disbelief.

verses.text: إِنَّا هَدَيۡنَٰهُ ٱلسَّبِيلَ إِمَّا شَاكِرٗا وَإِمَّا كَفُورًا
verses.translation: Indeed, We guided him to the way, be he grateful or be he ungrateful
verses.tafsir: Verily We have guided him to the way We have pointed out to him the path of guidance by sending messengers to mankind whether he be grateful that is to say whether he be a believer or ungrateful both shākiran and kafūran are circumstantial qualifiers referring to the direct object; in other words We have pointed out to him in both presupposed states whether his gratefulness or his unthankfulness; immā is used to list the ‘states’.
verses.tafsirV2: (Lo! We have shown him the way) of faith and disbelief, good and evil, (whether he be grateful) accepting faith (or disbelieving) it is also said this means: We have shown him the way to be either grateful or ungrateful.

verses.text: إِنَّآ أَعۡتَدۡنَا لِلۡكَٰفِرِينَ سَلَٰسِلَاْ وَأَغۡلَٰلٗا وَسَعِيرًا
verses.translation: Indeed, We have prepared for the disbelievers chains and shackles and a blaze
verses.tafsir: We have assuredly prepared for the disbelievers chains with which they are dragged through the Fire and fetters around their necks to which the chains will be attached and a hell-fire a fire set ablaze burning fiercely in which they shall be chastised.
verses.tafsirV2: (Lo! We have prepared for disbelievers) Abu Jahl and his followers (manacles and carcans) in the Fire (and a raging fire.

verses.text: إِنَّ ٱلۡأَبۡرَارَ يَشۡرَبُونَ مِن كَأۡسٖ كَانَ مِزَاجُهَا كَافُورًا
verses.translation: Indeed, the righteous will drink from a cup [of wine] whose mixture is of Kafur
verses.tafsir: Truly the righteous abrār is the plural of barr or bārr namely the obedient ones will drink from a cup ka’s is a vessel for drinking wine and this wine will be in it; what is meant is that they will drink from ‘wine’ a case where the actuality is referred to by the name of the locus in which it is found; min ‘from is partitive whose mixture that with which it is mixed is camphor;
verses.tafsirV2: Lo! the righteous) who are true in their faith and obey Allah (shall drink of a cup) shall drink wine in Paradise (whereof the mixture is of water of Kafur,

verses.text: عَيۡنٗا يَشۡرَبُ بِهَا عِبَادُ ٱللَّهِ يُفَجِّرُونَهَا تَفۡجِيرٗا
verses.translation: A spring of which the [righteous] servants of Allah will drink; they will make it gush forth in force [and abundance]
verses.tafsir: a spring ‘aynan substitutes for kāfūran containing the scent thereof from which the servants of God His friends drink making it gush forth plenteously directing it to wherever they wish of their dwellings.
verses.tafsirV2: A spring wherefrom the slaves of Allah) the friends of Allah (drink, making it gush forth abundantly) whenever they wish, from the Garden into their own habitations and palaces; it is also said that this means: they make it into a mixture;

verses.text: يُوفُونَ بِٱلنَّذۡرِ وَيَخَافُونَ يَوۡمٗا كَانَ شَرُّهُۥ مُسۡتَطِيرٗا
verses.translation: They [are those who] fulfill [their] vows and fear a Day whose evil will be widespread
verses.tafsir: They fulfil their vows pledged in obedience to God and fear a day the evil of which will be widespread.
verses.tafsirV2: Allah then described their traits when they were in the life of the world, saying: (Because they perform the vow) because they fulfil their pledges and oath by Allah; it is also said this means: they perform the obligations (and fear a day) and fear the torment of a day (whereof the evil) the torment (is wide spreading,

verses.text: وَيُطۡعِمُونَ ٱلطَّعَامَ عَلَىٰ حُبِّهِۦ مِسۡكِينٗا وَيَتِيمٗا وَأَسِيرًا
verses.translation: And they give food in spite of love for it to the needy, the orphan, and the captive
verses.tafsir: And they give food despite their love of it that is to say despite their love of food and their craving for it to the needy the poor and the orphan who does not have a father and the prisoner meaning the one who has been rightly imprisoned.
verses.tafsirV2: And feed with food the needy wretch, the orphan) among the Muslims (and the prisoner) and the Muslim prisoner in the captivity of the idolaters; and it is also said: any kind of prisoner, (for love of Him) despite their desire for food and its scarcity,

verses.text: إِنَّمَا نُطۡعِمُكُمۡ لِوَجۡهِ ٱللَّهِ لَا نُرِيدُ مِنكُمۡ جَزَآءٗ وَلَا شُكُورًا
verses.translation: [Saying], "We feed you only for the countenance of Allah. We wish not from you reward or gratitude
verses.tafsir: ‘We feed you only for the sake of God seeking His reward. We do not desire any reward from you nor any thanks this contains the reason for the giving of the food. Now do they actually say this or is it that God knows this to be true of them and has thus praised them by mentioning it? The two are different opinions regarding this matter.
verses.tafsirV2: ((Saying)) that is inwardly, because they did not utter this openly but Allah informed us about the genuineness of their hearts: (We feed you, for the sake of Allah only) we feed you for the sake of Allah's reward and beneficence only. (We wish for no reward) with which to pay us back (nor thanks from you) nor gratitude from you;

verses.text: إِنَّا نَخَافُ مِن رَّبِّنَا يَوۡمًا عَبُوسٗا قَمۡطَرِيرٗا
verses.translation: Indeed, We fear from our Lord a Day austere and distressful
verses.tafsir: Indeed we fear from our Lord a day of frowning one in which faces scowl in other words a horrid day to observe on account of its severity calamitous’ severe in that respect.
verses.tafsirV2: (Lo! we fear from our Lord) from the punishment of our Lord (a day of frowning) when faces are frowning (and of fate) a hard day whose torment and horrors are severe.

verses.text: فَوَقَىٰهُمُ ٱللَّهُ شَرَّ ذَٰلِكَ ٱلۡيَوۡمِ وَلَقَّىٰهُمۡ نَضۡرَةٗ وَسُرُورٗا
verses.translation: So Allah will protect them from the evil of that Day and give them radiance and happiness
verses.tafsir: God has therefore shielded them from the evil of that day and has granted them radiance fairness and resplendence in their faces and joy.
verses.tafsirV2: (Therefore Allah hath warded from them the evil of that day) the torment of that day, (and hath made them find) and has given them (brightness) bright and beautiful faces (and joy) in their hearts;

verses.text: وَجَزَىٰهُم بِمَا صَبَرُواْ جَنَّةٗ وَحَرِيرٗا
verses.translation: And will reward them for what they patiently endured [with] a garden [in Paradise] and silk [garments]
verses.tafsir: And He has rewarded them for their patience for their steadfastness in refraining from disobedience with a Garden into which they are admitted and silk which they are given to wear;
verses.tafsirV2: (And hath awarded them for all that they endured) in the life of the world of poverty and misfortunes, (a Garden and silk attire;

verses.text: مُّتَّكِـِٔينَ فِيهَا عَلَى ٱلۡأَرَآئِكِۖ لَا يَرَوۡنَ فِيهَا شَمۡسٗا وَلَا زَمۡهَرِيرٗا
verses.translation: [They will be] reclining therein on adorned couches. They will not see therein any [burning] sun or [freezing] cold
verses.tafsir: reclining muttaki’īna is a circumstantial qualifier referring to the subject of the implicit verb udkhilūhā ‘they are admitted into it’ therein upon couches arā’ik are beds inside canopies. They will not find lā yarawna is a second circumstantial qualifier therein either sun or bitter cold neither heat nor cold; but it is also said that zamharīr means ‘the moon’ and so in other words it means that it will be bright without any sun or moon.
verses.tafsirV2: (Reclining therein) sitting comfortably in the Garden (upon couches) in curtained canopies, (they will find there neither (heat of) a sun nor bitter cold) He says: they are touched neither by the heat of the sun nor by cold.

verses.text: وَدَانِيَةً عَلَيۡهِمۡ ظِلَٰلُهَا وَذُلِّلَتۡ قُطُوفُهَا تَذۡلِيلٗا
verses.translation: And near above them are its shades, and its [fruit] to be picked will be lowered in compliance
verses.tafsir: And close dāniyatan is a supplement to the syntactical locus of the clause lā yarawna in other words it is a supplement to the import ghayra rā’īna over them will be its shades its trees and its clusters of fruits will hang low its fruits will brought close so that they are reached by the one standing the one sitting or the one lying down.
verses.tafsirV2: (The shade) of trees (thereof is close upon them and the clustered fruits thereof bow down) are made close and available to them.

verses.text: وَيُطَافُ عَلَيۡهِم بِـَٔانِيَةٖ مِّن فِضَّةٖ وَأَكۡوَابٖ كَانَتۡ قَوَارِيرَا۠
verses.translation: And there will be circulated among them vessels of silver and cups having been [created] clear [as glass]
verses.tafsir: And they will be waited upon from all around them in it with vessels of silver and goblets akwāb are cups without handles of crystal —
verses.tafsirV2: (Goblets of silver are brought round for them) by servants, (and beakers (as) of glass) without handles or covers

verses.text: قَوَارِيرَاْ مِن فِضَّةٖ قَدَّرُوهَا تَقۡدِيرٗا
verses.translation: Clear glasses [made] from silver of which they have determined the measure
verses.tafsir: crystal of silver that is they are made of silver which is transparent like crystal — which they that is the ones passing around them in service have measured in a precise measure according to the measure required by the one drinking it neither more nor less which makes for a most delightful drink.
verses.tafsirV2: ((Bright as) glass but (made) of silver, which they (themselves) have measured) in the hands of slave youths (to the measure (of their deeds)) it is also said that the drink is so measured that it is neither more nor less than what is required.

verses.text: وَيُسۡقَوۡنَ فِيهَا كَأۡسٗا كَانَ مِزَاجُهَا زَنجَبِيلًا
verses.translation: And they will be given to drink a cup [of wine] whose mixture is of ginger
verses.tafsir: And they will be given to drink therein a cup wine whose mixture that with which it is mixed is ginger
verses.tafsirV2: (There) in the Garden (are they watered with a cup) of wine (whereof the mixture is of Zanjabil,

verses.text: عَيۡنٗا فِيهَا تُسَمَّىٰ سَلۡسَبِيلٗا
verses.translation: [From] a fountain within Paradise named Salsabeel
verses.tafsir: a spring ‘aynan substitutes for zanjabīlan ‘ginger’ therein named Salsabīl meaning that its water is like ginger which the Arabs find very tasteful and which is very palatable for the throat.
verses.tafsirV2: The water of a spring therein) in the Garden, (named Salsabil.

verses.text: ۞وَيَطُوفُ عَلَيۡهِمۡ وِلۡدَٰنٞ مُّخَلَّدُونَ إِذَا رَأَيۡتَهُمۡ حَسِبۡتَهُمۡ لُؤۡلُؤٗا مَّنثُورٗا
verses.translation: There will circulate among them young boys made eternal. When you see them, you would think them [as beautiful as] scattered pearls
verses.tafsir: And they will be waited upon by immortal youths immortally in the form of youths never ageing whom when you see them you will suppose them because of their beauty and the way in which they are scattered about offering service to be scattered pearls strewn from their string or from their shells in which they are fairer than when they the pearls are otherwise not in their shells.
verses.tafsirV2: There wait on them youths of immortal youths) in Paradise who never die or are taken out of it; it is also said this means: youths wearing beautiful garments, (whom, when you see) O Muhammad, (thou wouldst take for scattered pearls) because of their brightness; and it is also said this means: because of their scatteredness.

verses.text: وَإِذَا رَأَيۡتَ ثَمَّ رَأَيۡتَ نَعِيمٗا وَمُلۡكٗا كَبِيرًا
verses.translation: And when you look there [in Paradise], you will see pleasure and great dominion
verses.tafsir: And when you look there that is to say when you begin to look about in Paradise you will see ra’ayta is the response to idhā ‘when’ bliss that is indescribable and a great kingdom vast without limit.
verses.tafsirV2: (When thou seest) O Muhammad, (thou wilt see there) in the Garden (bliss) lasting bliss for its dwellers (and high estate) none enters in on them except with greetings of peace and permission.

verses.text: عَٰلِيَهُمۡ ثِيَابُ سُندُسٍ خُضۡرٞ وَإِسۡتَبۡرَقٞۖ وَحُلُّوٓاْ أَسَاوِرَ مِن فِضَّةٖ وَسَقَىٰهُمۡ رَبُّهُمۡ شَرَابٗا طَهُورًا
verses.translation: Upon the inhabitants will be green garments of fine silk and brocade. And they will be adorned with bracelets of silver, and their Lord will give them a purifying drink
verses.tafsir: Upon them ‘āliyahum is in the accusative as an adverbial clause and constitutes the predicate of a subject that will follow; a variant reading has ‘ālīhim as a subject with what follows as its predicate; the suffixed pronoun -hum denotes those persons to whom the supplement refers will be garments of fine green silk and heavy silk brocade sundus is fine silk and constitutes the outer cushion while istabraq is coarse silk and constitutes the inner lining; either read thiyābu sundusin khudrun wa’stabraqin or thiyābu sundusin khudrin wa’stabraqun or thiyābu sundusin khudrun wa’stabraqun or wa-thiyābu sundusin khudrin wa’stabraqin. And they will be adorned with bracelets of silver — elsewhere it is stated ‘of gold’ in order to show that they will be adorned with both types at the same time or separately — and their Lord will give them a pure drink to drink tahūran ‘pure’ is intended as a hyperbolic qualification of its purity and cleanness in contrast to the wine of this world.
verses.tafsirV2: (Their raiment will be fine green silk and gold embroidery. Bracelets of silver will they wear. Their Lord will slake their thirst with a pure drink) pure from filth; it is also said this means: Allah purifies them from hatred, cheating and enmity.

verses.text: إِنَّ هَٰذَا كَانَ لَكُمۡ جَزَآءٗ وَكَانَ سَعۡيُكُم مَّشۡكُورًا
verses.translation: [And it will be said], "Indeed, this is for you a reward, and your effort has been appreciated
verses.tafsir: ‘Verily this bliss is a reward for you and your endeavour has been appreciated’.
verses.tafsirV2: (Lo! This) which I have described to you of food, drink and raiment (is a reward for you) is a reward from Allah. (Your endeavour (upon earth) hath found acceptance) your works were accepted and made to grow.

verses.text: إِنَّا نَحۡنُ نَزَّلۡنَا عَلَيۡكَ ٱلۡقُرۡءَانَ تَنزِيلٗا
verses.translation: Indeed, it is We who have sent down to you, [O Muhammad], the Qur'an progressively
verses.tafsir: Assuredly We nahnu reiterates the subject of innā ‘assuredly for the purpose of emphasis; alternatively it is a separating pronoun have revealed the Qur’ān to you as a gradual revelation tanzīlan is the predicate of inna ‘assuredly’ in other words We have divided it into parts instead of not revealing it all at once.
verses.tafsirV2: (Lo! We, even We, have revealed unto thee the Qur'an) We have sent you Gabriel with the Qur'an, (a revelation) in instalments: one, two and three verses at a time;

verses.text: فَٱصۡبِرۡ لِحُكۡمِ رَبِّكَ وَلَا تُطِعۡ مِنۡهُمۡ ءَاثِمًا أَوۡ كَفُورٗا
verses.translation: So be patient for the decision of your Lord and do not obey from among them a sinner or ungrateful [disbeliever]
verses.tafsir: So submit patiently to your Lord’s decree to you to deliver His Message and do not obey of them that is of the disbelievers any sinner or disbeliever namely ‘Utba b. Rabī‘a and al-Walīd b. al-Mughīra — both of whom said to the Prophet s ‘Abandon this affair of yours!’; it is also possible that what is meant is every sinner or disbeliever in other words ‘Do not obey any of these whichever of the two he may be in what he may summon you to of sin or disbelief’.
verses.tafsirV2: (So submit patiently to thy Lord's command) to your Lord's decree; and it is also said this means: be patient in conveying the message of your Lord, (and obey not of them) of the disbelievers of Quraysh (any guilty one) any lewd and liar one, i.e. al-Walid Ibn al-Mughirah (or disbeliever) in Allah, i.e. 'Utbah Ibn Rabi'ah.

verses.text: وَٱذۡكُرِ ٱسۡمَ رَبِّكَ بُكۡرَةٗ وَأَصِيلٗا
verses.translation: And mention the name of your Lord [in prayer] morning and evening
verses.tafsir: And mention the Name of your Lord during prayer at dawn and with the declining of the sun that is at dawn fajr noon zuhr and in the afternoon ‘asr;
verses.tafsirV2: (Remember the name of thy Lord) pray by the command of your Lord (at morn and evening) i.e. the prayers of Fajr, Zuhr and 'Asr.

verses.text: وَمِنَ ٱلَّيۡلِ فَٱسۡجُدۡ لَهُۥ وَسَبِّحۡهُ لَيۡلٗا طَوِيلًا
verses.translation: And during the night prostrate to Him and exalt Him a long [part of the] night
verses.tafsir: and prostrate to Him for a portion of the night that is at after sunset maghrib and at night ‘ishā’ and glorify Him the length of the night perform supererogatory prayers during it as mentioned above for either two thirds a half or a third of it.
verses.tafsirV2: (And worship Him (a portion) of the night) pray the prayer of Maghrib and 'Isha'. (And glorify Him through the livelong night) pray to Him at night, this refers to supererogatory prayers; it is also said that the night prayer was made compulsory on him but not on his Companions.

verses.text: إِنَّ هَـٰٓؤُلَآءِ يُحِبُّونَ ٱلۡعَاجِلَةَ وَيَذَرُونَ وَرَآءَهُمۡ يَوۡمٗا ثَقِيلٗا
verses.translation: Indeed, these [disbelievers] love the immediate and leave behind them a grave Day
verses.tafsir: Assuredly these love the transitory life this world and leave behind them a burdensome day an awful one namely the Day of Resurrection not working towards it.
verses.tafsirV2: (Lo! These) the people of Mecca (love fleeting life) love striving for the life of the world, (and put behind them (the remembrance of)) and refrain from striving for the day which is ahead of them (a grievous day) whose torment and horrors are severe.

verses.text: نَّحۡنُ خَلَقۡنَٰهُمۡ وَشَدَدۡنَآ أَسۡرَهُمۡۖ وَإِذَا شِئۡنَا بَدَّلۡنَآ أَمۡثَٰلَهُمۡ تَبۡدِيلًا
verses.translation: We have created them and strengthened their forms, and when We will, We can change their likenesses with [complete] alteration
verses.tafsir: We created them and made firm their frames their limbs and their joints and whenever We will We can completely replace them with others like them in terms of their created form in place of them by destroying them tabdīlan ‘completely’ is for emphasis; idhā ‘when’ functions in the sense of in ‘if’ similar to where God says in several places in yasha’ yudhhibkum If He will He can take you away cf. Q. 1419; but because He exalted be He has not willed this it has not happened thus far.
verses.tafsirV2: (We, even We, created them) i.e. the people of Mecca, (and strengthened their frame) and made their constitution strong. (And when We will, We can replace them, bringing others like them) i.e. We destroy them (in their stead) He says: if We had willed, We would have destroyed these sinful and disbelieving people and brought instead of them people who are better and more obedient.

verses.text: إِنَّ هَٰذِهِۦ تَذۡكِرَةٞۖ فَمَن شَآءَ ٱتَّخَذَ إِلَىٰ رَبِّهِۦ سَبِيلٗا
verses.translation: Indeed, this is a reminder, so he who wills may take to his Lord a way
verses.tafsir: This sūra is indeed a reminder an admonition for all creatures. Let him who will then choose a way to his Lord a path through obedience.
verses.tafsirV2: (Lo! this is an Admonishment) from Allah, (that whosoever will may choose a way unto his Lord) that whoever will may believe in Allah's divine Oneness and return to his Lord.

verses.text: وَمَا تَشَآءُونَ إِلَّآ أَن يَشَآءَ ٱللَّهُۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ كَانَ عَلِيمًا حَكِيمٗا
verses.translation: And you do not will except that Allah wills. Indeed, Allah is ever Knowing and Wise
verses.tafsir: But you will not tashā’ūna may also be read yashā’ūna ‘they will’ choose a way through obedience unless God wills this. Assuredly God is ever Knower of His creatures Wise in what He does.
verses.tafsirV2: (Yet ye will not) good or evil, faith or disbelief, (unless Allah willeth) that you will it. (Lo! Allah is Knower) of what you will whether it is good or evil, (Wise) He decreed that you do not will anything of good or evil except that which He wills.

verses.text: يُدۡخِلُ مَن يَشَآءُ فِي رَحۡمَتِهِۦۚ وَٱلظَّـٰلِمِينَ أَعَدَّ لَهُمۡ عَذَابًا أَلِيمَۢا
verses.translation: He admits whom He wills into His mercy; but the wrongdoers - He has prepared for them a painful punishment
verses.tafsir: He admits whomever He will into His mercy His Paradise namely the believers; and as for the evildoers al-zālimīna is in the accusative because of an implied verb that is to say a‘adda ‘He has prepared’ as explained by what follows He has prepared for them a painful chastisement — these are the disbelievers.
verses.tafsirV2: (He maketh whom He will to enter His mercy) He honours whoever deserves it with the religion of Islam, (and for evil-doers) the disbelieving idolaters (hath prepared) soon in the Hereafter (a painful doom) whose pain extends to their hearts'.

verses.text: وَٱلۡمُرۡسَلَٰتِ عُرۡفٗا
verses.translation: By those [winds] sent forth in gusts
verses.tafsir: By those sent in succession ‘urfan that is by the winds that follow one another in succession like the mane ‘urf of a horse one part of hair coming after the other ‘urfan is in the accusative because it is a circumstantial qualifier;
verses.tafsirV2: And from his narration on the authority of Ibn 'Abbas that he said concerning the interpretation of Allah's saying (By the emissaries, (sent) one after another): '(By the emissaries, (sent) one after another) He says: Allah swears by the many angels who are sent one after another, just like horses follow one another; it is also said that these are the angels who are sent with the good, i.e. Gabriel, Michael and Seraphiel.

verses.text: فَٱلۡعَٰصِفَٰتِ عَصۡفٗا
verses.translation: And the winds that blow violently
verses.tafsir: by the raging hurricanes the violent winds;
verses.tafsirV2: (By the raging hurricanes) and He swore by the violent hurricanes which blow away people's houses,

verses.text: وَٱلنَّـٰشِرَٰتِ نَشۡرٗا
verses.translation: And [by] the winds that spread [clouds]
verses.tafsir: by the sweeping spreaders by the winds that scatter the rains;
verses.tafsirV2: (By those which cause earth's vegetation to revive) and He swore by the rain, i.e. He swore by the clouds from which comes the rain; it is also said: this refers to the angels who spread the Scripture;

verses.text: فَٱلۡفَٰرِقَٰتِ فَرۡقٗا
verses.translation: And those [angels] who bring criterion
verses.tafsir: by the decisive discriminators that is by the verses of the Qur’ān which discriminate between truth and falsehood and between what is lawful and what is unlawful;
verses.tafsirV2: (By those who winnow with a winnowing) and He swore by the angels who differentiate between the Truth and falsehood; it is also said that this refers to the verses of the Qur'an which distinguishes the Truth from falsehood, the lawful from the unlawful; and it is also said that these three refer to the angels,

verses.text: فَٱلۡمُلۡقِيَٰتِ ذِكۡرًا
verses.translation: And those [angels] who deliver a message
verses.tafsir: by the casters of the remembrance that is by angels that descend with the revelation upon the prophets and messengers casting the revelation onto the various communities of mankind
verses.tafsirV2: (By those who bring down the Reminder) and He swore by those who bring down the revelations,

verses.text: عُذۡرًا أَوۡ نُذۡرًا
verses.translation: As justification or warning
verses.tafsir: to excuse or to warn that is to say in order to excuse or to warn on behalf of God exalted be He a variant reading for nudhran and ‘udhran has nudhuran and ‘udhuran.
verses.tafsirV2: (To excuse) to leave no excuse for one to think that Allah is an oppressor or transgressor (or to warn) His created beings from His chastisement; it is also said that (to excuse) refers to that which He has made lawful while (or to warn) refers to that which He has made unlawful; and it is also said (to excuse) refers to His commands while (or to warn) refers to His prohibitions; Allah swore by all these things,

verses.text: إِنَّمَا تُوعَدُونَ لَوَٰقِعٞ
verses.translation: Indeed, what you are promised is to occur
verses.tafsir: Surely that which you are promised O disbelievers of Mecca in the way of resurrection and chastisement will befall it will be without any doubt.
verses.tafsirV2: (Surely that which ye are promised) of reward and punishment in the Hereafter (will befall) will happen and visit you.

verses.text: فَإِذَا ٱلنُّجُومُ طُمِسَتۡ
verses.translation: So when the stars are obliterated
verses.tafsir: So when the stars are obliterated when their light is extinguished
verses.tafsirV2: Allah then showed when this will be, saying: (So when the stars are put out) when the light of the stars is gone,

verses.text: وَإِذَا ٱلسَّمَآءُ فُرِجَتۡ
verses.translation: And when the heaven is opened
verses.tafsir: and when the heaven is rent asunder
verses.tafsirV2: (And when the sky is riven asunder,

verses.text: وَإِذَا ٱلۡجِبَالُ نُسِفَتۡ
verses.translation: And when the mountains are blown away
verses.tafsir: and when the mountains are blown away crushed to pieces and blown in the air
verses.tafsirV2: And when the mountains are blown away,

verses.text: وَإِذَا ٱلرُّسُلُ أُقِّتَتۡ
verses.translation: And when the messengers' time has come
verses.tafsir: and when the time is set for the testimony of the messengers read uqqitat or wuqqitat that is to say when they are gathered to an appointed time
verses.tafsirV2: And when the messengers are brought unto their time appointed) and when the messengers are gathered.

verses.text: لِأَيِّ يَوۡمٍ أُجِّلَتۡ
verses.translation: For what Day was it postponed
verses.tafsir: For what day — for a tremendous day — has it been appointed? it has been appointed for witnessing of the messengers against their communities to the effect that they delivered their messages from God.
verses.tafsirV2: (For what day is the time appointed) for these things? He says: for what day has its Master delayed it.

verses.text: لِيَوۡمِ ٱلۡفَصۡلِ
verses.translation: For the Day of Judgement
verses.tafsir: For the Day of Decision for creatures from this one may infer the response to the clauses beginning with idhā ‘when’ in other words ‘when … the decision will be made for all creatures’.
verses.tafsirV2: Allah then explained, saying: (For the Day of Decision) when differences between people will be settled.

verses.text: وَمَآ أَدۡرَىٰكَ مَا يَوۡمُ ٱلۡفَصۡلِ
verses.translation: And what can make you know what is the Day of Judgement
verses.tafsir: And how would you know what the Day of Decision is? — emphasising the enormity of its terror.
verses.tafsirV2: (And what will convey unto thee) O Muhammad (what the Day of Decision is!) How would you know about the Day of Decision?

verses.text: وَيۡلٞ يَوۡمَئِذٖ لِّلۡمُكَذِّبِينَ
verses.translation: Woe, that Day, to the deniers
verses.tafsir: Woe to the deniers on that day! — a threat of chastisement for them.
verses.tafsirV2: (Woe) a valley in Gehenna running with blood and puss; and it is also said: a well in the Fire; and it is also said that this refers to severe punishment (unto the repudiators) the disbelievers in Allah, the Scripture, the Messenger and resurrection after death (on that day) the Day of Judgement!

verses.text: أَلَمۡ نُهۡلِكِ ٱلۡأَوَّلِينَ
verses.translation: Did We not destroy the former peoples
verses.tafsir: Did We not destroy the ancients for their denial in other words We certainly destroyed them
verses.tafsirV2: (Destroyed We not the former folk) by means of death as well as chastisement,

verses.text: ثُمَّ نُتۡبِعُهُمُ ٱلۡأٓخِرِينَ
verses.translation: Then We will follow them with the later ones
verses.tafsir: then made the latter folk follow them? the latter folk of those who denied such as the disbelievers of Mecca whom We will destroy.
verses.tafsirV2: (Then caused the latter folk to follow after) through death and chastisement?

verses.text: كَذَٰلِكَ نَفۡعَلُ بِٱلۡمُجۡرِمِينَ
verses.translation: Thus do We deal with the criminals
verses.tafsir: So just as We dealt with those who denied will We deal with the guilty with every individual who will be guilty in the future and destroy them.
verses.tafsirV2: (Thus deal We ever with the guilty) with the idolaters among your folk.

verses.text: وَيۡلٞ يَوۡمَئِذٖ لِّلۡمُكَذِّبِينَ
verses.translation: Woe, that Day, to the deniers
verses.tafsir: Woe to the deniers on that day! — reiterated for emphasis.
verses.tafsirV2: (Woe) severe punishment (unto the repudiators) to the deniers of resurrection after death from among the people of your folk (on that day) the Day of Judgement!

verses.text: أَلَمۡ نَخۡلُقكُّم مِّن مَّآءٖ مَّهِينٖ
verses.translation: Did We not create you from a liquid disdained
verses.tafsir: Did We not create you from a base fluid one that is delicate — and this is semen
verses.tafsirV2: (Did We not create you) O disbelievers (from a base fluid) from a flimsy sperm drop

verses.text: فَجَعَلۡنَٰهُ فِي قَرَارٖ مَّكِينٍ
verses.translation: And We placed it in a firm lodging
verses.tafsir: then lodged it in a secure abode that is the womb
verses.tafsirV2: (Which We laid up in a safe abode) in the woman's womb.

verses.text: إِلَىٰ قَدَرٖ مَّعۡلُومٖ
verses.translation: For a known extent
verses.tafsir: for a known span? namely the time for delivery.
verses.tafsirV2: (For a known term) until the time of its birth after nine months or less or more?

verses.text: فَقَدَرۡنَا فَنِعۡمَ ٱلۡقَٰدِرُونَ
verses.translation: And We determined [it], and excellent [are We] to determine
verses.tafsir: Thus We were able to do this; so how excellent able ones We are!
verses.tafsirV2: (Thus We arranged) its creation; it is also said this means: We controlled its creation; it is also said this means: and We fashioned its creation in the woman's womb. (How excellent is Our arranging!) how excellent is what We created and fashioned!

verses.text: وَيۡلٞ يَوۡمَئِذٖ لِّلۡمُكَذِّبِينَ
verses.translation: Woe, that Day, to the deniers
verses.tafsir: Woe to the deniers on that day!
verses.tafsirV2: (Woe) severe punishment (unto the repudiators) of faith and resurrection after death (on that day) on the Day of Judgement!

verses.text: أَلَمۡ نَجۡعَلِ ٱلۡأَرۡضَ كِفَاتًا
verses.translation: Have We not made the earth a container
verses.tafsir: Have We not made the earth a receptacle kifātan is a verbal noun from kafata meaning damma ‘enclosed’ that is an enclosure
verses.tafsirV2: (Have We not made the earth a receptacle) to contain them

verses.text: أَحۡيَآءٗ وَأَمۡوَٰتٗا
verses.translation: Of the living and the dead
verses.tafsir: for the living on its surface and the dead inside it
verses.tafsirV2: (Both for the living) on its surface (and the dead) in its belly; it is also said this means: We made the earth a channel for both the living and the dead,

verses.text: وَجَعَلۡنَا فِيهَا رَوَٰسِيَ شَٰمِخَٰتٖ وَأَسۡقَيۡنَٰكُم مَّآءٗ فُرَاتٗا
verses.translation: And We placed therein lofty, firmly set mountains and have given you to drink sweet water
verses.tafsir: and set therein soaring mountains and give you sweet water to drink?
verses.tafsirV2: (And placed therein) in the earth (high mountains) firm mountains well-steeped in their locations (and given you) O repudiators (to drink sweet water therein) and it is said fine water?

verses.text: وَيۡلٞ يَوۡمَئِذٖ لِّلۡمُكَذِّبِينَ
verses.translation: Woe, that Day, to the deniers
verses.tafsir: Woe to the deniers on that day!
verses.tafsirV2: (Woe) severe punishment (unto the repudiators) of faith and the resurrection (on that day) the Day of Judgement!

verses.text: ٱنطَلِقُوٓاْ إِلَىٰ مَا كُنتُم بِهِۦ تُكَذِّبُونَ
verses.translation: [They will be told], "Proceed to that which you used to deny
verses.tafsir: And on the Day of Resurrection it will be said to the deniers Depart to that chastisement which you used to deny!
verses.tafsirV2: (Depart) O repudiators (unto that (doom) which ye used to deny) in the life of the world, claiming that it will never take place;

verses.text: ٱنطَلِقُوٓاْ إِلَىٰ ظِلّٖ ذِي ثَلَٰثِ شُعَبٖ
verses.translation: Proceed to a shadow [of smoke] having three columns
verses.tafsir: Depart to a triple-forked shadow — this is the smoke of Hell which as it rises splits into three parts because of its magnitude —
verses.tafsirV2: The angels who are the keepers of the Fire will say to them after the end of reckoning: (Depart) O deniers (unto the shadow) caused by the smoke of the Fire (falling threefold) three groups.

verses.text: لَّا ظَلِيلٖ وَلَا يُغۡنِي مِنَ ٱللَّهَبِ
verses.translation: [But having] no cool shade and availing not against the flame
verses.tafsir: which is neither shady neither protective unable to shade them from the heat of that Day nor of any avail against nor wards off from them anything of the flame the Fire.
verses.tafsirV2: ((Which yet is) no relief) from the heat of the Fire (nor shelter from the flame) of the Fire.

verses.text: إِنَّهَا تَرۡمِي بِشَرَرٖ كَٱلۡقَصۡرِ
verses.translation: Indeed, it throws sparks [as huge] as a fortress
verses.tafsir: Indeed it that is the Fire throws up sparks namely those flame that are thrown by it into the air huge like palace edifices in terms of their enormity and vertical extension
verses.tafsirV2: (Lo! It) i.e. the Fire (throweth up sparks like the castles) like the bases of huge trees,

verses.text: كَأَنَّهُۥ جِمَٰلَتٞ صُفۡرٞ
verses.translation: As if they were yellowish [black] camels
verses.tafsir: as if they were dark yellow camels jimālātun is the plural of jimalatun the plural of jamalun; a variant reading has jimālatun in terms of their shape and colour. In hadīth it is stated ‘The sparks of humans thrown into the air by the Fire are black as pitch qīr’; the Arabs call dark camels sufr ‘yellow’ because a touch of yellow is mixed with their blackish colour and therefore it is said that ‘yellow’ in this verse actually means ‘black’ on account of what has been mentioned; but some say no to this interpretation; sharar is the plural of sharāra; qīr is qār ‘pitch’.
verses.tafsirV2: ((Or) as it might be camels of bright yellow hue) black camels.

verses.text: وَيۡلٞ يَوۡمَئِذٖ لِّلۡمُكَذِّبِينَ
verses.translation: Woe, that Day, to the deniers
verses.tafsir: Woe to the deniers on that day!
verses.tafsirV2: (Woe) severe punishment (unto the repudiators) of faith and the resurrection (on that day) the Day of Judgement!

verses.text: هَٰذَا يَوۡمُ لَا يَنطِقُونَ
verses.translation: This is a Day they will not speak
verses.tafsir: This namely the Day of Resurrection is the day in which they will not utter anything
verses.tafsirV2: (This is a day wherein they speak not) in some places and speak in others,

verses.text: وَلَا يُؤۡذَنُ لَهُمۡ فَيَعۡتَذِرُونَ
verses.translation: Nor will it be permitted for them to make an excuse
verses.tafsir: nor will they be given permission to offer excuses and so offer excuses fa-ya‘tadhirūna is a supplement to yu’dhanu ‘given permission’ but without being a direct result of it since it belongs within the confines of the general denial of permission in other words ‘there will be no permission hence no excuses’.
verses.tafsirV2: (Nor are they suffered) nor are they given permission (to put forth excuses.

verses.text: وَيۡلٞ يَوۡمَئِذٖ لِّلۡمُكَذِّبِينَ
verses.translation: Woe, that Day, to the deniers
verses.tafsir: Woe to the deniers on that day!
verses.tafsirV2: Woe) severe punishment (unto the repudiators) of faith and the resurrection (on that day) the Day of Judgement!

verses.text: هَٰذَا يَوۡمُ ٱلۡفَصۡلِۖ جَمَعۡنَٰكُمۡ وَٱلۡأَوَّلِينَ
verses.translation: This is the Day of Judgement; We will have assembled you and the former peoples
verses.tafsir: ‘This is the Day of Decision. We have brought you O deniers from this community and the ancients together the ancients from among the deniers before you so that you will all be reckoned with and chastised together;
verses.tafsirV2: (This is the Day of Decision) regarding created beings, (We have brought you) O disbelievers (and the men of old together) as well as those who were after you.

verses.text: فَإِن كَانَ لَكُمۡ كَيۡدٞ فَكِيدُونِ
verses.translation: So if you have a plan, then plan against Me
verses.tafsir: So if you have any stratagems any ploy to ward off your chastisement try your strategems against Me!’ — put them into effect!
verses.tafsirV2: (If now ye have any wit) if you have the power to do anything to Me, (outwit Me) then do it; it is also said that this means: if you have any scheme against Me, then execute it.

verses.text: وَيۡلٞ يَوۡمَئِذٖ لِّلۡمُكَذِّبِينَ
verses.translation: Woe, that Day, to the deniers
verses.tafsir: Woe to the deniers on that day!
verses.tafsirV2: (Woe) severe punishment (unto the repudiators) of faith and the resurrection (on that day) the Day of Judgement!

verses.text: إِنَّ ٱلۡمُتَّقِينَ فِي ظِلَٰلٖ وَعُيُونٖ
verses.translation: Indeed, the righteous will be among shades and springs
verses.tafsir: Truly the God-fearing will be amid shades that is amid clusters of trees since there is no sun therein from whose heat to seek shade and springs issuing forth with water
verses.tafsirV2: Allah then explained the abode of the believers, saying: (Lo! those who kept their duty) those who ward off disbelief, idolatry and indecencies (are amid shade) amid the shade of trees (and fountains) plain, running water,

verses.text: وَفَوَٰكِهَ مِمَّا يَشۡتَهُونَ
verses.translation: And fruits from whatever they desire
verses.tafsir: and fruits such as they desire this is meant to point out that eating and drinking in Paradise is done according to their desires in contrast to the case in this world where it is predominantly determined by what people are able to procure. It will also be said to them
verses.tafsirV2: (And fruits) different kinds of fruit (such as they desire).

verses.text: كُلُواْ وَٱشۡرَبُواْ هَنِيٓـَٔۢا بِمَا كُنتُمۡ تَعۡمَلُونَ
verses.translation: [Being told], "Eat and drink in satisfaction for what you used to do
verses.tafsir: ‘Eat and drink in full enjoyment hanī’an is a circumstantial qualifier in other words mutahanni’īna for what you used to do’ in the way of obedience.
verses.tafsirV2: Allah will say to them (Eat) of the fruits, (drink) from the rivers (and welcome) fearing no sickness or death, (O ye blessed, in return for what ye did) and said of good in the life of the world.

verses.text: إِنَّا كَذَٰلِكَ نَجۡزِي ٱلۡمُحۡسِنِينَ
verses.translation: Indeed, We thus reward the doers of good
verses.tafsir: Indeed so in the same way that We reward the God-fearing do We reward the virtuous.
verses.tafsirV2: (Thus do We reward the good) in words and deeds.

verses.text: وَيۡلٞ يَوۡمَئِذٖ لِّلۡمُكَذِّبِينَ
verses.translation: Woe, that Day, to the deniers
verses.tafsir: Woe to the deniers on that day!
verses.tafsirV2: (Woe) severe punishment (unto the repudiators) of faith and the resurrection (on that day) the Day of Judgement!

verses.text: كُلُواْ وَتَمَتَّعُواْ قَلِيلًا إِنَّكُم مُّجۡرِمُونَ
verses.translation: [O disbelievers], eat and enjoy yourselves a little; indeed, you are criminals
verses.tafsir: ‘Eat and enjoy — addressing the disbelievers in this world — for a little time at the end of which comes death — this is meant as a threat for them. Indeed you are guilty!’
verses.tafsirV2: (Eat) O disbelievers (and take your ease a little) in the life of the world. (Lo! ye are guilty) you are idolaters and your destination in the Hereafter will be the Fire. This is a threat to them from Allah.

verses.text: وَيۡلٞ يَوۡمَئِذٖ لِّلۡمُكَذِّبِينَ
verses.translation: Woe, that Day, to the deniers
verses.tafsir: Woe to the deniers on that day!
verses.tafsirV2: (Woe) severe punishment (unto the repudiators) of faith and the resurrection (on that day) the Day of Judgement!

verses.text: وَإِذَا قِيلَ لَهُمُ ٱرۡكَعُواْ لَا يَرۡكَعُونَ
verses.translation: And when it is said to them, "Bow [in prayer]," they do not bow
verses.tafsir: For when it is said to them ‘Bow down!’ perform prayer they do not bow down they do not perform prayer.
verses.tafsirV2: (When it is said unto them) to the disbelievers when they were in the life of the world: (Bow down) submit to Allah by believing in His divine Oneness, (they bow not down!) they did not submit to Allah by accepting His divine Oneness; it is also said that they will be asked to do so in the Hereafter, when Allah will say to them: " bow down, if you are truthful that you believed in that which you now claim " , this is because they said: " By Allah, our Lord, we were not idolaters ". But they will not be able to bow down and their bodies will remain erect and stiff. It is also said that this verse was revealed about Thaqif who said: " we will not bend down to bow or prostrate ".

verses.text: وَيۡلٞ يَوۡمَئِذٖ لِّلۡمُكَذِّبِينَ
verses.translation: Woe, that Day, to the deniers
verses.tafsir: Woe to the deniers on that day!
verses.tafsirV2: (Woe) severe punishment (unto the repudiators) to the disbelievers in Allah, His Messenger, Scripture and the resurrection (on that day) the day of Judgement!

verses.text: فَبِأَيِّ حَدِيثِۭ بَعۡدَهُۥ يُؤۡمِنُونَ
verses.translation: Then in what statement after the Qur'an will they believe
verses.tafsir: In what discourse then after this namely the Qur’ān will they believe? In other words they cannot believe in any other of God’s Scriptures after having denied this Qur’ān since it comprises that inimitability i‘jāz which none of the others do.
verses.tafsirV2: (In what statement) in what Scripture, (after this) after the Book of Allah, (will they believe) if they do not believe in these tidings?'

verses.text: عَمَّ يَتَسَآءَلُونَ
verses.translation: About what are they asking one another
verses.tafsir: About what about what thing are they the people of Quraysh questioning one another?
verses.tafsirV2: And from his narration on the authority of Ibn 'Abbas that he said regarding the interpretation of Allah's saying (Whereof do they question one another?): He says: 'what are they-meaning the people of Quraysh-talking about?'

verses.text: عَنِ ٱلنَّبَإِ ٱلۡعَظِيمِ
verses.translation: About the great news
verses.tafsir: About the awesome tiding this is the explication of that ‘thing’; the interrogative is meant to emphasise its magnitude — this awesome tiding is the Qur’ān comprising news of the Resurrection and so on which the Prophet s brought —
verses.tafsirV2: ((It is) of the awful tidings) they are talking about the tidings of the noble, glorious and great Qur'an,

verses.text: ٱلَّذِي هُمۡ فِيهِ مُخۡتَلِفُونَ
verses.translation: That over which they are in disagreement
verses.tafsir: concerning which they are at variance for the believers affirm it while the disbelievers repudiate it.
verses.tafsirV2: (Concerning which they are in disagreement) some of them disbelieve in Muhammad (pbuh) and in the Qur'an while others believe in them. This is because whenever Gabriel brought down a section of the Qur'an to the Prophet (pbuh) and he recited it to them, they used to talk about it, and some of them would believe while others would persist in their disbelief.

verses.text: كَلَّا سَيَعۡلَمُونَ
verses.translation: No! They are going to know
verses.tafsir: No indeed! — a disavowal — they will come to know what will befall them for their rejection of it.
verses.tafsirV2: (Nay) this is a reply to the disbelievers, (but they will come to know!) They will come to know upon the advent of death what will be done with them.

verses.text: ثُمَّ كَلَّا سَيَعۡلَمُونَ
verses.translation: Then, no! They are going to know
verses.tafsir: Again no indeed! They will come to know! reiterated for emphasis; thumma is added here to declare that the second threat of chastisement is more severe than the first. God exalted be He then alludes to His power to resurrect saying
verses.tafsirV2: (Nay) truly, (again, but they will come to know!) They will come to know in the grave what will be done with them. This is a threat from Allah to those who disbelieved in Muhammad (pbuh) and in the Qur'an.

verses.text: أَلَمۡ نَجۡعَلِ ٱلۡأَرۡضَ مِهَٰدٗا
verses.translation: Have We not made the earth a resting place
verses.tafsir: Have We not made the earth a cradle a bed like a cradle
verses.tafsirV2: Allah then mentioned the blessings He bestowed upon them, saying: (Have We not made the earth an expanse) and a place to sleep,

verses.text: وَٱلۡجِبَالَ أَوۡتَادٗا
verses.translation: And the mountains as stakes
verses.tafsir: and the mountains pegs? with which the earth is tied down like tents are tied down with pegs the interrogative is meant as an affirmative.
verses.tafsirV2: (And the high hills bulwarks) for it so that it does not sway?

verses.text: وَخَلَقۡنَٰكُمۡ أَزۡوَٰجٗا
verses.translation: And We created you in pairs
verses.tafsir: And created you in pairs? males and females
verses.tafsirV2: (And We have created you in pairs) male and female,

verses.text: وَجَعَلۡنَا نَوۡمَكُمۡ سُبَاتٗا
verses.translation: And made your sleep [a means for] rest
verses.tafsir: and made your sleep for rest? repose for your bodies
verses.tafsirV2: (And have appointed your sleep for repose) a repose for your bodies; and it is said this means: nice and beautiful,

verses.text: وَجَعَلۡنَا ٱلَّيۡلَ لِبَاسٗا
verses.translation: And made the night as clothing
verses.tafsir: and made the night a cloak? to cover you with its darkness
verses.tafsirV2: (And have appointed the night as a cloak) and it is said this means: a dwelling,

verses.text: وَجَعَلۡنَا ٱلنَّهَارَ مَعَاشٗا
verses.translation: And made the day for livelihood
verses.tafsir: and made the day for livelihood? a time for seeking livelihood
verses.tafsirV2: (And have appointed the day for livelihood) for seeking livelihood.

verses.text: وَبَنَيۡنَا فَوۡقَكُمۡ سَبۡعٗا شِدَادٗا
verses.translation: And constructed above you seven strong [heavens]
verses.tafsir: and built above you seven mighty ones? seven heavens shidād is the plural of shadīda that is to say strong and sturdy unaffected by the passage of time
verses.tafsirV2: (And We have built) and We have created (above you) above your heads (seven strong (heavens)) seven thick heavens,

verses.text: وَجَعَلۡنَا سِرَاجٗا وَهَّاجٗا
verses.translation: And made [therein] a burning lamp
verses.tafsir: and set a radiant lamp? namely the sun
verses.tafsirV2: (And have appointed a dazzling lamp) and have appointed a radiant sun for the children of Adam,

verses.text: وَأَنزَلۡنَا مِنَ ٱلۡمُعۡصِرَٰتِ مَآءٗ ثَجَّاجٗا
verses.translation: And sent down, from the rain clouds, pouring water
verses.tafsir: and sent down from the rain-clouds mu‘sirāt the clouds due to give rain similar to the term mu‘sir which denotes a girl nearing menstruation cascading water? pouring forth
verses.tafsirV2: (And have sent down from the rainy clouds abundant Water,

verses.text: لِّنُخۡرِجَ بِهِۦ حَبّٗا وَنَبَاتٗا
verses.translation: That We may bring forth thereby grain and vegetation
verses.tafsir: that with it We may bring forth grains such as wheat and plants such as figs
verses.tafsirV2: Thereby to produce grain and plant) to produce through the rain all kinds of grains and plants,

verses.text: وَجَنَّـٰتٍ أَلۡفَافًا
verses.translation: And gardens of entwined growth
verses.tafsir: and gardens orchards of intertwining foliage? alfāf is the plural of lafīf similar in pattern to sharīf ‘noble’ plural ashrāf.
verses.tafsirV2: (And gardens of thick foliage) and it is also said this means: different kinds of foliage.

verses.text: إِنَّ يَوۡمَ ٱلۡفَصۡلِ كَانَ مِيقَٰتٗا
verses.translation: Indeed, the Day of Judgement is an appointed time
verses.tafsir: Verily the Day of Decision for creatures is the tryst a time fixed for reward and punishment
verses.tafsirV2: (Lo! the Day of Decision is a fixed time) it is the appointed time when the people of old and later generations will be gathered,

verses.text: يَوۡمَ يُنفَخُ فِي ٱلصُّورِ فَتَأۡتُونَ أَفۡوَاجٗا
verses.translation: The Day the Horn is blown and you will come forth in multitudes
verses.tafsir: the day the Trumpet the Horn is blown yawma yunfakhu fī’l-sūri is either a substitution for or an explication of yawma’l-fasli ‘the Day of Decision’ the blower being Isrāfīl and you come forth from your graves to the site of the Resurrection in droves in diverse groups
verses.tafsirV2: (A day when the trumpet is blown) the blowing of the resurrection, (and ye come in multitudes) host after host and group after group,

verses.text: وَفُتِحَتِ ٱلسَّمَآءُ فَكَانَتۡ أَبۡوَٰبٗا
verses.translation: And the heaven is opened and will become gateways
verses.tafsir: and the heaven is opened read futtihat or futihat sundered for the descent of the angels and becomes as gates it becomes a heaven with gates
verses.tafsirV2: (And the heaven is opened) and the gates of heaven are opened (and becometh as gates) and becomes different roads,

verses.text: وَسُيِّرَتِ ٱلۡجِبَالُ فَكَانَتۡ سَرَابًا
verses.translation: And the mountains are removed and will be [but] a mirage
verses.tafsir: and the mountains are set in motion dislocated from their positions and become as a mirage as fine dust that is to say like it in terms of its levity when in motion.
verses.tafsirV2: (And the hills are set in motion) on the face of the earth (and become as a mirage.

verses.text: إِنَّ جَهَنَّمَ كَانَتۡ مِرۡصَادٗا
verses.translation: Indeed, Hell has been lying in wait
verses.tafsir: Verily Hell lurks in ambush mirsādan in the sense of rāsidatan or mursidatan ‘lying in wait’
verses.tafsirV2: Lo! Hell lurketh in ambush) the Fire is a detention and prison,

verses.text: لِّلطَّـٰغِينَ مَـَٔابٗا
verses.translation: For the transgressors, a place of return
verses.tafsir: for the rebellious the disbelievers who will not be able to avoid it it is a resort a retreat for them and so they will enter it
verses.tafsirV2: (A home for the rebellious) a point of return for the disbelievers.

verses.text: لَّـٰبِثِينَ فِيهَآ أَحۡقَابٗا
verses.translation: In which they will remain for ages [unending]
verses.tafsir: to remain lābithīna is an implied circumstantial qualifier in other words their remaining therein will be decreed to be therein for ages for endless epochs ahqāb is the plural of huqb
verses.tafsirV2: (They will abide therein for ages) they will abide in the Fire for ages and ages, each age consisting of 80 years, each year being 360 days and each day is the equivalent of 1,000 years of the years of the life of the world; it is also said that none knows the exact duration of these ages save Allah, and therefore these ages are never interrupted.

verses.text: لَّا يَذُوقُونَ فِيهَا بَرۡدٗا وَلَا شَرَابًا
verses.translation: They will not taste therein [any] coolness or drink
verses.tafsir: tasting in it neither coolness neither sleep something which they will not taste therein nor drink nor anything that is imbibed for the sake of its delightful taste
verses.tafsirV2: (Therein) in the Fire (taste they neither coolness) cool water; and it is also said this means: sleep (nor (any) drink) cold drink

verses.text: إِلَّا حَمِيمٗا وَغَسَّاقٗا
verses.translation: Except scalding water and [foul] purulence
verses.tafsir: except boiling water of extreme temperatures and pus read ghasāqan or ghassāqan which is the vile matter that is emitted by the bodies of the inhabitants of the Fire which is what they will indeed taste. They are given this pair of tortures
verses.tafsirV2: (Save boiling water and a paralysing cold) and it is also said this means: filthy water:

verses.text: جَزَآءٗ وِفَاقًا
verses.translation: An appropriate recompense
verses.tafsir: as a fitting requital one that accords with the nature of their deeds for there is no sin greater than disbelief and no chastisement greater than the Fire.
verses.tafsirV2: (Reward proportioned (to their evil deeds)) a reward which is commensurate with their works.

verses.text: إِنَّهُمۡ كَانُواْ لَا يَرۡجُونَ حِسَابٗا
verses.translation: Indeed, they were not expecting an account
verses.tafsir: Indeed they never feared any reckoning given their rejection of the Resurrection
verses.tafsirV2: (For lo! they looked not) while in the life of the world (for a reckoning) they did not fear the chastisement of the Hereafter nor did they believe in it;

verses.text: وَكَذَّبُواْ بِـَٔايَٰتِنَا كِذَّابٗا
verses.translation: And denied Our verses with [emphatic] denial
verses.tafsir: and they denied Our signs the Qur’ān mendaciously
verses.tafsirV2: (They called Our revelations) Our Scripture and Messenger (false with strong denial.

verses.text: وَكُلَّ شَيۡءٍ أَحۡصَيۡنَٰهُ كِتَٰبٗا
verses.translation: But all things We have enumerated in writing
verses.tafsir: and everything in the way of deeds have We kept count of have We recorded precisely in a Book as individual written records in the Preserved Tablet in order to requite creatures in accordance with them including the record of their denial of the Qur’ān.
verses.tafsirV2: Everything) regarding the works of the children of Adam (have We recorded in a Book) We wrote it down in the Guarded or Preserved Tablet.

verses.text: فَذُوقُواْ فَلَن نَّزِيدَكُمۡ إِلَّا عَذَابًا
verses.translation: So taste [the penalty], and never will We increase you except in torment
verses.tafsir: ‘So now taste! — in other words it will be said to them in the Hereafter when the chastisement has befallen them taste now your requital! For We will increase you in nothing but chastisement’ in addition to your due chastisement.
verses.tafsirV2: (So taste) the chastisement in the Fire. (No increase do We give you) in the Fire (save of torment) one kind of torment after another.

verses.text: إِنَّ لِلۡمُتَّقِينَ مَفَازًا
verses.translation: Indeed, for the righteous is attainment
verses.tafsir: Truly for the God-fearing there will be a triumph a place of triumph in Paradise
verses.tafsirV2: (Lo! for the duteous) for those who ward off disbelief, idolatry and indecencies (is achievement) safety from the Fire and nearness of Allah

verses.text: حَدَآئِقَ وَأَعۡنَٰبٗا
verses.translation: Gardens and grapevines
verses.tafsir: gardens orchards hadā’iqa is either a substitution for or an explication of mafāzan ‘a triumph’ and vineyards wa-a‘nāban is a supplement to mafāzan ‘a triumph’
verses.tafsirV2: (Gardens) of trees and palm-trees (enclosed and vineyards,

verses.text: وَكَوَاعِبَ أَتۡرَابٗا
verses.translation: And full-breasted [companions] of equal age
verses.tafsir: and buxom maidens kawā‘ib is the plural of kā‘ib of equal age atrāb is the plural of tirb
verses.tafsirV2: And maidens for companions) who are all of the same age: 33 years of age,

verses.text: وَكَأۡسٗا دِهَاقٗا
verses.translation: And a full cup
verses.tafsir: and a brimming cup wine filling the vessels in which it is in; in sūrat al-Qitāl it is said and rivers of wine Q. 4715.
verses.tafsirV2: (And a full cup) one cup after another.

verses.text: لَّا يَسۡمَعُونَ فِيهَا لَغۡوٗا وَلَا كِذَّـٰبٗا
verses.translation: No ill speech will they hear therein or any falsehood
verses.tafsir: They will not hear in it that is in Paradise when they drink wine and in other situations any vain talk any words of falsehood or lies between one another read kidhāban to mean kadhiban ‘lies’ or kidhdhāban to mean takdhīban ‘lying’ in contrast to what happens in this world when wine is drunk
verses.tafsirV2: (There) in Paradise (hear they) the inhabitants of the Garden (never vain discourse) oaths or falsehood, (nor lying) they do not lie to each other.

verses.text: جَزَآءٗ مِّن رَّبِّكَ عَطَآءً حِسَابٗا
verses.translation: [As] reward from your Lord, [a generous] gift [made due by] account
verses.tafsir: this will be a reward from your Lord in other words God has rewarded them with this reward as a gift ‘atā’an substitutes for jazā’an ‘reward’ that is sufficing that is abundant hisāban as meaning ‘abundant’ derives from their saying a‘tānī fa-ahsabanī ‘he gave me so abundantly that I said “that is enough for me”’ hasbī
verses.tafsirV2: (Requital) a reward (from thy Lord a gift) that He bestows upon them in the Garden (in payment) ten rewards for each good deed; and it is also said this means: reward in proportion to their good deeds

verses.text: رَّبِّ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِ وَمَا بَيۡنَهُمَا ٱلرَّحۡمَٰنِۖ لَا يَمۡلِكُونَ مِنۡهُ خِطَابٗا
verses.translation: [From] the Lord of the heavens and the earth and whatever is between them, the Most Merciful. They possess not from Him [authority for] speech
verses.tafsir: from the Lord of the heavens and the earth read rabbi ‘from the Lord of’ or rabbu ‘He is the Lord of’ and all that is between them the Compassionate One likewise read rahmāni or rahmānu or read rahmānu with rabbi for the preceding Whom exalted be He they that is creatures will not be able to address that is to say not one of them will be able to address Him for fear of Him
verses.tafsirV2: (Lord of the heavens and the earth, and (all) that is between them) of creation and marvels, (the Beneficent) He is the Beneficent; (with Whom none) none of His slaves, i.e. the angels as well as others (can converse) with regard to intercession until Allah gives them permission to do so.

verses.text: يَوۡمَ يَقُومُ ٱلرُّوحُ وَٱلۡمَلَـٰٓئِكَةُ صَفّٗاۖ لَّا يَتَكَلَّمُونَ إِلَّا مَنۡ أَذِنَ لَهُ ٱلرَّحۡمَٰنُ وَقَالَ صَوَابٗا
verses.translation: The Day that the Spirit and the angels will stand in rows, they will not speak except for one whom the Most Merciful permits, and he will say what is correct
verses.tafsir: on the day yawma is the adverbial qualifier for lā yamlikūna ‘they will not be able to’ when the Spirit Gabriel or God’s hosts and the angels stand arrayed saffan is a circumstantial qualifier in other words mustaffīna. They creatures will not speak except him whom the Compassionate One permits to speak and who says what is right from among the believers and the angels as if meaning that they will intercede for he whom He approves of.
verses.tafsirV2: (On the day when the angels and the Spirit) Gabriel; and it is also said: this is a created being whose tremendousness only Allah knows; Ibn Mas'ud also said: the Spirit is an angel greater than every thing save the Throne, and this angel glorifies Allah each day 12,000 formulas of glorification, and which each glorification he utters Allah creates an angel who seeks forgiveness for the believers until the Day of Judgement; it is also said this refers to a group of angels who have feet and hands like those of humans (stand arrayed, they speak not) to intercede, (saving him whom the Beneficent alloweth) to intercede (and who speaketh right) truly “there is no deity save Allah”.

verses.text: ذَٰلِكَ ٱلۡيَوۡمُ ٱلۡحَقُّۖ فَمَن شَآءَ ٱتَّخَذَ إِلَىٰ رَبِّهِۦ مَـَٔابًا
verses.translation: That is the True Day; so he who wills may take to his Lord a [way of] return
verses.tafsir: That is the True Day whose coming to pass is definite namely the Day of Resurrection. So whoever wishes to let him seek resort with his Lord a return to Him that is to say let him return to God by being obedient to Him so that he may be secure from chastisement in it.
verses.tafsirV2: (That is the True Day) in which will happen what I have mentioned. (So whoso will should seek recourse) whoever will believe in Allah's divine Oneness and seek through his belief in Allah's divine Oneness a way of return (unto his Lord.

verses.text: إِنَّآ أَنذَرۡنَٰكُمۡ عَذَابٗا قَرِيبٗا يَوۡمَ يَنظُرُ ٱلۡمَرۡءُ مَا قَدَّمَتۡ يَدَاهُ وَيَقُولُ ٱلۡكَافِرُ يَٰلَيۡتَنِي كُنتُ تُرَٰبَۢا
verses.translation: Indeed, We have warned you of a near punishment on the Day when a man will observe what his hands have put forth and the disbeliever will say, "Oh, I wish that I were dust
verses.tafsir: Lo! We have warned you O disbelievers of Mecca of a chastisement that is near the chastisement of the impending Day of Resurrection — for anything that is impending is also near — the day yawma adverbially qualifies ‘adhāban ‘a chastisement’ by describing it when a person when every person will behold what his hands have sent ahead of good and evil and the disbeliever will say ‘O yā is a particle used to call attention to something would that I were dust!’ in other words and not be chastised. He says this when God exalted be He says to the beasts after each of them has retaliated against the other ‘Be dust!’.
verses.tafsirV2: Lo! We warn you) O people of Mecca (of a doom at hand) which will surely happen, (a day whereon a man will look) when the believer will look; and it is also said: when the disbeliever will look (on that which his own hands have sent before) have earned of good or evil, (and the disbeliever will cry: “Would that I were dust!”) with the beasts. Because of the horrors, severity and torment of that day, the disbeliever will wish to be turned into dust along with beasts. This will occur on the day when the first trumpet resounds'.

verses.text: وَٱلنَّـٰزِعَٰتِ غَرۡقٗا
verses.translation: By those [angels] who extract with violence
verses.tafsir: By those that wrest by the angels who wrest the souls of disbelievers violently;
verses.tafsirV2: And from his narration on the authority of Ibn 'Abbas that he said concerning the interpretation of Allah's saying (By those who drag forth): '(By those who drag forth) He says: Allah swears by the angels who take away the souls of the disbelievers (to destruction) the souls of the disbelievers,

verses.text: وَٱلنَّـٰشِطَٰتِ نَشۡطٗا
verses.translation: And [by] those who remove with ease
verses.tafsir: by those that draw out by the angels who draw out the souls of believers gently;
verses.tafsirV2: (By the meteors rushing) and it is also said that He is here swearing by the angels who busy the disbelievers with grief and anxiety; it is also said that this refers to the souls of the believers which hasten to come out of their bodies in order to go to the Garden.

verses.text: وَٱلسَّـٰبِحَٰتِ سَبۡحٗا
verses.translation: And [by] those who glide [as if] swimming
verses.tafsir: by those that glide serenely by the angels who descend from the heavens with His command exalted be He;
verses.tafsirV2: (By the lone stars floating) and it is also said that He is here swearing by the angels who take away the souls of the righteous slowly and gently and then let them rest; it is also said this refers to the souls of the believers,

verses.text: فَٱلسَّـٰبِقَٰتِ سَبۡقٗا
verses.translation: And those who race each other in a race
verses.tafsir: by those that race forward by the angels who race forward to Paradise with the souls of believers;
verses.tafsirV2: (By the angels hastening) and He swears by the angels who hasten to Paradise with the souls of the believers and to the Fire with the souls of the disbelievers; it is also said this refers to the souls of the believers that hasten to Paradise,

verses.text: فَٱلۡمُدَبِّرَٰتِ أَمۡرٗا
verses.translation: And those who arrange [each] matter
verses.tafsir: and by those that direct the affair by the angels who direct the affairs of this world that is to say they descend with the directions for it from God the response to all of these oath clauses has been omitted understood to be something like la-tub‘athunna yā kuffāra Makka ‘you shall certainly be resurrected O disbelievers of Mecca!’ which is also the operator of the following clause
verses.tafsirV2: (And those who govern the event) and He swears by the angels who govern the matters of the slaves, meaning Gabriel, Michael, Seraphiel and the angel of death. It is said that (those who govern the event) refers to the spears of soldiers, (the meteors rushing) refers to the ropes of soldiers and (the lone stars floating) refers to the ships of soldiers who fight at sea, (the ones who do the hastening) refers to the horses of soldiers, while (those who govern the event) refers to the generals of soldiers; it is also said that (the lone stars floating) refer to the sun, the moon, the day and the night. Allah swore by all these that the two blowings of the trumpet will take place, with an interval of 40 years separating the two blowings.

verses.text: يَوۡمَ تَرۡجُفُ ٱلرَّاجِفَةُ
verses.translation: On the Day the blast [of the Horn] will convulse [creation]
verses.tafsir: the day when the Tremor quakes that is to say the first blast as a result of which everything will be shaken violently thus it the subject has been described in terms of the effect it produces
verses.tafsirV2: So Allah said: (On the day when the first trump resoundeth) this refers to the first blowing of the trumpet when everything will quake.

verses.text: تَتۡبَعُهَا ٱلرَّادِفَةُ
verses.translation: There will follow it the subsequent [one]
verses.tafsir: and is followed by the Aftershock the second blast; between the two blasts is a span of forty years the sentence tatba‘uhā’l-rādifatu is a circumstantial qualifier referring to al-rājifa ‘the Tremor’ in other words the ‘day’ can adverbially accommodate both blasts and other events and so for this reason it can also properly function as the adverbial qualifier for the Resurrection that will take place after the second blast;
verses.tafsirV2: (And the second followeth it) this is the final blowing on the trumpet,

verses.text: قُلُوبٞ يَوۡمَئِذٖ وَاجِفَةٌ
verses.translation: Hearts, that Day, will tremble
verses.tafsir: on that day hearts will be trembling frightened and anxious
verses.tafsirV2: (On that day) which is the Day of Judgement (hearts beat painfully) the hearts are fearful

verses.text: أَبۡصَٰرُهَا خَٰشِعَةٞ
verses.translation: Their eyes humbled
verses.tafsir: their eyes humbled abject because of the terror that they see.
verses.tafsirV2: (While eyes are downcast) abased

verses.text: يَقُولُونَ أَءِنَّا لَمَرۡدُودُونَ فِي ٱلۡحَافِرَةِ
verses.translation: They are [presently] saying, "Will we indeed be returned to [our] former state [of life]
verses.tafsir: They those of the mentioned hearts and eyes will say mockingly and in rejection of the Resurrection ‘Are we indeed read a-innā pronouncing both hamzas or by not pronouncing the second and inserting an alif between them in both cases and in both instances being restored as before? Shall we be restored to life after death al-hāfira is a noun signifying the ‘first part’ of anything from which is derived the expression raja‘a fī hāfiratihi to mean that so and so ‘returned whence he had come’.
verses.tafsirV2: ((Now) they) the disbelievers of Mecca: al-Nadr Ibn al-Harith and his host (are saying: Shall we really be restored to our first state) to the life of the world; and it is also said: from the graves

verses.text: أَءِذَا كُنَّا عِظَٰمٗا نَّخِرَةٗ
verses.translation: Even if we should be decayed bones
verses.tafsir: What! When we have been decayed bones?’ nakhira a variant reading has nākhira ‘decayed and withered’ will we have life again?
verses.tafsirV2: (Even after we are crumbled bones?) Will Allah resurrect us? How is this possible?

verses.text: قَالُواْ تِلۡكَ إِذٗا كَرَّةٌ خَاسِرَةٞ
verses.translation: They say, "That, then, would be a losing return
verses.tafsir: They will say ‘That return of ours to life then if it were true would be a ruinous return!’.
verses.tafsirV2: The Prophet (pbuh) said to them: “Indeed, Allah will raise you again from the dead”. (They say: Then that would be a vain proceeding) that would be a failed attempt, because it will never happen.

verses.text: فَإِنَّمَا هِيَ زَجۡرَةٞ وَٰحِدَةٞ
verses.translation: Indeed, it will be but one shout
verses.tafsir: God exalted be He says But it the Aftershock which will be followed by the Resurrection will be only a single blast and so when it is blasted
verses.tafsirV2: And so Allah said: (Surely it will need but one shout) one blow which does not require a second one, and this is the blow of the resurrection,

verses.text: فَإِذَا هُم بِٱلسَّاهِرَةِ
verses.translation: And suddenly they will be [alert] upon the earth's surface
verses.tafsir: behold then they all creatures will be upon the surface of the earth alive after having been dead inside it.
verses.tafsirV2: (And lo! they will be awakened) on the face of the earth; and it is also said: in the land of the gathering.

verses.text: هَلۡ أَتَىٰكَ حَدِيثُ مُوسَىٰٓ
verses.translation: Has there reached you the story of Moses
verses.tafsir: Have you O Muhammad (s) received the story of Moses hadīthu Mūsā operates the clause that follows
verses.tafsirV2: (Hath there come unto thee) O Muhammad (the history of Moses) the story of Moses? Meaning: the story of Moses has already come to you; and it is also said this means: the story of Moses has not yet come to you.

verses.text: إِذۡ نَادَىٰهُ رَبُّهُۥ بِٱلۡوَادِ ٱلۡمُقَدَّسِ طُوًى
verses.translation: When his Lord called to him in the sacred valley of Tuwa
verses.tafsir: when his Lord called out to him in the holy valley of Tuwā? — this is the name of the valley it may be read with nunation Tuwan or without — and He said
verses.tafsirV2: (How his Lord called him in the holy vale of Tuwa) the name of the valley; it was called so because it was traversed by so many prophets; it is also said: tread (Ta'), O Moses, with your feet on this valley because of its goodness and grace.

verses.text: ٱذۡهَبۡ إِلَىٰ فِرۡعَوۡنَ إِنَّهُۥ طَغَىٰ
verses.translation: Go to Pharaoh. Indeed, he has transgressed
verses.tafsir: ‘Go to Pharaoh; he has indeed become rebellious he has exceeded all bounds with his disbelief
verses.tafsirV2: ((Saying:) Go thou) O Moses (unto Pharaoh. Lo! he hath rebelled) he is arrogant and too proud and has refused to believe in Allah

verses.text: فَقُلۡ هَل لَّكَ إِلَىٰٓ أَن تَزَكَّىٰ
verses.translation: And say to him, 'Would you [be willing to] purify yourself
verses.tafsir: and say “Would you — I call you to — purify yourself tazakkā a variant reading has tazzakkā where the original second tā’ of tatazakkā has been assimilated with the zāy to purge yourself of idolatry by bearing witness that there is no god but God
verses.tafsirV2: (And say (unto him): Hast thou) O Pharaoh ((will) to grow (in grace)) will become righteous, surrender and believe in Allah's divine Oneness?

verses.text: وَأَهۡدِيَكَ إِلَىٰ رَبِّكَ فَتَخۡشَىٰ
verses.translation: And let me guide you to your Lord so you would fear [Him]
verses.tafsir: and allow me to guide you to your Lord to show you how to know Him ma‘rifa by way of proofs so that you may have fear of Him?” ’
verses.tafsirV2: (Then I will guide thee) I will call you (to thy Lord and thou shalt fear (Him)) and therefore surrender to Him.

verses.text: فَأَرَىٰهُ ٱلۡأٓيَةَ ٱلۡكُبۡرَىٰ
verses.translation: And he showed him the greatest sign
verses.tafsir: So he showed him the greatest sign from among His nine signs namely the glowing hand or the slithering staff.
verses.tafsirV2: (And he) Moses (showed him the tremendous token) the hand and the staff.

verses.text: فَكَذَّبَ وَعَصَىٰ
verses.translation: But Pharaoh denied and disobeyed
verses.tafsir: But he Pharaoh denied Moses and disobeyed God exalted be He.
verses.tafsirV2: (But be denied) and said: this is not from Allah (and disobeyed) he refused the message,

verses.text: ثُمَّ أَدۡبَرَ يَسۡعَىٰ
verses.translation: Then he turned his back, striving
verses.tafsir: Then he turned his back to faith going about in haste throughout the land causing corruption.
verses.tafsirV2: (Then turned he away) from faith; and it is also said: from Moses (in haste) to his folk; and it is also said: to think what to do about Moses,

verses.text: فَحَشَرَ فَنَادَىٰ
verses.translation: And he gathered [his people] and called out
verses.tafsir: Then he gathered he assembled the sorcerers and his armies and proclaimed
verses.tafsirV2: (Then gathered he) his army (and summoned) and delivered a sermon

verses.text: فَقَالَ أَنَا۠ رَبُّكُمُ ٱلۡأَعۡلَىٰ
verses.translation: And said, "I am your most exalted lord
verses.tafsir: and said ‘I am your most high lord!’ above whom is no other lord.
verses.tafsirV2: (And proclaimed: “I (Pharaoh) am your Lord the Highest”.) I am your Highest Lord and the Lord of your idols, therefore, do not leave the worship of these idols.

verses.text: فَأَخَذَهُ ٱللَّهُ نَكَالَ ٱلۡأٓخِرَةِ وَٱلۡأُولَىٰٓ
verses.translation: So Allah seized him in exemplary punishment for the last and the first [transgression]
verses.tafsir: So God seized him He destroyed him by drowning him as punishment for the latter that is to say these last words of his and for the former that is to say his saying previously ‘I do not know of any god for you other than me’ Q. 2838 — and between the two claims made by Pharaoh was an interval of forty years.
verses.tafsirV2: (So Allah seized him) Allah punished him ((and made him) an example for the after (life) and for the former) the punishment that he suffered in the life of the world is drowning and the punishment of the Hereafter will be in the Fire; it is also said that this means: Allah has punished him because of his former and latter pronouncements. His first pronouncement being: “I do not know of any other god for you except Me” and the second being (I am your Lord the Highest) and it is said that there is an interval of 40 years between the first and second pronouncements.

verses.text: إِنَّ فِي ذَٰلِكَ لَعِبۡرَةٗ لِّمَن يَخۡشَىٰٓ
verses.translation: Indeed in that is a warning for whoever would fear [Allah]
verses.tafsir: Assuredly in that which is mentioned there is a moral for him who fears God exalted be He.
verses.tafsirV2: (Lo! Herein) in that which We did to Pharaoh and his host (is indeed a lesson) an admonition (for him who feareth) that which has been done to them.

verses.text: ءَأَنتُمۡ أَشَدُّ خَلۡقًا أَمِ ٱلسَّمَآءُۚ بَنَىٰهَا
verses.translation: Are you a more difficult creation or is the heaven? Allah constructed it
verses.tafsir: Are you read a-antum pronouncing both hamzas or by substituting an alif for the second one not pronouncing it and inserting an alif between the one not pronounced and the former or without this insertion namely you the deniers of the Resurrection harder to create or the heaven which He has built? harder to create banāhā an explication of the manner of its creation.
verses.tafsirV2: (Are ye) O people of Mecca (the harder to create) harder to resurrect and more perfect in your creation, (or is the heaven that He built?

verses.text: رَفَعَ سَمۡكَهَا فَسَوَّىٰهَا
verses.translation: He raised its ceiling and proportioned it
verses.tafsir: He made it rise high — an explication of the manner of its construction; in other words He made its vertical extension high; it is also said that samkahā means ‘its ceiling’ — and levelled it He made it even flawless
verses.tafsirV2: He raised the height) its ceiling (thereof and ordered it) above the earth;

verses.text: وَأَغۡطَشَ لَيۡلَهَا وَأَخۡرَجَ ضُحَىٰهَا
verses.translation: And He darkened its night and extracted its brightness
verses.tafsir: and darkened its night and brought forth its day He exposed the light of its sun ‘night’ has been annexed to it the heaven because it represents its shade and likewise the ‘sun’ because it represents its light;
verses.tafsirV2: (And He made dark the night thereof, and He brought forth the morn thereof) and He made its day and sun clear.

verses.text: وَٱلۡأَرۡضَ بَعۡدَ ذَٰلِكَ دَحَىٰهَآ
verses.translation: And after that He spread the earth
verses.tafsir: and after that He spread out the earth He made it flat for it had been created before the heaven but without having been spread out;
verses.tafsirV2: (And after that He spread the earth) even then He spread it on the water; it is also said: 2,000 years after that He spread it on the water,

verses.text: أَخۡرَجَ مِنۡهَا مَآءَهَا وَمَرۡعَىٰهَا
verses.translation: He extracted from it its water and its pasture
verses.tafsir: from it He has brought forth akhraja a circumstantial qualifier with a suppressed preceding qad that is to say mukhrijan ‘bringing forth from it’ its waters by making its springs gush forth and its pastures what cattle graze of trees and herbage and what humans consume of foods and fruits the use of mar‘ā to express this of the earth is figurative
verses.tafsirV2: (And produced therefrom) from the earth (the water thereof) running water as well as the water buried deep in the belly of the earth (and the pasture thereof,

verses.text: وَٱلۡجِبَالَ أَرۡسَىٰهَا
verses.translation: And the mountains He set firmly
verses.tafsir: and has set firm the mountains on the face of the earth so that it stays still
verses.tafsirV2: And He made fast the hills) and He made the mountains firm,

verses.text: مَتَٰعٗا لَّكُمۡ وَلِأَنۡعَٰمِكُمۡ
verses.translation: As provision for you and your grazing livestock
verses.tafsir: as a source of sustenance an object denoting reason for an implied verbal clause in other words fa‘ala dhālika mut‘atan or tamtī‘an ‘He did this to provide a source of sustenance’ for you and your flocks an‘ām is the plural of na‘am which are camels cows and sheep.
verses.tafsirV2: (A provision for you) water of benefit to you (and for your cattle) water and pasture benefit your cattle.

verses.text: فَإِذَا جَآءَتِ ٱلطَّآمَّةُ ٱلۡكُبۡرَىٰ
verses.translation: But when there comes the greatest Overwhelming Calamity
verses.tafsir: So when the Greatest Catastrophe befalls — the second blast —
verses.tafsirV2: (But when the great disaster cometh) but when the Hour comes, it will tower above everything and nothing will escape it,

verses.text: يَوۡمَ يَتَذَكَّرُ ٱلۡإِنسَٰنُ مَا سَعَىٰ
verses.translation: The Day when man will remember that for which he strove
verses.tafsir: the day when man will remember yawma yatadhakkaru’l-insānu substitutes for idhā ‘when’ his efforts in the life of the world in the way of good or evil
verses.tafsirV2: (The day when man will call to mind) when the disbeliever, al-Nadr Ibn al-Harith and his host, will remember and know (his (whole) endeavour) the works he did in his state of disbelief,

verses.text: وَبُرِّزَتِ ٱلۡجَحِيمُ لِمَن يَرَىٰ
verses.translation: And Hellfire will be exposed for [all] those who see
verses.tafsir: and the Hell-fire the consuming Fire is revealed for all to see for every on-looker the response to idhā ‘when’ is what follows
verses.tafsirV2: (And hell will stand forth visible to him who seeth) to him who is ordained to enter it,

verses.text: فَأَمَّا مَن طَغَىٰ
verses.translation: So as for he who transgressed
verses.tafsir: as for him who was rebellious who disbelieved
