verses.tafsirV2: (Then, as for him who rebelled) him who was too arrogant and proud and disbelieved in Allah, i.e. al-Nadr Ibn al-Harith Ibn 'Alqamah

verses.text: وَءَاثَرَ ٱلۡحَيَوٰةَ ٱلدُّنۡيَا
verses.translation: And preferred the life of the world
verses.tafsir: and preferred the life of this world by pursuing carnal desires
verses.tafsirV2: (And chose the life of the world) rather than the Hereafter and also chose disbelief rather than faith,

verses.text: فَإِنَّ ٱلۡجَحِيمَ هِيَ ٱلۡمَأۡوَىٰ
verses.translation: Then indeed, Hellfire will be [his] refuge
verses.tafsir: Hell-fire will indeed be the abode his abode.
verses.tafsirV2: (Lo! Hell will be his home) the Fire is the home of him who is thus.

verses.text: وَأَمَّا مَنۡ خَافَ مَقَامَ رَبِّهِۦ وَنَهَى ٱلنَّفۡسَ عَنِ ٱلۡهَوَىٰ
verses.translation: But as for he who feared the position of his Lord and prevented the soul from [unlawful] inclination
verses.tafsir: But as for him who feared the stance before his Lord his standing before Him and forbade the evil-bidding soul from pursuing desire that leads to perdition as a result of that person’s lusting after carnal desires
verses.tafsirV2: (But as for him who feared) upon committing a sin (to stand before his Lord) his standing before his Lord and abstains from engaging in sin (and restrained his soul from lust) from that which is unlawful, even though he desires it, this refers to Mus'ab Ibn 'Umayr.

verses.text: فَإِنَّ ٱلۡجَنَّةَ هِيَ ٱلۡمَأۡوَىٰ
verses.translation: Then indeed, Paradise will be [his] refuge
verses.tafsir: Paradise will indeed be the abode in sum the response to idhā ‘when’ verse 34 is that the disobedient one will be in the Fire and the obedient one in Paradise.
verses.tafsirV2: (Lo! the Garden will be his home) Paradise will be the home of him who is thus.

verses.text: يَسۡـَٔلُونَكَ عَنِ ٱلسَّاعَةِ أَيَّانَ مُرۡسَىٰهَا
verses.translation: They ask you, [O Muhammad], about the Hour: when is its arrival
verses.tafsir: They that is the disbelievers of Mecca will ask you about the Hour when will it set in? when will it come to pass and when will it begin?
verses.tafsirV2: (They ask thee) the disbelievers of Mecca ask you, O Muhammad, (of the Hour) about the advent of the Hour: (when will it come to port?) When is it going to happen? Because they disbelieved in it.

verses.text: فِيمَ أَنتَ مِن ذِكۡرَىٰهَآ
verses.translation: In what [position] are you that you should mention it
verses.tafsir: What have you to do with the mention of it? in other words you have no knowledge of it in order to mention it.
verses.tafsirV2: (Why (ask they)? What hast thou to tell thereof?) What has it to do with you that you should mention it to them?

verses.text: إِلَىٰ رَبِّكَ مُنتَهَىٰهَآ
verses.translation: To your Lord is its finality
verses.tafsir: With your Lord it belongs ultimately ultimate knowledge of it lies with Him; none other than Him has any knowledge of it.
verses.tafsirV2: (Unto thy Lord belongeth (knowledge of) the term thereof) the knowledge of its timing belongs to Allah.

verses.text: إِنَّمَآ أَنتَ مُنذِرُ مَن يَخۡشَىٰهَا
verses.translation: You are only a warner for those who fear it
verses.tafsir: You are only a warner for your warning will only benefit the one who fears it.
verses.tafsirV2: (Thou art but a warner) you are but a warning messenger by means of the Qur'an (unto him who feareth it) to him who fears its advent.

verses.text: كَأَنَّهُمۡ يَوۡمَ يَرَوۡنَهَا لَمۡ يَلۡبَثُوٓاْ إِلَّا عَشِيَّةً أَوۡ ضُحَىٰهَا
verses.translation: It will be, on the Day they see it, as though they had not remained [in the world] except for an afternoon or a morning thereof
verses.tafsir: The day they see it it will be as if they had only tarried in their graves for an evening or the morning thereof that is to say as if only one evening of a day or its morning the annexation of duhā ‘morning’ to ‘ashiyya ‘evening’ is valid on the basis of their contiguity since both constitute either side of the day; the annexation has also allowed for the word to fall in harmony with the end-rhyme of the verses.
verses.tafsirV2: (On the day when they behold it) i.e. the Hour, (it will be as if they had but tarried) in the graves (for an evening) the duration of an evening (or the morn thereof) or the duration of one morning'.

verses.text: عَبَسَ وَتَوَلَّىٰٓ
verses.translation: The Prophet frowned and turned away
verses.tafsir: He the Prophet frowned glowered with his face and turned away
verses.tafsirV2: And from his narration on the authority of Ibn 'Abbas that he said regarding the interpretation of Allah's saying (He frowned): '(He frowned) He says: Muhammad (pbuh) showed a stern face (and turned away) his face

verses.text: أَن جَآءَهُ ٱلۡأَعۡمَىٰ
verses.translation: Because there came to him the blind man, [interrupting]
verses.tafsir: because the blind man came to him ‘Abd Allāh son of Umm Maktūm who interrupted him while he was busy with those notables of Quryash whose submission to God he was very eager for. The blind man was not aware that he was busy with these and so he called out to him ‘Teach me of what God has taught you’. However the Prophet s went off to his house. He was then reproached for this with what was revealed in this sūra. Afterwards whenever he came to him the Prophet would say to him ‘Greetings to him on whose account God reproached me!’ and would lay down his cloak for him.
verses.tafsirV2: (Because the blind man came unto him) when 'Abdullah Ibn Umm Maktum came to him. His real name is 'Abdullah Ibn Shurayh. Umm Maktum was his father's mother. What happened is that the Prophet (pbuh) was sitting with a group of men among the nobles of Quraysh, among whom were his uncle al-'Abbas Ibn 'Abd al-Muttalib, Umayyah Ibn Khalaf al-Jumahi and Safwan Ibn Umayyah, who were at that time disbelievers. The Prophet (pbuh) was admonishing and inviting them to Islam when Ibn Maktum came to him and said: “O Messenger of Allah! Teach me of that which Allah has taught you”. The Prophet (pbuh) turned his face from him because he was busy with these people. When this happened Allah revealed: he frowned and turned away because the blind man came unto him.

verses.text: وَمَا يُدۡرِيكَ لَعَلَّهُۥ يَزَّكَّىٰٓ
verses.translation: But what would make you perceive, [O Muhammad], that perhaps he might be purified
verses.tafsir: And how would you know? Perhaps he would cleanse himself yazzakkā the original tā’ of yatazakkā has been assimilated with the zāy that is perhaps he would purge himself of sins by what he hears from you
verses.tafsirV2: (What could inform thee) O Muhammad (but that he might) i.e. the blind man (grow (in grace)) became righteous through the admonitions of the Qur'an

verses.text: أَوۡ يَذَّكَّرُ فَتَنفَعَهُ ٱلذِّكۡرَىٰٓ
verses.translation: Or be reminded and the remembrance would benefit him
verses.tafsir: or be admonished yadhdhakkar the original tā’ of yatadhakkar has been assimilated with the dhāl and so the reminder the admonition heard from you might benefit him a variant reading for tanfa‘uhu has tanfa‘ahu as the response to the optative statement.
verses.tafsirV2: (Or take heed) by means of the Qur'an (and so the reminder) by means of the Qur'an (might avail him?) It is also said that this means: how do you know O Muhammad, whether or not he becomes righteous and whether or not he benefits from the admonitions of the Qur'an.

verses.text: أَمَّا مَنِ ٱسۡتَغۡنَىٰ
verses.translation: As for he who thinks himself without need
verses.tafsir: But as for the one who thinks himself self-sufficient through wealth
verses.tafsirV2: (As for him who thinketh himself independent) of Allah, i.e. the three men mentioned above,

verses.text: فَأَنتَ لَهُۥ تَصَدَّىٰ
verses.translation: To him you give attention
verses.tafsir: to him you do attend tasaddā a variant reading has tassaddā where the original second tā’ of tatasaddā has been assimilated with the sād him you accept and turn your attention to;
verses.tafsirV2: (Unto him thou payest regard) you turn your face to them.

verses.text: وَمَا عَلَيۡكَ أَلَّا يَزَّكَّىٰ
verses.translation: And not upon you [is any blame] if he will not be purified
verses.tafsir: yet it is not your concern if he does not cleanse himself if he does not believe.
verses.tafsirV2: (Yet it is not thy concern if he grow not (in grace)) it is not your concern if these three men do not believe in Allah's divine Oneness.

verses.text: وَأَمَّا مَن جَآءَكَ يَسۡعَىٰ
verses.translation: But as for he who came to you striving [for knowledge]
verses.tafsir: But as for him who comes to you hurrying yas‘ā is a circumstantial qualifier referring to the subject of the verb jā’a ‘comes’
verses.tafsirV2: (But as for him who cometh unto thee with earnest purpose) hastening for goodness

verses.text: وَهُوَ يَخۡشَىٰ
verses.translation: While he fears [Allah]
verses.tafsir: fearful of God wa-huwa yakhshā is a circumstantial qualifier referring to the subject of the verb yas‘ā ‘hurrying’ — this being the blind man —
verses.tafsirV2: (And hath fear) of Allah, and is also a Muslim; this is because Ibn Umm Maktum had accepted Islam before this incident,

verses.text: فَأَنتَ عَنۡهُ تَلَهَّىٰ
verses.translation: From him you are distracted
verses.tafsir: to him you pay no heed talahhā the original second tā’ of tatalahhā has been omitted that is to say from him you are distracted by other things.
verses.tafsirV2: (From him thou) O Muhammad (art distracted) being busy with those three men.

verses.text: كَلَّآ إِنَّهَا تَذۡكِرَةٞ
verses.translation: No! Indeed, these verses are a reminder
verses.tafsir: No indeed! do not behave like this. Truly it the sūra is or the verses are a reminder an admonition for all creatures —
verses.tafsirV2: (Nay) do not do this; He says: do not turn to those who think themselves independent of Allah and turn away from he who fears Allah. After this reminder, the Prophet (pbuh) used to honour Ibn Umm Maktum and treat him well, (but verily it) this surah (is an Admonishment) from Allah both for the rich and the poor,

verses.text: فَمَن شَآءَ ذَكَرَهُۥ
verses.translation: So whoever wills may remember it
verses.tafsir: so let whoever will remember it preserve it in his memory and thus be admonished by it —
verses.tafsirV2: (So let whosoever will pay heed to it) whoever Allah wants him to be admonished will be admonished,

verses.text: فِي صُحُفٖ مُّكَرَّمَةٖ
verses.translation: [It is recorded] in honored sheets
verses.tafsir: on leaves fī suhufin is the second predicate of innahā ‘truly it’ and what precedes it is a parenthetical statement that are honoured by God
verses.tafsirV2: (On honoured leaves) He says: the Qur'an is written on scrolls made of skin which are honoured in the sight of Allah

verses.text: مَّرۡفُوعَةٖ مُّطَهَّرَةِۭ
verses.translation: Exalted and purified
verses.tafsir: elevated in the heavens purified exalted above the touch of devils
verses.tafsirV2: (Exalted) in heaven, (purified) from filth and idolatry,

verses.text: بِأَيۡدِي سَفَرَةٖ
verses.translation: [Carried] by the hands of messenger-angels
verses.tafsir: in the hands of scribes who write it down from the Preserved Tablet
verses.tafsirV2: ((Set down) by scribes) written by scribes

verses.text: كِرَامِۭ بَرَرَةٖ
verses.translation: Noble and dutiful
verses.tafsir: noble pious obedient to God exalted be He these being the angels.
verses.tafsirV2: (Noble) in the sight of Allah and surrendered to Him (and righteous) truthful; these are the keepers of the nether heaven.

verses.text: قُتِلَ ٱلۡإِنسَٰنُ مَآ أَكۡفَرَهُۥ
verses.translation: Cursed is man; how disbelieving is he
verses.tafsir: Perish man! accursed be the disbeliever! What has made him ungrateful? an interrogative statement meant as a rebuke — what has driven him to disbelief?
verses.tafsirV2: (Man is (self)-destroyed) the disbeliever, i.e. 'Utbah Ibn Abi Lahab, is cursed: (how ungrateful!) what has made him a disbelieve in Allah and in the stars of the Qur'an, i.e. in the star when it sets; it is also said that this means: how extreme is his disbelief.

verses.text: مِنۡ أَيِّ شَيۡءٍ خَلَقَهُۥ
verses.translation: From what substance did He create him
verses.tafsir: From what thing has He created him? an interrogative meant as an affirmative which He then explains by saying
verses.tafsirV2: (From what thing doth He create him?) He says: let him think about his own person: from what did He create him as a living being?

verses.text: مِن نُّطۡفَةٍ خَلَقَهُۥ فَقَدَّرَهُۥ
verses.translation: From a sperm-drop He created him and destined for him
verses.tafsir: From a drop of sperm did He create him then proportion him in stages as a blood-clot then an embryo up to the last stage of his creation.
verses.tafsirV2: Allah then explained and said to him: (From a drop of seed. He createth him) a living being (and proportioneth him) He proportioned his creation by giving him two hands, two feet, two eyes, two ears as well as all the other organs,

verses.text: ثُمَّ ٱلسَّبِيلَ يَسَّرَهُۥ
verses.translation: Then He eased the way for him
verses.tafsir: Then He made the way his exit from his mother’s belly easy for him;
verses.tafsirV2: (Then maketh the way easy for him) He made clear to him the way of good and the way of evil; and it is also said this means: He made easy for him to come out of the way of the womb,

verses.text: ثُمَّ أَمَاتَهُۥ فَأَقۡبَرَهُۥ
verses.translation: Then He causes his death and provides a grave for him
verses.tafsir: then He makes him die and buries him He places him in a grave that hides him;
verses.tafsirV2: (Then causeth him to die) after this, (and burieth him) and commanded to bury him;

verses.text: ثُمَّ إِذَا شَآءَ أَنشَرَهُۥ
verses.translation: Then when He wills, He will resurrect him
verses.tafsir: then when He wills He will raise him for the Resurrection.
verses.tafsirV2: (Then, when He will, He bringeth him again to life) i.e. He will resurrect him from the grave.

verses.text: كَلَّا لَمَّا يَقۡضِ مَآ أَمَرَهُۥ
verses.translation: No! Man has not yet accomplished what He commanded him
verses.tafsir: No indeed! Verily he has not accomplished he has not done what He his Lord commanded him to do.
verses.tafsirV2: (Nay) truly, O Muhammad, (but (man) hath not done what He commanded him) of profession of Allah's divine Oneness and other things.

verses.text: فَلۡيَنظُرِ ٱلۡإِنسَٰنُ إِلَىٰ طَعَامِهِۦٓ
verses.translation: Then let mankind look at his food
verses.tafsir: So let man consider in reflection his source of food how it is determined and procured for him
verses.tafsirV2: (Let man consider his food) let the disbelieving person, 'Utbah Ibn Abi Lahab, think about the food he eats, how it is transformed from state to state until it reaches him to eat:

verses.text: أَنَّا صَبَبۡنَا ٱلۡمَآءَ صَبّٗا
verses.translation: How We poured down water in torrents
verses.tafsir: that We pour down water from the clouds plenteously;
verses.tafsirV2: Allah then explained these different states, saying: (How We pour water) i.e. rain (in showers) upon the earth

verses.text: ثُمَّ شَقَقۡنَا ٱلۡأَرۡضَ شَقّٗا
verses.translation: Then We broke open the earth, splitting [it with sprouts]
verses.tafsir: then We split the earth into fissures with vegetation
verses.tafsirV2: (Then split the earth in clefts) through plants

verses.text: فَأَنۢبَتۡنَا فِيهَا حَبّٗا
verses.translation: And caused to grow within it grain
verses.tafsir: and cause the grains such as wheat and barley to grow therein
verses.tafsirV2: (And cause the grain) all kinds of grain (to grow therein) in the earth

verses.text: وَعِنَبٗا وَقَضۡبٗا
verses.translation: And grapes and herbage
verses.tafsir: and vines and herbs qadb is moist qatt
verses.tafsirV2: (And grapes and green fodder

verses.text: وَزَيۡتُونٗا وَنَخۡلٗا
verses.translation: And olive and palm trees
verses.tafsir: and olives and date-palms
verses.tafsirV2: And olive trees and palm-trees

verses.text: وَحَدَآئِقَ غُلۡبٗا
verses.translation: And gardens of dense shrubbery
verses.tafsir: and gardens of dense foliage orchards teeming with trees
verses.tafsirV2: And garden closes of thick foliage

verses.text: وَفَٰكِهَةٗ وَأَبّٗا
verses.translation: And fruit and grass
verses.tafsir: and fruits and pastures abb is what cattle graze; it is also said to be ‘straw’
verses.tafsirV2: And fruits) different kinds of fruit (and grasses) and fodder; and it also said this means: straw:

verses.text: مَّتَٰعٗا لَّكُمۡ وَلِأَنۡعَٰمِكُمۡ
verses.translation: [As] enjoyment for you and your grazing livestock
verses.tafsir: as sustenance understand matā‘an as mut‘atan or tamtī‘an as explained above in the previous sūra for you and your flocks also as explained above.
verses.tafsirV2: (Provision for you) the grains are of benefit to you (and your cattle) and fodder is of benefit to your cattle.

verses.text: فَإِذَا جَآءَتِ ٱلصَّآخَّةُ
verses.translation: But when there comes the Deafening Blast
verses.tafsir: So when the deafening Cry the second blast comes —
verses.tafsirV2: (But when the Shout cometh) when the Hour comes, all created beings will scream and then submit and answer the call. Created being will be abased and know then that its advent is true.

verses.text: يَوۡمَ يَفِرُّ ٱلۡمَرۡءُ مِنۡ أَخِيهِ
verses.translation: On the Day a man will flee from his brother
verses.tafsir: the day when a man will flee from his own brother
verses.tafsirV2: Allah then explained when this will happen, saying: (On the day when a man) the believer (fleeth from his brother) who is a disbeliever

verses.text: وَأُمِّهِۦ وَأَبِيهِ
verses.translation: And his mother and his father
verses.tafsir: and his mother and his father
verses.tafsirV2: (And his mother) and will also flee from his mother (and his father

verses.text: وَصَٰحِبَتِهِۦ وَبَنِيهِ
verses.translation: And his wife and his children
verses.tafsir: and his wife and his sons yawma ‘the day when’ is a substitution for idhā ‘when’ the response to which is indicated by what follows —
verses.tafsirV2: And his wife and his children) it is also said this means: when Abel will flee from Cain, and Muhammad (pbuh) will flee from his mother Aminah, and Abraham from his father, and Lot from his wife Wa'ilah and Nuh from his son Canaan.

verses.text: لِكُلِّ ٱمۡرِيٕٖ مِّنۡهُمۡ يَوۡمَئِذٖ شَأۡنٞ يُغۡنِيهِ
verses.translation: For every man, that Day, will be a matter adequate for him
verses.tafsir: every person that day will have a matter to preoccupy him a predicament to distract him from the affairs of others in other words every person will be preoccupied with his own self.
verses.tafsirV2: (Every man that day) on the Day of Judgement (will have concern enough to make him heedless (of others)) to keep him preoccupied from others.

verses.text: وُجُوهٞ يَوۡمَئِذٖ مُّسۡفِرَةٞ
verses.translation: [Some] faces, that Day, will be bright
verses.tafsir: On that day some faces will be shining radiant
verses.tafsirV2: (On that day faces) the faces of the believers who are true in their faith (will be bright as dawn) will be blooming due to Allah's pleasure with them,

verses.text: ضَاحِكَةٞ مُّسۡتَبۡشِرَةٞ
verses.translation: Laughing, rejoicing at good news
verses.tafsir: laughing joyous happy — these are the believers.
verses.tafsirV2: (Laughing) pleased with Allah's bestowal of honour upon them, (rejoicing at good news) happy with Allah's reward;

verses.text: وَوُجُوهٞ يَوۡمَئِذٍ عَلَيۡهَا غَبَرَةٞ
verses.translation: And [other] faces, that Day, will have upon them dust
verses.tafsir: And some faces on that day will be covered with dust
verses.tafsirV2: (And other faces) the faces of the hypocrites and disbelievers, (on that day) on the Day of Judgement, (with dust upon them,

verses.text: تَرۡهَقُهَا قَتَرَةٌ
verses.translation: Blackness will cover them
verses.tafsir: overcast covered with gloom darkness and blackness.
verses.tafsirV2: Veiled in darkness) gloomy and dark,

verses.text: أُوْلَـٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلۡكَفَرَةُ ٱلۡفَجَرَةُ
verses.translation: Those are the disbelievers, the wicked ones
verses.tafsir: Those the people of this predicament are the disbelievers the profligates those who have combined disbelief with profligacy.
verses.tafsirV2: (Those) with such a trait (are the disbelievers) in Allah, (the wicked) the liars against Allah'.

verses.text: إِذَا ٱلشَّمۡسُ كُوِّرَتۡ
verses.translation: When the sun is wrapped up [in darkness]
verses.tafsir: When the sun is folded away enfolded and stripped of its light
verses.tafsirV2: And from his narration on the authority of Ibn 'Abbas that he said regarding the interpretation of Allah's saying (When the sun is overthrown): '(When the sun is overthrown) it is also said that He says: when the sun is turned around as one turns a turban and is then thrown into the veil of light; it is also said this means: when the light of the sun vanishes.

verses.text: وَإِذَا ٱلنُّجُومُ ٱنكَدَرَتۡ
verses.translation: And when the stars fall, dispersing
verses.tafsir: and when the stars scatter when they are extinguished and hurtle down towards the earth
verses.tafsirV2: (And when the stars fall) on the face of the earth,

verses.text: وَإِذَا ٱلۡجِبَالُ سُيِّرَتۡ
verses.translation: And when the mountains are removed
verses.tafsir: and when the mountains are set in motion when they are blown away from the face of the earth becoming as scattered dust
verses.tafsirV2: (And when the hills are moved) from above the surface of the earth

verses.text: وَإِذَا ٱلۡعِشَارُ عُطِّلَتۡ
verses.translation: And when full-term she-camels are neglected
verses.tafsir: and when the pregnant camels are neglected abandoned without a herdsman or anyone to milk them on account of the matter that has come over them — even though previously no wealth was dearer to them than these pregnant camels;
verses.tafsirV2: (And when the camels big with young are abandoned) because they are preoccupied with their own selves,

verses.text: وَإِذَا ٱلۡوُحُوشُ حُشِرَتۡ
verses.translation: And when the wild beasts are gathered
verses.tafsir: and when the wild beasts are mustered when they are brought together after being resurrected so that each of them may retaliate against the other before becoming dust;
verses.tafsirV2: (And when the wild beasts are herded together) for retaliation; and it is also said this means: when they are dead,

verses.text: وَإِذَا ٱلۡبِحَارُ سُجِّرَتۡ
verses.translation: And when the seas are filled with flame
verses.tafsir: and when the seas are set afire read sujirat or sujjirat when they are set alight and become a mass of fire;
verses.tafsirV2: (And when the seas rise) and mix with each other, the sweet seas and the salty seas, such that they become one sea; and it is also said this means: when they become a burning site,

verses.text: وَإِذَا ٱلنُّفُوسُ زُوِّجَتۡ
verses.translation: And when the souls are paired
verses.tafsir: and when the souls are coupled when they are paired up with their bodies;
verses.tafsirV2: (And when souls are reunited) in pairs; it is also said this means: when souls are reunited with their companions: the believer with the maiden of Paradise and the disbeliever with Satan; the righteous with the righteous and the sinful with the sinful,

verses.text: وَإِذَا ٱلۡمَوۡءُۥدَةُ سُئِلَتۡ
verses.translation: And when the girl [who was] buried alive is asked
verses.tafsir: and when the girl buried-alive the young girl buried alive for fear of shame and impoverishment asks — in rebuke of its slayer —
verses.tafsirV2: (And when the girl child that was buried alive is asked) i.e. when she asks her father

verses.text: بِأَيِّ ذَنۢبٖ قُتِلَتۡ
verses.translation: For what sin she was killed
verses.tafsir: for what sin she was slain sa’alat ‘asks’ a variant reading has su’ilat ‘she is asked’ narrating the address directed to her to which she then responds by saying ‘I was slain without having committed any sin’;
verses.tafsirV2: (For what sin she was slain) for what sin did you kill me; it is also said that this means: when the one who killed her is asked: for what sin did you kill her,

verses.text: وَإِذَا ٱلصُّحُفُ نُشِرَتۡ
verses.translation: And when the pages are made public
verses.tafsir: and when the scrolls the scrolls containing the deeds are unrolled read nushirat or nushshirat when they are unfolded and spread out;
verses.tafsirV2: (And when the pages) the registers of good and bad deeds (are laid open) for reckoning; it is also said this means: when they fly about in people's hands,

verses.text: وَإِذَا ٱلسَّمَآءُ كُشِطَتۡ
verses.translation: And when the sky is stripped away
verses.tafsir: and when the heaven is stripped off torn away from its place just as the skin of a sheep is stripped off;
verses.tafsirV2: (And when the sky is torn away,

verses.text: وَإِذَا ٱلۡجَحِيمُ سُعِّرَتۡ
verses.translation: And when Hellfire is set ablaze
verses.tafsir: and when the Hell-fire is set ablaze read su‘irat or su‘‘irat when it is set alight;
verses.tafsirV2: And when hell is lighted) for the disbelievers

verses.text: وَإِذَا ٱلۡجَنَّةُ أُزۡلِفَتۡ
verses.translation: And when Paradise is brought near
verses.tafsir: and when Paradise is brought near when it is brought close to those who have merited it that they may enter it the response to idhā ‘when’ at the beginning of the sūra and all that has been supplemented thereto is the following
verses.tafsirV2: (And when the Garden is brought nigh) for the believers

verses.text: عَلِمَتۡ نَفۡسٞ مَّآ أَحۡضَرَتۡ
verses.translation: A soul will [then] know what it has brought [with it]
verses.tafsir: then a soul every soul at the time of the occurrence of the things mentioned which is the Day of Resurrection will know what it has presented of good or evil.
verses.tafsirV2: ((Then) every soul will know) every soul whether it is righteous or sinful will know at that point (what it hath made ready) what it has sent forth of good or evil.

verses.text: فَلَآ أُقۡسِمُ بِٱلۡخُنَّسِ
verses.translation: So I swear by the retreating stars
verses.tafsir: So I swear fa-lā lā is extra by the receding planets
verses.tafsirV2: (Oh, but I call to witness) He says: I swear by (the planets) which appear at night and disappear during the day,

verses.text: ٱلۡجَوَارِ ٱلۡكُنَّسِ
verses.translation: Those that run [their courses] and disappear
verses.tafsir: the movers the setters that is the five planets Saturn Jupiter Mars Venus and Mercury takhnusu means ‘they sink away’ during their orbit whereas we see stars at the end of their zodiacal course return to the start; taknisu means that they enter their kinās ‘hideaway’ in other words they retreat into their setting-places;
verses.tafsirV2: (The stars which rise and set) they move at night in the galaxy sweeping away the day and then go back to their positions and disappear; the reference here is to five planets: Venus, Saturn, Mars, Jupiter, and Mercury;

verses.text: وَٱلَّيۡلِ إِذَا عَسۡعَسَ
verses.translation: And by the night as it closes in
verses.tafsir: and by the night as it approaches as it falls with its darkness or it means as it recedes;
verses.tafsirV2: (And the close of night,

verses.text: وَٱلصُّبۡحِ إِذَا تَنَفَّسَ
verses.translation: And by the dawn when it breathes
verses.tafsir: and by the dawn as it breathes as it extends until it becomes broad daylight
verses.tafsirV2: And the breath of morning) and when the morning and brightens come; Allah swore by all these

verses.text: إِنَّهُۥ لَقَوۡلُ رَسُولٖ كَرِيمٖ
verses.translation: [That] indeed, the Qur'an is a word [conveyed by] a noble messenger
verses.tafsir: truly this Qur’ān is the word of a messenger who is noble in the sight of God exalted be He — this being the messenger Gabriel it qawl ‘word’ has been annexed to him because he descends with it
verses.tafsirV2: (That this) i.e. the Qur'an (is in truth the word of an honoured messenger) Allah says: it is brought down by Gabriel to a messenger who is honoured by Allah, i.e. Muhammad (pbuh)

verses.text: ذِي قُوَّةٍ عِندَ ذِي ٱلۡعَرۡشِ مَكِينٖ
verses.translation: [Who is] possessed of power and with the Owner of the Throne, secure [in position]
verses.tafsir: powerful one of mighty powers eminent one of eminent status makīnin is semantically connected ‘inda ‘in the presence of’ in the presence of the Lord of the Throne that is God exalted be He;
verses.tafsirV2: (Mighty) against his enemies, i.e. Gabriel, (established in the presence of the Lord of the Throne) he has standing and esteem with his Lord,

verses.text: مُّطَاعٖ ثَمَّ أَمِينٖ
verses.translation: Obeyed there [in the heavens] and trustworthy
verses.tafsir: obeyed there the angels obey him in the heavens trustworthy with the Revelation.
verses.tafsirV2: ((One) to be obeyed) i.e. Gabriel is obeyed in Heaven: the angels obey him, (and trustworthy) in conveying the message to the prophets;

verses.text: وَمَا صَاحِبُكُم بِمَجۡنُونٖ
verses.translation: And your companion is not [at all] mad
verses.tafsir: And your companion Muhammad (s) wa-mā sāhibukum a supplement to the clause from innahu ‘truly this is’ up to the last of the oath clauses is not a madman as you claim.
verses.tafsirV2: (And your comrade) your Prophet Muhammad, O Quraysh (is not mad) bewitched as you claim.

verses.text: وَلَقَدۡ رَءَاهُ بِٱلۡأُفُقِ ٱلۡمُبِينِ
verses.translation: And he has already seen Gabriel in the clear horizon
verses.tafsir: For verily he Muhammad (s) saw him Gabriel in the form in which he was created on the clear horizon the highest one towards the east;
verses.tafsirV2: (Surely he beheld him) Muhammad (s)aw Gabriel (on the clear horizon) on the high setting of the sun.

verses.text: وَمَا هُوَ عَلَى ٱلۡغَيۡبِ بِضَنِينٖ
verses.translation: And Muhammad is not a withholder of [knowledge of] the unseen
verses.tafsir: and he Muhammad (s) is not to be accused of knowing the Unseen what is hidden of the revelation and the tidings of the heaven a variant reading for bi-zanīnin has bi-danīnin meaning that he is not ‘niggardly’ with the Unseen so as to reduce something of it and not disclose it.
verses.tafsirV2: (And he is not) i.e. Muhammad (pbuh) (avid of the Unseen) he is accused with regard to the revelation; and it is also said this means: he is not avaricious.

verses.text: وَمَا هُوَ بِقَوۡلِ شَيۡطَٰنٖ رَّجِيمٖ
verses.translation: And the Qur'an is not the word of a devil, expelled [from the heavens]
verses.tafsir: And it that is the Qur’ān is not the word of an accursed satan eavesdropping stealthily.
verses.tafsirV2: (Nor is this) i.e. the Qur'an (the utterance of a devil worthy to be stoned) the utterance of an accursed, rebellious devil whose name is al-Marmi.

verses.text: فَأَيۡنَ تَذۡهَبُونَ
verses.translation: So where are you going
verses.tafsir: So where are you going? So what path are you going to follow in repudiating the Qur’ān and turning away from it?
verses.tafsirV2: (Whither then go ye) from Allah's chastisement, commands and prohibitions, O disbelievers? It is also said this means: why do you lie? And it is also said this means: why do you deviate from the Qur'an and refuse to believe in it?

verses.text: إِنۡ هُوَ إِلَّا ذِكۡرٞ لِّلۡعَٰلَمِينَ
verses.translation: It is not except a reminder to the worlds
verses.tafsir: It is only a reminder an admonition for all worlds those of mankind and jinn
verses.tafsirV2: (This is) i.e. the Qur'an (naught else than a reminder) an admonition from Allah (unto creation) the jinn and humankind,

verses.text: لِمَن شَآءَ مِنكُمۡ أَن يَسۡتَقِيمَ
verses.translation: For whoever wills among you to take a right course
verses.tafsir: for those of you who li-man shā’a minkum is a substitution for li’l-‘ālamīna ‘for all worlds’ using the same preposition wish to go straight by following the truth;
verses.tafsirV2: (Unto whomsoever of you willeth to walk straight) to whoever wills to conform to the commands of Allah: the belief in Allah's divine Oneness and other things.

verses.text: وَمَا تَشَآءُونَ إِلَّآ أَن يَشَآءَ ٱللَّهُ رَبُّ ٱلۡعَٰلَمِينَ
verses.translation: And you do not will except that Allah wills - Lord of the worlds
verses.tafsir: but you will not wish to go straight along the path of truth unless God the Lord of the Worlds of all creatures wills that you should go straight along it.
verses.tafsirV2: (And ye will not) conform with or believe in Allah's divine Oneness, (unless (it be) that Allah willeth) it for you, (the Lord of Creation) the Lord of all that which has a soul and creeps on the face of the earth, from the inhabitants of the heaven and of the earth'.

verses.text: إِذَا ٱلسَّمَآءُ ٱنفَطَرَتۡ
verses.translation: When the sky breaks apart
verses.tafsir: When the heaven is split open when it is rent asunder
verses.tafsirV2: And from his narration on the authority of Ibn 'Abbas that he said regarding the interpretation of Allah's saying (When the heaven is cleft asunder): '(When the heaven is cleft asunder) by the descent of the Lord-a descent without modality-and the angels and whatever He wills of His command,

verses.text: وَإِذَا ٱلۡكَوَاكِبُ ٱنتَثَرَتۡ
verses.translation: And when the stars fall, scattering
verses.tafsir: and when the stars are dispersed when they expire and begin to fall
verses.tafsirV2: (When the planets are dispersed) on the face of the earth,

verses.text: وَإِذَا ٱلۡبِحَارُ فُجِّرَتۡ
verses.translation: And when the seas are erupted
verses.tafsir: and when the seas are burst forth released one upon the other forming one mass of water so that the sweet water mixes with the salty;
verses.tafsirV2: (When the seas are poured forth) into each other, the sweet into the salty, such that they become one sea,

verses.text: وَإِذَا ٱلۡقُبُورُ بُعۡثِرَتۡ
verses.translation: And when the [contents of] graves are scattered
verses.tafsir: and when the tombs are overturned when their earth above them is dug up and its dead are raised the response to idhā ‘when’ and all that is supplemented thereto is the following
verses.tafsirV2: (And the sepulchres are overturned) the dead in them are taken out,

verses.text: عَلِمَتۡ نَفۡسٞ مَّا قَدَّمَتۡ وَأَخَّرَتۡ
verses.translation: A soul will [then] know what it has put forth and kept back
verses.tafsir: a soul every soul will know at the time of the occurrence of the things mentioned which is the Day of Resurrection what it has sent ahead in the way of deeds and what it has left behind of these and did not do.
verses.tafsirV2: (A soul) every soul at that point (will know what it hath sent before (it)) of good or evil (and what left behind) of good or evil wont; it is also said this means: it will know the acts of obedience it offered and those it missed.

verses.text: يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلۡإِنسَٰنُ مَا غَرَّكَ بِرَبِّكَ ٱلۡكَرِيمِ
verses.translation: O mankind, what has deceived you concerning your Lord, the Generous
verses.tafsir: O disbelieving man! What has deceived you with regard to your generous Lord? so that you have disobeyed Him
verses.tafsirV2: (O man!) i.e. O disbelieving man; here referring specifically to Kildah Ibn Usayd (What hath made thee careless concerning thy Lord) when you disbelieved in Him, (the Bountiful) the Forgiving,

verses.text: ٱلَّذِي خَلَقَكَ فَسَوَّىٰكَ فَعَدَلَكَ
verses.translation: Who created you, proportioned you, and balanced you
verses.tafsir: Who created you when you were not then made you upright in your created form with sound limbs then proportioned you read fa-‘adalak or fa-‘addalak making you symmetrical in shape with well-proportioned parts so that no hand or leg is longer than the other
verses.tafsirV2: (Who created thee) a living being from a sperm drop, (then fashioned) in the womb of your mother, (then proportioned thee) then made your stature erect?

verses.text: فِيٓ أَيِّ صُورَةٖ مَّا شَآءَ رَكَّبَكَ
verses.translation: In whatever form He willed has He assembled you
verses.tafsir: assembling you in whatever mā is a relative form He will?
verses.tafsirV2: (Into whatsoever form He will, He casteth thee) if He wills He makes you resemble your paternal or maternal uncles, He can make you handsome or ugly; and if He wills He can turn you into the form of an ape or swine, or the like of them.

verses.text: كَلَّا بَلۡ تُكَذِّبُونَ بِٱلدِّينِ
verses.translation: No! But you deny the Recompense
verses.tafsir: No indeed! — a deterrent against letting oneself be misled by the generosity of God exalted be He. Rather you that is disbelievers of Mecca deny Judgement requital for deeds;
verses.tafsirV2: (Nay) truly, (but they) the Quraysh (deny the Judgement) and the Reckoning.

verses.text: وَإِنَّ عَلَيۡكُمۡ لَحَٰفِظِينَ
verses.translation: And indeed, [appointed] over you are keepers
verses.tafsir: Yet lo! there are above you watchers from among the angels over your deeds
verses.tafsirV2: (Lo! there are above you guardians) among the angels who guard and preserve your works,

verses.text: كِرَامٗا كَٰتِبِينَ
verses.translation: Noble and recording
verses.tafsir: noble in God’s sight writers of these deeds
verses.tafsirV2: (Generous) who are honoured in the sight of Allah and completely surrendered to Him (and recording) they record your works,

verses.text: يَعۡلَمُونَ مَا تَفۡعَلُونَ
verses.translation: They know whatever you do
verses.tafsir: who know whatever you do all of it.
verses.tafsirV2: (Who know (all) that ye do) and say of good and evil and record all of it.

verses.text: إِنَّ ٱلۡأَبۡرَارَ لَفِي نَعِيمٖ
verses.translation: Indeed, the righteous will be in pleasure
verses.tafsir: Indeed the pious the believers who are sincere in their faith shall be amid bliss in Paradise
verses.tafsirV2: (Lo! the righteous) who are true in their faith: Abu Bakr and his believing brothers (verily will be in delight) in the Garden whose bliss is everlasting.

verses.text: وَإِنَّ ٱلۡفُجَّارَ لَفِي جَحِيمٖ
verses.translation: And indeed, the wicked will be in Hellfire
verses.tafsir: and indeed the profligates the disbelievers shall be in Hell-fire a scorching fire
verses.tafsirV2: (And lo! the wicked) Kildah and his fellow disbelievers (verily will be in hell;

verses.text: يَصۡلَوۡنَهَا يَوۡمَ ٱلدِّينِ
verses.translation: They will [enter to] burn therein on the Day of Recompense
verses.tafsir: entering it to suffer its heat on the Day of Judgement the Day of Requital
verses.tafsirV2: They will burn therein) they will enter the Fire (on the Day of Judgement) on the Day of Reckoning and Judgement between created beings,

verses.text: وَمَا هُمۡ عَنۡهَا بِغَآئِبِينَ
verses.translation: And never therefrom will they be absent
verses.tafsir: and they shall not be absent from it they shall not be taken out of it.
verses.tafsirV2: (And will not) i.e. the disbelievers (be absent thence) whence they enter it.

verses.text: وَمَآ أَدۡرَىٰكَ مَا يَوۡمُ ٱلدِّينِ
verses.translation: And what can make you know what is the Day of Recompense
verses.tafsir: And what would show you what would inform you what the Day of Judgement is?
verses.tafsirV2: (Ah, what will convey unto thee) O Muhammad (what the Day of Judgement is!) what is the Day of Reckoning. (Again, what will convey unto thee) O Muhammad

verses.text: ثُمَّ مَآ أَدۡرَىٰكَ مَا يَوۡمُ ٱلدِّينِ
verses.translation: Then, what can make you know what is the Day of Recompense
verses.tafsir: Again what would show you what the Day of Judgement is? — repeated to emphasise its enormity.
verses.tafsirV2: (what the Day of Judgement is!) what the Day of Reckoning is. He said this to arouse his astonishment, in order to magnify such a Day.

verses.text: يَوۡمَ لَا تَمۡلِكُ نَفۡسٞ لِّنَفۡسٖ شَيۡـٔٗاۖ وَٱلۡأَمۡرُ يَوۡمَئِذٖ لِّلَّهِ
verses.translation: It is the Day when a soul will not possess for another soul [power to do] a thing; and the command, that Day, is [entirely] with Allah
verses.tafsir: It is a day read yawmu when no soul will be of any avail any use to another soul and the absolute command on that day will be God’s there will be no power of command for anyone other than Him thereat in other words none has been given the power to mediate thereupon in contrast to situations in this world.
verses.tafsirV2: Allah the explained to him, saying: (A day on which no soul) no believing soul (hath power at all) no power to save or intercede (for any (other) soul) for any disbelieving soul. (The (absolute) command) sentencing and judging between people (on that day is Allah's) is in Allah's hands; none other than Him has that in his power and none will challenge Him about it'.

verses.text: وَيۡلٞ لِّلۡمُطَفِّفِينَ
verses.translation: Woe to those who give less [than due]
verses.tafsir: Woe waylun a term entailing chastisement; or it is the name of a valley in Hell to the defrauders
verses.tafsirV2: And from his narration on the authority of Ibn 'Abbas that he said regarding the interpretation of Allah's saying: (Woe unto the defrauders): '(Woe) severe punishment (unto the defrauders) in weighing and measurement; this refers to the people of Medina who used to cheat in weighing and measurement before the coming of the Prophet (pbuh) and so this surah was revealed to the Prophet (pbuh) on his way when he was migrating to Medina:

verses.text: ٱلَّذِينَ إِذَا ٱكۡتَالُواْ عَلَى ٱلنَّاسِ يَسۡتَوۡفُونَ
verses.translation: Who, when they take a measure from people, take in full
verses.tafsir: those who when they take measure from people demand it in full the measure;
verses.tafsirV2: Allah then explained who these defrauders are, saying: (Those who when they take the measure from mankind) those who, when they buy from people and weigh or measure that which they buy for themselves, (demand it full) they weigh and measure their merchandise in full,

verses.text: وَإِذَا كَالُوهُمۡ أَو وَّزَنُوهُمۡ يُخۡسِرُونَ
verses.translation: But if they give by measure or by weight to them, they cause loss
verses.tafsir: but who when they measure for them or weigh for them they cause them loss they diminish for them the measure or the weight.
verses.tafsirV2: (But if they measure unto them) but when they measure for others (or weigh for them, they cause them loss) they decrease the measurement or the weight and behave very badly; it is also said that the above means: severe punishment on that day is unto the defrauders in the prayer, the poor-due, fasting and other acts of worship.

verses.text: أَلَا يَظُنُّ أُوْلَـٰٓئِكَ أَنَّهُم مَّبۡعُوثُونَ
verses.translation: Do they not think that they will be resurrected
verses.tafsir: Do such individuals not know for certain alā indicates an interrogative of rebuke that they will be resurrected
verses.tafsirV2: (Do such (men)) those who deal in fraud in weight and measurement (not consider) not know and believe (that they will be raised again) brought back to life

verses.text: لِيَوۡمٍ عَظِيمٖ
verses.translation: For a tremendous Day
verses.tafsir: for an awful day that is to say on it and this is the Day of Resurrection
verses.tafsirV2: Unto an awful Day) the Day of Judgement whose horrors are great,

verses.text: يَوۡمَ يَقُومُ ٱلنَّاسُ لِرَبِّ ٱلۡعَٰلَمِينَ
verses.translation: The Day when mankind will stand before the Lord of the worlds
verses.tafsir: a day when yawma is a substitution for the syntactical locus of li-yawmin ‘to an awful day’ and as such is in the accusative because of the verb mab‘ūthūna ‘will be resurrected’ mankind will rise from their graves before the Lord of the Worlds? the Lord of all creatures for His affair His reckoning and His requital.
verses.tafsirV2: (The day when (all) mankind stand) after emerging from the graves (before the Lord of the Worlds) the Lord of every living being who walks on the earth and the Lord of the dwellers of heaven? When the Prophet (pbuh) read to them this surah, they repented and started giving full weight and measurement.

verses.text: كَلَّآ إِنَّ كِتَٰبَ ٱلۡفُجَّارِ لَفِي سِجِّينٖ
verses.translation: No! Indeed, the record of the wicked is in sijjeen
verses.tafsir: Nay! verily the record of the profligates that is to say the record of the deeds of the disbelievers is in Sijjīn — this is said to be a book containing the record of all the deeds of the devils and the disbelievers; but it is also said to be a location in the lowermost part of the seventh earth the place of Satan and his hosts.
verses.tafsirV2: (Nay) truly, O Muhammad, (but the record of the vile) the works of the disbelievers (is in Sijjin

verses.text: وَمَآ أَدۡرَىٰكَ مَا سِجِّينٞ
verses.translation: And what can make you know what is sijjeen
verses.tafsir: And what would tell you what Sijjīn is? what the book of Sijjīn is.
verses.tafsirV2: Ah! what will convey unto thee what Sijjin is) what is in Sijjin! This is mentioned by way of aggrandizement of Sijjin.

verses.text: كِتَٰبٞ مَّرۡقُومٞ
verses.translation: It is [their destination recorded in] a register inscribed
verses.tafsir: It is a sealed book.
verses.tafsirV2: (A written record) He says: the works of the children of Adam are written on a green rock under the seventh earth; this is Sijjin.

verses.text: وَيۡلٞ يَوۡمَئِذٖ لِّلۡمُكَذِّبِينَ
verses.translation: Woe, that Day, to the deniers
verses.tafsir: Woe to the deniers on that day
verses.tafsirV2: (Woe) severe punishment (unto the repudiators) unto the deniers of faith and the resurrection (on that day) the Day of Judgement!

verses.text: ٱلَّذِينَ يُكَذِّبُونَ بِيَوۡمِ ٱلدِّينِ
verses.translation: Who deny the Day of Recompense
verses.tafsir: who deny the Day of Judgement the Day of Requital alladhīna yukadhdhibūna bi-yawmi’l-dīn either a substitution for or an explication of al-mukadhdhibīna ‘the deniers’;
verses.tafsirV2: (Those who deny the Day of Judgement) and the Reckoning which will take place in it

verses.text: وَمَا يُكَذِّبُ بِهِۦٓ إِلَّا كُلُّ مُعۡتَدٍ أَثِيمٍ
verses.translation: And none deny it except every sinful transgressor
verses.tafsir: and none deny it but every sinful the form athīm is hyperbolic transgressor overstepping the bounds.
verses.tafsirV2: (Which none denieth) i.e. none denies the Day of Judgement (save each criminal transgressor) save each sinful and unjust person who transgresses against the Truth, such as al-Walid Ibn al-Mughirah al-Makhzumi,

verses.text: إِذَا تُتۡلَىٰ عَلَيۡهِ ءَايَٰتُنَا قَالَ أَسَٰطِيرُ ٱلۡأَوَّلِينَ
verses.translation: When Our verses are recited to him, he says, "Legends of the former peoples
verses.tafsir: When Our signs of the Qur’ān are recited to him he says ‘Mere fables asātīr of the ancients!’ mere tales that were written down sutirat in ancient times asātīr is the plural of ustūra or istāra.
verses.tafsirV2: (Who, when thou readest unto him) unto al-Walid Ibn al-Mughirah (Our revelations) the Qur'an explaining the commands and prohibitions, (saith: (Mere) fables of the men of old) this is nothing but the lies and idle talk of the people of old.

verses.text: كَلَّاۖ بَلۡۜ رَانَ عَلَىٰ قُلُوبِهِم مَّا كَانُواْ يَكۡسِبُونَ
verses.translation: No! Rather, the stain has covered their hearts of that which they were earning
verses.tafsir: No indeed! — a deterrent and a warning against saying such things. Rather there has slayed engulfed their hearts covering them like rust that which they earned of acts of disobedience.
verses.tafsirV2: (Nay) truly, O Muhammad, (but that which they have earned) which they have done and said in their state of idolatry (is rust upon their hearts) Allah has sealed the hearts of those who disbelieve in the Day of Judgement; it is also said that the accumulation of sins blackens the heart and this is what is meant by the rust of hearts.

verses.text: كَلَّآ إِنَّهُمۡ عَن رَّبِّهِمۡ يَوۡمَئِذٖ لَّمَحۡجُوبُونَ
verses.translation: No! Indeed, from their Lord, that Day, they will be partitioned
verses.tafsir: Nay! verily they on that day the Day of Resurrection will be screened off from their Lord and so they will not see Him.
verses.tafsirV2: (Nay) truly, O Muhammad, (but surely on that day) the Day of Judgement (they) i.e. the deniers of the Day of Judgement (will be covered from (the mercy of) their Lord) they will be prevented from beholding their Lord while the believers will behold Him.

verses.text: ثُمَّ إِنَّهُمۡ لَصَالُواْ ٱلۡجَحِيمِ
verses.translation: Then indeed, they will [enter and] burn in Hellfire
verses.tafsir: Then they will be exposed to Hell-fire then they will enter the scorching Fire;
verses.tafsirV2: (Then lo! they verily will burn in hell) then they will enter the Fire,

verses.text: ثُمَّ يُقَالُ هَٰذَا ٱلَّذِي كُنتُم بِهِۦ تُكَذِّبُونَ
verses.translation: Then it will be said [to them], "This is what you used to deny
verses.tafsir: then it will be said to them ‘This that is the chastisement is that which you used to deny!’
verses.tafsirV2: (And it will be said (unto them)) the keepers of hell will say to them when they enter it: (This is that which ye used to deny) this is the chastisement which you used to claim it will never happen.

verses.text: كَلَّآ إِنَّ كِتَٰبَ ٱلۡأَبۡرَارِ لَفِي عِلِّيِّينَ
verses.translation: No! Indeed, the record of the righteous is in 'illiyyun
verses.tafsir: Nay! verily the record of the pious that is the record of the deeds of the believers who were sincere in their faith is in ‘Illiyyūn — this is said to be the book containing all the good deeds of the angels and the believers from among the two heavy ones sc. mankind and jinn; but it is also said to be a place below the Throne in the seventh heaven;
verses.tafsirV2: (Nay) truly, O Muhammad, (but the record of the righteous) the works of those who are true in their faith (is in 'Illiyyin

verses.text: وَمَآ أَدۡرَىٰكَ مَا عِلِّيُّونَ
verses.translation: And what can make you know what is 'illiyyun
verses.tafsir: and what will tell you what will inform you what ‘Illiyyūn is? what the book of ‘Illiyyūn is.
verses.tafsirV2: Ah, what will convey unto thee) O Muhammad (what 'Illiyyin is!) what is in 'Illiyyin.

verses.text: كِتَٰبٞ مَّرۡقُومٞ
verses.translation: It is [their destination recorded in] a register inscribed
verses.tafsir: It is a sealed book
verses.tafsirV2: (A written record) it is said that the works of the righteous are written on tablets made of green chrysolite which are placed above the seventh heaven below the Throne of the Beneficent; this is 'Illiyyin,

verses.text: يَشۡهَدُهُ ٱلۡمُقَرَّبُونَ
verses.translation: Which is witnessed by those brought near [to Allah]
verses.tafsir: witnessed by those brought near from among the angels.
verses.tafsirV2: (Attested by those who are brought near (unto their Lord)) the works of the righteous are attested by the dwellers of heaven who are near their Lord.

verses.text: إِنَّ ٱلۡأَبۡرَارَ لَفِي نَعِيمٍ
verses.translation: Indeed, the righteous will be in pleasure
verses.tafsir: Assuredly the pious will be amid bliss in Paradise
verses.tafsirV2: (Lo! the righteous) those who are true in their faith, and these are the ones who do not harm even the tiniest ant (verily are in delight) in Paradise whose bliss is everlasting,

verses.text: عَلَى ٱلۡأَرَآئِكِ يَنظُرُونَ
verses.translation: On adorned couches, observing
verses.tafsir: upon couches upon beds beneath canopies gazing at the bliss which they have been given.
verses.tafsirV2: (On couches) in curtained canopies, (gazing) looking at the inhabitants of the Fire,

verses.text: تَعۡرِفُ فِي وُجُوهِهِمۡ نَضۡرَةَ ٱلنَّعِيمِ
verses.translation: You will recognize in their faces the radiance of pleasure
verses.tafsir: You will perceive in their faces the radiancy of bliss the splendour and beauty of blissfulness
verses.tafsirV2: (Thou wilt know) O Muhammad (in their faces) the faces of the inhabitants of Paradise (the radiance of delight

verses.text: يُسۡقَوۡنَ مِن رَّحِيقٖ مَّخۡتُومٍ
verses.translation: They will be given to drink [pure] wine [which was] sealed
verses.tafsir: as they are given to drink a nectar a wine free of any impurities that is sealed in its vessel none other than them breaking its seal
verses.tafsirV2: They are given to drink) in Paradise (of a pure wine, sealed) mixed,

verses.text: خِتَٰمُهُۥ مِسۡكٞۚ وَفِي ذَٰلِكَ فَلۡيَتَنَافَسِ ٱلۡمُتَنَٰفِسُونَ
verses.translation: The last of it is musk. So for this let the competitors compete
verses.tafsir: whose seal is musk that is whose final sip is followed by an emanating scent of musk — so for such bliss let the viers vie let them desire to apply themselves to obedience of God —
verses.tafsirV2: (Whose seal) whose end result (is musk. For this) for what I have mentioned (let (all) those who strive for bliss) let those who work and those who strive and those who hasten and those who take the initiative take the initiative.

verses.text: وَمِزَاجُهُۥ مِن تَسۡنِيمٍ
verses.translation: And its mixture is of Tasneem
verses.tafsir: and whose mixture that is to say that with which it is mixed is of Tasnīm which is explained by His following words
verses.tafsirV2: (And mixed with water of Tasnim,

verses.text: عَيۡنٗا يَشۡرَبُ بِهَا ٱلۡمُقَرَّبُونَ
verses.translation: A spring from which those near [to Allah] drink
verses.tafsir: a spring ‘aynan is in the accusative because of an implicit prefatory amdahu ‘I extol this spring’ from which those brought near will drink yashrabu bihā should be yashrabu minhā or it may be that bihā is used because yashrabu is meant to imply the sense of yaltadhdhu bihā ‘in which they delight’.
verses.tafsirV2: A spring) gushing forth for them from the Garden of Eden (whence those brought near to Allah drink) those who are near to the Garden of Eden drink from the spring of Tasnim.

verses.text: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ أَجۡرَمُواْ كَانُواْ مِنَ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ يَضۡحَكُونَ
verses.translation: Indeed, those who committed crimes used to laugh at those who believed
verses.tafsir: Verily the guilty like Abū Jahl and his ilk used to laugh at the believers such as ‘Ammār b. Yāsir and Bilāl the Ethiopian and those like them in mockery of them;
verses.tafsirV2: (Lo! the guilty) the idolaters, Abu Jahl and his host (used to laugh at those who believed) used to mock and poke fun at 'Ali and his fellow believers,

verses.text: وَإِذَا مَرُّواْ بِهِمۡ يَتَغَامَزُونَ
verses.translation: And when they passed by them, they would exchange derisive glances
verses.tafsir: and when they the believers passed them by they would wink at one another the guilty beckoned with their eyebrows and eyelids towards the believers in mockery;
verses.tafsirV2: (And wink one to another) they slander the believers (when they passed them) when the believers passed the disbelievers in their way to the Messenger of Allah (pbuh);

verses.text: وَإِذَا ٱنقَلَبُوٓاْ إِلَىٰٓ أَهۡلِهِمُ ٱنقَلَبُواْ فَكِهِينَ
verses.translation: And when they returned to their people, they would return jesting
verses.tafsir: and when they returned to their folks they would return blithely fākihīna a variant reading has fakihīna rejoicing in their disparaging mention of the believers;
verses.tafsirV2: (And when they) the disbelievers (returned to their own folk, they returned jesting) they returned happy with their idolatry and mocking the believers;

verses.text: وَإِذَا رَأَوۡهُمۡ قَالُوٓاْ إِنَّ هَـٰٓؤُلَآءِ لَضَآلُّونَ
verses.translation: And when they saw them, they would say, "Indeed, those are truly lost
verses.tafsir: and when they see them that is the believers they say ‘Lo! these men are astray!’ on account of their belief in Muhammad (s).
verses.tafsirV2: (And when they saw them) and when they saw the Companions of the Prophet (pbuh) (they said) i.e. the disbelievers said: (Lo! These) the Companions of the Prophet (pbuh) (have gone astray) from true guidance.

verses.text: وَمَآ أُرۡسِلُواْ عَلَيۡهِمۡ حَٰفِظِينَ
verses.translation: But they had not been sent as guardians over them
verses.tafsir: God exalted be He says Yet they that is the disbelievers were not sent as watchers over them over the believers to preserve them or to keep a record of their deeds and thus guide them back to what is best for them.
verses.tafsirV2: (Yet they were not sent) they were not set upon the believers (as guardians over them) as guardians over them or over their works.

verses.text: فَٱلۡيَوۡمَ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ مِنَ ٱلۡكُفَّارِ يَضۡحَكُونَ
verses.translation: So Today those who believed are laughing at the disbelievers
verses.tafsir: So today that is the Day of Resurrection the believers will be laughing at the disbelievers
verses.tafsirV2: (This day) which is the Day of Judgement (it is those who believe) in Muhammad (pbuh) and the Qur'an: i.e. 'Ali and his fellow believers (who have the laugh of disbelievers) who will laugh at the disbelievers,

verses.text: عَلَى ٱلۡأَرَآئِكِ يَنظُرُونَ
verses.translation: On adorned couches, observing
verses.tafsir: upon couches in Paradise gazing out from their dwellings at the disbelievers while they are being tortured; and they will laugh at them just as they the disbelievers had laughed at them in the world.
verses.tafsirV2: (On high couches) in curtained canopies, (gazing) looking at the people of the Fire being dragged therein.

verses.text: هَلۡ ثُوِّبَ ٱلۡكُفَّارُ مَا كَانُواْ يَفۡعَلُونَ
verses.translation: Have the disbelievers [not] been rewarded [this Day] for what they used to do
verses.tafsir: Have the disbelievers been requited for what they used to do? Yes indeed!
verses.tafsirV2: (Are not the disbelievers paid) rewarded in the Hereafter (for what they used to do) except for what they used to do and say in the life of the world?'

verses.text: إِذَا ٱلسَّمَآءُ ٱنشَقَّتۡ
verses.translation: When the sky has split [open]
verses.tafsir: When the heaven is rent asunder
verses.tafsirV2: And from his narration on the authority of Ibn 'Abbas that he said regarding the interpretation of Allah's saying (When the heaven is split asunder): '(When the heaven is split asunder) by the clouds because of the descent of the Lord-a descent without any modality-and the angels and whatever Allah wills of His command.

verses.text: وَأَذِنَتۡ لِرَبِّهَا وَحُقَّتۡ
verses.translation: And has responded to its Lord and was obligated [to do so]
verses.tafsir: and heeds gives ear to and in rending itself asunder obeys its Lord as it should that is as its duty is to heed and obey
verses.tafsirV2: (And attentive) and it obeys and listens (to her Lord in fear) and it befits her to do so,

verses.text: وَإِذَا ٱلۡأَرۡضُ مُدَّتۡ
verses.translation: And when the earth has been extended
verses.tafsir: and when the earth is stretched out when its width is increased just as a piece of leather is stretched so that no edifice or mountain remains upon it
verses.tafsirV2: (And when the earth is spread out) like the spreading out of a flat plain; and it is also said this means: when the earth is removed from its place and then flattened.

verses.text: وَأَلۡقَتۡ مَا فِيهَا وَتَخَلَّتۡ
verses.translation: And has cast out that within it and relinquished [it]
verses.tafsir: and casts out all that is in it of the dead onto its surface and empties itself thereof
verses.tafsirV2: (And hath cast out all that was in her) of corpses and treasures, (and is empty) from all of that

verses.text: وَأَذِنَتۡ لِرَبِّهَا وَحُقَّتۡ
verses.translation: And has responded to its Lord and was obligated [to do so]
verses.tafsir: and heeds and in this respect gives ear to and obeys its Lord as it should all of this will be on the Day of Resurrection the response to idhā ‘when’ and to all that is supplemented thereto has been omitted; but it is indicated by what follows it and is implied to be something like laqiya’l-insānu ‘amalahu ‘man will encounter his deeds’.
verses.tafsirV2: (And attentive) and obeys and listens (to her Lord in fear!) and it behoves her do so.

verses.text: يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلۡإِنسَٰنُ إِنَّكَ كَادِحٌ إِلَىٰ رَبِّكَ كَدۡحٗا فَمُلَٰقِيهِ
verses.translation: O mankind, indeed you are laboring toward your Lord with [great] exertion and will meet it
verses.tafsir: O man! Verily you are labouring exerting your efforts toward the encounter with your Lord that is death laboriously and you will encounter it that is you will encounter your mentioned good or evil deeds on the Day of Resurrection.
verses.tafsirV2: (Thou, verily, O man) O disbelieving man, in reference to Abu'l-Aswad Ibn Kildah Ibn Usayd Ibn Khalaf, (art working) He says: you are working something in your state of disbelief and shall return with it (towards thy Lord) in the Hereafter (a work which you will meet (in His presence)) whether your work is righteous or evil.

verses.text: فَأَمَّا مَنۡ أُوتِيَ كِتَٰبَهُۥ بِيَمِينِهِۦ
verses.translation: Then as for he who is given his record in his right hand
verses.tafsir: Then as for him who is given his book the record of his deeds in his right hand — and this is the believer —
verses.tafsirV2: (Then whoso is given his account) the account of his good works (in his right hand) in reference here to Abu Salamah Ibn 'Abd al-Asad

verses.text: فَسَوۡفَ يُحَاسَبُ حِسَابٗا يَسِيرٗا
verses.translation: He will be judged with an easy account
verses.tafsir: he will receive an easy reckoning which simply entails the presentation of his deeds to him as in the hadīth of the two Sahīhs of Bukhārī and Muslim — in which there is also a hadīth saying ‘He who is reckoned with at length will be destined for perdition’ — and after this presentation of his deeds to the believer he will be excused
verses.tafsirV2: (He truly will receive an easy reckoning) this refers to his parade before Allah

verses.text: وَيَنقَلِبُ إِلَىٰٓ أَهۡلِهِۦ مَسۡرُورٗا
verses.translation: And return to his people in happiness
verses.tafsir: and return to his family in Paradise joyful because of it.
verses.tafsirV2: (And will return) in the Hereafter (unto his folk) whom Allah prepared for him in Paradise (in joy) with them.

verses.text: وَأَمَّا مَنۡ أُوتِيَ كِتَٰبَهُۥ وَرَآءَ ظَهۡرِهِۦ
verses.translation: But as for he who is given his record behind his back
verses.tafsir: But as for him who is given his book from behind his back — and this is the disbeliever whose right hand is chained to his neck and whose left hand by which he is given the book is placed behind his back
verses.tafsirV2: (But whoso is given his account) the account of his evil deeds (behind his back) in his left hand, referring here to al-Aswad Ibn 'Abd al-Asad, the brother of Abu Salamah,

verses.text: فَسَوۡفَ يَدۡعُواْ ثُبُورٗا
verses.translation: He will cry out for destruction
verses.tafsir: he will pray upon seeing what is in it for annihilation he will invoke destruction against himself by saying yā thabūrāh ‘O annihilation of mine!’
verses.tafsirV2: (He surely will invoke destruction

verses.text: وَيَصۡلَىٰ سَعِيرًا
verses.translation: And [enter to] burn in a Blaze
verses.tafsir: and he will enter the Blaze an intense fire a variant reading for yaslā ‘he will enter’ has yusallā ‘he will be admitted’.
verses.tafsirV2: And be thrown to scorching fire.

verses.text: إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ فِيٓ أَهۡلِهِۦ مَسۡرُورًا
verses.translation: Indeed, he had [once] been among his people in happiness
verses.tafsir: Indeed among his folk his clan in the world he used to be joyful wanton lusting after his desires;
verses.tafsirV2: He verily lived joyous with his folk) he was happy with his folk,

verses.text: إِنَّهُۥ ظَنَّ أَن لَّن يَحُورَ
verses.translation: Indeed, he had thought he would never return [to Allah]
verses.tafsir: indeed he thought that an softened in place of the hardened form with its subject omitted that is to say annahu he would never return to his Lord.
verses.tafsirV2: (He verily deemed that he would never return (unto Allah)) in the Hereafter.

verses.text: بَلَىٰٓۚ إِنَّ رَبَّهُۥ كَانَ بِهِۦ بَصِيرٗا
verses.translation: But yes! Indeed, his Lord was ever of him, Seeing
verses.tafsir: Nay! he will return to Him; indeed his Lord is ever Seer of him knowing that he would return to Him.
verses.tafsirV2: (Nay, but lo! his Lord) when He created him (is ever looking on him!) knew that He will raise him again after death

verses.text: فَلَآ أُقۡسِمُ بِٱلشَّفَقِ
verses.translation: So I swear by the twilight glow
verses.tafsir: So I swear fa-lā lā is extra by the twilight al-shafaq the reddishness visible in the horizon after the sunset
verses.tafsirV2: (Oh, I swear by the afterglow of sunset,

verses.text: وَٱلَّيۡلِ وَمَا وَسَقَ
verses.translation: And [by] the night and what it envelops
verses.tafsir: and by the night and what it envelops what it brings together of creatures and otherwise that have entered into it
verses.tafsirV2: And by the night and all that it enshroudeth) and I swear by the night and that which returns to its place when the night falls,

verses.text: وَٱلۡقَمَرِ إِذَا ٱتَّسَقَ
verses.translation: And [by] the moon when it becomes full
verses.tafsir: and by the moon when it is at the full and its light is complete and this happens during the nights of the full moon
verses.tafsirV2: (And by the moon when she is at the full) for three nights: the nights of the thirteenth, fourteenth and fifteenth of the lunar month

verses.text: لَتَرۡكَبُنَّ طَبَقًا عَن طَبَقٖ
verses.translation: [That] you will surely experience state after state
verses.tafsir: you will surely journey tarkabunna is actually tarkabūnanna but the nūn of the indicative has been omitted because of two identical letters following one another and the wāw is omitted because of two unvocalised consonants coming together from stage to stage state after state namely death then life then what comes afterwards of the states at the Resurrection.
verses.tafsirV2: (That ye shall journey) the whole creation shall be transformed (on from plane to plane) from one state to another; from the time He created them until the time they die, and from the time they die until they enter either Paradise or hell: in all these times Allah transforms them from one state to another; it is also said that this means: you shall journey, O Muhammad, from one heaven to another on the day of the ascent; and it is also said that this means: this denier will go from one state to another, from the time he dies until he enters the Fire.

verses.text: فَمَا لَهُمۡ لَا يُؤۡمِنُونَ
verses.translation: So what is [the matter] with them [that] they do not believe
verses.tafsir: So what is wrong with them that is the disbelievers that they do not have faith that is to say what is there to prevent them from embracing faith; or what argument do they have for neglecting it despite the existence of proofs for it
verses.tafsirV2: (What aileth them) the disbelievers of Mecca; and it is said this refers to the three sons of 'Abd Yalayl al-Thaqafi: Mas'ud, Habib and Rabi'ah, the last two had later on accepted Islam (then, that they believe not) in Muhammad (pbuh) and the Qur'an.

verses.text: وَإِذَا قُرِئَ عَلَيۡهِمُ ٱلۡقُرۡءَانُ لَا يَسۡجُدُونَۤ۩
verses.translation: And when the Qur'an is recited to them, they do not prostrate [to Allah]
verses.tafsir: and what is wrong with them that when the Qur’ān is recited to them they do not prostrate? they do not submit by believing in it given its inimitability?
verses.tafsirV2: (And, when the Qur'an is recited unto them) and when Muhammad (pbuh) recites the Qur'an to them explaining the commands and prohibitions, (worship not (Allah)) do not submit to Allah by believing in Allah's divine Oneness?

verses.text: بَلِ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ يُكَذِّبُونَ
verses.translation: But those who have disbelieved deny
verses.tafsir: Nay but the disbelievers deny resurrection and other matters
verses.tafsirV2: (Nay, but those who disbelieve) the disbelievers of Mecca and those among the sons of 'Abd Yalayl who did not believe (will deny) will disbelieve in Muhammad (pbuh) and the Qur'an;

verses.text: وَٱللَّهُ أَعۡلَمُ بِمَا يُوعُونَ
verses.translation: And Allah is most knowing of what they keep within themselves
verses.tafsir: and God knows best what they are amassing accumulating in their scrolls in the way of disbelief denial and evil deeds.
verses.tafsirV2: (And Allah knoweth best what they are hiding) and Allah knows best what they say and do; and it is also said this means: Allah knows best what they hear and hide in their hearts.

verses.text: فَبَشِّرۡهُم بِعَذَابٍ أَلِيمٍ
verses.translation: So give them tidings of a painful punishment
verses.tafsir: So give them good tidings inform them of a painful chastisement
verses.tafsirV2: (So give them) so give, O Muhammad, to those who disbelieve in Allah (tidings of a painful doom) whose pain will extend to their hearts on the Day of Badr as well as in the Hereafter,

verses.text: إِلَّا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ وَعَمِلُواْ ٱلصَّـٰلِحَٰتِ لَهُمۡ أَجۡرٌ غَيۡرُ مَمۡنُونِۭ
verses.translation: Except for those who believe and do righteous deeds. For them is a reward uninterrupted
verses.tafsir: except those who believe and perform righteous deeds theirs will be an unfailing reward one that is unending undiminished and not given to them in expectance of anything in return.
verses.tafsirV2: Allah then exempted from these the believers, saying: (Save those who believe) in Muhammad (pbuh) and the Qur'an (and do good works) and do acts of obedience privately between themselves and their Lord, (for theirs is a reward) in Paradise (unfailing) undiminished and unblemished; it is also said this means: they will not be constantly reminded about the blessings bestowed upon them; and it is also said this means: their good deeds will not be decreased after they reach old age or after they die'.

verses.text: وَٱلسَّمَآءِ ذَاتِ ٱلۡبُرُوجِ
verses.translation: By the sky containing great stars
verses.tafsir: By the heaven of the constellations the twelve constellations of the planets — as explained in sūrat al-Furqān Q. 2561;
verses.tafsirV2: And from his narration on the authority of Ibn 'Abbas that he said regarding the interpretation of Allah's saying (By the heaven, holding mansions of the stars): '(By the heaven, holding mansions of the stars) He says: Allah swears by the heaven which includes mansions of the stars; it is also said: He swears by the heaven which has mansions between heaven and earth; Allah knows that,

verses.text: وَٱلۡيَوۡمِ ٱلۡمَوۡعُودِ
verses.translation: And [by] the promised Day
verses.tafsir: and by the promised day the Day of Resurrection;
verses.tafsirV2: (And by the Promised Day) which is the Day of Judgement.

verses.text: وَشَاهِدٖ وَمَشۡهُودٖ
verses.translation: And [by] the witness and what is witnessed
verses.tafsir: and by the witness Friday and the witnessed the day of ‘Arafa — that is how these three elements have been explained in hadīth for the first one is ‘promised’ the second one is ‘a witness’ that testifies to deeds performed in it while the third is ‘witnessed’ by mankind and angels the introductory particle of the response to the oath has been omitted but is implied to be laqad ‘verily’ sc. laqad qutila ashābu’l-ukhdūd
verses.tafsirV2: (And by the witness) the day of Friday (and that whereunto he beareth testimony) the day of 'Arafah and it is said it is the day of immolation; it is also said that 'the witness' refers to the children of Adam while 'that whereunto he bears testimony' refers to the Day of Judgement; and it is also said that 'the witness' is Muhammad (pbuh) while 'that whereunto he bears testimony' is his community; Allah swore by all these things that His chastisement of those who disbelieve in Him is very severe,

verses.text: قُتِلَ أَصۡحَٰبُ ٱلۡأُخۡدُودِ
verses.translation: Cursed were the companions of the trench
verses.tafsir: perish accursed be the men of the ditch! the pit in the ground
verses.tafsirV2: ((Self-)destroyed were the owners of the ditch

verses.text: ٱلنَّارِ ذَاتِ ٱلۡوَقُودِ
verses.translation: [Containing] the fire full of fuel
verses.tafsir: of the fire al-nāri is an inclusive substitution of it al-ukhdūdi ‘of the ditch’ abounding in fuel by which it was fuelled
verses.tafsirV2: Of the fuel-fed fire) slandered were the owners of the ditch; it is also said that they were believers who were killed by the disbelievers by means of fire in which they threw naphtha, oil and firewood,

verses.text: إِذۡ هُمۡ عَلَيۡهَا قُعُودٞ
verses.translation: When they were sitting near it
verses.tafsir: when they sat by it around the edge of the ditch on chairs
verses.tafsirV2: (When they) i.e. the disbelievers (sat by it) by the ditch; and it is said: they sat on chairs when Allah burned them with the Fire,

verses.text: وَهُمۡ عَلَىٰ مَا يَفۡعَلُونَ بِٱلۡمُؤۡمِنِينَ شُهُودٞ
verses.translation: And they, to what they were doing against the believers, were witnesses
verses.tafsir: and they themselves to what they did to those who believed in God in the way of torturing them by hurling them into the fire when they did not recant their faith were witnesses they were themselves present thereat. It is reported in a hadīth that God saved the believers who had been thrown into the fire by taking their souls before they fell into it and that the fire then rose up and burnt all those sitting around it.
verses.tafsirV2: (And were themselves the witnesses) they used to testify that the believers were folk of error (of what they did to the believers) and it is said this means: they were present when they did this to the believers.

verses.text: وَمَا نَقَمُواْ مِنۡهُمۡ إِلَّآ أَن يُؤۡمِنُواْ بِٱللَّهِ ٱلۡعَزِيزِ ٱلۡحَمِيدِ
verses.translation: And they resented them not except because they believed in Allah, the Exalted in Might, the Praiseworthy
verses.tafsir: And all that they were vindicative towards them of was that they believed in God the Mighty in His kingdom the Praised
verses.tafsirV2: (They had naught against them) against the believers nor did they find any fault with them (save that they believed in Allah, the Mighty) in His retribution against those who disbelieve in Him, (the Owner of Praise) for those who believe in Him,

verses.text: ٱلَّذِي لَهُۥ مُلۡكُ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِۚ وَٱللَّهُ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَيۡءٖ شَهِيدٌ
verses.translation: To whom belongs the dominion of the heavens and the earth. And Allah, over all things, is Witness
verses.tafsir: to Whom belongs the kingdom of the heavens and the earth and God is Witness to all things in other words all that the disbelievers disavowed of the believers was their faith.
verses.tafsirV2: (Him unto Whom belongeth the Sovereignty) the stores (of the heavens) rain (and the earth) plants; (and Allah is of all things the Witness) He is the Witness over their works.

verses.text: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ فَتَنُواْ ٱلۡمُؤۡمِنِينَ وَٱلۡمُؤۡمِنَٰتِ ثُمَّ لَمۡ يَتُوبُواْ فَلَهُمۡ عَذَابُ جَهَنَّمَ وَلَهُمۡ عَذَابُ ٱلۡحَرِيقِ
verses.translation: Indeed, those who have tortured the believing men and believing women and then have not repented will have the punishment of Hell, and they will have the punishment of the Burning Fire
verses.tafsir: Indeed those who persecute believing men and believing women by having them burnt then do not repent there will be for them the chastisement of Hell in return for their disbelief and there will also be for them the chastisement of burning that is to say the chastisement for their having had the believers burnt in the Hereafter; but it is also said that there is this chastisement for them in this world as when the fire rose up and burnt them as mentioned above.
verses.tafsirV2: (Lo! they who persecute) those who burn and torture with fire (believing men) men who are true in their faith (and believing women) who are true in their faith (and repent not) from their idolatry and disbelief, (theirs verily will be the doom of hell) in the Hereafter, (and theirs the doom of burning) in the Fire; and it is also said: in the life of the world, for Allah had burned them with the Fire. These were people from Najran, and it is said from Mosul, who tortured and consequently killed a group of believers with fire in attempt to make them renounce their religion. The name of the king of these people is Yusuf, and it is said his name is Dhu'l-Nuwas.

verses.text: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ وَعَمِلُواْ ٱلصَّـٰلِحَٰتِ لَهُمۡ جَنَّـٰتٞ تَجۡرِي مِن تَحۡتِهَا ٱلۡأَنۡهَٰرُۚ ذَٰلِكَ ٱلۡفَوۡزُ ٱلۡكَبِيرُ
verses.translation: Indeed, those who have believed and done righteous deeds will have gardens beneath which rivers flow. That is the great attainment
verses.tafsir: Indeed those who believe and perform righteous deeds for them there will be gardens underneath which rivers flow that is the supreme triumph.
verses.tafsirV2: Allah then mentioned the believers who did not renounce their religion despite being tortured, saying: (Lo! those who believe) in Allah (and do good works) privately between themselves and their Lord, (theirs will be Gardens beneath which) beneath its trees and habitations (rivers flow) rivers of wine, water, honey and milk flow. (That is the Great Success) they earned the Garden and were saved from the Fire.

verses.text: إِنَّ بَطۡشَ رَبِّكَ لَشَدِيدٌ
verses.translation: Indeed, the vengeance of your Lord is severe
verses.tafsir: Assuredly your Lord’s assault against the disbelievers is severe as severe as He will it to be.
verses.tafsirV2: (Lo! the punishment of thy Lord) the seizure of your Lord of those who disbelieve in Him (is stern.

verses.text: إِنَّهُۥ هُوَ يُبۡدِئُ وَيُعِيدُ
verses.translation: Indeed, it is He who originates [creation] and repeats
verses.tafsir: Assuredly it is He Who originates creation and restores and is never thwarted in what He wills
verses.tafsirV2: Lo! He it is Who produceth) He it is Who begins creation from a sperm drop, (then reproduceth) a new creation after death,

verses.text: وَهُوَ ٱلۡغَفُورُ ٱلۡوَدُودُ
verses.translation: And He is the Forgiving, the Affectionate
verses.tafsir: and He is the Forgiving to sinning believers the Loving the One Who shows love to His friends through His acts of generosity
verses.tafsirV2: (And He is the Forgiving) He forgives he who repents of disbelief and believes in Allah, (the Loving) He loves His friends; and it is also said this means: He loves those who obey Him,

verses.text: ذُو ٱلۡعَرۡشِ ٱلۡمَجِيدُ
verses.translation: Honorable Owner of the Throne
verses.tafsir: Lord of the Throne its Creator and Possessor the Glorious read nominative al-majīdu the One deserving of the perfect attributes of sublimity
verses.tafsirV2: (Lord of the Throne of Glory) the good and fine Throne; and it is also said this means: Lord of the glorious Throne,

verses.text: فَعَّالٞ لِّمَا يُرِيدُ
verses.translation: Effecter of what He intends
verses.tafsir: Doer of what He desires nothing able to thwart Him.
verses.tafsirV2: (Doer of what He will) as He wills, He gives life and also takes it away.

verses.text: هَلۡ أَتَىٰكَ حَدِيثُ ٱلۡجُنُودِ
verses.translation: Has there reached you the story of the soldiers
verses.tafsir: Have you O Muhammad (s) received the story of the hosts
verses.tafsirV2: (Hath there come unto thee) O Muhammad-He asked His Prophet about this because He did not inform him about it before and then He did-(the story of the hosts

verses.text: فِرۡعَوۡنَ وَثَمُودَ
verses.translation: [Those of] Pharaoh and Thamud
verses.tafsir: Pharaoh and Thamūd? Fir‘awna wa-Thamūda substitutes for al-junūdi — the mention of ‘Pharaoh’ suffices to also include his followers; their ‘story’ is that they were destroyed for their disbelief and this is meant as a warning for those who deny the Prophet s and the Qur’ān that they may be admonished thereby.
verses.tafsirV2: Of Pharaoh and (the tribe of) Thamud) and of those before and after them, what We did to them when they disbelieved?

verses.text: بَلِ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ فِي تَكۡذِيبٖ
verses.translation: But they who disbelieve are in [persistent] denial
verses.tafsir: Nay but the disbelievers are engrossed in denial of the mentioned;
verses.tafsirV2: (Nay, but those who disbelieve) the disbelievers of Mecca (live in denial) of Muhammad (pbuh) and the Qur'an.

verses.text: وَٱللَّهُ مِن وَرَآئِهِم مُّحِيطُۢ
verses.translation: While Allah encompasses them from behind
verses.tafsir: and God is behind them All-Encompassing — they have no protector against Him.
